function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_yellow(1), self.yellow_clear_zone) then
		start_coroutine(self.puzzle_calculate, self, self.get_yellow_big(), {
			self.get_yellow(1),
			self.get_yellow(2),
			self.get_yellow(3),
			self.get_yellow(4),
		}, self.get_yellow_pos())
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_sky(1), self.sky_clear_zone) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.puzzle_calculate, self, self.get_sky_big(), {
			self.get_sky(1),
			self.get_sky(2),
			self.get_sky(3),
			self.get_sky(4),
		}, self.get_sky_pos())
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_dark(1), self.dark_clear_zone) then
		start_coroutine(self.puzzle_calculate, self, self.get_dark_big(), {
			self.get_dark(1),
			self.get_dark(2),
			self.get_dark(3),
			self.get_dark(4),
		}, self.get_dark_pos())
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.tutorial_zone) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.tutorial
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.tutorial_scene, self)
		--start_coroutine(self.tutorial_scene, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local yellow_slime = self.get_yellow(1)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, yellow_slime, self.puzzle_zone) then
		message_system:Send(yellow_slime, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	local sky_slime = self.get_sky(1)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, sky_slime, self.puzzle_zone) then
		message_system:Send(sky_slime, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	local dark_slime = self.get_dark(1)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, dark_slime, self.puzzle_zone) then
		message_system:Send(dark_slime, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:puzzle_calculate(big_slime, slime_list, pos)
	self:combine_slime(big_slime, slime_list, pos)

	self.clear_count = self.clear_count + 1

	if self.clear_count == 3 then
		self:puzzle_clear()
	end
end

function local_class:tutorial_scene()
	local farmer = self.get_farmer()
	local slime_list = {
		self.get_orange(1),
		self.get_orange(2),
		self.get_orange(3),
		self.get_orange(4)
	}

	--이벤트 시작하면 bgm 볼륨 0.5로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(farmer.Position, 0.3)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--농장 직원(down, damaged , push) : 끄응… 끄응…!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farmer, self.slime_collection_string_key .. 1, false)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--농장직원이 붉은 슬라임을 한칸 아래로 밀어낸다.
			wp_util.move(farmer, { farmer.Position + vector(0, 0, -1) }, 1, nil)
			--이벤트 시작 후 농장 직원이 슬라임 밀기 시작하면 한번 재생
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_fall_down_01')
			wp_util.move_async(slime_list[1], { slime_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, -1) }, 1, nil)
		end)
	})

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farmer, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farmer, 'idle')

	--붉은 슬라임들 이동되면, 4마리가 한마리로 뭉쳐진다.
	--슬라임 뭉치는 연출
	self:combine_slime(self.get_orange_big(), slime_list, self.get_orange_pos())

	--농장 직원(right,tired,idle) : 어제도 하루 종일 농장일 때문에 못 쉬었는데.
	scene_util.set_direction(farmer, 'right')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farmer, self.slime_collection_string_key .. 2)

	--농장 직원(right,tired,release) : 나 혼자 이 자는 얘들을 다 정리하라고?
	scene_util.set_direction(farmer, 'right')
	--농장직원 release 키에 삽입
	scene_util.set_release_anim(farmer)
	--scene_util.set_anim_loop(farmer, 'release')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farmer, self.slime_collection_string_key .. 3)

	--농장 직원(down, tired, dead3) : 뒤섞여있어서 도저히 정리할 수가 없잖아!
	scene_util.set_direction(farmer, 'down')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(farmer, 'dead3')
	--농장직원 대사
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farmer, self.slime_collection_string_key .. 4)

	--이 후 (right,tired,seat) 상태로 상단대사 원라인
	scene_util.set_seat_anim(farmer)
	scene_util.set_direction(farmer, 'right')
	--농장직원 앉는
	farmer.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	farmer.Interactable.Talk = self.slime_collection_string_key .. 4

	--이벤트 시작하면 bgm 볼륨 0.5로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.3)
end

function local_class:puzzle_clear()
	local farmer = self.get_farmer()
	local yellow_slime = self.get_yellow_big()
	local sky_slime = self.get_sky_big()
	local dark_slime = self.get_dark_big()

	local align_default = self.get_yellow_pos() + vector(-1, 0, -1)

	local align_list = {
		align_default,
		align_default + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		align_default + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		align_default + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		align_default + vector(1, 0, 0),
		align_default + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	}

	--마지막 슬라임 뭉치고 컨트롤 잃으면 볼륨 0.5로 조절, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		wp_util.move(user_party[i - 1], { align_list[i] }, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(farmer.Position, 1, { end_target = farmer })

	--농장직원(rught,tired,seat) 카메라가 농장직원에게 도달하였을 때 바로
	--카메라 농장직원에게 고정되면 나오는 사운드 제거 부탁드립니다
	scene_util.set_direction(farmer, 'right', false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--농장직원(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farmer, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farmer, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(farmer, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--smile표정으로 변경 1번까지 run모션 이동
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farmer, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(farmer)

	--직원 달리는
	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	wp_util.move_async(farmer, {
		farmer.Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
		farmer.Position + vector(2, 0, 2),
	}, 4, nil, { run = true })

	run_sfx:Stop()
	run_sfx = nil

	camera_util.move_async(farmer.Position, 0)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farmer, 'attack')

	--거대슬라임들 우측으로 움직이기 시작하면 세 번 연달아 재생
	local slime_move_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gell_fall_down_01', loop = true })

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--농장직원 release 키에 삽입
			scene_util.set_release_anim(farmer)
			--직원 대사
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_05')
			--농장직원(right,attack,release) : 워이~ 워이~!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farmer, self.slime_collection_string_key .. 5)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(farmer, 'idle')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(sky_slime, 'walk_right')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(dark_slime, 'walk_right')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(yellow_slime, 'walk_right')
			wp_util.move(sky_slime, { self.get_big_pos(3) }, 2, nil)
			wp_util.move(dark_slime, { self.get_big_pos(2) }, 2, nil)
			wp_util.move_async(yellow_slime, { self.get_big_pos(1) }, 2, nil)
		end)
	})

	slime_move_sfx:Stop()
	slime_move_sfx = nil

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(sky_slime, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(dark_slime, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(yellow_slime, 'idle')

	--농장직원(down,smile,success):고마워! 나 대신 슬라임들을 다 정리해줬구나!
	party_util.set_direction('up')
	scene_util.set_direction(farmer, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farmer, 'smile')
	--직원 success 키에 삽입
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farmer, 'success', { sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })
	--직원 대사
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farmer, self.slime_collection_string_key .. 6)


	--농장직원(down,doyagao,sing):오늘에야말로 쉴 수 있겠어!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farmer, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farmer, 'sing')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(farmer, self.slime_collection_string_key .. 7)
	character_util.remove_anim(farmer)

	party_util.set_direction('right')

	--직원 달리는
	run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	wp_util.move_async(farmer, {
		farmer.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
		farmer.Position + vector(3, 0, -3),
		farmer.Position + vector(4, 0, -3),
	}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right', run = true })

	run_sfx:Stop()
	run_sfx = nil

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(farmer, 'get')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(farmer, 'right')
	character_util.jump_move(farmer, farmer.Position + vector(1, 1, -1), 4, 2, true)
	--직원 마리오점프
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(farmer)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farmer, 'idle')
	--직원 착지
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_flower_hit_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--그 후 초록색 화살표 경로로 이동 후 건초위로 마리오 점프 하고 2번위치에서 (left,sleep,sleep) 모션
	scene_util.set_direction(farmer, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(farmer, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(farmer, 'sleep')
	--직원 드러눕는
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	farmer.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이벤트 끝나면 bgm 볼륨 1로 원복, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:combine_slime(big_slime, slime_list, pos)
	local duration = 1
	local dir_list = {}
	local count = #slime_list

	slime_list[1].FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour.Instance
	slime_list[1].Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance

	big_slime.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, 0)
	character_util.add_fade_color(big_slime, big_slime.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1, 0)

	for i = 1, count do
		local slime = slime_list[i]
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(slime, 'damaged')
		local dir = slime_list[i].transform.position - pos
		dir = dir / duration
		table.insert(dir_list, dir)

		character_util.shake(slime, 0.03, 1)
		character_util.add_fade_color(slime, slime.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1, duration)
	end

	--슬라임 뭉쳐지는 연출에 붙여주세요
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_slime_01')

	while duration > 0 do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		duration = duration - dt

		for i = 1, count do
			slime_list[i].Position = slime_list[i].Position - dir_list[i] * dt
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, count do
		character_util.set_active_state(slime_list[i], 'disabled')
	end

	big_slime.Position = pos

	big_slime.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0.5)
	character_util.remove_fade_color(big_slime, big_slime.Name, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

	self.get_farmer().ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
	self.get_orange(1).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	--점수판 셋팅
	self.ui_num_counter_object = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUINumCounter'):Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 1))
	self.ui_num_counter = self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUINumCounter))
	self.ui_num_counter:Reposition()
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(0)
	self.ui_num_counter:SetMaxCount(self.catch_count_max)
	self.ui_num_counter_object.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5
	self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--range setting
	local range_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76)
	local range_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)

	local pos = self.get_game_pos() + vector(-0.45, 0.2, -1)
	local size = unity_class.vector2(9.9, 1)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(pos, size, range_light_color, range_dark_color)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	self:dispose_dynamic_slime()
	self:destroy_ui_num_counter()

	if self.festival_man_fx ~= nil then
		self.festival_man_fx:Dispose()
		self.festival_man_fx = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.is_playing = false
	self.is_interact = false
	self.stun = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_festival_man()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_first_talk then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.festival_man_interact_scene, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_first_talk then
			start_coroutine(self.pause_interact_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(self.get_butterfly_net_dai().FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState) then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(get_party_leader(), self.get_butterfly_net_dai()) and self.swing_routine == nil then
				self.swing_routine = start_coroutine(self.swing_butterfly_net, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_butterfly_net_dai(), self.add_catch_enter_zone) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_first_talk and #self.head_slime_list > 0 then
		start_coroutine(self.add_catch_count, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_butterfly_net_dai()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_first_talk then
		for i = 1, #self.head_slime_list do
			self.head_slime_list[i].Position = self.get_butterfly_net_dai().Position + vector(0, 0.5 + 0.5 * i, 0)
		end
		return true
	end
end

	self.catch_count = self.catch_count + self.current_catch_count

	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(self.catch_count)

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'visible')

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end
end

function local_class:swing_butterfly_net()
	local anim_scale = 2
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swing_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(user_party.Leader, 'twohand_attack') / anim_scale
	local swing_hit_time = swing_duration * 0.5
	local floor = #self.head_slime_list

	message_system:SendSync(leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState.Create(leader)))

	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(leader, 'twohand_attack', { scale = 2 })

	-- 스윙소리가 나는 시간까지 기다림.
	wait_for_sec(swing_hit_time)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	--슬라임 잡기 판정
	local catch_slime = nil
	local center = leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction) * 0.5
	local swing_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8)
	local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, swing_bound)
	local color = self.slime_color.none

	--check_continue
	for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = list[i]

		--이미 잡은 슬라임인지 체크
		local is_catch = false
		if floor > 0 then
			for j = 1, #self.head_slime_list do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.head_slime_list[j], fo) then
					is_catch = true
					break
				end
			end
		end

		if is_catch then
			goto check_continue
		end

		--잡힌 슬라임 색상 구분
		if string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, 'slime_orange_') then
			color = self.slime_color.orange
			catch_slime = fo
			break
		elseif string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, 'slime_dark_') then
			color = self.slime_color.dark
			catch_slime = fo
			break
		elseif string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, 'slime_ice_') then
			color = self.slime_color.ice
			catch_slime = fo
			break
		elseif string_helper.start_with(fo.Name, 'slime_light_') then
			color = self.slime_color.light
			catch_slime = fo
			break
		end

		:: check_continue ::
	end

	--잡은 슬라임에 대한 처리
	--4종류 중 한마리가 있다면
	if catch_slime ~= nil then
		self.field_slime_count = self.field_slime_count - 1

		--머리에 슬라임 없으면
		if floor == 0 then
			--슬라임 층 추가
			self:add_slime_on_head(catch_slime, color)
		else
			--슬라임이 있다면 색깔 기준으로 판별
			if self.current_color[floor] == color then
				--스택 오버 인지
				if self.head_stack[floor] < self.head_stack_max then
					--몸집 불리기
					self:up_grade_slime(catch_slime, floor, color)
				else
					--터짐
					start_coroutine(self.stun_and_fade, self, catch_slime, color)
				end
			else
				--과적인지
				if floor < self.head_slime_max then
					--슬라임 층 추가
					self:add_slime_on_head(catch_slime, color)
				else
					--터짐
					start_coroutine(self.stun_and_fade, self, catch_slime, color)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	list:Dispose()

	wait_for_sec(swing_duration - swing_hit_time)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	while self.stun do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.stun then
		wait_for_sec(0.12)
	end

	message_system:SendSync(leader, CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviourResetEvent.Instance);

	self.swing_routine = nil
end

function local_class:add_slime_on_head(fo, color)
	--데이터 처리
	self.current_catch_count = self.current_catch_count + 1
	character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'visible')
	self:back_area_pos(fo.Position)
	self.get_fx():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_01')
	table.insert(self.head_slime_list, fo)
	local floor = #self.head_slime_list
	self.head_stack[floor] = 1
	self.current_color[floor] = color
	self.head_slime_list[floor].Position = self.get_butterfly_net_dai().Position + vector(0, 0.5 + 0.5 * floor, 0)

	--연출
	start_coroutine(self.slime_appear_routine, self, fo, 0.5, unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.one)
end

function local_class:back_slime_list(slime, color, stack)
	character_util.set_active_state(slime, 'visible')
	if stack == 3 then
		if color == self.slime_color.orange then
			table.insert(self.appear_slime_big_list, slime)
		elseif color == self.slime_color.dark then
			table.insert(self.appear_slime_big_dark_list, slime)
		elseif color == self.slime_color.ice then
			table.insert(self.appear_slime_big_ice_list, slime)
		elseif color == self.slime_color.light then
			table.insert(self.appear_slime_big_light_list, slime)
		end
	else
		if color == self.slime_color.orange then
			table.insert(self.appear_slime_list, slime)
		elseif color == self.slime_color.dark then
			table.insert(self.appear_slime_dark_list, slime)
		elseif color == self.slime_color.ice then
			table.insert(self.appear_slime_ice_list, slime)
		elseif color == self.slime_color.light then
			table.insert(self.appear_slime_light_list, slime)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:back_area_pos(pos)
	if pos.x < 89 then
		table.insert(self.first_area_pos, pos)
	elseif pos.x < 93 then
		table.insert(self.second_area_pos, pos)
	else
		table.insert(self.third_area_pos, pos)
	end
end

function local_class:up_grade_slime(slime, floor, color)
	local head_slime = self.head_slime_list[floor]

	--데이터 처리
	self.current_catch_count = self.current_catch_count + 2
	self:back_slime_list(slime, color, self.head_stack[floor])
	self.head_stack[floor] = self.head_stack[floor] + 1
	self:back_area_pos(slime.Position)

	--연출
	self.get_fx():Instantiate(slime.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_01')

	slime.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	if self.head_stack[floor] == 2 then
		start_coroutine(self.slime_appear_routine, self, head_slime, 0.5, nil, unity_class.vector3.one * 1.25)
	elseif self.head_stack[floor] == 3 then
		start_coroutine(self.combine_slime, self, floor, 0.5)
	end
end

--슬라임 커지는 연출
function local_class:slime_appear_routine(fo, duration, start_size, target_size)
	if start_size ~= nil then
		character_util.spine_scale(fo, start_size, 0)
	end

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(fo, 'damaged')
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, target_size, duration)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(fo, 0.7, 1.3, 1, duration)
	wait_for_sec(duration)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(fo, 'idle')
end

function local_class:combine_slime(floor, duration)
	local big_slime = nil
	local head_slime = self.head_slime_list[floor]

	if self.current_color[floor] == self.slime_color.orange then
		big_slime = table.remove(self.appear_slime_big_list)
	elseif self.current_color[floor] == self.slime_color.dark then
		big_slime = table.remove(self.appear_slime_big_dark_list)
	elseif self.current_color[floor] == self.slime_color.ice then
		big_slime = table.remove(self.appear_slime_big_ice_list)
	elseif self.current_color[floor] == self.slime_color.light then
		big_slime = table.remove(self.appear_slime_big_light_list)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_slime_01')

	--빅슬라임 초기화
	character_util.spine_scale(big_slime, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0)
	character_util.add_fade_color(big_slime, big_slime.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1, 0)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	--슬라임 교체
	big_slime.Position = head_slime.Position
	self.head_slime_list[floor] = big_slime

	character_util.spine_scale(big_slime, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6, duration * 2)
	character_util.remove_fade_color(big_slime, big_slime.Name, duration * 2)

	--기존 슬라임 하얗게 변화
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(head_slime, 'damaged')
	character_util.shake(head_slime, 0.03, 1)
	character_util.add_fade_color(head_slime, head_slime.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1, duration)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		head_slime.Position = big_slime.Position
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--기존 슬라임 초기화
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(head_slime, 'idle')
	character_util.remove_fade_color(head_slime, head_slime.Name, 0)
	character_util.spine_scale(head_slime, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	head_slime.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

function local_class:stun_and_fade(slime, color)
	local leader = self.get_butterfly_net_dai()
	local slime_list = table_util.duplicate(self.head_slime_list)
	local floor = #slime_list

	self.stun = true
	self.current_catch_count = 0
	self.head_slime_list = {}

	--무거워지는 연출
	self.get_fx():Instantiate(slime.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gell_01')

	if self.current_color[floor] == color then
		slime.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		start_coroutine(self.slime_appear_routine, self, slime_list[floor], 0.5, nil, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.9)
	else
		table.insert(slime_list, slime)
		floor = #slime_list
		slime.Position = self.get_butterfly_net_dai().Position + vector(0, 0.5 + 0.5 * floor, 0)
		start_coroutine(self.slime_appear_routine, self, slime, 0.5, unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.one)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.current_color do
		self.current_color[i] = self.slime_color.none
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'scared')
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.1, 0.9)

	wait_for_sec(0.9)

	--깔리는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_slime_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(leader, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'confused')

	for i = 1, #slime_list do
		wp_util.move(slime_list[i], leader.Position, nil, 0.1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local move_list = {
		leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1),
		leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 1),
		leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		leader.Position + vector(1, 0, -1)
	}

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	local bounce_fx = self.slime_buttbounce_fx():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	bounce_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

	for i = 1, #slime_list do
		local npc = slime_list[i]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, 1)
		character_util.jump(npc,1,0.9)
		character_util.move_to(npc,move_list[i],0.9)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--일어서는 연출
	for i = 1, #slime_list do
		local npc = slime_list[i]
		self:back_slime_list(npc, self.current_color[i], self.head_stack[i])
		npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_scale(npc, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, 'left', 2, nil, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	self.head_stack = {
		0, 0, 0
	}
	self.stun = false
end

--게임 일시 정지
function local_class:pause_interact_scene()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRequestPauseEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))

	if self.ticking_loop ~= nil then
		self.ticking_loop:Stop()
		self.ticking_loop = nil
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.5)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.is_interact = true

	--빨간색: 포기한다.
	--하얀색: 아무것도 아니다.
	local choose_list = {
		{ 'short_story_dai_slime_festival_11', 'brutal' },
		{ 'short_story_dai_slime_festival_12', 'normal' }
	}
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)

	if choose_result == 1 then
		self:timer_finished()
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRequestResumeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))

		if self.hurry_up then
			if self.ticking_loop == nil then
				self.ticking_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gimmick_ticking_loop_01', loop = true })
			end
		end

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end

	self.is_interact = false
end

--게임 로직
function local_class:game_routine()
	local festival_man = self.get_festival_man()
	local festival_man_game_pos = self.get_game_pos()
	local festival_man_pos = self.get_festival_man_pos()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local leader_pos = festival_man_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)

	local butterfly_net_dai = self.get_butterfly_net_dai()
	local butterfly_net_dai_pos = festival_man_game_pos + vector(0, 0, -4)

	--파티원 이동 및 멤버 해제
	self.member_list = {}
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		table.insert(self.member_list, member)
	end

	--이벤트용 다이로 교체
	--플레이어 무기 셋팅
	self:change_leader_to_butterfly_net_dai()
	character_util.set_position(butterfly_net_dai, butterfly_net_dai_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(butterfly_net_dai, 'down')

	--npc, leader 셋팅
	character_util.set_position(festival_man, festival_man_game_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(festival_man, 'down')

	self.result_pos_count = 0
	self.catch_count = 0
	self.current_catch_count = 0
	self.is_playing = true
	self.is_clear = false
	self.hurry_up = false
	self.attack_range:Show()

	--게임 플레이
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_result', mix = 1 })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.is_fist_explanation then
		self.is_fist_explanation = false
		camera_util.move_async(festival_man.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), 0.5)

		--마을 주민(down, release, smile) : 잡은 슬라임을 이곳으로 가져오시면 점수를 획득할 수 있습니다!
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(festival_man, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_release_anim(festival_man)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(festival_man, 'short_story_dai_slime_festival_8', true)
		character_util.remove_anim(festival_man)

		--마을 주민(left, idle, smile) 슬라임 크기가 클수록 더 높은 점수를 받을 수 있죠… 단!
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(festival_man, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(festival_man, 'sing')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(festival_man, 'short_story_dai_slime_festival_9', true)
		character_util.remove_anim(festival_man)

		--마을 주민(left, idle, smile) 너무 크게 만들거나, 너무 높게 쌓으려 할 시 무너질 수 있으므로 주의하세요!
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(festival_man, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(festival_man, 'cast2')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(festival_man, 'short_story_dai_slime_festival_10', true)
		character_util.remove_anim(festival_man)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(festival_man, 'smile')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	end

	start_coroutine(self.calculate_in_game_routine, self)

	--타이머 셋팅
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_event', state = 'event', mix = 1 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.timer_duration, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished', show_ui = true })

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()


	--카운팅 ui 셋팅
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(0)
	self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	--게임 종료 까지 대기
	local time_passed = self.timer_duration
	local ticking_check = true
	while self.is_playing do

		if not self.is_interact then
			time_passed = time_passed - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		if time_passed < 5 and ticking_check then
			if self.ticking_loop == nil then
				self.hurry_up = true
				self.ticking_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gimmick_ticking_loop_01', loop = true })
				ticking_check = false
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	while self.stun do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--혹시 인터렉트 타이밍과 겹칠 경우 대기
	while self.is_interact do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--시간 초과 시 타이머 종료
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	if self.ticking_loop ~= nil then
		self.ticking_loop:Stop()
		self.ticking_loop = nil
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	--승리 연출
	if self.is_clear then
		character_util.set_direction(butterfly_net_dai, 'right')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(butterfly_net_dai, 'victory_get')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(butterfly_net_dai, 'smile')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

		wait_for_sec(2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--카운팅 초기화
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.head_slime_list = {}

	local slime_init_func = function(slime_list)
		for _, character in pairs(slime_list) do
			character.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			character_util.set_active_state(character, 'visible')
			character_util.spine_scale(character, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
		end
	end

	slime_init_func(self.dynamic_slime_list)
	slime_init_func(self.dynamic_slime_dark_list)
	slime_init_func(self.dynamic_slime_ice_list)
	slime_init_func(self.dynamic_slime_light_list)
	slime_init_func(self.dynamic_big_slime)
	slime_init_func(self.dynamic_big_slime_dark_list)

	character_util.set_position(festival_man, festival_man_pos)
	character_util.set_anim(festival_man, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_direction(festival_man, 'left', false)

	character_util.stop_shake(butterfly_net_dai)

	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_pos)
	character_util.set_position(butterfly_net_dai, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(butterfly_net_dai)

	local list_count = #self.member_list
	--제외한 파티 멤버 복구
	for i = list_count, 1, -1 do
		local member = self.member_list[i]
		--고메 흉켈 레오나일 경우 파티 팔로워로
		if i < list_count - 1 then
			character_util.convert_to_following_npc(member, user_party, false)
		else
			--포프 마암은 파티 멤버로
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(member, user_party, true)
		end
	end

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'idle')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.5 })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if self.is_clear then
		self:clear_game()
	else

	end

end

function local_class:slime_jump_routine(npc, start_pos, target_pos, height, duration)
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(npc, 'attack')

	local time_passed = 0
	local wait = true
	while time_passed < duration and self.is_playing do
		if not self.is_interact then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height

			npc.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_h

			if wait then
				npc.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
				wait = false
			end
		else
			npc.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
			wait = true
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'idle')
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.common_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Util')

	local is_created = false
	is_created, self.store = global_table_util.try_get('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Dungeon/Store.lua')

	do
		-- 비앙카 세팅
		local succubus_kid = self.npc.succubus_kid()

		scene_util.set_direction(succubus_kid, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_kid, self, 'tired')

		field_object_util.set_active_state(succubus_kid, active_state_type.enabled)
	end

	do
		-- 서큐버스 선생 세팅
		local succubus_teacher = self.npc.succubus_teacher()
		succubus_teacher.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_bianca_outer_pos_2')

		scene_util.set_direction(succubus_teacher, 'right', false)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(succubus_teacher, active_state_type.enabled)
	end

	-- 메인 퀘스트 상태에 따라 비활성화 처리
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest_progress ~= nil then
		local is_ban = table_util.contain_value(self.ban_progress_list, main_quest_progress.InnerProgress)
		self.is_quest_active = is_ban == false
	end

	-- 6섹션 이상이면 좌표 세팅도 해줌
	self:set_active_quest(main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 5)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	self:dispose_gift_item()

	self.cached_party = nil
	self.common_util = nil
	self.store = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.is_quest_active == false then
		return false
	end

	-- 비앙카와 상호작용 했을 때
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.succubus_kid()) then
		if self.current_state <= self.states.interact_succubus_kid then
			-- 최초 연출을 다 봤을 때
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_succubus_kid, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_state > self.states.interact_succubus_kid and
				self.current_state <= self.states.check_display_case then
			-- 이후
			sp_util.start_scene(self.choose_enter_shop, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_state <= self.states.ending and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.exit()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.choose_exit_shop, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.enter_shop then
		-- 상점 진열장 선택 중일 때
		for i = 1, #self.interact_obj do
			local info = self.interact_obj[i]
			local display_case = info.fo

			if info.is_interact == false and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, display_case) then
				self.interact_obj[i].is_interact = true

				quest_marker_util.remove(display_case.Name)
				display_case.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

				sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_display_case, self, display_case)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.check_display_case and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.counter()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.is_quest_active == false then
		return false
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.current_state <= self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_bianca_event_start_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_first_zone_event
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_succubus_event_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id then
		local is_ban = table_util.contain_value(self.ban_progress_list, e.CurrentProgress)

		if self.is_quest_active == is_ban then
			self.is_quest_active = (is_ban == false)
			self:set_active_quest(e.CurrentProgress >= 5)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 빨간색 존 진입시 이벤트
function local_class:enter_succubus_event_zone()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local succubus_kid = self.npc.succubus_kid()
	local succubus_teacher = self.npc.succubus_teacher()

	-- 꼬마 비앙카쪽으로 1초간 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move_async(succubus_kid.Position, 1)

	-- 선생님 (right, tired, bomb_idle): 비앙카,  견학 중에 보호자 없이 혼자 다닌 건가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_teacher, self, nil, 'bomb_idle',
			'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_1')

	-- 비앙카 (left, tired, idle): 하,  하지만. 집사분들이 오늘은 휴가여서….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(succubus_kid, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_2')

	-- 선생님 (right, idle, idle): 선생님도 내일 소풍 준비로 바빠서 미안해요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(succubus_teacher, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_3')

	-- 선생님 (right, idle, release2회): 하지만 안 되는 건 안 되는 거에요. 필요하다면 보호자를 구해주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_teacher, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_4')

	-- 선생님 0.5초간 좌측 1칸 이동후 (left, idle, eat) 상태 유지
	wp_util.move_async(succubus_teacher, succubus_teacher.Position - vector(1.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(succubus_teacher, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.add_listener(succubus_kid, self)

	-- 카메라 1초간 프리렌에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:set_active_quest(is_set_pos)
	local succubus_kid = self.npc.succubus_kid()
	local succubus_teacher = self.npc.succubus_teacher()

	if self.is_quest_active then
		self:set_gift_item()

		if is_set_pos then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus_kid)

			if self.current_state <= self.states.show_first_zone_event then
				scene_util.set_direction(succubus_kid, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_kid, self, 'tired')
			end

			succubus_kid.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_bianca_outer_pos_1')
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(succubus_kid, active_state_type.enabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(succubus_teacher, active_state_type.enabled)
	else
		self:dispose_gift_item()

		field_object_util.set_active_state(succubus_kid, active_state_type.disabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(succubus_teacher, active_state_type.disabled)
	end
end

function local_class:set_gift_item()
	self:dispose_gift_item()
	self.gift_item = {}

	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_bianca_outer_pos_1')

	local gift_box = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = self.item_id.gift_box,
		pos = pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.25),
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		skip_text = true,
		spr_scale = 0.8,
	})

	table.insert(self.gift_item, gift_box)

	local basket = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = self.item_id.basket,
		pos = pos + vector(-3, 0, 0.25),
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		skip_text = true,
		spr_scale = 0.6,
	})

	table.insert(self.gift_item, basket)
end

-- 비앙카 인터랙트시 파티 정렬
function local_class:interact_succubus_kid()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local frieren = self.npc.frieren()
	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.npc.stark()
	local succubus_kid = self.npc.succubus_kid()
	local succubus_teacher = self.npc.succubus_teacher()

	local is_first_event = self.current_state <= self.states.show_first_zone_event
	self.current_state = self.states.interact_succubus_kid

	-- (a) 프리렌 (left, idle, idle) (40, 0, -35)
	-- (b) 페른 (left, idle, idle) (41, 0, -35)
	-- (c) 슈타르크 (left, idle, idle) (42, 0, -35)
	-- (d) 파티원 4 (left, idle, idle) (39.5, 0, -36)
	-- (e) 파티원 5 (left, idle, idle ) (40.5, 0, -36)
	self.common_util:align_party_by_index_async(succubus_kid.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1,
			direction_constants.left, self.align_offset_data[1])

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	scene_util.set_direction(succubus_kid, 'right')

	if is_first_event then
		-- 슈타르크 (left, idle, idle): 너 빵집에 있던 꼬마 아냐?
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stark, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_5')

		-- 페른 (left, tired, question): 그 상자… 그때 그 빵 아직 안 드신 건가요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, nil, 'question',
				'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_6')

		-- 비앙카 (right, idle, idle): 네,  이건 선물용으로 산 거라서….
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(succubus_kid, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_7')

		-- 비앙카 (right, idle, question) (silence)이모티콘 버블
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, 'question',
				nil, 'silence')

		-- 비앙카 (right, tired, cast): 저기, 혹시 잠깐만 보호자 역할을 해주겠어요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, 'cast',
				'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_8')

		-- 비앙카 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 서큐버스들은 자기 마을에서 잘 벗어나지 않아요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, 'bomb_idle',
				nil, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_10')

		-- 비앙카 (right, tired, idle): 제 친구 중에는 한 번도 밖에 나가본 적 없는 친구들도 있어요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, nil,
				'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_11')

		-- 슈타르크 (left, worried, cast): 조금 불쌍한 느낌이 드네….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, nil, 'cast',
				'worried', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_12')

		-- 비앙카 (right, attack, nod2회): 이번 기회에 최대한 많은 것들을 마을의 친구들한테 보여 주고 싶어요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, 'nod',
				'attack', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_13')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus_kid)

	-- 선택지
	-- 보호자가 되어준다. (mercy)
	-- 지금은 곤란하다. (normal)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_14', 'mercy' },
		{ 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_15', 'normal' }
	})

	if choose_result ~= 1 then
		-- 지금은 곤란하다. 선택시

		-- 프리렌 (left, sleep_deep, idle): 미안,  지금 당장은 곤란할 것 같아.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, nil, nil,
				'sleep_deep', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_16')

		-- 비앙카 (right, tired, idle): 그런가요… 알겠습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, nil,
				'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_17')

		-- 컨트롤 해제 이후 다시 말걸면 선택지 부터 시작
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 보호자가 되어준다. 선택시

	-- 프리렌 (left, idle, nod2회): 좋아. 잠깐이라면 어울려줄게.

	-- 선생님 (right, idle, bomb_idle): 보호자? 제대로 된 분을 찾아온 거겠죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_teacher, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },

	-- 비앙카 (left, attack, idle) (jump1회): 네! 마을에서 만났던 모험가 분들이에요!

			{ name = 'question', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_27')

	-- 선생님 (silence) 이모티콘
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(succubus_teacher, nil, 'silence')

	-- 선생님 (right, smile, idle): 그래! 확실히 보호자로 적합한 훌륭하신 분이구나.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_teacher, self, nil,
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_28')

-- 상점 들어갈 때 세팅
function local_class:set_shop_enter_spec()
	do
		-- 비앙카
		local succubus_kid = self.npc.succubus_kid()
		character_util.remove_relate_event(succubus_kid, self)
	end

	-- 파티 순서 리더 페른- 2 꼬마 비앙카- 3 프리렌 - 4슈타르크 - 만약 파티원 4, 5 가 있다면 이탈 상태 (이벤트를 통해 다시 나가면 파티원 4, 5 재합류)
	self.cached_party = {}

	local user_party = get_user_party()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count do
		table.insert(self.cached_party, user_party[i])
	end

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(fern, param, true)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(fern, active_state_type.enabled)

	local party_member = { self.npc.succubus_kid(), self.npc.frieren(), self.npc.stark() }

	for i = 1, #party_member do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(party_member[i], user_party, true)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(party_member[i], active_state_type.enabled)
	end

	-- exit 도어 publish로 변경해서 연출함
	local exit_fo = self.field_object.exit()
	exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- State에 따라 세팅
	if self.current_state == self.states.enter_shop then
		-- 진열장을 아직 확인 안했을 때
		for i = 1, #self.interact_obj do
			local info = self.interact_obj[i]
			if info.is_interact == false then
				local fo = info.fo

				fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
				quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(fo.Name, self.quest_id, false, fo)
				field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.check_display_case then
		-- 모든 진열장을 확인 했을 때
		local staff = self.npc.staff()
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(staff.Name, self.quest_id, false, self.npc.staff())

		local counter = self.field_object.counter()
		counter.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

-- 상점 나갈 때 세팅
function local_class:set_shop_exit_spec()
	if self.cached_party ~= nil then
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

		local leader = self.cached_party[1]
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(leader, param, true)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.enabled)

		for i = 2, #self.cached_party do
			local member = self.cached_party[i]
			character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(member, user_party, true)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(member, active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end

	do
		-- 도어 원복
		local exit_fo = self.field_object.exit()
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.ExitInteractable()

		local open_path_info = CS.Oak.OpenPathInfo()
		open_path_info.OpenWaypoint = exit_fo.Name
		exit_fo.Interactable.MoveStage = open_path_info
	end

	if self.current_state < self.states.ending then
		-- 비앙카
		local succubus_kid = self.npc.succubus_kid()
		succubus_kid.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_bianca_outer_pos_1')

		scene_util.set_direction(succubus_kid, 'right', false)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(succubus_kid, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.add_listener(succubus_kid, self)
	end

	-- State에 따라 세팅
	if self.current_state == self.states.enter_shop then
		-- 진열장을 아직 확인 안했을 때
		for i = 1, #self.interact_obj do
			local info = self.interact_obj[i]
			local fo = info.fo

			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			quest_marker_util.remove(fo.Name)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.check_display_case then
		-- 모든 진열장을 확인 했을 때
		local staff = self.npc.staff()
		quest_marker_util.remove(staff.Name)

		local counter = self.field_object.counter()
		counter.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

-- 오브젝트 인터랙트시
function local_class:interact_display_case(display_case)
	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local succubus_kid = self.npc.succubus_kid()

	-- 페른 (오브젝트 바라보며, release 2회): 이 물건은 어떠신가요?
	character_util.look_at(fern, display_case)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, nil, { name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_45')

	-- 비앙카 (오브젝트 바라보며, tired, question): 흐으음….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.look_at(succubus_kid, display_case)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, 'question',
			'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_46')

	-- 오브젝트 3개 인터랙트 한 후 이어서 이벤트 진행 (남은 오브젝트의 인터랙트 및 서브 퀘스트 마커는 제거)
	local is_clear_count = 0

	for i = 1, #self.interact_obj do
		local info = self.interact_obj[i]

		if info.is_interact then
			is_clear_count = is_clear_count + 1
		end
	end

	if is_clear_count < 3 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.interact_obj do
		local info = self.interact_obj[i]
		local fo = info.fo

		quest_marker_util.remove(fo.Name)
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	-- 비앙카 (tired, idle): 죄송해요… 뭔가 느낌이 오는 게 없어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, nil,
			'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_47')

	-- 페른 (비앙카 바라보며, idle): 그럼 한 번 카운터에 물어볼까요?
	character_util.look_at(fern, succubus_kid)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fern, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_48')

	-- 비앙카 (페른 바라보며, idle): 네,  좋아요.
	character_util.look_at(succubus_kid, fern)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(succubus_kid, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_49')

	self.current_state = self.states.check_display_case

	local staff = self.npc.staff()
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(staff.Name, self.quest_id, false, self.npc.staff())

	local counter = self.field_object.counter()
	counter.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:ending_scene()

	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.npc.stark()
	local succubus_kid = self.npc.succubus_kid()
	local succubus_teacher = self.npc.succubus_teacher()
	local staff = self.npc.staff()

	quest_marker_util.remove(staff.Name)

	-- 초록색 표시된 부분 인터랙트시 파티 정렬

	-- (1) 페른 (234, 0, -1.5)
	-- (2) 꼬마 비앙카 (234, 0, -2.5)
	-- (3) 프리렌 (235, 0, -1.5)
	-- (4) 슈타르크 (235, 0, -2.5)

	-- 페른 (left, idle, idle): 안녕하세요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fern, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_50')

	-- 종업원 (right, smile, idle): 네,  뭔가 찾으시는 물건이라도 있으신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, nil, nil,
			'smile', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_51')

	-- 페른 (left, tired, idle): 저기… 혹시 다른 곳에서 볼 수 없는 특별한 물건같은 게 있을까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, nil, nil,
			'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_52')

	-- 종업원 (right, idle, idle) (jump1회): 흠… 아! 그거라면 이게 있어요.
	character_util.normal_jump(staff, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(staff, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_53')

	-- 종업원 (right, smile, clap): 자신의 마법을 담아 꾸밀 수 있는 마도구에요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, nil, 'clap',
			'smile', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_54')

	-- 비앙카 (left, tired, bomb_idle): 자신의 마법을 담는다고요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, 'bomb_idle',
			'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_55')

	-- 종업원 (right, smile, nod2회): 네,  마법에 따라 빛깔과 형태가 바뀌는 마도구에요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, nil, 'nod',
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_56')

	-- 종업원 (right, smile, sing): 전투용은 아니지만 자신만의 장신구를 만들 수 있는 특별한 물건이죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, nil, 'sing',
			'smile', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_57')

	-- 프리렌 (left, smile, cast): 오오… 멋진 마도구야….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, nil, 'cast',
			'smile', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_58')

	-- 페른 (down, idle, idle): 잘됐네요. 비앙카 씨의 마법을 한 번 담아보세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'down', nil,
			nil, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_59')

	-- 비앙카 (left, tired, idle): 하지만 제 마법은…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, nil,
			'tired', 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_60')

	-- 비앙카 (left, tired, idle) (silence) 이모티콘 버블
	scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_kid, self, 'tired')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(succubus_kid, nil, 'silence')

	-- 비앙카 (left, tired, cast): 제 마법은 사람을 끌어들이는 다른 친구들과는 달라요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, 'cast',
			nil, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_62')

	-- 비앙카 (left, tired, bomb_idle): 오히려 차가운 얼음으로 다른 사람들을 털어내는 마법이라고요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(succubus_kid, self, nil, 'bomb_idle',

	-- 프리렌 (left, sleep_deep,idle) (silence) 이모티콘 버블

			{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_bianca_s1_69')

		pos = start_pos,
		item_id = self.item_id.gold_ring,
		show_on_character = false,
		spr_scale = 0.5,

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryFrierenBreadRecipeController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_frieren'

	self.get_star_piece = function()
		return get_field_object('bread_recipe_star_piece')
	end

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_intro_zone_enter = 2,
		outside_storage = 3,
		talk_employee = 4,
		inside_storage = 5,
		lead_password = 6,
		start_decryption = 7,
		complete_decryption = 7,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	--npc
	self.npc = {
		frieren = function()
			return get_character('frieren')
		end,
		fern = function()
			return get_character('fern')
		end,
		stark = function()
			return get_character('stark')
		end,
		employee = function()
			return get_character('dessert_shop_employee')
		end,
	}

	self.password_item = {
		---@type fun(this:self)
		load = function(this)
			if this.is_load then
				return
			else
				this.is_load = true
			end

			local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(this.marker_pos_name)
			local count = 1

			for key, info in pairs(this.data) do
				local fo = get_field_object(this.fo_prefix .. count)
				local target_pos = center_pos + info.offset

				--item
				local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = info.id,
					pos = target_pos,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				})

				--fo
				fo.Position = target_pos
				fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				this.data[key].fo = fo
				this.data[key].item = item

				count = count + 1
			end
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, key:string):IFieldObject
		get_fo = function(this, key)
			return this.data[key].fo
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, key:string):IFieldObject
		dispose_item = function(this, key)
			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.data[key].item)
			this.data[key].item = nil
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, target:IFieldObject):function
		is_interact = function(this, target)
			for key, info in pairs(this.data) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, this:get_fo(key)) then
					return info.cb
				end
			end

			return false
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		dispose = function(this)
			if not this.is_load then
				return
			end

			--fo
			for key, _ in pairs(this.data) do

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.target_quest)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self:activate_quest()
	elseif quest_progress.InnerProgress == 5 or
			quest_progress.InnerProgress == 6 or
			quest_progress.InnerProgress == 8 or
			quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 10 then
		--6,7,9, 11~ 섹션 활성화
		self:activate_quest()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	self.common_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Util')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	self.password_item:dispose()

	self.common_util = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	--창고 바깥 종업원
	if self.current_state == self.states.outside_storage and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.employee()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_employee

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			self:employee_interact_scene(false)

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end)

		return true
	end

	--창고 안 종업원
	if self.current_state == self.states.inside_storage and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.employee()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_employee
		sp_util.start_scene(self.storage_out_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	--암호문 아이템
	if self.current_state == self.states.inside_storage then
		local cb = self.password_item:is_interact(e.Target)

		if type_util.is_function(cb) then
			self.current_state = self.states.lead_password
			sp_util.start_scene(cb, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_intro_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'sub_bread_align_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_employee
		self.enter_end = true

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			self:intro_enter_scene()
			self:employee_interact_scene(true)

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.target_quest then
		if e.CurrentProgress == 5 then
			self:activate_quest()
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 7 then
			self:deactivate_quest()
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 8 then
			self:activate_quest()
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 9 then
			self:deactivate_quest()
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 10 then
			self:activate_quest()
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--5명 파티원 정렬
function local_class:align_party_async(duration)
	local frieren = self.npc.frieren()
	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.npc.stark()
	local current_party = get_user_party()

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_bread_center_pos')

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(frieren, center_pos + vector(0, 0, -2),
			nil, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fern, center_pos + vector(-1, 0, -2),
			nil, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(stark, center_pos + vector(1, 0, -2),
			nil, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

	if current_party.Count > 3 then
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(current_party[3], center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -3),
				nil, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	end

	if current_party.Count > 4 then
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(current_party[4], center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -3),
				nil, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
end

function local_class:intro_enter_scene()
	local frieren = self.npc.frieren()
	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.npc.stark()
	local employee = self.npc.employee()

	--카메라 0.5초간 종업원에게 이동

	--종업원(down,smile,idle)(jump1회): 아! 저번에 레시피를 찾아주신 분들이군요.
	character_util.normal_jump(employee, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_0')

	--파티원 정렬
	self:align_party_async(1)

	--프리렌(up,idle,idle): 레시피는 그 후로 진척이 좀 있었어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_1')

	--종업원(down,idle,question): 창고를 더 뒤져보니 비슷한 걸 찾았는데, 예전에 쓰던 암호문 같더라고요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'question', loop = false }, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_2')

	--종업원(down,tired,idle): 이런 거에는 재능이 없어서 영 모르겠지만요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_3')

	--슈타르크(left,idle,idle): 암호라… 재밌어 보이는데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_4')

	--페른(right,idle,ilde): 그 정도로 소중한 레시피였던 걸까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_5')

	--종업원(down,idle,ilde): 그러게 말이예요. 해독해 줄 사람이 있다면 의뢰라도 맡기고 싶은데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_6')

	--프리렌에게 카메라 0.5초간 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(frieren, 0.5)

	--프리렌(up,idle,idle): 암호 해독이라면 비슷한 걸 해본 적이 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_7')

	--종업원(down,smile,idle)(jump1회): 정말인가요? 그럼 혹시 암호 푸는 걸 도와주실 수 있을까요?
	character_util.normal_jump(employee, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'smile' }, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_8')
end

function local_class:employee_interact_scene(is_enter)
	local frieren = self.npc.frieren()
	local employee = self.npc.employee()

	--파티원 정렬
	self:align_party_async(1)

	--선택지
	do
		--그거라면 맡겨둬. (mercy)
		--기회가 되면 도와줄게.  (normal)
		local first_branch_data = {
			{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_1', 'mercy' },
			{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_2', 'normal' }
		}

		--다시 해독을 시작한다. (mercy)
		--조금 더 생각해 본다. (normal)
		local branch_data = {
			{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_3', 'mercy' },
			{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_4', 'normal' }
		}

		local target_data = is_enter and first_branch_data or branch_data
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(target_data)

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--프리렌(up,idle,idle): 알겠어. 지금 시도해 볼게.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'up',
					nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_11')

			--종업원(down,smile,nod2회): 정말이요? 당장 준비해 드릴게요.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
					{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_12')

			self:storage_in_scene()
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--프리렌(up,idle,idle): 아직은 바빠서 기회가 되면 도와줄게.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'up',
					nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_9')

			--종업원(down,idle,nod2회): 말씀만이라도 감사하네요. 좋은 하루 되세요.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
					{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_10')

			self.current_state = self.states.outside_storage

			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.01)

			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:meringue_interact_scene()

--암호 해독 연출
function local_class:decryption_scene()
	local frieren = self.npc.frieren()
	local password_fo = self.password_item:get_fo('password')

	--프리렌 0.5초간 정렬 위로
	wp_util.move_async(frieren, password_fo.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5,
			nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'down' })

	--프리렌(down,idle,idle): 좋아… 일단 아로의 의미는 달걀이였지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_28')

	local password_data = {
		{
			branch_data = {
				--젓다
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_9', 'normal' },
				--설탕 (정답)
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_11', 'normal' },
				--끓이다
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_12', 'normal' },
			},
			correct = 2,
			cb = function()
				--프리렌(down,idle,question): 그럼 파논의 의미는…
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
						'question', nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_29')
			end,
		},
		{
			branch_data = {
				--물
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_14', 'normal' },
				--뿌리다
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_15', 'normal' },
				--우유(정답)
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_10', 'normal' },
			},
			correct = 3,
			cb = function()
				--프리렌(down,idle,question): 그다음 호샤의 의미는…
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
						'question', nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_30')
			end,
		},
		{
			branch_data = {
				--소금 (정답)
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_13', 'normal' },
				--넣다
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_16', 'normal' },
				--빵
				{ 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_choose_17', 'normal' },
			},
			correct = 1,
			cb = function()
				--프리렌(down,sleep_deep,question): 그럼 이제… 카룬의 의미는?
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
						'question', 'sleep_deep', 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_31')
			end,
		},
	}

	local is_clear = false

	--암호 해독
	for _, info in ipairs(password_data) do
		info:cb()

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(info.branch_data)

		--결과 입력
		is_clear = (choose_result == info.correct)

		if not is_clear then
			break
		end
	end

	if is_clear then
		self.current_state = self.states.complete_decryption

		self:complete_scene()
	else
		--프리렌(down,sleep_deep,idle)(sience)이모티콘 버블
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(frieren, self, 'down',
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'silence')

		--프리렌(down,tired,idle): 흐음… 이 의미가 아닌 것 같아.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
				nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_32')

		self.current_state = self.states.inside_storage
	end
end

--창고 내부 환경 세팅
function local_class:storage_convert_to_npc()
	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.npc.stark()
	local current_party = get_user_party()
	self.fourth_member = nil
	self.fifth_member = nil

	scene_util.set_group_direction({ fern, stark }, 'right', false)

	if current_party.Count > 4 then
		self.fifth_member = current_party[4]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.fifth_member)
	end

	if current_party.Count > 3 then
		self.fourth_member = current_party[3]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.fourth_member)
	end

	--페른(right,idle,idle) : 레시피와 암호에서 겹치는 단어를 찾아 뜻을 유추하는 거군요.
	character_util.convert_to_npc(fern)
	fern.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	fern.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_oneline_1'

	--슈타르크(right,idle,idle): 파논, 호샤, 카룬의 의미만 더 찾으면 끝나는 거지?
	character_util.convert_to_npc(stark)
	stark.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	stark.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_frieren_sub_bread_s1_oneline_2'
end

--창고 외부 환경 세팅
function local_class:storage_convert_to_party_member()
	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.npc.stark()

	character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(fern, user_party, true)
	fern.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(stark, user_party, true)
	stark.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if self.fourth_member ~= nil then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.fourth_member, user_party, true)
		self.fourth_member = nil

		local offset = unity_class.vector3.zero
		local last_direction = direction
		local member_data = data[member]

		if member_data ~= nil then
			if member_data.offset ~= nil then
				offset = data[member].offset
			end

			if member_data.direction ~= nil then
				last_direction = data[member].direction
			end
		end

		local target_pos = align_pivot + offset

		character_util.set_position(member, target_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(member, last_direction)
	end
end

function local_class:align_party_async(align_pivot, duration, direction, offsets)
	self:start_align_party(align_pivot, duration, direction, offsets)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	self:wait_align_end_async()
end

function local_class:start_align_party(align_pivot, duration, direction, data)
	if duration < constants.epsilon then
		self:position_party(align_pivot, direction, data)

		return
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do

		local offset = unity_class.vector3.zero

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent), 'on_reset_switch_turned_on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')

	self.common_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Util')
end

function local_class:start()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest_progress ~= nil and main_quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
		self:setting()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.common_util = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.talk_employee and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'dessert_shop_enter_storage_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.enter_storage

		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_storage, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.is_active_exit_event and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'dessert_shop_exit_zone') then

		self.is_active_exit_event = false

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			local leader = get_party_leader()

			--프리렌: 아직 제대로 둘러보지 못했어.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.character.frieren, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_44')

			local target_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter('dessert_shop_exit_zone', leader, 'up', 0.5)
			wp_util.move_async(leader, target_pos, nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'down' })

			self.is_active_exit_event = true
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.clear_puzzle and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'dessert_shop_ending_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.ending

		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending, self)
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, self.boxes.count do
		local box = self.boxes:get(i)

		if self.current_state == self.states.enter_storage and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, box, 'dessert_shop_puzzle_zone') then
			self.boxes.clear_list:add(box)

			if #self.boxes.clear_list > 3 then
				self.current_state = self.states.clear_puzzle

				sp_util.start_scene(self.clear_puzzle, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.starting and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.interactable_exit) then

		self.current_state = self.states.enter_shop

		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_shop, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.enter_shop and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.interactable_counter) then

		self.current_state = self.states.talk_employee

		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_employee, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_reset_switch_turned_on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.enter_storage and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.field_object.reset_switch) then
		self.boxes:reset()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 2 then
		self:setting()
	end

	return false
end

--가게 들어감
function local_class:enter_shop()
	self.field_object.interactable_exit.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.field_object.interactable_exit, active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.field_object.exit, active_state_type.enabled)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	--페이드 아웃 1초
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.8, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local frieren = self.character.frieren
	local fern = self.character.fern
	local stark = self.character.stark
	local ailie = self.character.ailie

	--캐릭터 배치
	self.common_util:position_party(self.marker.shop_exit_pos, direction_constants.up, {
		[frieren] = {
			offset = vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5)
		},
		[fern] = {
			offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5)
		},
		[stark] = {
			offset = vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)
		},
		[ailie] = {
			offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)
		},
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local party = { frieren, fern, stark, ailie }

	for i = 1, #party do
		local member = party[i]

		if i == 4 then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, member.Position + vector(0, 0, 6), nil, 1, self)
		else
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, member.Position + vector(0, 0, 4), nil, 2, self)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 3)

	--페이드 인 0.8초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.8, 'linear')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--카메라 0.5초간 에일리에게 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(ailie, 0.5)

	--에일리(right,smile,victory_get 상태 유지): 여긴 무려 100년이나 대를 이어온 명가 디저트 가게지!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
		{ name = 'victory_get', keep = true }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_1')

	--페른(right,attack,cast 상태 유지): 100년의 명가라고요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'right',
		{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, 'attack', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_2')

	--에일리(down,smile,nod2회) : 응! 여러 가지 디저트들이 잔뜩 있다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, { dir = 'down', sfx = false },
		{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_3')

	--아래 동작 동시에
	--에일리, 슈타르크, 프리렌 (right,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(frieren, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(stark, 'right', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ailie)
	scene_util.set_direction(ailie, 'right', false)

--점원과 대화
function local_class:talk_employee()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local frieren = self.character.frieren
	local stark = self.character.stark
	local ailie = self.character.ailie
	local employee = self.character.employee

	local employee_shop_pos = self.marker.employee_shop_pos

	local interactable_counter = self.field_object.interactable_counter
	interactable_counter.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(interactable_counter, active_state_type.disabled)

	--파티 정렬
	self.common_util:align_party_async(employee_shop_pos + vector(0, 0, -2), 1, direction_constants.up, {
		[frieren] = {
			offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		},
		[stark] = {
			offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		},
		[ailie] = {
			offset = vector(0, 0, -1)
		},
	})

	--(1) 종업원 (fr_bakery_male)(down,idle,idle)(249,-18)에서 0.5초간 알파 페이드로 생긴 후 (run) 애니메이션으로 1.5초간 (257.5,-18) 위치까지 이동
	character_util.set_direction(employee, 'down')
	employee.Position = employee_shop_pos + vector(-6.5, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(employee, 0, 0)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(employee, active_state_type.enabled)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(employee, 1, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wp_util.move_async(employee, employee_shop_pos, nil, 1.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	--가게 직원(down,tired,idle) (jump1회): 아, 죄송합니다 손님! 제가 지금 좀 바빠서 신경을 못쓰고 있었네요.
	character_util.normal_jump(employee, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, { dir = 'down', sfx = false },
		nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_7')

	--가게 직원(down,tired,bomb_idle) : 오늘까지 창고 정리를 마쳐야하는데 양이 너무 많아서 말이죠…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
		'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_9')

	--슈타르크(up,idle,relesae2회) : 창고 정리 정도라면 도와줄 수 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'up',
		{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_10')

	--프리렌(right,idle,nod2회) : 페른도 기다릴 겸, 잠깐 정도는 괜찮겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
		{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_11')

	--가게 직원(down,smile,cast) : 정말요?! 감사드립니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
		'cast', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_12')

	--프리렌(up,idle,idle) : 보수로는 뭘 받을 수 있지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'up',
		nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_13')

	--가게 직원(down,attack,release회) : 저희 가게에 공짜로 빵 한 바구니 담을 수 있게 해드리겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'down',
		{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_14')

	--다음 동작 동시에
	--초록색 표시된 오브젝트 (obj_shop_counter open) 애니메이션 재생 지나갈 수 있음
	self.counter_door:open()

	--종업원 (275.5,-18)에서 (249,-18)까지 1초간 이동 후 0.5초간 알파 페이드로 사라짐
	wp_util.move_async(employee, employee.Position + vector(-6.5, 0, 0), nil, 1)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(employee, 0, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	employee.Position = self.marker.employee_storage_pos
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(employee, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(employee, 'left')

	--종업원 사라지면 가게 내에서 메인 마커 위치 (251,-17.5)로 변경 (exit) 위치
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_desert_shop', {
		{ zone = 'dessert_shop_storage_field', target = self.marker.storage_center + vector(-1, 0, 1) },
	})

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(employee, self, 'left',
		'question', nil, 'silence')

	--가게 직원(left,tired,bomb_idle): 아… 옛날 문자로 써져있어서 읽을 수는 없네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(employee, self, 'left',
		'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_21')

	--가게 직원(left,smile,release2회) : 그래도 도와주셔서 정말 감사드립니다!

		{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_22')

	--가게 직원(left,smile,idle) : 원하시는대로 빵을 골라오면 공짜로 드리죠!

		nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_23')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
		'bomb_idle', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_25')

	--파티 변경 리더 프리렌-  2슈타르크- 3에일리
	self:party_setting({
		frieren,
		stark,
		ailie,
	})

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--메인 마커 위치 창고안에 있다면 (238,-27.5) 로 변경

		{ zone = 'dessert_shop_field', target = self.marker.employee_shop_pos + vector(-2, 0, -2) },

	self.current_state = self.states.clear_puzzle

	--가게 직원(left,smile,idle) 원라인 상태 : 원하시는대로 빵을 골라오면 공짜로 드리죠!
	employee.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_frieren_dessert_shop_23'

	local puff_pos = self.marker.puff_pos

	local succubus_kid = self.character.succubus_kid
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus_kid)
	succubus_kid.Position = puff_pos + vector(1, 0, 3)
	character_util.set_direction(succubus_kid, 'up')

	local fern = self.character.fern
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fern)
	fern.Position = puff_pos + vector(-1, 0, -3)
	character_util.set_direction(fern, 'right')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryFrierenElfFraternityController
	self.controller = controller

	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_frieren'
