	local medal_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = 21464,
		pos = member_1.Position + vector(0.4, 0.4, 0),
		unique_id = 'main_s11_medal',
		unique_id = 'main_s11_medal',
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
		spr_scale = 0.6
	})

	--모험가1(right,attack,push):이게 바로… 용사의 증표!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'push', keep = true },
			'attack',
			'ss_frieren_main_s11_37')

	--모험가2(right,idle,release회):우리가 해낸 거야…! 모두가 정복하지 못했던 던전을 공략해냈다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_2, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_38')

	--모험가2(right,idle,success):이제 우리는 모두에게 인정받는 진짜 용사가 된 거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_2, self, 'right',
			'success', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_39')

	--모험가3(left,idle,nod2회):다들 정말 수고 많았어! 기념으로 한잔하러 가자고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_3, self, 'left',
			'nod', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_40')

	--젊은 헬드(left,tired,idle): …있잖아, 다들.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_41')

	--젊은 헬드(left,tired,bomb_idle): 정말 그걸로 괜찮은 거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_42')

	--모험가1의 손에 증표 스프라이트 사라짐
	quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(medal_item)
	character_util.remove_anim(member_1)

	--모험가1(right,idle,relesae2회): 갑자기 무슨 소리야, 헬드?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_43')

	--젊은 헬드(left,tired,cast):던전 정복이 우선이랍시고... 우린 동료를 버리고 왔어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'left',
			'cast', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_44')

	--젊은 헬드(left,attack,idle):우리의… 소중한 동료였다고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'ss_frieren_main_s11_45')

	--젊은 헬드(left,tired,relesae2회):정복을 포기하고 서둘러 그를 구했다면… 충분히 살릴 수 있었을 텐데…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'ss_frieren_main_s11_46')

	--모험가3(left,idle,idle)(jump1회):그 얘기는 더 이상 안 하기로 했잖아!
	character_util.normal_jump(member_3, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_3, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_47')

	--모험가2(right,idle,cross_arm):순진한 소리 하지마, 헬드. 던전에선 늘 있는 일이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_2, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_48')

	--모험가2(right,idle,idle):누군가는 나아가야 돼. 우린 앞으로도 그럴 거고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_2, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_49')

	--모험가1(right,idle,bomb_idle):성공하지 못하면 결국 아무도 인정해 주지 않아, 헬드.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_1, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_50')

	--모험가1(right,idle,nod2회):우리가 버려야 했던 건... 필요했던 일이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(member_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_51')

	--젊은 헬드(left,tired,idle):…….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_52')

	--젊은 헬드(left,tired,idle):난 더 이상 이 파티에 있고 싶지 않아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s11_53')

	--젊은 헬드(left,tired,bomb_idle): 이 증표도… 필요 없어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle',
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'ss_frieren_main_s11_54')

	--아래 동작 동시에
	do
		local target_pos = held.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 20

		--젊은 헬드 속도4로 (walk)애니메이션 사용 우측으로 계속 이동
		wp_util.move(held, target_pos, 4)
	end

	--화면 shake 0.1 /0.5초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	--모험가1(right,idle,idle)(jump1회): 어이! 헬드!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(member_1, '01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(member_1, {
		key = 'ss_frieren_main_s11_55',
		skip = false,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		keep_display = true,
		type_speed = 0,
	})

	--헬드 출발 2초후
	wait_for_sec(2)

	amb_sfx:FadeOut(1)

	--페이드 아웃 1초
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(member_1)

	character_util.stop(held)

	self.grading_controller:detach()

	-- 스크린 플레이 상태로의 전환은 stop 호출 프레임의 lateUpdate에서 실행될 것
	-- 파괴가 먼저 되어버리면 나중에 GC에서 걸러질 때 오류가 발생할 수 있다...
	coroutine.yield()
end

function local_class:ailie_disappeared_scene()
	local tanker = self.character.tanker()
	local frieren = self.character.frieren()
	local fern = self.character.fern()
	local stark = self.character.stark()
	local held = self.character.held()

	do
		local blackout_pos = vector(500, 0, 0)

		camera_util.set_position(blackout_pos)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black)

		--화면 shake 0.1 / 0.5초
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

		--검은 화면에 말꼬리 없는 대사 출력 (화자: 크레이그)
		--( 0.5 x 0.5 ) [shout]다들! 큰일이야!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(tanker, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_92', nil, {
			world_pos = blackout_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, -1.5),
		})

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black)
	end

	--NPC배치
	do
		local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s11_ailie_disappeared_align_pivot')
		local member_pivot = pivot + unity_class.vector3.forward * 13

		--(1)프리렌(down,idle,idle)(186.5,-44)
		character_util.set_position(frieren, member_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left)
		character_util.set_direction(frieren, direction_constants.down)

		--(2)페른(down,idle,idle)(187.5,-44)
		character_util.set_position(fern, member_pivot)
		character_util.set_direction(fern, direction_constants.down)

		--(3)슈타르크(down,idle,idle)(188.5,-44)
		character_util.set_position(stark, member_pivot + unity_class.vector3.right)
		character_util.set_direction(stark, direction_constants.down)

		--(4)헬드(right,idle,push)(187,-57)
		character_util.set_position(held, pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5)
		character_util.set_direction(held, direction_constants.right)
		scene_util.set_anim(held, self, 'push')

		--(5)크레이그(left,idle,idle)(188,-57)
		character_util.set_position(tanker, pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5)
		character_util.set_direction(tanker, direction_constants.left)
	end

	--헬드 손에 해당 스프라이트가 들려있다.
	local paper_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = 21460,
		pos = held.Position + vector(0.35, 0.4, 0),
		unique_id = 'main_s11_ailie_paper',
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter
	})

	--카메라 크레이그 위치
	camera_util.set_position(tanker.Position)

	--하단 동작 동시에
	--프리렌,페른,슈타르크 (run)애니메이션으로 2초간 하단 12칸 이동
	do
		local members = {
			frieren,
			fern,
			stark,
		}

		local duration = 2

		for _, member in pairs(members) do
			local target_pos = vector(member.Position.x, 0, tanker.Position.z + 1)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, nil, duration, self, nil, {
				run = true,
				play_sfx = true,
				last_direction = direction_constants.down
			})
		end
	end

	--화면 페이드인에 환경음 볼륨 0.8로 재생, 믹스 5초
	local amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_room_01', volume = 0.8, fade_in_time = 5, loop = true
	})

	--페이드 인 1초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--프리렌,페른,슈타르크 도착후 (down,idle,idle)
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--슈타르크(down,attack,relesae2회):크레이그? 무슨 일이야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'ss_frieren_main_s11_93')

	--크레이그(left,attack,release2회): 이걸 봐!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'ss_frieren_main_s11_94')

	--나레이션 박스
	--「미안, 난 할아버지가 위독한 모습을 이대로 두고 볼 순 없어.
	--할아버지를 구할 약초를 찾기 위해 저번에 봤던 파티랑 던전에 다녀올게.」
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({
		key = 'ss_frieren_main_s11_95'
	})

	--위와 함께 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 재생, 믹스 3초
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'event', name = 'bgm_occult', volume = 0.6, mix = 3
	})

	--프리렌(down,idle,idle): 이건….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
			'question', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_96')

	--페른(down,tired,idle):저희가 자는 사이 에일리 씨가 몰래 혼자 나간 모양이에요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'down',
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s11_97')

	--페른(down,idle,idle):저번에 봤던 파티라면… 크레이그 씨를 모욕했던 그 사람들이랑 같이….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_98')

	--헬드 손에 스프라이트 사라짐
	quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(paper_item)

	character_util.remove_anim(held)

	--헬드(right,damaged,idle):에일리… 우리 손녀가…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'right',
			nil, 'damaged', 'ss_frieren_main_s11_99')

	--슈타르크(down,attack,idle):에일리 녀석… 아무리 급하다 해도 그렇지…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_100')

	--슈타르크(down,attack,cast):녀석들이 무슨 짓을 할 줄 알고…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'down',
			'cast', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_101')

	--프리렌(down,sleep_deep,idle):…헬드.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'ss_frieren_main_s11_102')

	--프리렌(down,idle,idle):에일리가 말했던 약초 말인데, 정말로 있는 거 맞아?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_103')

	--헬드(right,tired,idle):…….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_104')

	--헬드(right,tired,cast):…그런 약초는 존재하지 않습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'right',
			'cast', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_105')

	--헬드(right,tired,bomb_idle):아마도… 와전된 기록이었을 테죠….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_106')

	--프리렌(down,idle,idle):…역시.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_107')

	--슈타르크(down,attack,release2회):이럴 때가 아니야…! 빨리 에일리를 구하러 가자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_108')

	--페른(down,idle,nod2회):그게 좋겠어, 서두르자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'down',
			'nod', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_109')

	character_util.remove_emotion(held)

	--헬드(up,idle,idle):프리렌 님… 에일리를… 부디 부탁합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_110')

	--헬드(up,idle,release):제게 하나뿐인 소중한 손녀입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, 'up',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_111')

	--프리렌(down,idle,nod2회): 응. 꼭 무사히 데려올게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'down',
			'nod', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_112')

	character_util.remove_emotion(stark)

	--컨트롤 복귀에 BGM 볼륨 1로 전환, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field', volume = 1
	})

	amb_sfx:FadeOut(4)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	--컨트롤 해제
end

function local_class:before_enter_dungeon_scene()
	local tanker = self.character.tanker()
	local frieren = self.character.frieren()
	local fern = self.character.fern()
	local stark = self.character.stark()

	--컨트롤 뺏길 때 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	do
		local entrance = self.get_dungeon_entrance()
		local pivot = vector(entrance.Bounds.center.x, 0, entrance.Bounds.min.z - 0.5)

		--던전 입구 오브젝트 인터렉트 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
		--각 캐릭터 1초에 걸쳐 up 방향으로 상단의 이미지 위치에 맞게 정렬.
		--프리렌,페른은 right 방향, 슈타르크/크레이그는 left 방향 전환.
		self.controller.common_util:align_party_async(pivot, 1, direction_constants.right, {
			[frieren] = {
				offset = vector(-0.5, 0, -1),
			},
			[fern] = {
				offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			},
			[tanker] = {
				offset = vector(0.5, 0, -1),
				direction = direction_constants.left
			},
			[stark] = {
				offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				direction = direction_constants.left
			},
		})
	end

	--프리렌(right,idle,idle): 이제 최심부까지 얼마 남지 않았어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_113')

	--프리렌(right,idle,nod2회):안에서 에일리가 무사할진 가봐야 알겠지만….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'right',
			'nod', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_114')

	--크레이그(left,attack,idle):다른 파티가 에일리와 같이 들어갔다면, 그들도 분명 지하 3층 쪽을 공략 중이겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_115')

	--크레이그(left,attack,release2회):그들이 먼저 던전을 정복하기 전에 서둘러야 해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_116')

	character_util.remove_emotion(tanker)

	--페른(right,idle,nod2회):내려가죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'right',
			'nod', nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s11_117')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryFrierenMainController

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능

		none = 1,

		frieren = function()
			return get_character('frieren')

			return get_character('fern')
		end,
		stark = function()
			return get_character('stark')
		end,
		tanker = function()
			return get_character('dungeon_tanker')
		end,
		ailie = function()
			return get_character('ailie')
		end,
		boss = function()

			return get_field_object('dungeon_3_wall_' .. number)
		end,
		paper = function()
			return get_field_object('dungeon_3_paper')
		end
	}

	self.marker = {
		party_marker = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker('dungeon_3_boss_room_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		boss_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('dungeon_3_boss_pos')
		end,
		holdable_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('store_item_pos_dungeon_3_6')
		end,
		sign_board_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('store_sign_board_pos_dungeon_3_6')
		end,
		puzzle_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('dungeon_3_puzzle_pos')
		end,
	}

	self.dungeon_sprite = setmetatable({
		paper_sprite_id = 21501,
		paper_sprite = nil,
	}, {
		__index = {
			add_paper_sprite = function(this, pos)
				if this.paper_sprite ~= nil then
					return
				end

				this.paper_sprite = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = this.paper_sprite_id,
					pos = pos,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter
				})
			end,
			dispose = function(this)
				if this.paper_sprite ~= nil then
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.paper_sprite)

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.common_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Util')

	self:setting_boss()
	self:setting_holdable()
	self.controller.dungeon_in_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		start_coroutine(self.controller.dungeon_in_event, self.controller, 'dungeon_3')
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('village_to_dungeon_entrance_exit') },
		{ zone = 'dungeon_entrance_field', target = self.controller.dungeon_in_door() }
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.dungeon_sprite:dispose()
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
	self.controller.dungeon_in_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.common_util = nil
	self.store = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region on_event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.dungeon_in_door()) then
		start_coroutine(self.controller.dungeon_in_event, self.controller, 'dungeon_3')

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo.dungeon_out_stair()) then
		start_coroutine(self.controller.dungeon_out_event, self.controller)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo.holdable()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.buy_puzzle_item, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.boss_zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.states.boss_battle
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })
			self:start_boss_battle()
			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.boss_battle and e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_zone_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_clear
		self.controller:hide_party_joinable_field_ui_character_stats()

		start_coroutine(self.clear_boss_battle, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'dungeon_activity_fail' then
		self:fail_dungeon()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local switch_count = 2

	for i = 1, switch_count do
		if not self.check_switch[i] and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.fo.switch(i)) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.switch_on_event, self, i)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local wall_count = 2

	for i = 1, wall_count do
		local wall = self.fo.wall(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, wall) and
				e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap then
			wall.Transform:Find('OFF').gameObject:SetActive(false)
			wall.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			self.fx.smoke():Instantiate(wall.Position)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_rock_break_02', play_pos = wall.Position })
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion on_event

--region setting
function local_class:setting_boss()
	local boss = self.characters.boss()
	character_util.set_position(boss, self.marker.boss_pos())
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, 70 - 1)
	boss.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(exp)
end

function local_class:setting_holdable()
	local is_create
	is_create, self.store = global_table_util.try_get('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Dungeon/Store.lua')

	local holdable = self.fo.holdable()
	local sign_board = self.fo.sign_board()

	holdable.Position = self.marker.holdable_pos()
	sign_board.Position = self.marker.sign_board_pos()

	if not self.store.resource_save_data:check_has_item(self.holdable_item_key) then
		holdable.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
		holdable.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		sign_board.Interactable.Message = game_string:Format('ss_frieren_dungeon_gunpowder', self.holdable_gold)

	else
		sign_board.Interactable.Message = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_sold_out'
	end

	self.dungeon_sprite:add_paper_sprite(self.fo.paper().Position)

	if self.store.resource_save_data:check_has_item(self.puzzle_key) then
		local wall_count = 2

		for i = 1, wall_count do
			self.check_switch[i] = true

			self.fo.wall(i).Transform:Find('OFF').gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.fo.wall(i).CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

			command_util.publish_burn(user_party.Leader, self.fo.brazier(i))
		end
	end
end
--endregion setting

function local_class:buy_puzzle_item()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local seller = self.characters.seller()
	local holdable = self.fo.holdable()
	local sign_board = self.fo.sign_board()
	local offsets = {
		vector(-0.5, 0, -0.7),
		vector(0.5, 0, -0.7),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -1.4),
		vector(0.5, 0, -1.4),
	}

	local align_party_members = {}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		align_party_members[user_party[i]] = { offset = offsets[i] }
	end

	-- 각 아이템 위치에 따라 리더 캐릭터 0.5초에 걸쳐 up 방향으로 정렬.
	self.common_util:align_party_async(holdable.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.5, 'up', align_party_members)

	--나레이션 박스 출력
	--해당 아이템을 구매하겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_1' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy) 구매한다.
		{ 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_2', 'mercy' },
		--(brutal) 구매하지 않는다.
		{ 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_3', 'brutal' }
	})

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	if choose_result == 2 then
		return
	end

	local cur_gold = self.store:get_gold()
	if self.holdable_gold > cur_gold then
		--가지고 있는 골드가 부족합니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_4' })
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')
	self.store.resource_save_data:add_item(self.holdable_item_key)
	self.store:add_gold_and_save(-self.holdable_gold)

	holdable.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	holdable.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	sign_board.Interactable.Message = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_sold_out'

	command_util.publish_holdup(leader, holdable, leader.Position, nil, true)

	--상인 (left, smile, seat) : 거래 성사! 몸 조심히 가라고.
	character_util.set_emotion(seller, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_6')

	--대사 이후 idle 표정으로 변경.
	character_util.remove_emotion(seller)
end

function local_class:start_boss_battle()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 5 })

	local boss = self.characters.boss()

	do
		local wp_key = 'dungeon_party_wp'

		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]
			local marker = self.marker.party_marker(i)

			character_util.set_immortal(member, true)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, marker.position, nil,
					1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = marker.direction })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 보스 캐릭터 중앙으로 패닝.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(boss, 1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--보스전 타이틀 출력.
	screen_util.show_boss_title('ss_frieren_dungeon_boss_3_title',
			'ss_frieren_dungeon_boss_3_sub_title', 2, false)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 플레이어한테 원상 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.convert_to_monster(boss, self.boss_zone_name, self.boss_zone_name)
	command_util.publish_monster_notice(boss, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	-- battle gate close
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('dungeon_3_boss_battle_gate_1'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('dungeon_3_boss_battle_gate_2'))

	for i = 2, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]
		character_util.set_immortal(member, false)
	end

end

function local_class:clear_boss_battle()
	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	party_util.remove_animation()
	wait_for_sec(6)

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')

	--지하 3층 공략 완료!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')
	screen_util.show_stage_title('ss_frieren_dungeon_clear_3')
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('dungeon_3_boss_battle_gate_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('dungeon_3_boss_battle_gate_2', false))

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	self.controller.dungeon_controller:close_dungeon()

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local character = user_party[i]

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()

		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		heal_info.sender = character
		heal_info.target = character

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		scene_util.show_weapon(character)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

--- 던전 실패 시 처리
function local_class:fail_dungeon()
	local boss = self.characters.boss()

	--state 리셋
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- 보스 npc 변환
	character_util.convert_to_npc(boss)
	character_util.set_position(boss, self.marker.boss_pos())
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boss)
	character_util.set_direction(boss, 'down')

	-- 상태이상 게이지 초기화
	boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Down)
	boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison)
	boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial)
	-- 상태이상 초기화
	message_system:SendSync(boss, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
	-- 디버프 해제
	buff_manager:CureAllDebuffs(boss, boss)

	-- 보스 회복
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	heal_info.sender = boss
	heal_info.target = boss

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	message_system:SendSync(self.fo.holdable().FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

	-- battle gate open
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('dungeon_3_boss_battle_gate_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('dungeon_3_boss_battle_gate_2', false))
end

--- 플레이어가 스위치를 밟을 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
function local_class:switch_on_event(index)
	local center = self.marker.puzzle_pos()
	local brazier = self.fo.brazier(index)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--카메라는 ■타일을 포커스한채로 1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	camera_util.move_async(center, 0.2)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--고정 화로에 불이 들어옴.
	command_util.publish_burn(user_party.Leader, brazier)

	self.check_switch[index] = true

	--고정 화로에 모두 불을 붙였을 경우
	if self.check_switch[1] and self.check_switch[2] then
		self.store.resource_save_data:add_item(self.puzzle_key)
		self.store:force_all_data_save()
		--2개의 도어 FullOpening 으로 보여줌.
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--카메라는 다시 플레이어(리더 캐릭터)를 포커스.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.2)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
end


return local_class

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fr_souls_white_start')
		end,
		trail_change = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fr_souls_white_change')
		end,
		trail_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fr_souls_white_end')
		end,
	}

	self.background_util = {
		controller = nil,

		load_resource = function(this)
			this.controller = global_table_util.get_or_create_background_fade_controller()

			local asset_path = 'ondemand/short_story_frieren/effects'
			local asset_name = 'white_tint_background'
			this.controller:load_async(asset_path, asset_name)
		end,

		set_position = function(this, pos)
			this.controller:set_background_position(pos)
		end,

		set_color = function(this, rgb_vector3)
			this.controller:set_background_color(rgb_vector3.x, rgb_vector3.y, rgb_vector3.z)
		end,

		set_active = function(this, boolean)
			this.controller:set_background_active(boolean)
		end,

		fade_in_async = function(this, duration, fade_value)
			local time_passed = 0
			local value = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_value, 1)

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(time_passed / duration, value)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end,

		fade_out_async = function(this, duration)
			local time_passed = 0

			local value = this.controller.background_renderer.color.a

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(value - time_passed)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함

	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	do
		-- 에일리 세팅
		local ailie = self.controller.npc.ailie()
		ailie.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_ailie_pos')

		field_object_util.set_active_state(ailie, active_state_type.enabled)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ailie)
		scene_util.set_direction(ailie, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(ailie, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(ailie, self, 'prostrate')
	end

	do
		-- 슬라임 세팅
		local slime = self.npc.slime()

		slime.Position = vector(191.5, 0, -181.5)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(slime, active_state_type.enabled)
		scene_util.set_direction(slime, 'right', false)
	end

	do
		local aura = self.npc.aura()

		-- 아우라 틴트 및 작게해둠
		aura.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(aura, active_state_type.enabled)
		scene_util.set_direction(aura, 'right', false)
		character_util.add_color(aura, aura.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_scale(aura, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0)
	end

	do
		-- 모험가 4명 세팅
		local conqueror_party_count = 4

		for i = 1, conqueror_party_count do
			local member = self.npc.conqueror_party(i)
			member.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_conqueror_pos_' .. i)

			local dir = i % 2 == 0 and 'right' or 'left'
			scene_util.set_direction(member, dir, false)

			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(member, self, 'prostrate')

			field_object_util.set_active_state(member, active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(self.start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.current_state <= self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's13_ailie_event_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.show_ailie
		start_coroutine(self.show_prostrate_ailie, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.show_ailie and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's13_boss_event_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.ending
		start_coroutine(self.meet_dungeon_boss, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	local frieren = self.controller.npc.frieren()
	local fern = self.controller.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.controller.npc.stark()
	local tanker = self.controller.npc.dungeon_tanker()

	-- 최초 화면 페이드 아웃 되어 있는 상태
	local camera_pos = vector(242, 0, -181.5)

	-- 카메라는 플레이어(프리렌) 포커스중.
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local character = user_party[i]

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()

		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		heal_info.sender = character
		heal_info.target = character

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local character = user_party[i]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
		damage_info.sender = character
		damage_info.target = character
		damage_info.direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
		damage_info.noCritical = true
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.8)

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end

	local npc_list = { frieren, fern, tanker, stark }
	do
		-- 시작 정렬
		for i = 1, #npc_list do
			local npc = npc_list[i]
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'left', false)
			npc.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_first_scene_pos_' .. i)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'ondemand/short_story_frieren/audio:bgm_frieren_dungeon',
		state = 'field',
		volume = 0.6,
		mix = 3
	})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 페이드 인 되는 동시에 프리렌, 페른, 슈타르크, 크레이그 2초에 걸쳐 left 방향 walk 자세로 4칸 이동.
	local move_key = 's13_move_key'

	for i = 1, #npc_list do
		local npc = npc_list[i]
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position - vector(4, 0, 0),
				nil, 2, self, move_key)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 페른 (left, idle, idle) : 최심부에 도착한 것 같네요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fern, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_1')

	-- 크레이그 (left, tired, cast) : …이제 정말 던전 정복까지 얼마 남지 않은 건가.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil, 'cast',
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_2')
	-- 대사 이후 tired 표정 유지.

	-- 프리렌 이동속도 값 1.5로 walk 자세로 1.5칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(frieren, frieren.Position - vector(1.5, 0, 0), nil, 1.5)

	-- 프리렌 머리 위에 (silence) 이모티콘 표시.
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(frieren, nil, 'silence')

	-- 프리렌 (right, idle, idle) : 인기척이 느껴져. 아무래도 안에서 보스와 전투 중인 것 같아.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(frieren, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_3')

	-- 크레이그 (left, attack, idle 자세로 jump 1회) : 분명 우리보다 먼저 갔던 파티 녀석들일 거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil, nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_4')

	-- 크레이그 (left, attack, release) : 놈들이 먼저 던전을 정복하기 전에 어서…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil, nil,
			'attack', 'ss_frieren_main_s13_5')

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.25)

	-- 프리렌 리더, 페른/슈타르크/크레이그 순으로 4인 파티원.
	-- 이후 메인 퀘스트 마커는 하단의 구역을 가리킴.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	sp_util.exit_scene({ show_weapon = false }, user_party.Leader)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- 쓰러져있는 에일리 확인 및 크레이그 파티 이탈
function local_class:show_prostrate_ailie()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	local frieren = self.controller.npc.frieren()
	local fern = self.controller.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.controller.npc.stark()
	local tanker = self.controller.npc.dungeon_tanker()
	local ailie = self.controller.npc.ailie()
	local held = self.controller.npc.held()

	held.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(held, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(held, 0, 0)
	scene_util.set_direction(held, 'left', false)
	held.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)

	-- 플레이어가 강제 트리거 존 진입 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.

	-- 프리렌, 페른, 슈타르크, 크레이그 left 방향 전환.
	party_util.set_direction('left')

	-- 슈타르크 캐릭터만 (left, attack, jump 1회) 하며 머리 위에 (notice) 이모티콘 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(stark, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(stark, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(stark, nil, 'notice')

	-- 슈타르크 (left, attack, release) : 저길 봐!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, nil, 'release',
			nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_6')
	-- 대사 이후 attack 표정 유지.

	-- 카메라 0.7초에 걸쳐 ●지점으로 패닝.
	local camera_pos = ailie.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.7)

	-- 0.8초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	character_util.remove_emotion(stark)

	-- 캐릭터들 정렬/이동 이벤트 동시 진행.
	local move_key = 's13_move_end_key'

	-- 프리렌, 페른, 슈타르크는 left 방향 run 자세로 이동속도 값 6으로 left 방향 3칸 이동.
	local npc_list = { frieren, fern, nil, stark }

	do
		-- 시작 정렬
		for i = 1, #npc_list do
			local npc = npc_list[i]

			if npc ~= nil then
				local z = i == 1 and 0.5 or 0
				local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_ailie_scene_pos_' .. i) - vector(2.5, 0, z)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, pos, 6, nil, self,
						move_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'left', end_callback = function()
							scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'tired')
						end })
			end
		end
	end

	-- 크레이그는 left 방향 run 자세로 이동속도 값 6으로 에일리 캐릭터 왼쪽 1칸 옆으로 정렬.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(tanker, ailie.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			6, nil, self,
			move_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'left', play_sfx = true })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 크레이그 (left, tired, walk4legs 정지 자세) : 에일리!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			{ name = 'walk4legs', loop = false, keep = true, scale = 0 },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'ss_frieren_main_s13_7')

	-- 크레이그 (left, tired, walk4legs 정지 자세) : 괜찮은 거야?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(tanker, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_8')
	-- 대사 이후에도 (left, tired, walk4legs 정지 자세) 유지.

	-- 에일리 (right, damaged, prostrate) 자세로 0.03값 shake 1초
	scene_util.normal_shake(ailie, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 에일리 (right, damaged, prostrate) : 으윽… 크, 크레이그 아저씨….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ailie, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_9')
	-- 대사 이후에도 (right, damaged, prostrate) 유지.

	-- 크레이그 (left, tired, walk4legs 정지 자세) : 어떻게 된 거야, 다른 파티랑 같이 같었다며!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(tanker, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_10')
	-- 대사 이후에도 (left, tired, walk4legs 정지 자세) 유지.

	-- 에일리 (right, damaged, prostrate) : 그, 그게… 보스 방 앞에 있던 함정을 밟아 버렸어….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ailie, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_11')

	-- 에일리 (right, damaged, prostrate) : 다친 난 더 이상 필요 없다고… 여기에 버리고 보스가 있는 방으로….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ailie, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_12')
	-- 대사 이후에도 (right, damaged, prostrate) 유지.

	-- 크레이그 (left, tired, walk4legs 정지 자세) : 에일리….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(tanker, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_13')
	-- 대사 이후에도 (left, tired, walk4legs 정지 자세) 유지.

	-- 에일리 (right, damaged, prostrate) : 미안해 모두들… 내가… 혼자서 멋대로….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ailie, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_14')
	-- 대사 이후에도 (right, damaged, prostrate) 유지.

	-- 크레이그 (left, tired, idle) : ……
	character_util.remove_anim(tanker)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(tanker, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_15')

	-- 프리렌 sleep_deep 표정으로 변환
	scene_util.set_emotion(frieren, self, 'sleep_deep')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_group_emotion({ fern, stark })

	-- 프리렌 (left, idle, idle) : 헬드가 했던 말을 기억해, 크레이그?
	character_util.remove_emotion(frieren)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(frieren, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_16')

	-- 크레이그 (right, tired, idle) : 프리렌….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, 'right', nil, nil,
			'ss_frieren_main_s13_17')

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local fade_character = { frieren, fern, stark, ailie }

	for i = 1, #fade_character do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fade_character[i], 0, 1)
	end

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 크레이그 캐릭터를 제외한 화면 및 다른 캐릭터들 모두 암전.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.3, 4)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	self.background_util:set_position(tanker.Position)
	self.background_util:set_color(vector(0, 0, 0))
	self.background_util:set_active(true)

	self.background_util:fade_in_async(1)

	-- ●지점에 헬드 NPC (left, idle, idle) 1초에 걸쳐 투명도 0.6 값으로 나타나는 연출 진행.
	local water_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_water_loop_05', fade_in_time = 4, volume = 0.5, loop = true })

	held.Position = tanker.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(held, 0.8, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 헬드 (left, idle, nod 1회) : 검은 정직하단다, 크레이그. 네 마음이 바라보는 것을 함께 바라보지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(held, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_18')

	-- 헬드 (left, idle, idle) : 쟁취해야 할 것만을 바라보다가 진정 바라보아야 할 것을 놓치지는 말거라.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(held, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_19')

	-- 헬드 캐릭터 1초에 걸쳐 투명도 0 값으로 사라지는 동시에 화면 1초에 걸쳐 암전 풀리고 원상 복귀.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(held, 0, 1)

	for i = 1, #fade_character do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(fade_character[i], 1, 1)
	end

	water_loop_sfx:FadeOut(3)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 3)
	self.background_util:fade_out_async(1)
	self.background_util:set_active(false)

	held.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(held, 1, 0)
	held.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(held, active_state_type.disabled)

	-- 크레이그 (right, sleep_deep, idle) : ……
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil, nil,
			{ name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_20')

	-- 대기 0.8초
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 크레이그 (right, attack, nod 1회) : 지금 내가 봐야 할 건… 지켜야 할 것이겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_main_s13_21')

	-- 크레이그 (left, attack, eat) 자세 1초
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_direction(tanker, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(tanker, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 크레이그 hold 자세로 왼쪽 옆에 있는 에일리 캐릭터 머리 위에 듬.
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(tanker)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	command_util.publish_holdup(tanker, ailie, tanker.Position, nil, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 크레이그 (right, attack, hold) : 프리렌, 던전 공략을 마저 부탁할게.

function local_class:move_target_bezier_curve(move_data_list, cycle, is_scale_changed)
	for i = 1, #move_data_list do
		local point_list = move_data_list[i].point

		local calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()
		local curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear

		if #point_list == 3 then
			curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
		elseif #point_list == 4 then
			curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
		end

		local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		for j = 1, #point_list do
			list:Add(point_list[j])
		end

		calculator:Add(list, cycle, curve_type)
		move_data_list[i].calculator = calculator
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local to = 0.2
	local from = 1

	while time_passed < cycle do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		for i = 1, #move_data_list do
			local trail = move_data_list[i].trail
			local cur_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

			local calculator = move_data_list[i].calculator
			calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			cur_pos = calculator.CurrentPosition

			trail.transform.position = cur_pos

			if is_scale_changed then
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, cycle)
				trail.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

	self.fx_list = nil

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			medal = 21464,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Etc
	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.main_quest_id = 7001901

function local_class:fourth_scene()
	local frieren = self.get_character.frieren()
	local fern = self.get_character.fern()
	local stark = self.get_character.stark()
	local craig = self.get_character.craig()
	local ailie = self.get_character.ailie()
	local held = self.get_character.held()

	--화면 페이드 아웃 된 채로 카메라는 ● 지점 포커스중. ← ● 지점 현재보다 위쪽으로 1칸 이동

	--1.5초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--0.5초 대기

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ailie)

	--에일리 이동속도 값 5 run 자세로 left 방향 1.5칸, up 방향 3.5칸 이동 이후 (down, smile, idle) 자세 전환.

function local_class:ending_scene()
	local frieren = self.get_character.frieren()
	local fern = self.get_character.fern()
	local stark = self.get_character.stark()
	local craig = self.get_character.craig()

			nil,
			'ss_frieren_main_s15_92')

			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },

			nil,
			nil,

	self:heal_target(frieren)
	self:heal_target(fern)
	self:heal_target(stark)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	--프리렌 리더, 페른/슈타르크 순으로 3인 파티원.

	--크레이크 무기 활성화
	scene_util.show_weapon(craig)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 3)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	self.controller:progress_section()
end

function local_class:heal_target(target)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()

	heal_info.sender = target
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active

	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			medal = 21464,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	--region Etc
	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.main_quest_id = 7001901

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:all_npc_wait_pos()

		self.get_character.frieren(),
		self.get_character.fern(),
		self.get_character.stark(),
		self.get_character.ailie(),
		self.get_character.held(),
		self.get_character.craig(),
		self.get_character.camera_npc(),
	}

	for idx = 1, #npc_list do
		npc_list[idx].Position = self.wait_pos
	end
end

function local_class:set_field_routine()
	-- 땜빵
	field_object_util.set_active_state(get_character('sub_part_time_master'), active_state_type.disabled)

	self:check_sub_event_clear_info()
	self:create_dynamic_npcs_async()

	if self.sub_event_cleard_info:is_any_cleared() then
		self.current_state = self.states.met_succubus

		self:set_npcs_with_data({
			-- 마을 주민 1(right, idle, idle) (71, 0, -36)
			{
				fo = self.characters.civil_1,
				dir = 'right',
				pos = vector(65, 0, -16) 
			},
			-- 마을 주민 2 (right, idle, idle) (72, 0, -36)
			{
				fo = self.characters.civil_2,
				dir = 'right',
				pos = vector(65, 0, -17)
			},
		})

		self:set_town_hall_event_oneline()

		if not self.sub_event_cleard_info[self.sub_event_quest_id.magic_tool_shop] then
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_magic_tool_shop', {})
		end

		if not self.sub_event_cleard_info[self.sub_event_quest_id.dessert_shop] then
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_desert_shop', {})
		end

		-- 만약 두 서브 퀘스트를 클리어했었다면, 재 접속시 마지막 이벤트 부터 시작
		if self.sub_event_cleard_info:is_all_cleared() then
			self.is_starting_from_this_section = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.sp_cleared_both_sub_events, self, self.sub_event_quest_id.magic_tool_shop)
		end

		return
	end
	
	self:set_npcs()
	self:set_quest_marker()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.characters.succubus)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.both_quest_cleared then
		local is_dessert_shop_exit = type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.dessert_shop_exit)
		local is_magic_tool_shop_exit = type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.magic_tool_shop_exit)

		if is_dessert_shop_exit or is_magic_tool_shop_exit then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
			sp_util.start_scene(self.sp_cleared_both_sub_events, self, self.last_cleared_quest_id)
			self:reset_exit_interactable()
		end
	
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.going_to_izakaya then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.izakaya_exit) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.sp_entered_izakaya, self)
			self:reset_exit_interactable()
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.met_tanker then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.izakaya_table) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.sp_take_a_seat, self)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.going_to_dungeon then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.dungeon_exit) then
			start_coroutine(self.sp_entering_dungeon, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self:check_has_entered_path_blocking_area(e, leader)

	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_town_hall_event') then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.sp_town_hall_event, self)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.town_hall then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader , 's3_met_succubus_event') then
			self.current_state = self.states.met_succubus
			sp_util.start_scene(self.sp_met_succubus, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_has_entered_path_blocking_area(e, leader)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_blocking_area_1_right') then
		local has_not_cleared_both_sub = self.current_state ~= self.states.going_to_dungeon
		local is_not_watching_path_blocking_scene = not self.is_watching_path_blocking_scene

		if has_not_cleared_both_sub and is_not_watching_path_blocking_scene then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.sp_path_blocking, self, e.Zone.Name)
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_blocking_area_5_right') then
		local has_met_succubus = self.current_state == self.states.met_succubus
		local is_not_watching_path_blocking_scene = not self.is_watching_path_blocking_scene

		if has_met_succubus and is_not_watching_path_blocking_scene then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.sp_path_blocking, self, e.Zone.Name)
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.sub_event_quest_id.dessert_shop or
		e.QuestId == self.sub_event_quest_id.magic_tool_shop then

		self.sub_event_cleard_info[e.QuestId] = true
		self:add_quest_marker_if_both_sub_event_cleared(e.QuestId)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:sp_path_blocking(zone_name)
	local dir_vec = switch(zone_name:match('%w+$'), {
		['right'] = vector(1, 0, 0),
		['left'] = vector(-1, 0, 0),
		['up'] = vector(0, 0, 1),
		['down'] = vector(0, 0, -1),
	})

	local reaction = switch(zone_name, {
		--에일리: 거긴 던전 방향이야! 마을 안 쪽으로 가자!
		['s3_blocking_area_1_right'] = 'ss_frieren_main_path_blocking_1',
		--에일리: 크레이그 아저씨 쪽에 가기엔 지금 많이 바쁠 거야.
		['s3_blocking_area_5_right'] = 'ss_frieren_main_path_blocking_2',
	})

	self.is_watching_path_blocking_scene = true

	-- 에일리: 어디 가는 거야? 둘러볼 곳은 저기야!
	-- 0.5칸 0.5초간 존 반대쪽으로 뒷걸음질

	local ailie = self.characters.ailie
	
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ailie, reaction)

	-- 0.5칸 0.5초간 존 반대쪽으로 뒷걸음질
	-- 바라보고 있는 방향의 반대 방향으로 감
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local moving_dist = 0.5

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'walk')
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + (dir_vec * moving_dist), nil, 0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader())

	self.is_watching_path_blocking_scene = false
end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civil_1, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s3_8')

	--모험가 1 (right, doyagao, idle):뭐, 이번 던전 공략도 초스피드로 끝내버리자고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(adventurer_1, self, 'right',
			nil, 'doyagao', 'ss_frieren_main_s3_9')

	-- 해당 동작 동시에	
	do
		-- 모험가 1, 2, 3, 4 속도 4로 좌측 4칸 이동 후 위로 쭉 올라간 후 그리드 밖에서 사라짐
		local function compute_wp_list(fo)
			return {
				fo.Position + vector(-9, 0, 0)
			}
		end

		local move_speed = 4
		local num_wp_finished = 0 

		linq(adventurers):foreach(function(_, adventurer)
			scene_util.set_anim(adventurer, self, 'walk')
			wp_util.move(adventurer, compute_wp_list(adventurer), move_speed, nil, {
				end_callback = function()
					num_wp_finished = num_wp_finished + 1
					character_util.remove_anim(adventurer)
					field_object_util.set_active_state(adventurer, active_state_type.disabled)
				end
			})
		end)

		-- 카메라 프리렌에게 1초간 복귀
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		while num_wp_finished < #adventurers do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--슈타르크 (left, tired, bomb_idle): 저녀석들 자만심이 장난 아니네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'left',
		'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s3_10')

	--아래 동작 동시에
	do
		--마을 사람 1, 마을 사람2 (left, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_group_direction({ civil_1, civil_2 }, 'right', false)

		--슈타르크 (right, sleep_deep, question) : 뭐 하는 놈들이지?
		music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01', '01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'left',
			'question', 'sleep_deep', 'ss_frieren_main_s3_11')
	end

	--마을 사람1 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 너, 모험가란 사람이 저 파티를 모른단 말이야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civil_1, self, 'right',
		'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s3_12')

	--마을 사람2 (right, idle, rlease2회) : 수단과 방법을 가리지 않고 빠른 던전 정복을 목표로 하는 파티라구.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civil_2, self, 'right',
		{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s3_13')

	--프리렌 (left, tired, idle) : 저런. 던전은 한층 한층 꼼꼼히 돌아보는 게 좋은 건데 말이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'left',
		nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s3_14')

	--에일리 (left, smile, idle) (jump1회) : 할아버지도 그렇게 말씀하셨어!
	character_util.normal_jump(ailie, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, 'left',
		nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_main_s3_15')

	--페른 (left, tired, idle) : 괜히 저 사람들이랑 엮여서 좋을건 없겠네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'left',
		nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s3_16')

	--아래 동작 동시에
	do
		--프리렌, 에일리, 페른, 슈타르크 (left, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_group_direction({ frieren, ailie, fern, stark }, 'left', false)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	end

	self:set_town_hall_event_oneline()

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name.main_quest, {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.characters.succubus },

function local_class:set_npcs_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local fo = data[i].fo
		local dir = data[i].dir
		local pos = data[i].pos
		local anim = data[i].anim
		local oneline = data[i].oneline

		character_util.set_position(fo, pos)
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)

		if anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, anim)
		end

		if oneline ~= nil then
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			fo.Interactable.Talk = oneline
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sp_entering_dungeon()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local tanker = self.characters.tanker
	local frieren = self.characters.frieren
	local fern = self.characters.fern
	local stark = self.characters.stark
	local ailie = self.characters.ailie

	-- 각 캐릭터 1초에 걸쳐 up 방향으로 상단의 이미지 위치에 맞게 정렬.
	local align_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_dungeon_align_center')
	self.common_util:align_party_async(align_center, 1, direction_constants.up, {
		[frieren] = {
			offset = vector(0, 0, -1)
		},
		[fern] = {
			offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 1)
		},
		[stark] = {
			offset = vector(0.5, 0, 1)
		},
		[ailie] = {
			offset = vector(1, 0, 0)
		},
		[tanker] = {
			offset = vector(-1, 0, 0)
		},
	})
	-- 프리렌, 페른, 크레이그는 right 방향, 슈타르크/에일리는 left 방향 전환.

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryFrierenMainSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryFrierenMain @
		Comment = 던전 1층 탐험@
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryFrierenMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능

	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		boss_battle = 2,
		battle_clear = 3
	}

	self.characters = {
		frieren = function()
			return get_character('frieren')
		end,
		fern = function()
			return get_character('fern')
		end,
		stark = function()
			return get_character('stark')
		end,
		tanker = function()
			return get_character('dungeon_tanker')
		end,
		ailie = function()
			return get_character('ailie')
		end,
		boss = function()
			return get_character('dungeon_1_boss')
		end,
		seller = function()
			return get_character('store_seller')
		end
	}

	self.fo = {
		dungeon_out_stair = function()
			return get_field_object('dungeon_1_exit')
		end,
		sign_board = function()
			return get_field_object('store_signboard_4')
		end,
		holdable = function()
			return get_field_object('dungeon_1_holdable')
		end,
		gargoyle = function()
			return get_field_object('dungeon_1_gagoyle')
		end
	}

	self.marker = {
		party_marker = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker('dungeon_1_boss_room_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		boss_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('dungeon_1_boss_pos')
		end,
		holdable_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('store_item_pos_dungeon_1_4')
		end,
		sign_board_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('store_sign_board_pos_dungeon_1_4')
		end
	}

	self.boss_zone_name = 'dungeon_1_boos_zone'

	self.puzzle_key = 'puzzle_1_clear'
	self.puzzle_check = false
	self.puzzle_zone = {
		'dungeon_1_puzzle_zone_1',
		'dungeon_1_puzzle_zone_2'
	}
	self.holdable_item_key = 'brazier_holdable'
	self.holdable_gold = 2000
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.common_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Util')

	self:setting_boss()
	self:setting_holdable()
	self.controller.dungeon_in_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		start_coroutine(self.controller.dungeon_in_event, self.controller, 'dungeon_1')
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('village_to_dungeon_entrance_exit') },
		{ zone = 'dungeon_entrance_field', target = self.controller.dungeon_in_door() }
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
	self.controller.dungeon_in_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.common_util = nil
	self.store = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.puzzle_zone = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region on_event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.dungeon_in_door()) then
		start_coroutine(self.controller.dungeon_in_event, self.controller, 'dungeon_1')

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo.dungeon_out_stair()) then
		start_coroutine(self.controller.dungeon_out_event, self.controller)

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.fo.holdable()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.buy_puzzle_item, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.puzzle_check and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.puzzle_zone[1]) then
		self.puzzle_check = true
		start_coroutine(self.check_puzzle_event, self)

		return true
	end


	if self.current_state == self.states.none
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.boss_zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.states.boss_battle
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })
			self:start_boss_battle()
			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.boss_battle and e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_zone_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_clear
		self.controller:hide_party_joinable_field_ui_character_stats()
		start_coroutine(self.clear_boss_battle, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'dungeon_activity_fail' then
		self:fail_dungeon()

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion on_event

--region setting
function local_class:setting_boss()
	local boss = self.characters.boss()
	character_util.set_position(boss, self.marker.boss_pos())
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, 60 - 1)
	boss.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(exp)
end

function local_class:setting_holdable()
	local is_create
	is_create, self.store = global_table_util.try_get('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Dungeon/Store.lua')

	local holdable = self.fo.holdable()
	local sign_board = self.fo.sign_board()

	holdable.Position = self.marker.holdable_pos()
	sign_board.Position = self.marker.sign_board_pos()

	if not self.store.resource_save_data:check_has_item(self.holdable_item_key) then
		holdable.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
		holdable.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		sign_board.Interactable.Message = game_string:Format('ss_frieren_dungeon_brazier_holdable', self.holdable_gold)
	else
		sign_board.Interactable.Message = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_sold_out'
	end

	if self.store.resource_save_data:check_has_item(self.puzzle_key) then
		self.puzzle_check = true
		self.fo.gargoyle().Position = self.fo.gargoyle().Position + vector(2, 0, 0)
	end
end
--endregion setting

function local_class:buy_puzzle_item()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local seller = self.characters.seller()
	local holdable = self.fo.holdable()
	local sign_board = self.fo.sign_board()
	local offsets = {
		vector(-0.5, 0, -0.7),
		vector(0.5, 0, -0.7),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -1.4),
		vector(0.5, 0, -1.4),
	}

	local align_party_members = {}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		align_party_members[user_party[i]] = { offset = offsets[i] }
	end

	-- 각 아이템 위치에 따라 리더 캐릭터 0.5초에 걸쳐 up 방향으로 정렬.
	self.common_util:align_party_async(holdable.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.5, 'up', align_party_members)

	--나레이션 박스 출력
	--해당 아이템을 구매하겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_1' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy) 구매한다.
		{ 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_2', 'mercy' },
		--(brutal) 구매하지 않는다.
		{ 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_3', 'brutal' }
	})

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	if choose_result == 2 then
		return
	end

	local cur_gold = self.store:get_gold()
	if self.holdable_gold > cur_gold then
		--가지고 있는 골드가 부족합니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_4' })
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')
	self.store.resource_save_data:add_item(self.holdable_item_key)
	self.store:add_gold_and_save(-self.holdable_gold)

	holdable.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	holdable.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	holdable.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_bounce_iron_02'

	sign_board.Interactable.Message = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_sold_out'

	command_util.publish_holdup(leader, holdable, leader.Position, nil, true)

	--상인 (left, smile, seat) : 거래 성사! 몸 조심히 가라고.
	character_util.set_emotion(seller, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_6')

	--대사 이후 idle 표정으로 변경.
	character_util.remove_emotion(seller)
end

--region 보스방 처리
function local_class:start_boss_battle()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 5 })

	local boss = self.characters.boss()

	message_system:SendSync(self.fo.holdable().FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

	do
		local wp_key = 'dungeon_party_wp'

		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]
			local marker = self.marker.party_marker(i)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, marker.position, nil,
					1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = marker.direction })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 보스 캐릭터 중앙으로 패닝.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(boss, 1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--보스전 타이틀 출력.
	screen_util.show_boss_title('ss_frieren_dungeon_boss_1_title',
			'ss_frieren_dungeon_boss_1_sub_title', 2, false)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 플레이어한테 원상 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.convert_to_monster(boss, self.boss_zone_name, self.boss_zone_name)
	command_util.publish_monster_notice(boss, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	-- battle gate close
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('dungeon_1_boss_battle_gate_1'))

	start_coroutine(function()
		coroutine.yield()

		local frieren = user_party[user_party.Count - 2]
		local ailie = user_party[user_party.Count - 1]

		character_util.teleport(ailie, frieren.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	end)
end

function local_class:clear_boss_battle()
	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	party_util.remove_animation()
	wait_for_sec(6)

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')

	--지하 1층 공략 완료!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')
	screen_util.show_stage_title('ss_frieren_dungeon_clear_1')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('dungeon_1_boss_battle_gate_1', false))

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	self.controller.dungeon_controller:close_dungeon()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.controller:progress_section()
end
--endregion 보스방 처리

--- 던전 실패 시 처리
function local_class:fail_dungeon()
	local boss = self.characters.boss()

	--state 리셋
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- 보스 npc 변환
	character_util.convert_to_npc(boss)
	character_util.set_position(boss, self.marker.boss_pos())
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boss)
	character_util.set_direction(boss, 'down')

	-- 상태이상 게이지 초기화
	boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Down)
	boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison)
	boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour:ResetGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial)
	-- 상태이상 초기화
	message_system:SendSync(boss, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
	-- 디버프 해제
	buff_manager:CureAllDebuffs(boss, boss)

	-- 보스 회복
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	heal_info.sender = boss
	heal_info.target = boss

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	message_system:SendSync(self.fo.holdable().FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

	-- battle gate open
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('dungeon_1_boss_battle_gate_1', false))
end

function local_class:check_puzzle_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local gargoyle = self.fo.gargoyle()
	local holdable = self.fo.holdable()
	local zone_bound = field:GetZone(self.puzzle_zone[2]).Bounds

	-- 불이 붙지 않았다면 종료
	if not holdable.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
		self.puzzle_check = false
		return
	end

	-- 존 안에 들어있지 않다면 종료
	if not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(zone_bound, holdable.Position) then
		self.puzzle_check = false
		return
	end

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	--1.5초에 걸쳐 wall_dun_gargoyle 오브젝트 중앙으로 카메라 패닝.
	camera_util.move_async(gargoyle.Position, 1.5)

	--대기 0.8초
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--wall_dun_gargoyle 오브젝트 2초에 걸쳐 오른쪽으로 2칸 이동.
	--이동하는 동안에 wall_dun_gargoyle 오브젝트 0.02값으로 shake.
	--이동을 멈추면 shake 정지.
	local rock_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_push_rock_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 0 })
	gargoyle:Shake(0.02, 2)
	character_util.move_to_async(gargoyle, gargoyle.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 2)

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 플레이어 한테 원상 복귀.
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(rock_sfx, 1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	self.store.resource_save_data:add_item(self.puzzle_key)
	self.store:force_all_data_save()

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.held_scene_before and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.object.held_house_entrance()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.held_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.sleep_before and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.object.frieren_bed()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.sleep_scene, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = self.npc.frieren()

	if self.current_state == self.states.breakfast_before and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's5_breakfast') then
		self.controller:hide_party_joinable_field_ui_character_stats()

		sp_util.start_scene(self.breakfast_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.sleep_before and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'main_s10_picture_blocking_3') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.block_house_exit_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.held_scene_before then

		for i = 1, #self.night_blocking_zone do
			local zone_name = self.night_blocking_zone[i].name
			local exit_direction = self.night_blocking_zone[i].direction
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, zone_name) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.block_night_village, self, zone_name, exit_direction)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

			frieren, direction_util.to_str(exit_direction), 1)
	local pos_diff = return_pos - frieren.Position

	local party_align_move_key = 'party_align'

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
