function local_class:sleep_scene()
	local frieren = self.npc.frieren()
	local frieren_pajamas = self.npc.frieren_pajamas()
	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local briefcase = self.npc.briefcase()
	local ailie = self.npc.ailie()

	--침대 퀘스트 마커 기준
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.sleep_pos(4)
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	--침대 인터랙트 시, BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값	bgm_frieren_field
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--플레이어 침대 오브젝트 인터렉트 시, 1초에 걸쳐 ■타일로 right 방향 정렬.
	local frieren_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1.5)
	frieren_pajamas.Position = frieren_pos
	camera_util.move(frieren_pos, 1, { end_target = frieren_pajamas })
	wp_util.move_async(frieren, frieren_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--프리렌(플레이어) (right, idle, eat) 자세 지속.
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_direction(frieren, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_emotion(frieren)
	scene_util.set_anim(frieren, self, 'eat')

	--화면 암전 준비
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_color(0, 0, 0)
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_active(true)
	self.background_fade_controller:set_background_sorting_order('Default', 0)

	--eat 자세 0.5초 지났을 때
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--프리렌의 right 방향 0.7칸 옆에 FX_dead 이펙트 출력되는 동시에 fox_mouse_knight (임시) 캐릭터 스파인 (left, idle, idle) 생성.
	local briefcase_pos = frieren_pos + vector(0.7, 0, 0)

	self.fx:dead():Instantiate(briefcase_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_ball_01')

	briefcase.Position = briefcase_pos
	field_object_util.set_active_state(briefcase, active_state_type.enabled)
	scene_util.set_direction(briefcase, 'left', false)

	--0.8초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--프리렌의 가방 캐릭터 (left, idle, close) 애니메이션 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_02')
	local open_anim = 'open'
	scene_util.set_direction(briefcase, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(briefcase, self, { name = open_anim, loop = false })

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(briefcase, open_anim)
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	--프리렌 캐릭터 위치에 FX_dead 이펙트 출력됨과 동시에, 플레이어 의 스파인 변경.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_ball_01')
	self.fx:dead():Instantiate(frieren_pos)

	--변경된 채로 여전히 (right, idle, eat) 자세 유지
	scene_util.set_direction(frieren_pajamas, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_emotion(frieren_pajamas)
	scene_util.set_anim(frieren_pajamas, self, 'eat')

	field_object_util.set_active_state(frieren, active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(frieren_pajamas, active_state_type.enabled)

	scene_util.set_direction(frieren, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(frieren)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--프리렌의 가방 캐릭터 (left, idle, close) 애니메이션 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02', 3)
	local close_anim = 'close'

	scene_util.set_direction(briefcase, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(briefcase, self, { name = close_anim, loop = false })

	anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(briefcase, close_anim)
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

	--0.4초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	--프리렌의 가방 캐릭터 위치에 FX_dead 이펙트 출력됨과 동시에 가방 캐릭터 제거.
	self.fx:dead():Instantiate(briefcase_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

	briefcase.Position = briefcase_pos
	field_object_util.set_active_state(briefcase, active_state_type.disabled)

	--프리렌 가방 캐릭터 제거 된 뒤, 프리렌 캐릭터 (right, idle, idle) 로 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(frieren_pajamas, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(frieren_pajamas)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)


	--상단의 이벤트 완료 이후 하단의 이벤트 진행.

	--프리렌 (right, idle, get) 자세로 0.5초에 걸쳐 ■타일 + 오른쪽 0.2칸 침대 오브젝트 위로 올라감.
	scene_util.set_direction(frieren_pajamas, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(frieren_pajamas, self, 'get')

	local bed_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0.2, 0.5, 0)
	local jump_duration = 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(frieren_pajamas, 1, jump_duration)

	wp_util.move_async(frieren_pajamas, bed_pos, nil, jump_duration)

	--착지
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_02')

	--프리렌 left 방향 전환 후 0.3초 대기
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(frieren_pajamas)
	scene_util.set_direction(frieren_pajamas, 'left', false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--이후 프리렌 (left, idle, prostrate) 자세 전환과 동시에
	local prostrate_mix_duration = 0.3
	scene_util.set_direction(frieren_pajamas, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(frieren_pajamas, self, { name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = prostrate_mix_duration })

	--prostrate 자세가 완료되었을 때
	wait_for_sec(prostrate_mix_duration)

	--프리렌 캐릭터 left방향 0.5칸 옆에 fr_dungeon_book_open 아이템 생성.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')
	self.dungeon_book_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		--별도 문구 없이 바로 기사가 획득
		pos = frieren_pajamas.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		item_id = 21459,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		scale = 0.7,
		skip_text = true,
	})

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--페른 (right, idle, seat) : 프리렌님, 이 세계의 책도 읽으실 수 있으신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_36')

	--프리렌 (left, idle, prostrate) : 그 서부 던전이라는 곳에 대한 기록을 계속 해석해 보고 있어. 좀 까다롭지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren_pajamas, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'prostrate', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_37')

	--프리렌 (left, idle, prostrate) : 재미있는 정보가 많아. 처음 보는 마물들도 있고, 차원의 균열에 대한 것도…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren_pajamas, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'prostrate', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_38')

	--프리렌 (left, idle, prostrate) : 차원 이동은 다른 세계에서의 기억을 함께 가져갈 수 없다…라던가.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren_pajamas, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'prostrate', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_39')

	--페른 (right, tired, seat) : 그럼… 원래 세계로 돌아가면 저희는 이곳의 기억을 잃는 걸까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s8_40')

	--프리렌 (left, idle, prostrate) : 아마도 그럴 가능성이 높겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren_pajamas, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'prostrate', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_41')

	--페른 (right, tired, seat) : 그건 조금 아쉽네요….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_42')

	--에일리 캐릭터 생성되어 이동속도 값 3.5 walk 자세로 up방향 2.5칸 , right 방향 6.5칸 , up방향 3.5칸 이동.
	character_util.set_anim(ailie, { name = 'walk' })

	ailie.Position = pivot_pos + vector(-12, 0, -8.5)

	local ailie_wp = {
		ailie.Position + vector(0, 0, 2.5),
		ailie.Position + vector(6.5, 0, 2.5),
		ailie.Position + vector(6.5, 0, 6),
	}

	wp_util.move_async(ailie, ailie_wp, 3.5, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

	character_util.remove_anim(ailie)

	--에일리 캐릭터 이동 완료 후 하단의 이벤트 진행.

	--페른 (down, idle, idle) 자세 전환,
	scene_util.set_direction(fern, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fern)

	--프리렌은 (left, idle, seat) 자세 전환과 동시에 (question) 이모티콘 표시.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(frieren_pajamas, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, nil, 'question')

	--페른 (down, idle, idle) : 에일리 님?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_44')

	--에일리 (right, idle, idle) : 언니들… 잠깐 얘기 나눠도 괜찮아?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'idle', 'ss_frieren_main_s8_45')

	--프리렌 (left, idle, seat) : 응. 무슨 일인데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren_pajamas, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_46')

	--에일리 (right, smile, idle) : 이제 던전 공략까지 얼마 남지 않았으니까… 원래 세계로 돌아간다면 오랫동안 못 볼 거 같아서…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_main_s8_47')

	--에일리 (right, smile, cast2) : 돌아가기 전에 같이 이것저것 추억들을 남기고 가는 게 어떨까 물어보러 왔어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, 'right',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_main_s8_48')

	--에일리 (right, idle, idle) : 또…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_49')

	--프리렌 (left, idle, seat) : 또?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren_pajamas, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_50')

	--에일리 (right, tired, cast) 자세 전환 후 0.5초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(ailie, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(ailie, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(ailie, self, 'cast')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--에일리 (right, tired, cast) : …할아버지의 병세가 조금씩 안 좋아지는 것 같아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s8_51')

	--에일리 (right, tired, cast) : 생각해 보면… 할아버지랑 같이 시간을 보낸 적이 많이 없어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s8_52')

	--에일리 (right, tired, idle) : 할아버지가 아직 건강하실 때, 같이 추억을 많이 쌓고 싶어서….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ailie, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_main_s8_53')

	--(silence) 이모티콘 표시.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(frieren_pajamas, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'silence')

	--프리렌 (left, idle, seat) : 추억….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren_pajamas, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_frieren_main_s8_54')

	--캐릭터 미리 배치.
	local flashback_pivot_pos = pivot_pos + vector(5, 0, 0)
	local himmel = self.npc.himmel()
	local heiter = self.npc.heiter()
	local eisen = self.npc.eisen()
	local npc_info_list = {
		--힘멜 (down, smile, idle)
		{
			target = himmel,
			direction = 'down',
			emotion = 'smile',
			anim = 'idle',
			pos = flashback_pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 1),
			alpha = 0,
		},
		--하이터 (left, smile, idle)
		{
			target = heiter,
			direction = 'left',
			emotion = 'smile',
			anim = 'idle',
			pos = flashback_pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			alpha = 0,
		},
		--아이젠 (right, idle, idle)
		{
			target = eisen,
			direction = 'right',
			emotion = 'idle',
			anim = 'idle',
			pos = flashback_pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),

				character_util.remove_anim(ailie, true)

				item_sync_routine = false
				ailie_item.Position = ailie.Position + item_height

				wait_for_sec(0.1)

				--아이템 throw 하여

					coroutine.yield(nil)

function local_class:set_npc_by_list(npc_info_list)
	for name, info_list in pairs(npc_info_list) do
		local npc = nil
		local active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(info_list.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)
		local target = info_list.target
		local pos = info_list.pos
		local direction = info_list.direction
		local anim = info_list.anim
		local emotion = info_list.emotion
		local remove_anim_and_emotion = info_list.remove_anim_and_emotion
		local hide_weapon = info_list.hide_weapon
		local oneline = info_list.oneline
		local alpha = info_list.alpha
		local crash_behaviour = info_list.crash_behaviour
		local tint = info_list.tint
		local remove_tint = info_list.remove_tint

		if target == nil then
			if name == 'china_hero' then
				npc = user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
			elseif name == 'knight' then
				npc = user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
			elseif name == 'party_leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(name)
			end
		else
			npc = target
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state)

		if pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		end

		if direction ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, direction)
		end

		if anim ~= nil then
			if type_util.is_table(anim) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = anim, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if emotion ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, emotion)
		end

		if hide_weapon ~= nil then
			character_util.hide_weapon(npc, hide_weapon)
		end

		if remove_anim_and_emotion then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		end

		if oneline ~= nil then
			if oneline == 'nil' then
				npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
			else
				npc.Interactable.Talk = oneline
			end
		end

		if alpha ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, alpha, 0)
		end

		if crash_behaviour ~= nil then
			npc.CrashBehaviour = crash_behaviour
		end

		if tint ~= nil then
			character_util.add_color(npc, npc.name, tint.color, tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if remove_tint ~= nil then

		end

function local_class:npc_hit(npc, play_effect)
	play_effect = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_effect, false)
	if play_effect then
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(npc.Bounds.center)
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(npc.Bounds.center)
	end

	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)
end

function local_class:interpolation_move_async(fo, position, duration, interpolation)
	local interpolation_func = interpolations_constants[lua_helper.get_or_default(interpolation, 'linear')]

	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = interpolation_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, position, progress)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	fo.Position = position
end

return local_class

		passed_event.enter_eating_contest_1 = true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s9_eating_contest_2')

			and passed_event ~= nil and not passed_event.enter_eating_contest_2 then

	if self.qte_activity_info.cur_qte_type == self.qte_type.tap then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			self.qte_activity_info.tap_count = self.qte_activity_info.tap_count + 1

			-- 각 QTE에 대한 이벤트 함수 처리
			local tap_count_event_list = self.qte_activity_info.current_qte_callback_list

			if tap_count_event_list ~= nil then
				for _, info in pairs(tap_count_event_list) do
					if not info.passed_event then
						if info.event_count == self.qte_activity_info.tap_count then
							info.passed_event = true
							start_coroutine(info.event_func)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc_data()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					npc_data.weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					npc_data.weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_item_data()
	local pre_item_data = self.pre_item_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_item_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_item_data):foreach(function(_, item_data)
		item_data.scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(item_data.scale, 1)

		self.items:add_item(item_data.sprite_id, item_data.unique_name,
				item_data.pos, nil, item_data.scale, false, item_data.skip_text, item_data.sorting_layer)
	end)
end

		this.cur_qte_type = self.qte_type.tap

		this.play_qte = true

		this.current_qte_callback_list = tap_count_event_list

		qte_play_util.show_turbo_tap(darken)

		while this.tap_count < tap_max_count do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.qte_activity_info.cur_qte_type = self.qte_type.none

		screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

		this.current_qte_callback_list = nil

		this.cur_qte_step = this.cur_qte_step + 1

		this.play_qte = false

		self.qte_activity_info.tap_count = 0

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

function local_class:qte_setting(step)
	self.qte_activity_info.current_state = step

	if self.qte_activity_info.current_state == self.qte_activity_state.prepare then
		for i = 1, self.adventurer_count do
			local adventurer = self.characters.adventurer(i)

			character_util.set_position(adventurer, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end

		-- 탁자 오브젝트 위에 배치되어있던 6개의 아이템 스프라이트들 제거.
		self.items:dispose_all()

		camera_util.move(self.markers.camera(2, 1), 0)

		-- 0.1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 3으로 줌인.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0)

		self.current_state = self.states.eating_contest_event

		self:set_current_scene_npc_data()
		self:set_current_scene_item_data()

		self:set_dynamic_npcs()

		-- 0.7초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.7)

	elseif self.qte_activity_info.current_state == self.qte_activity_state.ending then
		self.current_state = self.states.end_eating_contest

		self:set_current_scene_npc_data()

		self:set_dynamic_npcs()

		-- 최초 카메라 플레이어(프리렌) 한테 포커스 한 상태.
		camera_util.move(self.markers.frieren(3, 1), 0)
		camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

return local_class

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함

end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.common_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Util')
end

function local_class:start()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	-- 6섹션 이후 및 8, 10이 아닐 때
	if main_quest_progress ~= nil and main_quest_progress.InnerProgress > 4 and
		(main_quest_progress.InnerProgress ~= 7 and main_quest_progress.InnerProgress ~= 9) then

		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.oni_girl_kid, active_state_type.enabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.oni_girl_mother, active_state_type.enabled)

		self:setting()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.oni_girl_kid, self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.oni_girl_mother, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.common_util = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.is_activate_event then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.meet_oni_girl and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, { self.character.oni_girl_kid, self.character.oni_girl_mother }) then

		self.current_state = self.states.talk_oni_girl

		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_oni_girl, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_activate_event then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.setting and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'oni_girl_meeting_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.meet_oni_girl

		sp_util.start_scene(self.meet_oni_girl, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.talk_oni_girl then
		--용암 패배
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.acting_stark, 'oni_girl_lava') then

			self.current_state = self.states.end_racing

			sp_util.start_scene(self.lose_racing, self, self.lose_type.lava)
			return true
		end

		--허수아비 패배
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.acting_stark, 'oni_girl_scarecrow') then

			self.current_state = self.states.end_racing

			sp_util.start_scene(self.lose_racing, self, self.lose_type.scarecrow)
			return true
		end

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.character.acting_stark, 'oni_girl_goal_zone') then

			self.current_state = self.states.end_racing

			sp_util.start_scene(self.win_racing, self)
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 5 or e.CurrentProgress == 8 or e.CurrentProgress == 10 then
		self.is_activate_event = true
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.oni_girl_kid, active_state_type.enabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.oni_girl_mother, active_state_type.enabled)

		if self.current_state == self.states.none then
			self:setting()

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('oni_girl_door'))
		end

		return true
	end

	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 7 or e.CurrentProgress == 9 then
		self.is_activate_event = false
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.oni_girl_kid, active_state_type.disabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character.oni_girl_mother, active_state_type.disabled)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 라나 만남
function local_class:meet_oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_kid = self.character.oni_girl_kid
	local oni_girl_mother = self.character.oni_girl_mother

	--카메라 1초간 라나에게 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(oni_girl_kid, 1)

	--라나(right,smile,success): 이제 뛰어도 돼? 이제 뛰어도 되는 거지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'right',
		'success', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_1')

	--라라(left,smile,release2회): 그래! 이제 번개처럼 달릴 시간이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
		{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_2')

	--아래 동작 동시에
	--라나 라라 속도 7 (run)애니메이션 사용하여 각각 (91,-55.5)(92,-55.5) 에서 (112,-55.5)(113,-55.5) 까지 이동
	local target_pos = self.marker.oni_girl_talking_pos

	wp_util.move(oni_girl_kid, target_pos, 7, nil, {
		run = true,
		end_callback = function()
			character_util.add_listener(oni_girl_kid, self)
		end
	})

	wp_util.move(oni_girl_mother, target_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), 7, nil, {
			run = true,
			last_direction = 'left',
			end_callback = function()
				character_util.add_listener(oni_girl_mother, self)
			end
		})

	--카메라 1초간 다시 플레이어에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

-- 라나랑 대화
function local_class:talk_oni_girl()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local frieren = self.character.frieren
	local fern = self.character.fern
	local stark = self.character.stark
	local oni_girl_kid = self.character.oni_girl_kid
	local oni_girl_mother = self.character.oni_girl_mother

	--0.5초간 정렬
	self.current_party = {}

	for i = 0, get_user_party().Count - 1 do
		local member = get_user_party()[i]
		self.current_party[i + 1] = member

		local target_pos = oni_girl_kid.Position + self.offset_data.talking[i + 1]
		local dist = (target_pos - member.Position).magnitude
		local move_speed = math.max(dist / 0.5, 1)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, move_speed,
			nil, self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)


	if not self.is_interacted_oni_girl then
		--다음 동작 동시에
		--라라 (left,idle,idle)
		--라나(left,smile,release2회): 어! 가게에서 봤던 언니 오빠들이다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_3')

		--슈타르크(right,smile,idle): 그때 그 꼬마애구나! 즐거워 보이네.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_4')

		--라나(left,smile,victory_get): 응! 방금 스피드퀸을 위한 특제 던전 코스가 완성됐거든!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
			'victory_get', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_5')

		--슈타르크(right,idle,bomb_idle): 뭔가 엄청 멋있는 걸 만든 것 같네.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_6')

		--라라(left,sleep_deep,nod2회): 던전은 험난하고 독특한 지형으로 유명하거든.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'sleep_deep', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_7')

		--라라(left,smile,release2회): 어디서든 빠르게 달리기 위해서는 이만한 훈련 장소가 없다고!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_8')

		--라나(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 맞아! 난 세상에서 가장 빠른 달리기 선수가 될 거니까!
		character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_kid, '01_small_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_9')

		--프리렌(right,idle,nod2회): 지형지물에 익숙해지는 훈련도 중요한 일이지.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(frieren, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_10')

		--라라(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 하지만 어린 딸을 실전 코스로 보내는 건 위험하니까.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_11')

		--라라(left,idle,release2회): 이렇게 던전의 험난한 지형을 따라 한 코스를 만든 거야.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_12')

		--페른(right,idle,idle): 정성이 대단하시군요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_13')

		--라라(left,sleep_deep,question) (silence)이모티콘 버블
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			'question', 'sleep_deep', 'silence')

		--라라(left,idle,bomb_idle): 혹시 괜찮다면 우리 딸 라나랑 이 코스를 뛰어줄래?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_14')

		--라라(left,smile,nod2회): 실전 경험이 있는 모험가와 맞붙는 게 훈련에 더 적합할 테니까.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_15')

		--슈타르크(right,idle,release회): 이 꼬마랑 달리기 시합을 하라고?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_16')

		--라라(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 어리다고 무시하지 않는 게 좋아. 우리 딸은 차기 스피드퀸 이니까!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'sleep_deep', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_17')

		--라라(left,smile,release2회): 만약 우리 딸을 이긴다면 그에 걸맞은 보상도 해줄게.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_18')
	end

	--플레이어 라나에게 3회 이상 패배시 추가 대사
	if self.lose_count > 2 then
		--라나 (left, doyagao, idle): 힘들면, 오빠가 더 앞에서 출발해도 괜찮아! 나는 자신 있으니까!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
			nil, 'doyagaodoyagao', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_18_1')

		--선택지
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--좀 더 앞에서 출발한다.(mercy)
			{ 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_18_2', 'mercy' },
			--사양 한다. (brutal)
			{ 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_18_3', 'brutal' }
		})

		--앞으로 간다. 선택시
		--액팅 시작 위치 (118.5, 0, -53.5) -> (125, 0, -53) 로 변경
		self.is_easy_mod = player_choice == 1

		--필요 없다. 선택시 하단 선택지 출력
	end

	self.is_interacted_oni_girl = true

	--거절 이나 패배 후 인터랙트 시 선택지 부터 시작

	if not self.is_easy_mod then
		--선택지
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--달리기 시합을 한다. (mercy)
			{ 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_19', 'mercy' },
			--시간이 없다. (normal)
			{ 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_20' }
		})

		if player_choice == 2 then
			--시간이 없다. 선택시
			--슈타르크(right,tired,bomb_idle): 미안, 아직 해야 할 일이 있어서.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
				'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_21')

			--라라(left,idle,idle): 아쉽네. 하지만 빨리 도전하는 게 좋을 거야.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
				nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_22')

			--라라(left,attack,victory_get): 이 코스까지 마스터하면 우리 딸은 무적이 될 테니까!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
				'victory_get', 'attack', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_23')

			self.current_state = self.states.meet_oni_girl

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
			return
		end

		--달리기 시합을 한다.
		--슈타르크(right,idle,nod2회): 좋아, 잠깐이라면 어울려줄 수 있으니까.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_24')

		--라라(left,smile,release2회): 그럼, 바로 코스를 준비해 줄게!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_25')
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl_kid, self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl_mother, self)

	self:start_race()
end

--- 레이스 시작
function local_class:start_race()
	--페이드 아웃 1초
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--라나 모녀를 1회 라도 인터랙트 했을 시 클리어 전까지 마을에 있을 때 서브 퀘스트 마커가 라나에게 표시됨 (112,-55.5)
	--만약 마을이 아닌 곳에 있을시 서브 퀘스트 마커는 노출되지 않음

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent.Create(self.field_object.reset_switch))

	self.oni_girl_wp:reset()

	--플레이어 리더 캐릭터 슈타르크(무기 장착 안 한 서브 퀘스트 용)로 변경
	local acting_stark = self.character.acting_stark
	field_object_util.set_active_state(acting_stark, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_direction(acting_stark, 'right')
	acting_stark.Position = self.marker.leader_start_pos

	--NPC 배치
	for i = 1, #self.current_party do
		local member = self.current_party[i]

		if i ~= 3 then
			member.Position = acting_stark.Position + self.offset_data.racing[i]
			character_util.set_direction(member, 'right')
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(member, active_state_type.disabled)
		end
	end

	if self.is_easy_mod then
		acting_stark.Position = self.marker.leader_start_pos + vector(11.5, 0, -1.5)
	end

	local oni_girl_kid = self.character.oni_girl_kid
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_kid, 'right')
	oni_girl_kid.Position = self.marker.oni_girl_part1_start_pos

	local oni_girl_mother = self.character.oni_girl_mother
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'right')
	oni_girl_mother.Position = oni_girl_kid.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(acting_stark, param, true)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--페이드 인 1초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local replay = true

	while replay do
		if not self.is_listened_rule then
			--첫 튜토리얼 (맨 처음 시작할 때 및 다시 알려줄래? 선택시)
			--카메라가 라나에게 0.5초간 이동
			camera_util.move_to_target_async(oni_girl_kid, 0.5)

			--라나(right,smile,idle)(jump1회): 좋아! 코스를 설명해 줄게!
			character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_kid, '01_small_jump_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'right',
				nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_25_1')

			--카메라 (128.5,-56.5) 위치까지 1초간 이동 후
			camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos_1 + vector(-4, 0, 0), 1)

			--화면 (0.5,0.5) 위치에 말꼬리 없는 말풍선 대사
			--라나: 저긴 용암 지역이야! 길이 아닌 곳으로 다니면 그대로 녹아버려!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_kid, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_26', true, {
				viewport_pos = vector(0.5,  0.5)
			})

			--카메라 (132.5,-46) 위치까지 1초간 이동 후
			camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos_2, 1)

			--화면 (0.5,0.5) 위치에 말꼬리 없는 말풍선 대사
			--라나: 그다음 던전에 수많은 역경을 헤쳐나간후에!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_kid, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_27', true, {
				viewport_pos = vector(0.5,  0.5)
			})

			--카메라 (123,-38) 위치까지 1초간 이동 후
			camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera_pos_3, 1)

			--화면 (0.5,0.5) 위치에 말꼬리 없는 말풍선 대사
			--라나: 허수아비 괴물들의 눈을 피해 골인 지점으로 오는 거야!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_kid, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_28', true, {
				viewport_pos = vector(0.5,  0.5)
			})

			--카메라 슈타르크에게 1초간 이동 후
			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
		end

		self.is_listened_rule = true
		replay = false

		--선택지 (이후 재도전은 선택지부터 시작)
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--다시 알려줄래? (intellect)
			{ 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_29', 'intellect' },
			--바로 시작하자! (mercy)
			{ 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_30', 'mercy' }
		})

		if player_choice == 1 then
			self.is_listened_rule = false
			replay = true
		end
	end

	--달리기를 시작한다. 선택시

	--라나: 3… 2… 1… 출발!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oni_girl_kid, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_31', false, {
		viewport_pos = vector(0.5,  0.2)
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_lana', state = 'event' })

	start_coroutine(self.run_oni_girl_kid, self)
end

function local_class:run_oni_girl_kid()
	local oni_girl_kid = self.character.oni_girl_kid
	field_object_util.set_active_state(oni_girl_kid, active_state_type.visible)

	--첫 번째 달리기
	for _ = 1, self.oni_girl_wp.count[1] do
		wp_util.move_async(oni_girl_kid, self.oni_girl_wp:get(1), 5.5, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

		if self.current_state == self.states.end_racing then
			return
		end
	end

	self.is_jumping = true

	--점프 타일
	self.jump_tile:play()

	character_util.jump(oni_girl_kid, 2, 2)
	character_util.move_to_async(oni_girl_kid, oni_girl_kid.Position + vector(0, 1, 7), 2)

	self.is_jumping = false

	if self.current_state == self.states.end_racing then
		return
	end

	--두 번째 달리기
	for _ = 1, self.oni_girl_wp.count[2] do
		wp_util.move_async(oni_girl_kid, self.oni_girl_wp:get(2), 5.5, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

		if self.current_state == self.states.end_racing then
			return
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		if self.current_state == self.states.end_racing then
			return
		end

		self.is_jumping = true

		character_util.jump(oni_girl_kid, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(oni_girl_kid, oni_girl_kid.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 0.5)

		self.is_jumping = false

		if self.current_state == self.states.end_racing then
			return
		end
	end

	--점프 하기 전 위치로 이동
	local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(oni_girl_kid, oni_girl_kid.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1))
	wp_util.move_async(oni_girl_kid, wp, 5.5, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	if self.current_state == self.states.end_racing then
		return
	end

	self.is_jumping = true

	--점프해서 아래로
	character_util.jump(oni_girl_kid, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.move_to_async(oni_girl_kid, oni_girl_kid.Position + vector(-2, -1, 0), 0.3)

	self.is_jumping = false

	if self.current_state == self.states.end_racing then
		return
	end

	--세 번째 달리기
	for _ = 1, self.oni_girl_wp.count[3] do
		wp_util.move_async(oni_girl_kid, self.oni_girl_wp:get(3), 6, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

		if self.current_state == self.states.end_racing then
			return
		end
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.end_racing

	sp_util.start_scene(self.lose_racing, self, self.lose_type.goal)
end

--- 레이스 이겼을 때
function local_class:win_racing()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')

	local frieren = self.character.frieren
	local stark = self.character.stark
	local acting_stark = self.character.acting_stark
	local oni_girl_kid = self.character.oni_girl_kid
	local oni_girl_mother = self.character.oni_girl_mother

	character_util.stop(oni_girl_kid)

	--슈타르크 (left,smile,success) 1초
	character_util.set_direction(acting_stark, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(acting_stark, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(acting_stark, self, 'success')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 라나 점프 행동 끝날 때까지 대기
	while self.is_jumping do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--아래 동작 동시에
	--라나 정지 후 방향 변경 없이 (surprise,idle)(jump1회)

	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_kid, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_kid)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	--페이드 아웃 1초
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local ending_pos = self.marker.ending_pos

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_kid)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(oni_girl_kid, active_state_type.enabled)
	oni_girl_kid.Position = ending_pos + vector(1, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_kid, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_kid, self, 'tired')

	oni_girl_mother.Position = ending_pos + vector(1, 0, 1)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'tired')

	field_object_util.set_active_state(stark, active_state_type.enabled)

	for i = 1, #self.current_party do
		local member = self.current_party[i]
		member.Position = ending_pos + self.offset_data.ending[i]

		if i ~= 3 then
			character_util.set_direction(member, 'down')
		else
			--(3)슈타르크 (right,damaged,cast)(112,-39)
			character_util.set_direction(member, 'right')
			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(member, self, 'cast')
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(acting_stark)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(frieren, param, true)

	--카메라 슈타르크인 상태
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(stark, 0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })

	--페이드 인 1초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--슈타르크(right,damaged,cast): 이, 이겼다…! 지는 줄 알았어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_39')

	--라나(left,tired,seat): 내가… 졌다고…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
		'seat', nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_40')

	--슈타르크(right,tired,idle): 어… 괜찮니, 꼬마야?
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(stark)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
		nil, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_41')

	--라나(left,tired,idle) (silence)이모티콘 버블
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_kid)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
		nil, 'tired', 'silence')

	--다음 동작 동시에
	--라라(down,smile,idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	scene_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'smile')

	--라나(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 역시 연습 코스는 내 스피드를 담을 수 없구나!
	character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_kid, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
		nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_42')

	--라나(left,attack,shoot): 오빠도 꽤나 잘 달리지만… 조심하는 게 좋을 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
		'shoot', 'attack', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_43')

	--라나(left,smile,victory_get): <b>라이트닝 라이더</b>는 실전에 가장 강하니까!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
		'victory_get', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_44')

	--라라(down,smile,clap): 역시 우리 딸이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'down',
		'clap', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_45')

	--카메라 0.5초간 프리렌에게 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--다음 동작 동시에
	--프리렌 (right,idle,idle)
	for i = 1, #self.current_party do
		local member = self.current_party[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
		scene_util.set_direction(member, 'right')
	end

	--라라(left,smile,idle): 라나의 연습 상대가 되어 줘서 고마워! 여기 말했던 보수야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
		nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_46')

	--coin스프라이트와 동시에 스타피스가 라라 위치에서 (112,-38)로 생겨난다.
	star_piece_util.appear(self.field_object.star_piece, oni_girl_mother.Position)

	--라라(left,smile,throw)로  coin 스프라이트를 (112,-37)위치에 던진 후 골드량프리렌이 습득한다.
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
	self.coin_item:create(oni_girl_mother.Position, frieren.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	quest_drop_item_util.consumed(self.coin_item.item, frieren)

	--액티비티 UI 골드량 +2000
	local _, store = global_table_util.try_get('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Dungeon/Store.lua')
	local add_value = 2000
	self.common_util:show_gold_floating_text(add_value)
	store:add_gold_and_not_save(add_value)

	--라나(up,idle,idle)(jump1회): 그래도 아직 실전 코스를 뛸 순 없으니 계속 연습하는 거야!
	character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_kid, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'up',
		nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_47')

	--라라(down,attack,release2회): 좋아! 오늘 밤새 엄마랑 달려보자!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'down',
		{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_48')

	--다음 동작 동시에
	--라라(right,smile,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'smile')

	--라나(right,smile,victory_get): 벙개보다 빠르게!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'right',
		'victory_get', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_49')

	--라나 속도 7 (run) 애니메이션으로 (127,-39)위치까지 이동
	--출발 0.1초 후 마리오 점프 (점프 높이 height 1.5 / duration 0.5) 후 다시 (run) 애니메이션 복귀 도착하면 (up,idle,idle)
	local run_routine = function(target, last_dir)
		local wp = {
			target.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
			target.Position + vector(13, 0, 0),
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(target, 1.5, 0.5)
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'get')

		wp_util.move(target, wp, 7, nil, {
			run = true,
			play_sfx = true,
			callback = function(waypoint_index)
				if waypoint_index == 0 then
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
				elseif waypoint_index == 1 then
					scene_util.set_direction(target, last_dir)
					scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'smile')
				end
			end
		})
	end

	run_routine(oni_girl_kid, 'up')

	--라라(right,smile,clap): 잘한다! 우리 딸!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'right',
		'clap', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_50')

	--다음 동작 동시에
	--라라 속도 7 (run) 애니메이션으로 (127,-37)위치까지 이동
	--출발 0.1초 후 마리오 점프 (점프 높이 height 1.5 / duration 0.5) 후 다시 (run) 애니메이션 복귀 도착하면 (down,smile,idle)
	run_routine(oni_girl_mother, 'down')

	--슈타르크(right,idle,idle): 활기찬 모녀네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_51')

	for i = 2, #self.current_party do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.current_party[i], get_user_party(), true)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()
end

--- 레이스 졌을 때
function local_class:lose_racing(type)
	local frieren = self.character.frieren
	local fern = self.character.fern
	local stark = self.character.stark
	local acting_stark = self.character.acting_stark
	local oni_girl_kid = self.character.oni_girl_kid
	local oni_girl_mother = self.character.oni_girl_mother

	character_util.stop(oni_girl_kid)

	--슈타르크 방향 변경없이 (surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion(acting_stark, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(acting_stark)

	-- 라나 점프 행동 끝날 때까지 대기
	while self.is_jumping do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--카메라 0.5초간 라나에게 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(oni_girl_kid, 0.5)

	if type == self.lose_type.lava then
		--라나 플레이어 방향으로 (smile, success) 후 대사 재생
		character_util.look_at(oni_girl_kid, acting_stark)
		scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_kid, self, 'success')
		scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_kid, self, 'smile')

		--라나: 용암에 빠졌대요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_32')

	elseif type == self.lose_type.scarecrow then
		--라나 플레이어 방향으로 (smile, success) 후 대사 재생
		character_util.look_at(oni_girl_kid, acting_stark)
		scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_kid, self, 'success')
		scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_kid, self, 'smile')

		--라나: 기사한테 걸렸대요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_33')

	elseif type == self.lose_type.goal then
		--라나 (left,smile,victory_get) 1초
		scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_kid, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_kid, self, 'victory_get')
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	--페이드 아웃 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--상단 라나 모녀한테 인터랙트 했을 때 대열과 동일하게 복귀
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_kid)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(oni_girl_kid, active_state_type.enabled)
	oni_girl_kid.Position = self.marker.oni_girl_talking_pos
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_kid, 'left')

	oni_girl_mother.Position = oni_girl_kid.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(acting_stark)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(acting_stark, active_state_type.disabled)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(stark, active_state_type.enabled)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(frieren, param, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, #self.current_party do
		local member = self.current_party[i]
		member.Position = oni_girl_kid.Position + self.offset_data.talking[i]
		character_util.set_direction(member, 'right')
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })

	--페이드인 1초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--페른(right,idle,bomb_idle): 꼬마애한테 지신 건가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fern, self, 'right',
		'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_34')

	--슈타르크(right,worried,cast): 하, 하지만 이런 달리기는 처음 해보는 걸…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, 'right',
		'cast', 'worried', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_35')

	--라라(left,smile,idle): 원한다면 언제든 재도전해도 좋아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
		nil, 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_36')

	--라라(left,attack,cast): 하지만 다음엔 더 진심을 다해야 할 거야. 우리 딸은 누구보다 빠른…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
		'cast', 'attack', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_37')

	--라나(left,smile,victory_get): <b>라이트닝 라이더</b>니까!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_kid, self, 'left',
		'victory_get', 'smile', 'ss_frieren_oni_girl_38')

	end

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class ShortStoryFrierenPartTimeController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryFrierenPartTimeController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		get = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
	})

	self.dirty_place = {
		fo_prefix = 'sub_part_time_dirty_',
		marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
		dirty_item_id = 21495,
		dirty_scale = 1,
		menu_item_id = 21499,
		menu_scale = 1,
		pool = {},
		init_pos = vector(999, 0, 999),

		states = {
			dirty = 1,
			clean = 2,
			menu = 3,
		},

		--info
		load_info = {
			{
				label = 1,
				offset = vector(-3, 0, -0.5),
			},
			{
				label = 1,
				offset = vector(-3, 0, 4.5),
			},
			{
				label = 1,
				offset = vector(0, 0, 8),
			},
			{
				label = 2,
				offset = vector(3.5, 0, -0.5),
			},
			{
				label = 2,
				offset = vector(8, 0, 0),
			},
			{
				label = 3,
				offset = vector(14, 0, 0),
			},
			{
				label = 3,
				offset = vector(18.5, 0, -1.5),
			},
			{
				label = 3,
				offset = vector(18.5, 0, 4.5),
			},
		},

		---@type fun(this:self)
		load = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.load_info do
				local load_info = this.load_info[i]
				local fo = get_field_object(this.fo_prefix .. i)

				local init_pos = this.init_pos
				local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(this.marker_name) + load_info.offset

				fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.Interactable()
				fo.Position = init_pos

				local dirty_item = this:create_dirty_item(init_pos)
				local menu_item = this:create_menu_item(init_pos)

				local info = {
					fo = fo,
					target_pos = target_pos,
					dirty_item = dirty_item,
					menu_item = menu_item,
					clean_fx = nil,
					state = this.states.clean,
				}

				if this.pool[load_info.label] == nil then
					this.pool[load_info.label] = {}
				end

				table.insert(this.pool[load_info.label], info)
			end
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, item_id:number, scale:number, pos:Vector3):DropItem
		create_item = function(this, item_id, scale, pos)
			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = item_id,
				pos = pos,
				spr_scale = scale,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
			})

			return item
		end,

		activity_init = function(this)
			for label = 1, #this.pool do
				local current_pool = this.pool[label]

				for num = 1, #current_pool do
					local target_pos = this.pool[label][num].target_pos
					this.pool[label][num].fo.Position = target_pos
					this.pool[label][num].clean_fx = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, 1))
				end
			end

			this:dirty_create(1, 2)
			this:dirty_create(2, 1)
			this:dirty_create(3, 3)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, pos:Vector3):DropItem
		create_dirty_item = function(this, pos)
			return this:create_item(this.dirty_item_id, this.dirty_scale, pos)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, pos:Vector3):DropItem
		create_menu_item = function(this, pos)
			return this:create_item(this.menu_item_id, this.menu_scale, pos)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, target:IFieldObject):boolean, number, number
		interact_event = function(this, target)
			for label = 1, #this.pool do
				local current_pool = this.pool[label]

				--reference check and clear routine
				for num = 1, #current_pool do
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(current_pool[num].fo, target) then
						return true, label, num
					end
				end
			end

			return false, nil, nil
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, label:number, num:number)
		set_clean = function(this, label, num)
			if this.pool[label][num].state == this.states.dirty then
				local clean_fx = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(this.pool[label][num].dirty_item.Position)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
				this.pool[label][num].clean_fx = clean_fx
				self.fx.get():Instantiate(this.pool[label][num].dirty_item.Position)
				this:dirty_hide(label, num)
			elseif this.pool[label][num].state == this.states.clean then
				this:menu_create(label, num)
				this.pool[label][num].fo.Position = this.init_pos
				self.fx.get():Instantiate(this.pool[label][num].menu_item.Position)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')

				if this.pool[label][num].clean_fx ~= nil then
					this.pool[label][num].clean_fx:Dispose()
					this.pool[label][num].clean_fx = nil
				end
			end

		end,

		---@type fun(this:self):boolean
		is_clear = function(this)
			local is_clear = true

			for label = 1, #this.pool do
				local current_pool = this.pool[label]

				for num = 1, #current_pool do
					is_clear = is_clear and (current_pool[num].state == this.states.menu)
				end
			end

			return is_clear
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, label:number, num:Vector3)
		dirty_hide = function(this, label, num)
			this.pool[label][num].state = this.states.clean
			this.pool[label][num].dirty_item.Position = this.init_pos
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, label:number, num:Vector3)
		menu_hide = function(this, label, num)
			this.pool[label][num].state = this.states.clean
			this.pool[label][num].menu_item.Position = this.init_pos
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		hide_all = function(this)
			for label = 1, #this.pool do
				for num = 1, #this.pool[label] do
					if this.pool[label][num].state == this.states.dirty then
						this:dirty_hide(label, num)
					elseif this.pool[label][num].state == this.states.menu then
						this:menu_hide(label, num)
					elseif this.pool[label][num].state == this.states.clean then
						if this.pool[label][num].clean_fx ~= nil then
							this.pool[label][num].clean_fx:Dispose()
							this.pool[label][num].clean_fx = nil
						end
					end

					this.pool[label][num].fo.Position = this.init_pos
				end
			end
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, label:number, pos:Vector3,distance:number):number, Vector3
		clean_search = function(this, label, pos, target_distance)
			local current_pool = this.pool[label]
			local min_distance = target_distance
			local num = -1

			--search
			for i = 1, #current_pool do
				if current_pool[i].state == this.states.clean then
					local distance = vector_util.distance(current_pool[i].target_pos, pos)

					if distance < min_distance then
						min_distance = distance
						num = i
					end
				end
			end

			if num < 0 then
				return num, unity_class.vector3.zero
			else
				return num, this.pool[label][num].target_pos
			end
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, label:number, pos:Vector3)
		dirty_create = function(this, label, num)
			if this.pool[label][num].state == this.states.menu then
				this:menu_hide(label, num)
			elseif this.pool[label][num].state == this.states.clean then
				if this.pool[label][num].clean_fx ~= nil then
					this.pool[label][num].clean_fx:Dispose()
					this.pool[label][num].clean_fx = nil
				end
			end

			local target_pos = this.pool[label][num].target_pos

			this.pool[label][num].state = this.states.dirty
			this.pool[label][num].fo.Position = target_pos
			this.pool[label][num].dirty_item.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, 1)
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self, label:number, pos:Vector3)
		menu_create = function(this, label, num)
			local target_pos = this.pool[label][num].target_pos

			this.pool[label][num].state = this.states.menu
			this.pool[label][num].menu_item.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, 1)
		end,

		final_setting = function(this)
			for label = 1, #this.pool do
				for num = 1, #this.pool[label] do
					this:menu_create(label, num)
				end
			end
		end,

		---@type fun(this:self)
		dispose_all = function(this)
			for label = 1, #this.pool do
				for num = 1, #this.pool[label] do
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.pool[label][num].dirty_item)
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.pool[label][num].menu_item)

					if this.pool[label][num].clean_fx ~= nil then
						this.pool[label][num].clean_fx:Dispose()
						this.pool[label][num].clean_fx = nil
					end

					this.pool[label][num].fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
					this.pool[label][num].fo.Position = this.init_pos
				end
			end

			this.pool = {}
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.dirty_place:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

return local_class

	end

	self.kid_state = {
		none = 1,
		run_start = 2,
		run = 3,
		charge = 4,
		jump_start = 5,
		jump = 6,
		success = 7,
		fail = 8,
		back_jump_start = 9,
		back_jump = 10,
		wait = 11,
	}

			this.data[key] = info

		---@type fun(this:self)

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	self.controller.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent), 'on_interact_cancel_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent), 'on_interact_finish_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.target_quest)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self:activate_quest()
	elseif quest_progress.InnerProgress == 5 or
			quest_progress.InnerProgress == 6 or
			quest_progress.InnerProgress == 8 or
			quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 10 then
		--6,7,9, 11~ 섹션 활성화
		self:activate_quest()
	else
		self:deactivate_quest()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	self.common_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Util')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractFinishEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	self.common_util = nil

	self.current_state = self.states.none
	self.is_playing = false

	-- 저장된 파티 정보 제거
	self.party_info.leader = nil
	self.party_info.saved_party = nil
	self.party_info = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_cancel_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.play_activity and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.current_clean_fo) then
		self.current_clean_fo = nil

		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_master_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.master()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_master

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:activity_accept_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	--액티비티 인터렉트
	if self.current_state == self.states.play_activity then
		local count = 3
		for i = 1, count do
			local npc = self.npc.kid(i)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc) then
				sp_util.start_scene(function()
					self.kid_info:set_current_state(npc.Name, self.kid_state.fail)

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
					scene_util.play_wait_action(get_party_leader(), self,
							nil, 'cast', 'attack', 0.5)
				end)

				return true
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.master()) then
			self.current_state = self.states.pause_activity
			sp_util.start_scene(self.activity_master_interact_scene, self)
			return true
		end

		local is_interact, label, num = self.controller.dirty_place:interact_event(e.Target)

		if is_interact then
			self.current_clean_fo = e.Target

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_finish_event(e)
	--액티비티 인터렉트
	if self.current_state == self.states.play_activity then
		local is_interact, label, num = self.controller.dirty_place:interact_event(e.Target)

		if is_interact then
			self.controller.dirty_place:set_clean(label, num)
			self.current_clean_fo = nil

			if self.controller.dirty_place:is_clear() and self.kid_info:is_clear() then
				sp_util.start_scene(function()
					self.current_state = self.states.finish_activity
					self:finish_activity_scene()
				end)
			end

			return true
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_master_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_part_time_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_master

		self.enter_end = true

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:intro_scene()
			self:activity_accept_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.target_quest then
		if e.CurrentProgress == 5 then
			self:activate_quest()
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 7 then
			self:deactivate_quest()
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 8 then
			self:activate_quest()
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 9 then
			self:deactivate_quest()
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 10 then
			self:activate_quest()
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.stage_end = true
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
	quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.menu_item)
end

			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(master, self, 'down',

			self.is_playing = false
			self:stop_activity_setting(function()
				local npc_data = {
					sub_part_time_kid_1 = {
						dir = 'left',
						emo = 'smile',
						anim = 'victory_extra',
						marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
						offset = vector(3.5, 1, -0.5),
					},
					sub_part_time_kid_2 = {
						dir = 'right',
						emo = 'smile',
						anim = 'victory_extra',
						marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
						offset = vector(-3, 1, 4.5),
					},
					sub_part_time_kid_3 = {
						dir = 'right',
						emo = 'smile',
						anim = 'victory_extra',
						marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
						offset = vector(-3, 1, -0.5),
					},
					sub_part_time_master = {
						dir = 'down',
						emo = 'idle',
						anim = 'idle',
						marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
						offset = vector(0, 0, 0),
					},
				}

				self:set_by_npc_data(npc_data)

				self:align_party_async(0)

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1 })
			end)

			self.current_state = self.states.before_master_interact
		elseif choose_result == 2 then

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRequestResumeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
		end
	end

function local_class:time_end_scene()
	local master = self.npc.master()

	--주인장 (down, tired, release 2회): 힘들겠지만 다시 준비되면 말해줘….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(master, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'tired', 'ss_frieren_sub_part_time_s1_18')
end

function local_class:stop_activity_setting(set_end_callback)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

	--페이드 아웃 1초
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--set
	do
		self:convert_to_leader()

		self.controller.dirty_place:hide_all()

		local exit = self.get_exit()
		exit.Position = self.exit_cashed_pos

		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:Show(self.target_quest, true)

		quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.menu_item)
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	if set_end_callback ~= nil then
		set_end_callback()
	end

	--페이드 인 1초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
end

function local_class:get_party()
	local party = {}
	local current_party = get_user_party()

	for i = 0, current_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(party, current_party[i])
	end

	return party
end

function local_class:align_party_async(duration)
	local frieren = self.npc.frieren()
	local fern = self.npc.fern()
	local stark = self.npc.stark()
	local current_party = self:get_party()

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_part_time_center_pos')
	local offset = {
		vector(0, 0, -1),
		vector(-1, 0, 0),
		vector(1, 0, 0),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -2),
		vector(0.5, 0, -2),
	}

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(frieren, center_pos + offset[1],
			nil, duration, self, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fern, center_pos + offset[2],
			nil, duration, self, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(stark, center_pos + offset[3],
			nil, duration, self, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

	if #current_party > 3 then
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(current_party[4], center_pos + offset[4],
				nil, duration, self, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'up' })
	end

	if #current_party > 4 then
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(current_party[5], center_pos + offset[5],
				nil, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, nil)
end

function local_class:activity_accept_scene()
	local stark = self.npc.stark()
	local master = self.npc.master()

	--주인장(down,tired,sing): 부탁이야. 저 꼬마애들만 어떻게 해줄 수 있을까?
	character_util.look_at(master, get_party_leader())
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(master, self, nil,
			'sing', 'tired', 'ss_frieren_sub_part_time_s1_11')

	--선택지
	do
		--꼬맹이들이라면 맡겨둬.(mercy)
		--지금은 곤란해.(normal)
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'ss_frieren_sub_part_time_choose_1', 'mercy' },
			{ 'ss_frieren_sub_part_time_choose_2', 'normal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			self:activity_start()

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--슈타르크(left,idle,bomb_idle): 미안, 지금 당장은 힘들 것 같아.
			character_util.look_at(stark, master)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(stark, self, nil,
					'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_frieren_sub_part_time_s1_12')

			--주인장(down,scared,cast): 으윽… 최대한 빨리 도와줬으면 하는데….
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(master, self, nil,
					'cast', 'scared', 'ss_frieren_sub_part_time_s1_13')

			self.current_state = self.states.before_master_interact
		end
	end

	character_util.add_listener(master, self.controller)

	--컨트롤 해제
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
end

function local_class:convert_to_acting_leader()
	-- 기존 파티 정보 저장
	self.party_info.leader = user_party.Leader
	self.party_info.saved_party = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.party_info.saved_party, user_party[i])
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.npc.acting_stark())
end

function local_class:convert_to_leader()
	-- 기존 파티원들 복구
	for i = 1, #self.party_info.saved_party do
		if self.party_info.saved_party[i] == self.party_info.leader then
			local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
			param.MoveCamera = false

			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.party_info.leader, param)
		else
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.party_info.saved_party[i], user_party)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.party_info.saved_party[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(self.party_info.saved_party[i], 'enabled')
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_car_crash', state = 'event', mix = 1 })

	self.current_state = self.states.play_activity
	self.is_playing = true

	scene_util.set_group_anim({ self.npc.kid(1), self.npc.kid(2), self.npc.kid(3) }, self, 'run')

	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = 300, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished', show_ui = true })

	local dt = 0
	while self.is_playing and not self.stage_end do
		dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		--kid update
		self.kid_info:foreach(function(key, info)
			self:kid_update(key, dt)

			--player to kid aabb
			if not self.is_hit and
					info.current_state == self.kid_state.run and
					self:aabb(leader.Bounds, info.fo.Bounds) then
				start_coroutine(function()
					self.is_hit = true
					self:hit_routine(info.fo.Position)
					self.is_hit = false
				end)
			end
		end)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--초기화
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.npc.kid(i))
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.npc.kid(i), self.controller)
	end
end
