function local_class:kid_update(key, dt)
	local current_info = self.kid_info:get(key)
	local fo = current_info.fo
	local speed = 6

	if current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.run_start then
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.visible)
		character_util.set_position(fo, fo.Position, false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'awesome')
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'run')

		--info
		current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.run
		current_info.time_passed = 0
		current_info.max_duration = 7
	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.run then
		--행선지 설정
		local current_wp = current_info.wp[current_info.wp_count]
		local next_wp = current_info.wp_count == #current_info.wp and current_info.wp[1] or current_info.wp[current_info.wp_count + 1]

		--이동
		local dir_vector = (next_wp - current_wp).normalized
		local move_pos = dir_vector * dt * speed
		fo.Position = fo.Position + move_pos

		--info
		current_info.time_passed = current_info.time_passed + dt

		local check = false
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)
		fo.Direction = dir

		if dir == direction_constants.up then
			check = next_wp.z <= fo.Position.z
		elseif dir == direction_constants.down then
			check = next_wp.z >= fo.Position.z
		elseif dir == direction_constants.left then
			check = next_wp.x >= fo.Position.x
		elseif dir == direction_constants.right then
			check = next_wp.x <= fo.Position.x
		end

		if check then
			if current_info.wp_count < #current_info.wp then
				current_info.wp_count = current_info.wp_count + 1
			else
				current_info.wp_count = 1
			end
		end

		if current_info.time_passed > current_info.max_duration and self.current_state == self.states.play_activity then
			local num, target_pos = self.controller.dirty_place:clean_search(current_info.label, fo.Position, 4)

			if num > 0 then
				self:look_at_side(fo, target_pos)

				current_info.dirty_number = num
				current_info.jump_target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, 1)
				current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.charge
			end
		end

	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.charge then
		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'shoot')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.add_listener(fo, self.controller)

		--info
		current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.wait
		current_info.next_state = self.kid_state.jump_start
		current_info.time_passed = 0
		current_info.max_duration = 2.5
		current_info.jump_start_pos = fo.Position

		character_util.show_attack_timer(fo, current_info.max_duration)

	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.jump_start then
		character_util.hide_attack_timer(fo)
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'get')
		character_util.remove_relate_event(fo, self.controller)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.visible)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', loop = false, parent = fo })

		--info
		current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.jump
		current_info.max_duration = 1.5
		current_info.time_passed = 0

	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.jump then
		current_info.time_passed = current_info.time_passed + dt

		local progress = current_info.time_passed / current_info.max_duration
		local pos = self:calculate_curve_move(current_info.jump_start_pos, current_info.jump_target_pos, progress, current_info.jump_height)

		character_util.set_position(fo, pos, true)

		if current_info.time_passed > current_info.max_duration then
			current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.success
			self.controller.dirty_place:dirty_create(current_info.label, current_info.dirty_number)
		end
	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.success then

		character_util.set_position(fo, fo.Position, false)

		scene_util.set_direction(fo, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'victory_extra')

		--info
		current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.wait
		current_info.next_state = self.kid_state.back_jump_start
		current_info.time_passed = 0
		current_info.max_duration = 1

	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.back_jump_start then
		self:look_at_side(fo, current_info.jump_start_pos)
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'get')

		--info
		current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.back_jump
		current_info.time_passed = 0
		current_info.max_duration = 1.5

	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.back_jump then
		current_info.time_passed = current_info.time_passed + dt

		local progress = current_info.time_passed / current_info.max_duration
		local pos = self:calculate_curve_move(current_info.jump_target_pos, current_info.jump_start_pos, progress, current_info.jump_height)

		character_util.set_position(fo, pos, true)

		if current_info.time_passed > current_info.max_duration then
			current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.run_start
		end

	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.fail then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(fo, self.controller)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
		character_util.hide_attack_timer(fo)

		--info
		current_info.current_state = self.kid_state.wait
		current_info.next_state = self.kid_state.run_start
		current_info.time_passed = 0
		current_info.max_duration = 1.5

	elseif current_info.current_state == self.kid_state.wait then
		current_info.time_passed = current_info.time_passed + dt

		if current_info.time_passed > current_info.max_duration then
			current_info.current_state = current_info.next_state
		end
	end

	self.kid_info:set(key, current_info)
end

function local_class:hit_routine(enemy_center_pos)
	local wakeup_dir = 'right'
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local leader_to_enemy_dir = (enemy_center_pos - leader.Position).normalized
	local distance = 0.7
	local speed = 6

	if self.current_clean_fo ~= nil then
		message_system:SendSync(self.current_clean_fo, CS.Oak.InteractCancelEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, self.current_clean_fo))
		self.current_clean_fo = nil
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if enemy_center_pos.x > leader.Position.x then
		wakeup_dir = 'left'
	end

	local goal_pos = leader.Position - (leader_to_enemy_dir * 0.7)

	local fx_hit_inst = self.controller.fx.hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + (leader_to_enemy_dir * 0.1))

	fx_hit_inst.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * 0.8
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, wakeup_dir)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.jump(leader, 0.5, 0.3)

	self:move_async(leader, goal_pos, distance / speed, self.game_bound)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, leader.Direction, 0, nil, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	self.controller.dirty_place:load()

	local info = { 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 13, 15 }
	for i = 1, #info do
		local cs_bound = field_util.get_zone('part_time_hit_zone_' .. info[i]).Bounds
		local data = {
			min = {
				x = cs_bound.min.x,
				z = cs_bound.min.z,
			},
			max = {
				x = cs_bound.max.x,
				z = cs_bound.max.z,
			},
		}

		table.insert(self.game_bound, data)
	end
end

function local_class:activate_quest()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.kid(1), active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.kid(2), active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.kid(3), active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.master(), active_state_type.enabled)

	if self.current_state <= self.states.before_master_enter then
		self:npc_setting()
	end

	--state
	if self.enter_end then
		character_util.add_listener(self.npc.master(), self.controller)

		self.current_state = self.states.before_master_interact
	else
		self.current_state = self.states.before_master_enter
	end

end

function local_class:deactivate_quest()
	--npc
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.npc.master(), self.controller)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.kid(1), active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.kid(2), active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.kid(3), active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npc.master(), active_state_type.disabled)

	self.current_state = self.states.none
end

function local_class:calculate_curve_move(start_pos, target_pos, progress, height)
	local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

	if progress < 1 then
		return vector_util.lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
	else
		return target_pos
	end
end

function local_class:set_by_npc_data(data)
	for key, info in pairs(data) do
		local npc = get_character(key)
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(info.marker_name)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

		scene_util.set_direction(npc, info.dir, false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, info.emo)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, info.anim)

		if info.oneline ~= nil then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			npc.Interactable.Talk = info.oneline
		end

		if info.add_listener ~= nil then
			character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)
		end

		npc.Position = pos + info.offset
	end
end

function local_class:npc_setting()
	local npc_data = {
		sub_part_time_master = {
			dir = 'right',
			emo = 'confused',
			anim = 'prostrate',
			marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
			offset = unity_class.vector3.zero,
		},
		sub_part_time_kid_1 = {
			dir = 'left',
			emo = 'smile',
			anim = 'idle',
			marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
			offset = vector(7.5, 0, 2),
		},
		sub_part_time_kid_2 = {
			dir = 'left',
			emo = 'smile',
			anim = 'idle',
			marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
			offset = vector(9.5, 0, 2),
		},
		sub_part_time_kid_3 = {
			dir = 'left',
			emo = 'smile',
			anim = 'idle',
			marker_name = 'sub_part_time_center_pos',
			offset = vector(11.5, 0, 2),
		},
	}

	--npc
	self:set_by_npc_data(npc_data)
end

-- aabb 함수
function local_class:aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

function local_class:move_async(fo, target_pos, duration, collision_target)
	local dt = 0
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0
	local start_pos = fo.Position

	local aabb_check = function(bound, list)
		for i = 1, #list do
			if self:aabb(bound, list[i]) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	while not aabb_check(fo.Bounds, collision_target) do
		dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		progress = time_passed / duration

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		if time_passed > duration then
			fo.Position = target_pos
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:look_at_side(fo, target_pos)
	fo.Direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(target_pos - fo.Position)
end

return local_class

---@class ShortStoryFrierenDungeonMonsterManager
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryFrierenDungeonMonsterManager')
local monster_pool = newclass('ShortStoryFrierenDungeonMonsterPool')
local monster_pool_system = newclass('ShortStoryFrierenDungeonMonsterPoolSystem')

function local_class:init()
	self.store = nil

	self.pooling_system = nil
	self.monster_data_list = {}

	self.cur_battle_info = nil

	self.dungeon_info = nil
	self.cur_dungeon_info = nil
end

function local_class:initialize(store)
	self.store = store

	local constants = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Dungeon/MonsterConstant')

	self.pools = constants.pools
	self.dungeon_info = constants.dungeon_info

	self.pooling_system = monster_pool_system()
	self.pooling_system:init_pools(constants.pools)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self:dispose_monster_data()

	self.cur_battle_info = nil
	self.cur_dungeon_info = nil
	self.pooling_system = nil
	self.store = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.cur_battle_info == nil then
		return false
	end

	for i, battle_info in ipairs(self.cur_dungeon_info.battle_info) do
		if e.BattleGroupName == battle_info.zone_name then
			self:battle_end()

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_obj_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.cur_battle_info == nil then
		return false
	end

	for monster_name, _ in pairs(self.monster_data_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.monster_data_list[monster_name].monster, e.FieldObject) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_gold_01')
			self.store:add_gold_and_not_save(self.monster_data_list[e.FieldObject.Name].gold)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.cur_dungeon_info == nil or self.cur_battle_info ~= nil then
		return false
	end

	for i, battle_info in ipairs(self.cur_dungeon_info.battle_info) do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), battle_info.zone_name) then
			self:battle_start(battle_info.zone_name)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

--region setting
function local_class:setting_dungeon(dungeon_name)
	self.cur_dungeon_info = self.dungeon_info[dungeon_name]

	for i, battle_info in ipairs(self.cur_dungeon_info.battle_info) do
		for j, monster_info in ipairs(battle_info.monster) do
			local info = {
				key = monster_info.key,
				marker = field_util.get_marker(monster_info.marker),
				gold = monster_info.gold,
				level = self.cur_dungeon_info.level,
				zone = battle_info.zone_name,
			}

			self:setting_monster(info)
		end
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_obj_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:setting_monster(info)
	local monster = self.pooling_system:get_monster(info.key)

	-- 부활 힐을 처리한다.
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.sender = monster
	heal_info.target = monster
	heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	character_util.set_position(monster, info.marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(monster, info.marker.direction)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(monster, active_state_type.enabled)

	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, info.level - 1)
	monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(exp)

	self.monster_data_list[monster.Name] = {
		monster = monster,
		gold = info.gold,
		zone = info.zone,
		battle_check = false
	}
end
--endregion setting

--region dispose
function local_class:dispose_monster_data()
	if self.monster_data_list ~= nil then
		for monster_name, data in pairs(self.monster_data_list) do
			self.monster_data_list[monster_name] = nil
		end

		self.monster_data_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:close_dungeon()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self:dispose_monster_data()

	if self.pooling_system ~= nil then
		self.pooling_system:reset_pools()
	end

	self.monster_data_list = {}

	if self.cur_battle_info ~= nil then
		for _, name in ipairs(self.cur_battle_info.battle_gate) do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(name, false))
		end

		self.cur_battle_info = nil
	end

	self.cur_dungeon_info = nil
end
--endregion dispose

function local_class:battle_start(zone_name)
	self.cur_battle_info = { monster = {}, battle_gate = {} }

	for monster_name, data in pairs(self.monster_data_list) do
		if data.battle_check and data.zone == zone_name then
			self.cur_battle_info = nil
			return
		end

		if not data.battle_check and data.zone == zone_name then
			local monster = data.monster

			--- convert_to_monster 기능으로 다시 초기화
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, data.zone, data.zone)
			command_util.publish_monster_notice(monster, get_party_leader(), 'battle')

			table.insert(self.cur_battle_info.monster, monster)
			data.battle_check = true
		end
	end

	for i, battle_info in ipairs(self.cur_dungeon_info.battle_info) do
		if battle_info.zone_name == zone_name then
			for j = 1, battle_info.battle_gate_count do
				local battle_gate_name = battle_info.battle_gate_pre_fix .. j
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(battle_gate_name, true))

				table.insert(self.cur_battle_info.battle_gate, battle_gate_name)
			end
		end
	end

	-- following npc가 겹치는 현상 임시 텔레포트 추가
	if user_party.Count > 4 then
		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine.yield()

			local frieren = user_party[user_party.Count - 2]
			local ailie = user_party[user_party.Count - 1]
			local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(frieren.Direction)

			character_util.teleport(ailie, frieren.Position - dir)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:battle_end()
	if self.cur_battle_info ~= nil then
		for _, name in ipairs(self.cur_battle_info.battle_gate) do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(name, true))
		end

		self.cur_battle_info = nil
	end
end

--region monster_pool
do
	function monster_pool_system:init()
		self.pools = {}
	end

	function monster_pool_system:dispose()
		if self.pools ~= nil then
			for _, pool in pairs(self.pools) do
				pool:dispose()
			end

			self.pools = nil
		end
	end

	function monster_pool_system:init_pools(data)
		for key, pool_data in pairs(data) do
			if self.pools[key] == nil then
				self.pools[key] = monster_pool(pool_data.prefix, pool_data.count)
			else
				logger_util.warning(string.format('Overwriting spec is not available. [Key : %s]', key))
			end
		end
	end

	function monster_pool_system:get_monster(key)
		local pool = self.pools[key]
		local monster = pool:get_monster()

		if monster == nil then
			logger_util.error(string.format('Not enough Pooled Npc [Key : %s]', key))

			monster = pool:get_any_monster()
		end

		return monster
	end

	function monster_pool_system:reset_pools()
		if self.pools ~= nil then
			for _, pool in pairs(self.pools) do
				pool:reset_pool()
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 단순 pop 용도로 작성
do
	function monster_pool:init(prefix, count)
		self.prefix = prefix
		self.cur_index = 1
		self.container = {}

		for i = 1, count do
			self.container[i] = get_character(prefix .. i)
		end
	end

	function monster_pool:dispose()
		self.container = nil
	end

	function monster_pool:get_monster()
		if #self.container < self.cur_index then
			return nil
		end

		local monster = self.container[self.cur_index]
		self.cur_index = self.cur_index + 1

		return monster
	end

	function monster_pool:get_any_monster()
		self.cur_index = 1
		return self:get_monster()
	end

	function monster_pool:reset_pool()
		for _, monster in pairs(self.container) do
			character_util.convert_to_npc(monster)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monster)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(monster, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		self.cur_index = 1
	end
end
--endregion monster_pool

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

function local_class:close_dungeon()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { 'dungeon_activity_fail' }))
	-- 버프 제거
	self:remove_buff_all()

	self:reset_party()

	self.is_playing = false
end

--region event
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not self.is_playing or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, user_party.Leader) then
		return false
	end

	if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < 1 then
		self.is_playing = false
		sp_util.start_scene(self.dungeon_fail_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

--- 던전 진입용 파티 세팅
function local_class:setting_party(in_battle_party, out_battle_party)
	self.current_party = {}
	self.dungeon_leader = in_battle_party[1]

	-- 모든 파티원 제외
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local character = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(character)
		character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))
		field_object_util.set_active_state(character, active_state_type.disabled)

		table.insert(self.current_party, character)
	end

	-- 플레이어가 던전 액티비티 진입 전에 선택한 캐릭터를 1번 캐릭터로 설정.
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.dungeon_leader, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(self.dungeon_leader, param, true)
	character_util.set_immortal(self.dungeon_leader, true)

	-- 전투 인원 파티 세팅
	for i = 2, #in_battle_party do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(in_battle_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(in_battle_party[i], user_party, false)
	end

	-- 비 전투 인원 세팅
	for i = 1, #out_battle_party do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(out_battle_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(out_battle_party[i], user_party,
				false, CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
	end
end

--- 던전 진입 전 파티원 되돌려줌
--- 해당 함수 실행 이전에 setting_party를 거쳐야 함
function local_class:reset_party()
	if self.current_party == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 모든 파티원 제외
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local character = user_party[i]

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()

		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		heal_info.sender = character
		heal_info.target = character

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		coroutine.yield()

		character_util.convert_to_npc(character)
		character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))

		field_object_util.set_active_state(character, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.current_party[#self.current_party], active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(self.current_party[#self.current_party], param, true)
	character_util.set_immortal(self.current_party[#self.current_party], false)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.current_party[#self.current_party], 1, 0)

	for i = #self.current_party - 1, 1, -1 do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.current_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.current_party[i], 1, 0)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.current_party[i], user_party, true)
	end

	self.current_party = nil
end

--- 입장 연출
function local_class:dungeon_start_scene(dungeon_name)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local start_marker = self.markers.start_marker(dungeon_name)
	local wp_key = 'dungeon_party_wp'
	local offsets = {
		vector(0, 0, -3),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -2),
		vector(0.5, 0, -2),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -1),
		vector(0.5, 0, -1),
	}

	if start_marker.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		offsets = {
			vector(-3, 0, 0),
			vector(-2, 0, 0.5),
			vector(-2, 0, -0.5),
			vector(-1, 0, 0.5),
			vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
		}
	elseif start_marker.direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		offsets = {
			vector(3, 0, 0),
			vector(2, 0, 0.5),
			vector(2, 0, -0.5),
			vector(1, 0, 0),
			vector(1, 0, 0),
		}
	end

	-- 최초 계단 오브젝트가 있는 ■지점에 투명도 0값으로 캐릭터들 배치
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], start_marker.position)
		scene_util.show_weapon(user_party[i])
	end

	party_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(0, 0)
	party_util.set_direction(start_marker.direction)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--화면 1초에 걸쳐 일반 페이드 인 되는 동시에, 캐릭터들 이동 이벤트 진행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_05')
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	party_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(1, 1)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(party_member, start_marker.position + offsets[i + 1],
				nil, 2, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = start_marker.direction })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	screen_util.show_stage_title('ss_frieren_dungeon_start')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_side_direction(leader)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { 'dungeon_activity_start' }))
end

--- 리더 사망 연출
function local_class:dungeon_fail_event()
	local cur_leader = get_party_leader()
	local door = self.dungeon_in_door()

	--리더 캐릭터 (right, damaged, dead) 자세 출력과 동시에 하단의 액티비티 시작 문구 출력
	cur_leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	character_util.set_side_direction(cur_leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(cur_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(cur_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false })

	--던전 공략 실패…
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	screen_util.show_stage_title('ss_frieren_dungeon_fail')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	-- 던전 퇴장
	self.dungeon_controller:close_dungeon()
	self.store:force_all_data_save()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	local offsets = {
		vector(1, 0, 0),
		vector(2, 1.5, 0),
		vector(1.5, 0, 1),
		vector(1, 0, 2),
		vector(2, 0, 2),
	}

	-- 이전 리더에 따른 offset 변경
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party[1], cur_leader) then
		offsets = {
			vector(1, 0, 0),
			vector(1.5, 0, 1),
			vector(2, 1.5, 0),
			vector(1, 0, 2),
			vector(2, 0, 2),
		}
	end

	-- 최초 계단 오브젝트가 있는 ■지점에 투명도 0값으로 캐릭터들 배치
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], door.Position + offsets[i + 1])
	end

	party_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(0, 0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	--프리렌 tired 표정 (down, tired, staff_idle)
	scene_util.show_weapon(user_party.Leader)
	user_party.Leader.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'staff_idle'
	user_party.Leader.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'staff_walk'

	--(2번) 리더가 아닌 파티원 (down, tired, idle)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'tired' })

	--(1번) 액티비티 리더 캐릭터 (left, damaged, prostrate) 자세로 y값 1.5 상태로 공중에 뜬 상태.
	character_util.set_locked_dir(cur_leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(cur_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(cur_leader, { name = 'prostrate' })

	--화면 0.6초에 걸쳐 서큘러 페이드 인
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/short_story_frieren/audio:bgm_frieren_field', state = 'field', volume = 1, mix = 3 })

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.6, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(party_member, party_member.Position + vector(0, 0, -3),
				2, nil, self, wp_key, { y_mode = 'flying' })
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[0], 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[1], 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[2], 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[3], 1, 1)
	if user_party.Count > 4 then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[4], 1, 1)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--프리렌 (right, tired, staff_cast) 자세로 0.5초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'staff_cast' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--1번 캐릭터 1초에 걸쳐 y값 1로 변경되며 땅으로 내려옴.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')
	wp_util.move_async(cur_leader, vector_util.get_x0z(cur_leader.Position), nil, 1, { y_mode = 'flying' })

	--프리렌 idle 자세로 전환.
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--1번 캐릭터 (left, tired, mario jump 기상)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(cur_leader, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.remove_anim(cur_leader)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(cur_leader, 'left')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--프리렌, 페른, 슈타르크, 에일리, 크레이그 모두 idle 표정으로 전환.
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(cur_leader)
	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	user_party.Leader.CustomIdleAnimationName = nil
	user_party.Leader.CustomWalkAnimationName = nil

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('village_to_dungeon_entrance_exit') },
		{ zone = 'dungeon_entrance_field', target = get_field_object('dungeon_in_door') }
	})
end

--region 버프 처리
function local_class:check_accessory_item()
	-- buff level 1당 0.1%
	local accessory_count = self.store.resource_save_data:get_accessory_count(self.accessory_buffs.emerald_ring.key)

	if accessory_count > 0 then
		self:add_party_buff(self.accessory_buffs.emerald_ring.buff_name,
				self.accessory_buffs.emerald_ring.buff_level * accessory_count)
	end

	accessory_count = self.store.resource_save_data:get_accessory_count(self.accessory_buffs.ocean_earring.key)

	if accessory_count > 0 then
		self:add_party_buff(self.accessory_buffs.ocean_earring.buff_name,
				self.accessory_buffs.ocean_earring.buff_level * accessory_count)
	end

	accessory_count = self.store.resource_save_data:get_accessory_count(self.accessory_buffs.the_earth_necklace.key)

	if accessory_count > 0 then
		self:add_party_buff(self.accessory_buffs.the_earth_necklace.buff_name,
				self.accessory_buffs.the_earth_necklace.buff_level * accessory_count)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_buff_all()
	for key, _ in pairs(self.accessory_buffs) do
		self:remove_party_buff(self.accessory_buffs[key].buff_name)
	end
end

function local_class:add_party_buff(buff_spec_name, buff_level)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		buff_manager:AddBuff(user_party[i], CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				user_party[i], buff_spec_name, buff_level, false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_party_buff(buff_spec_name)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(user_party[i], CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party[i], buff_spec_name)
	end
end
--endregion 버프 처리

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class ShortStoryFrierenDungeonStore
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryFrierenDungeonStore')

function local_class:init()
	self.common_util = nil

	-- npc
	self.store_seller = function()
		return get_character('store_seller')
	end

	-- interact용 field object
	self.fo = {
		store_item = function(number)
			return get_field_object('store_item_' .. number)
		end,
		sign_board = function(number)
			return get_field_object('store_signboard_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		item_pos = function(dungeon_name, item_number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('store_item_pos_' .. dungeon_name .. '_' .. item_number)
		end,
		sign_board_pos = function(dungeon_name, item_number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('store_sign_board_pos_' .. dungeon_name .. '_' .. item_number)
		end,
		npc_pos = function(dungeon_name)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('store_seller_pos_' .. dungeon_name)
		end
	}

	-- data storage
	-- 악세사리는 소지 한도 3개로 제한
	self.data_storage_id = 7001903
	self.store_save_data_key = 'store_save_data'
	self.resource_save_data = setmetatable({
		accessory_max_count = 3,
		data_bit = 0,
		save_bit = {
			emerald_ring = 0,
			ocean_earring = 2,
			the_earth_necklace = 4,
			brazier_holdable = 6,
			puzzle_1_clear = 7,
			compass_holdable = 8,
			broken_compass = 9,
			hammer = 10,
			boomerang_holdable = 11,
			puzzle_3_clear = 12,
			gold = 13
		}
	}, {
		__index = {
			get_bit = function(this)
				return this.data_bit
			end,
			add_bit = function(this, bit)
				this.data_bit = this.data_bit | bit
			end,
			set_bit = function(this, bit)
				this.data_bit = bit
			end,
			get_gold = function(this)
				return (this.data_bit >> this.save_bit.gold) * 10
			end,
			set_gold = function(this, gold)
				local item_bit = this.data_bit & ((1 << this.save_bit.gold) - 1)
				local gold_bit = (gold << this.save_bit.gold)
				this.data_bit = item_bit | gold_bit
			end,
			add_gold = function(this, gold)
				-- 골드 단위가 10부터 시작
				local total_gold = (this:get_gold() + gold) / 10

				total_gold = math.min(total_gold, 100000)
				total_gold = math.max(total_gold, 0)
				this:set_gold(total_gold)
			end,
			add_item = function(this, item_key)
				local add_bit = 1 << this.save_bit[item_key]

				this:add_bit(add_bit)
			end,
			get_accessory_count = function(this, item_key)
				return (this.data_bit >> this.save_bit[item_key]) & this.accessory_max_count
			end,
			add_accessory_item = function(this, item_key)
				local cur_count = this:get_accessory_count(item_key)
				local cur_bit = cur_count << this.save_bit[item_key]
				local count = math.min(cur_count + 1, this.accessory_max_count)

				this.data_bit = this.data_bit - cur_bit
				this:add_bit(count << this.save_bit[item_key])
			end,
			check_has_item = function(this, item_key)
				local check_bit = 1 << this.save_bit[item_key]

				if (check_bit & this.data_bit) ~= 0 then
					return true
				end

				return false
			end,
		}
	})

	-- constant
	self.store_constant = nil

	-- item
	self.items = nil

	-- sprite
	self.sprite = setmetatable({
		container = nil
	}, {
		__index = {
			add_sprite = function(this, item_id, pos)
				if this.container == nil then
					this.container = {}
				end

				local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = item_id,
					pos = pos,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
					skip_text = true
				})

				table.insert(this.container, item)
			end,
			buy_potion_item = function(this, item_id, pos)
				local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = item_id,
					pos = pos,
					target = get_party_leader().Position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0),
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
					skip_text = true,
					bounce_callback = function()
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_saloon_01')
					end
				})

				return item
			end,
			buy_accessory_item = function(this, item_id, pos)
				quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = item_id,
					pos = pos,
					target = get_party_leader().Position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0),
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.find_looter,
					skip_text = true,
					bounce_callback = function()
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_key_01')
					end
				})
			end,
			consumed_accessory_item = function(this, item_id, target)
				if this.container ~= nil then
					for i, item in ipairs(this.container) do
						if item.ItemId == item_id then
							table.remove(this.container, i)
							quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, target)
						end
					end
				end
			end,
			dispose_all = function(this)
				if this.container ~= nil then
					for _, item in ipairs(this.container) do
						quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
						item = nil
					end

					this.container = nil
				end
			end
		}
	})

	-- gold ui
	self.res_holder = nil
	self.gold_ui = nil
	self.plus_ui = { label = nil, tween = nil }
	self.status_ui = nil
end

function local_class:initialize(common_util)
	self.common_util = common_util
	self.store_constant = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Dungeon/StoreConstant')

	local storage_create = require('utils/QuestDataStorage')
	self.data_storage = storage_create.create(self.data_storage_id)

	self:setting_data()
	self:setting_gold_ui()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:close_dungeon()

	if not is_unity_null(self.status_ui) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.status_ui)
		self.status_ui = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.gold_ui = nil
	self.plus_ui = nil
	self.heal_ratio = nil
	self.store_constant = nil
end

--region gold_ui
function local_class:setting_gold_ui()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder,
			'ondemand/short_story_frieren/ui', 'FrierenGoldUI', function(prefab)
				self.status_ui = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.gameObject, prefab)
				self.gold_ui = self.status_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Gold/Item/Amount/Value'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
				self.plus_ui.label = self.status_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Gold/Item/Amount/Plus'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
				self.plus_ui.tween = self.status_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Gold/Item/Amount/Plus'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.TweenAlpha))
				self.plus_ui.label.text = ''
				self.plus_ui.tween.enabled = false

				self.gold_ui.text = self.resource_save_data:get_gold()
				self.status_ui:SetActive(false)
			end)
end

function local_class:set_active_gold_ui(active)
	if self.status_ui ~= nil then
		self.status_ui:SetActive(active)
	end
end

function local_class:show_gold_ui()

end
--endregion gold_ui

function local_class:setting_dungeon(dungeon_name)
	self:setting_data()

	-- item, sign_board
	local constant = self.store_constant[dungeon_name]
	self.items = {}

	for i, item_info in ipairs(constant) do
		local sign_board_pos = self.markers.sign_board_pos(dungeon_name, i)
		local sign_board = self.fo.sign_board(i)
		local interact_wall = self.fo.store_item(i)

		sign_board.Position = sign_board_pos

		if item_info.count ~= 0 then
			local item_pos = self.markers.item_pos(dungeon_name, i)
			interact_wall.Position = item_pos
			self.sprite:add_sprite(item_info.sprite_id, item_pos)

			sign_board.Interactable.Message = game_string:Format(item_info.sign_board_message, item_info.gold)

			local item = {
				fo = interact_wall,
				type_key = item_info.type_key,
				sprite_id = item_info.sprite_id,
				count = item_info.count,
				sign_board = sign_board,
				gold = item_info.gold,
				save_bit = item_info.save_bit
			}

			table.insert(self.items, item)
		else
			sign_board.Interactable.Message = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_sold_out'
		end
	end

	-- npc
	local store_npc = self.store_seller()

	character_util.set_position(store_npc, self.markers.npc_pos(dungeon_name))

	-- Subscribe
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:close_dungeon()
	-- Unsubscribe
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	-- item
	if self.items ~= nil then
		for _, item_info in pairs(self.items) do
			item_info.fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			item_info.sign_board.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end

		self.items = nil
	end

	-- npc
	character_util.set_position(self.store_seller(), vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- sprite
	self.sprite:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:setting_data()
	local accessory_data = self.data_storage:get_data(self.store_save_data_key)
	if accessory_data < 0 then
		accessory_data = 0
	end

	self.resource_save_data:set_bit(accessory_data)

	for _, store_info in pairs(self.store_constant) do
		for i, item_info in ipairs(store_info) do
			if item_info.count ~= -1 then
				item_info.count = self.resource_save_data.accessory_max_count -
						self.resource_save_data:get_accessory_count(item_info.type_key)
			end
		end
	end
end

--region gold 처리
---@return number 반환될 골드
function local_class:get_gold()
	return self.resource_save_data:get_gold()
end

--- 서버에 바로 보내지 않음
---@field gold number 더해질 골드 값
function local_class:add_gold_and_not_save(add_gold)
	self.resource_save_data:add_gold(add_gold)
	self:save_all()
	self.gold_ui.text = self.resource_save_data:get_gold()

	self.plus_ui.label.text = self:get_resource_text(add_gold)
	self.plus_ui.tween:ResetToBeginning()
	self.plus_ui.tween.enabled = true
end

--- 코루틴 사용 혹은 스크린 플레이 상태에서만 사용
---@field gold number 더해질 골드 값
function local_class:add_gold_and_save(add_gold)
	self.resource_save_data:add_gold(add_gold)
	self:force_all_data_save()
	self.gold_ui.text = self.resource_save_data:get_gold()

	self.plus_ui.label.text = self:get_resource_text(add_gold)
	self.plus_ui.tween:ResetToBeginning()
	self.plus_ui.tween.enabled = true
end

function local_class:get_resource_text(value)
	if value > 0 then
		return '[c][03FC1C]+' .. value .. '[-][/c]'
	end

	return '[c][F94545]' .. value .. '[-][/c]'
end
--endregion 골드 처리

function local_class:save_all()
	self.data_storage:set_data(self.store_save_data_key, self.resource_save_data:get_bit())
end

function local_class:force_all_data_save()
	local is_replaying = CS.Oak.QuestReplaySystem.IsReplaying

	if is_replaying then
		return
	end

	self:save_all()

	-- CustomState저장용 ProgressSection
	local data_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.data_storage_id)

	local fail_count = 0
	local save_success = false

	local on_success = function(_)
		save_success = true
	end

	-- 저장 성공할 때까지 요청
	while true do
		save_success = false

		local r = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendProgressQuest(stage.StageId,
				data_quest_progress.QuestId, data_quest_progress.InnerProgress, nil)
		r:Then(on_success)

		coroutine.yield(r:SuppressDefaultErrorHandler())
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('FrierenDungeonStoreDataSave Failed : SendProgressQuest Retry')
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for _, item in ipairs(self.items) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, item.fo) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.buy_item_routine, self, item)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:buy_item_routine(item)
	local offsets = {
		vector(-0.5, 0, -0.7),
		vector(0.5, 0, -0.7),
		vector(-0.5, 0, -1.4),
		vector(0.5, 0, -1.4),
	}

	local align_party_members = {}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		align_party_members[user_party[i]] = { offset = offsets[i] }
	end

	-- 각 아이템 위치에 따라 리더 캐릭터 0.5초에 걸쳐 up 방향으로 정렬.
	self.common_util:align_party_async(item.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.5, 'up', align_party_members)

	--나레이션 박스 출력
	--해당 아이템을 구매하겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_1' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy) 구매한다.
		{ 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_2', 'mercy' },
		--(brutal) 구매하지 않는다.
		{ 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_3', 'brutal' }
	})

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	if choose_result == 2 then
		return
	end

	--플레이어의 재화가 부족할 시
	local player_gold = self.resource_save_data:get_gold()
	local seller = self.store_seller()

	if item.gold > player_gold then
		--가지고 있는 골드가 부족합니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_4' })
		return
	end

	if item.type_key == 'holy_potion' then
		local dead_check = false

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			if user_party[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				dead_check = true
				break
			end
		end

		if not dead_check then
			--나레이션 박스 출력
			--부활할 파티원이 없습니다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_4_1' })
			return

		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')
	self:add_gold_and_save(-item.gold)

	local item_routine_func = {
		healing_potion = self.healing_potion_routine,
		holy_potion = self.holy_potion_routine,
		emerald_ring = self.accessory_routine,
		ocean_earring = self.accessory_routine,
		the_earth_necklace = self.accessory_routine,
	}

	--플레이어의 재화가 충분할 시
	--하단의 아이템 구매 이벤트로 진행.
	item_routine_func[item.type_key](self, item)

	--상인 (left, smile, seat) : 거래 성사! 몸 조심히 가라고.
	character_util.set_emotion(seller, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_6')

	--대사 이후 idle 표정으로 변경.
	character_util.remove_emotion(seller)
end

--- 체력 포션 구매 연출
function local_class:healing_potion_routine(item)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--리더 캐릭터 (left, idle, eat) 자세 진행.
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })

	--다른 bob_healing_potion 아이템이 나타나, fly하여 리더 캐릭터의 왼쪽 0.2칸 옆에 떨어짐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	local healing_potion_item = self.sprite:buy_potion_item(item.sprite_id, item.fo.Position)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--이후 bob_healing_potion 아이템이 리더 캐릭터한테 흡수됨.
	quest_drop_item_util.consumed(healing_potion_item, leader)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 모든 파티원들의 HP를 각각 30% 씩 회복.
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		--죽은 파티원들의 HP는 회복하지 않는다.
		if not party_member.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = math.floor(party_member.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.3)
			heal_info.isRevive = false
			heal_info.sender = party_member
			heal_info.target = party_member

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_01')
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
end

--- 부활 포션 구매 연출
function local_class:holy_potion_routine(item)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local check_revive = false

	--리더 캐릭터 (left, idle, eat) 자세 진행.
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--holy_potion 아이템이 나타나, fly하여 리더 캐릭터의 왼쪽 0.2칸 옆에 떨어짐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	local holy_potion_item = self.sprite:buy_potion_item(item.sprite_id, item.fo.Position)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		if party_member.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and not check_revive then
			--이후 holy_potion 아이템이 리더 캐릭터가 아닌 파티원(페른 or 슈타르크) 또는 크레이그 캐릭터한테 흡수됨.
			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(holy_potion_item, party_member)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			--이후 0.3초에 걸쳐 화면 화이트 페이드 아웃.
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

			--죽은 캐릭터 FX_levelup_new 이펙트 출력되며 부활.
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = party_member.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = party_member
			heal_info.target = party_member

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			--0.3초에 걸쳐 화면 화이트 페이드 인.
			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

			check_revive = true
		end
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
end

function local_class:accessory_routine(item)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 데이터 저장
	self.resource_save_data:add_accessory_item(item.type_key)
	self:force_all_data_save()

	local accessory_count = self.resource_save_data:get_accessory_count(item.type_key)

	if accessory_count >= 3 then
		self.sprite:consumed_accessory_item(item.sprite_id, leader)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		self.sprite:buy_accessory_item(item.sprite_id, item.fo.Position, '01_small_key_01')
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

	--ItemGet 연출 진행.
	local item_get_string = {
		emerald_ring = {
			spec_name = 'fr_dungeon_emerald_ring',
			--에메랄드 반지
			title = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_7',
			--당신을 강력하게 만들어줍니다.
			sub_title = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_8',
			--파티 공격력 증가
			desc = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_9'
		},
		ocean_earring = {
			spec_name = 'fr_dungeon_ocean_earring',
			--바다의 귀걸이
			title = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_10',
			--당신을 좀 더 강력하게 만들어줍니다.
			sub_title = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_11',
			--파티 방어력 증가
			desc = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_12'
		},
		the_earth_necklace = {
			spec_name = 'fr_dungeon_the_earth_necklace',
			--대지의 목걸이
			title = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_13',
			--당신을 매우 강력하게 만들어줍니다.
			sub_title = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_14',
			--파티 체력 증가
			desc = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_store_15'
		},
	}

	local item_text = item_get_string[item.type_key]

	screen_util.item_get_event(item_text.spec_name,
			item_text.title,
			item_text.sub_title,
			item_text.desc)

	-- 표지판, fo 처리
	if accessory_count >= 3 then
		item.fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		item.sign_board.Interactable.Message = 'ss_frieren_dungeon_sold_out'
	end

	local is_create, party_manager
	is_create, party_manager = global_table_util.try_get('Quest/ShortStory/Frieren/Common/Dungeon/PartyManager.lua')

	party_manager:remove_buff_all()
	party_manager:check_accessory_item()

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	-- 아이템 삭제
	for i = 1, #self.watermelon_items do
		local watermelon = self.watermelon_items[i]
		if watermelon ~= nil then
			watermelon:ConsumeComplete()
			watermelon = nil
		end
	end

	--루틴 종료
	self:stop_watermelon_destruction_show_routine()

	self.watermelon_items = nil

	-- 비치볼 아이템 해제
	if self.beach_ball_prod ~= nil then
		self.beach_ball_prod:ConsumeComplete()
		self.beach_ball_prod = nil
	end

	if self.beach_ball_virtual_wall ~= nil then
		self.beach_ball_virtual_wall:Dispose()
		self.beach_ball_virtual_wall = nil
	end

	--sfx 종료
	self:stop_crowd_sfx()
	self:stop_flamethrower_sfx()

	--오브젝트 풀 dispose
	if self.fx_flamethrower ~= nil then
		self.fx_flamethrower:Dispose()
		self.fx_flamethrower = nil
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)

	if self.quest_progress then
		local is_clear_section_1 = (self.quest_progress.IsComplete or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1)

		if e.CameraGrid.name == self.beach_ball_gird_name then
			self:play_crowd_sfx()
			if is_clear_section_1 then
				self.is_play_sfx_on_watermelon_routine = true
				start_coroutine(self.watermelon_destruction_show_routine, self)
				self:play_flamethrower_sfx()
				self:set_active_fx_flamethrower(true)
			end
		else
			self:fade_out_crowd_sfx()
			if is_clear_section_1 then
				self.is_play_sfx_on_watermelon_routine = false
				self:stop_watermelon_destruction_show_routine()
				self:fade_out_flamethrower_sfx()
				self:set_active_fx_flamethrower(false)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false

			e.FieldObject == leader and
			e.Zone.Name == self.flamethrower_zone_name then
		--플레이어가 비슈바크가 뿜고 있는 FX_Flamethrower 이펙트에 닿았을 경우
		--FX_Flamethrower 이펙트 구간에 존 처리.
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_fire_bishop_flamethrower_zone, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:watermelon_update(watermelon, time_passed, start_pos, end_pos, rotation_angle, air_time, throw_height)
	-- 수박이 날아감
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / air_time)
	local cur_horizontal_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
	local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * throw_height
	local cur_pos = cur_horizontal_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)

	watermelon.Position = cur_pos

	-- 수박이 회전함
	local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, rotation_angle, progress)

	-- 수박 그림자 위치 조정
	local shadow_pos = vector(cur_pos.x, 0, cur_pos.z)

	watermelon.ShadowTransform.position = shadow_pos
	watermelon.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)
end

function local_class:gauntlet_kick_watermelon_routine(is_succesive)
	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local male_1 = self.get_civilian_male(1)

	local sfx_volume = 0.5
	if self.is_gauntlet_kick_first then
		sfx_volume = 1
	end

	self.request_id_kick = self.request_id_kick + 1
	local cur_request_id = self.request_id_kick

	if self.is_play_sfx_on_watermelon_routine then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01', play_pos = male_1.Position, volume = sfx_volume })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', play_pos = fire_harpy.Position, volume = sfx_volume })
	end

	--남자1 NPC가 ●타일 방향으로 watermelon 아이템을 throw함.
	scene_util.set_anim(male_1, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'left', false)

	-- throw 애니메이션 시간 보정
	local throw_anim_time_offset = 0.067

	if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_kick then
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(throw_anim_time_offset)

	if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_kick then
		return
	end

	if is_succesive then
		local throw_term = 0.3
		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(throw_term)

			if cur_request_id == self.request_id_kick then
				scene_util.set_anim(male_1, self, 'eat')
			end

		end)
	else
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(male_1)
	end

	local is_air_routine = true
	local is_jump_routine = true

	-- 수박 1이 날라감
	local time_passed = 0
	local jump_started_time = 0

	--air_time 은 jump_duration보다 낮으면 안됨
	local air_time = 0.5
	local jump_height = 0.5
	local start_pos = male_1.Position + vector(0, self.watermelon_height, 0)
	local end_pos = fire_harpy.Position + vector(-1, jump_height, 0)
	local attack_anim_name = 'gauntlet_kick'

	--0.333
	local jump_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(fire_harpy, attack_anim_name)
	local is_attacked = false
	self.is_gauntlet_kick_jump_attack_routine = false

	--수박 날아가는 루틴, 신틸라 점프하는 루틴 둘 다 끝날 때 까지 대기
	while cur_request_id == self.request_id_kick and
			is_air_routine or is_jump_routine do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_kick then
			break
		end

		--수박이 공중에서 날아가는 루틴
		if is_air_routine then
			if time_passed <= air_time then
				self:watermelon_update(self.watermelon_items[1], time_passed, start_pos, end_pos, 720, air_time, 1)
			else
				is_air_routine = false
				--타이밍에 맞춰 FX_lasthit 이펙트와 함께, (hammock_fx_cwp_eighttail_explosion) 이펙트 출력되며 watermelon 아이템은 사라짐.
				self.get_fx_water_melon_hit():Instantiate(self.watermelon_items[1].Position)
				self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(self.watermelon_items[1].Position)

				if self.is_play_sfx_on_watermelon_routine then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_melon_01', play_pos = fire_harpy.Position, volume = sfx_volume })
				end

				drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.watermelon_items[1], 0, 0)
				self.watermelon_items[1].Position = start_pos
			end
		end

		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_kick then
			break
		end

		--신틸라가 점프 공격하는 루틴
		if is_jump_routine then
			--신틸라 점프 최대 높이가 될 타이밍과 수박이 최종 도착지점에 도달할 타이밍이 일치할 수 있을 시간에 점프를 시작한다.
			if not is_attacked and
					time_passed + jump_duration / 2 >= air_time then

				jump_started_time = time_passed

				if self.is_play_sfx_on_watermelon_routine and
						self.is_gauntlet_kick_first then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')
				end

				scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, self, { name = attack_anim_name, count = 1 })
				character_util.jump(fire_harpy, jump_height, jump_duration)

				is_attacked = true
			end

			--점프가 끝나면, 점프 루틴 종료
			if is_attacked and
					time_passed - jump_started_time >= jump_duration then
				character_util.remove_emotion(fire_harpy)
				is_jump_routine = false
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_gauntlet_kick_watermelon_routine = false
end

function local_class:watermelon_destruction_show_routine()
	local males = {
		self.get_civilian_male(1),
		self.get_civilian_male(2),
	}

	self.request_id_destruction = self.request_id_destruction + 1
	local cur_request_id = self.request_id_destruction

	--수박이 투명이라면 다시 보이게 설정
	for i = 1, 2 do
		scene_util.set_anim(males[i], self, { name = 'hold', one_shot_sfx = false })
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.watermelon_items[i], 0)
		self.watermelon_items[i].Position = males[i].Position + vector(0, self.watermelon_height, 0)
	end

	if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
		return
	end

	while cur_request_id == self.request_id_destruction do
		--남자1 NPC ●타일 방향으로 watermelon 아이템을 throw
		--신틸라가 jump 하며 (gauntlet_kick) 자세하며 수박 격파
		self.is_gauntlet_kick_watermelon_routine = true

		start_coroutine(self.gauntlet_kick_watermelon_routine, self, true)

		--수박 throw 한 뒤 남자1 NPC right 방향 eat 자세 0.7초 뒤 다시 수박을 hold.
		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
			break
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
			break
		end

		while self.is_gauntlet_kick_watermelon_routine do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
			break
		end

		scene_util.set_anim(males[1], self, { name = 'hold', one_shot_sfx = false })
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.watermelon_items[1], 0)

		--남자2 NPC가 ●타일 방향으로 watermelon 아이템을 throw
		--신틸라가(gauntlet_handskill) 자세하며 수박 격파
		self.is_gauntlet_handskill_watermelon_routine = true

		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
			break
		end

		start_coroutine(self.gauntlet_handskill_watermelon_routine, self, true)

		--throw 한 뒤 남자2 NPC left 방향 eat 자세 0.7초 뒤 다시 수박을 hold.

		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
			break
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
			break
		end

		while self.is_gauntlet_handskill_watermelon_routine do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if cur_request_id ~= self.request_id_destruction then
			break
		end

		scene_util.set_anim(males[2], self, { name = 'hold', one_shot_sfx = false })
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.watermelon_items[2], 0)

		--반복
	end

function local_class:set_sfx_volume(sfx, time, from, to)
	local time_passed = 0

	if sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	while time_passed < time do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local progress = time_passed / time
		sfx.Volume = from + (to - from) * progress

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	sfx.Volume = to
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_notice_fire_harpy

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, self.get_fire_harpy())

end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	-- 비치볼 아이템 해제
	if self.controller.beach_ball_prod ~= nil then
		self.controller.beach_ball_prod:ConsumeComplete()
		self.controller.beach_ball_prod = nil
	end

	-- 미니게임 dispose
	if self.mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_notice_fire_harpy and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fire_harpy()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_fire_harpy, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_notice_fire_harpy and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.notice_fire_harpy_zone) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_notice_fire_harpy

		sp_util.start_scene(self.notice_fire_harpy, self)

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_notice_fire_bishop and
			self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.after_activity and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.notice_fire_bishop_zone) then
		self.is_notice_fire_bishop = true

		start_coroutine(self.notice_fire_bishop, self)

		return true

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name or
			self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_activity then
		return false
	end

	self:mini_game_end_setting()

	--각 미니게임 클리어 후 연출이 있는 경우
	--연출 시작할 때는 컨트롤 뺏고, 연출 끝나는 시점에는 컨트롤 돌려주지 말고,
	--연출이 끝났다는 이벤트를 Publish로 보내주시면 메인에서 이벤트 받고, 연출 이어서 처리 후 컨트롤 리셋하려고 합니다.
	--sp_util사용 말고 start_coroutine으로 사용 요망
	if e.Success then
		start_coroutine(self.success_mini_game, self)
	else
		-- 미니게임 재도전 이벤트 연출 여기서 작성
		sp_util.start_scene(self.failed_mini_game, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:notice_fire_harpy()

	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 1)

	--남자3 (left, confused, prostrate) : 벌써 5세트째야… 그만하고 싶어…

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male_3, self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_1')

	--신틸라 (right, smile, idle) : 벌써 지친 거야? 난 아직 몸이 근질거린다고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

			'right', nil, 'smile',
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_2')

	--여자1 (down, smile, sing) : 저 사람 봐! 1시간 넘게 비치발리볼을 해도 전혀 지친 기색이 없어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female_1, self,

	--여자2 (down, smile, clap) : 멋져요, 언니!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female_2, self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_4')

	--카메라 다시 플레이어한테로 복귀.
	start_coroutine(self.controller.set_sfx_volume, self.controller, self.controller.crowd_sfx, 1 ,1, 0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.0)

	--인어(left, smile, idle) : 보세요! 비치 발리볼을 하고 있어요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'left', nil, 'smile',
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_5')

	--인어(left, smile, sing) : 잠깐 구경하고 가도 될까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'left', 'sing', 'smile',
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_6')

	--소히 (right, idle, question) : 흠… 저 지칠 줄 모르는 체력…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(surfer_sohee, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, 'question')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_7')

	--소히 (right, idle, question) : 운동 생각밖에 없는 근육 뇌…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_8')

	--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 저 녀석이라면 사람들 이목을 끌기 딱이겠는데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			'right', 'idle', nil,
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_9')

	--인어(left, surprise, idle) : 그, 그런가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'left', 'idle', 'surprise',
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_10')

	--소히 (right, idle, release) : 날 믿어! 자고로 가게가 흥하려면 홍보가 필수라고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			'right', 'release', nil,
			'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_1_11')

	--인어,소히 표정 idle 전환.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(surfer_sohee)

	character_util.add_listener(fire_harpy, self.controller)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

function local_class:notice_fire_bishop()
	local fire_bishop = self.get_fire_bishop()
	--비슈바크 (right, idle, question) : 기르가스 녀석한테 그런 예쁜 여자 친구가 있을 줄이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self,
			'right', 'question', 'idle',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_oneline_12',
			  skip = false })

	--비슈바크 (right, idle, idle) : 둘이 좋은 시간 보내게 잠깐 빠져있어줘야지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self,
			'right', 'idle', 'idle',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_oneline_13',
			  skip = false })

	--비슈바크 (left 방향 1회 / right 방향 1회, idle, idle) : 자, 그럼… 근처에 맛있는 음식이라도 없으려나?
	local look_around_routine = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'left', true)
		wait_for_sec(1.0)
		scene_util.set_direction(fire_bishop, 'right', true)
		wait_for_sec(1.0)
		look_around_routine = false
	end)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_bishop, self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_oneline_14',
			  skip = false })

	while look_around_routine do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--이후 해당 NPC의 마지막 대사를 원라인 대사로 출력.
	fire_bishop.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_oneline_14'
end

function local_class:interact_fire_harpy()
	local fire_harpy = self.get_fire_harpy()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	do
		local move_key = 'party_align'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer_sohee,
				self.get_surfer_sohee_pos(1, 1),
				4,
				nil,
				self, move_key,
				{ last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid,
				self.get_mermaid_pos(1, 1),
				4,
				nil,
				self, move_key,
				{ last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	if not self.is_interact_fire_harpy then
		self.is_interact_fire_harpy = true
		--소히 (right, idle, release) : 야, 근육 뇌!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
				'right', 'release', 'idle',
				'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_2_1')

		--신틸라 left 방향 전환 후 0.5초 대기.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fire_harpy)
		scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'left', false)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--신틸라 (left, idle, jump 1회) : 무슨 일이야?
		character_util.normal_jump_async(fire_harpy, '01_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self,
				'left', 'idle', 'smile',
				'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_2_2')

		--신틸라 (left, smile, idle) : 나하고 같이 비치볼 하러 온 거야?

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self,
				'left', 'idle', nil,
				'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_2_3')

		--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 아니, 다른 이유에서야.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
				'right', 'idle', 'idle',
				'short_story_mm_bbr_s1_2_4')

		--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 우린 지금 해변에서 장사를 하고 있던 중이거든.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
