local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMermaidFlappyBirdSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMermaidFlappyBird @
		Comment = 코코 영입 및 수영 미니게임 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc
	self.get_innuit = function()
		return get_character('innuit')
	end

	self.get_innuit_granddaughter = function()
		return get_character('innuit_granddaughter')
	end

	self.get_witch_coco = function()
		return get_character('witch_coco')
	end

	self.get_librarian = function()
		return get_character('librarian')
	end

	self.get_npc = function(idx)
		return get_character('sub_fb_npc_' .. idx)
	end

	self.get_surfer_sohee = function()
		return get_character('surfer_sohee')
	end

	self.get_mermaid = function()
		return get_character('mermaid')
	end

	self.get_swindler = function()
		return get_character('sub_fb_swindler')
	end

	-- fx
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in')
	end

	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_out = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_out')
	end

	-- object
	self.get_store = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('sub_fb_store_' .. idx)
	end

	self.get_store_a = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('sub_fb_store_a' .. idx)
	end

	self.item_id = {
		octopus = 20984,
		shaving_machine = 20997
	}
	self.quest_id = 7001504

	self.mini_game_name = 'FlappyBird'

	self.octopus_item_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_innuit_granddaughter_start_pos')
			+ vector(3.5, 0, 0)

	self.mini_game_clear_event_key = 'mini_game_clear_signal'

	self.octopus_item = nil

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		-- 코코에게 말걸기 전
		before_innuit_interact = 2,
		-- 미니게임 시작 전
		before_mini_game = 3,
		-- 미니게임 클리어 후
		mini_game_clear = 4,
		done = 5
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 존 엔터 중복 방지용 플래그의 명칭을 알기 쉽게 is_in_zone 으로 묶음
	self.is_in_zone = {
		sub_fb_witch_coco = false,
		sub_fb_innuit = false
	}

	self.is_interact_innuit = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in()
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_out()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_innuit_interact
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()
	local witch_coco = self.get_witch_coco()
	local librarian = self.get_librarian()

	--마코의 바다 오른편에 (basket_octopus) 아이템이 배치되어있음.
	self.octopus_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = self.octopus_item_pos,
		itemid = self.item_id.octopus,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true,
		showoncharacter = true
	})

	--최초 NPC는 다음과 같이 배치된 상태.
	--코코 (right, idle, idle) 상태.
	local innuit_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_innuit_start_pos')
	character_util.set_position(innuit, innuit_start_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(innuit)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	--마코 (right, tired, idle) 상태.
	local innuit_granddaughter_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_innuit_granddaughter_start_pos')
	character_util.set_position(innuit_granddaughter, innuit_granddaughter_start_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim(innuit_granddaughter)
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	--루피나 (right, attack, idle) 상태.
	local witch_coco_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_witch_coco_start_pos')
	character_util.set_position(witch_coco, witch_coco_start_pos)
	scene_util.set_emotion(witch_coco, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(witch_coco, self, { name = 'sword_idle' })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(witch_coco, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	--손에 (selfie_stick) 아이템을 들고 있음.
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(witch_coco, '[base]weapon1', 'selfie_stick')

	--란 (left, idle, librarian/writing) 상태.
	local librarian_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_librarian_start_pos')
	character_util.set_position(librarian, librarian_start_pos)
	character_util.remove_emotion(librarian)
	scene_util.set_anim(librarian, self, { name = 'librarian/writing' })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(librarian, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

	local npc = {
		self.get_npc(1),
		self.get_npc(2),
		self.get_npc(4),
		self.get_npc(5),
	}

	--플레이어 각 NPC들 인터렉트 시, 아래의 원라인 대사 출력.
	--남자1 (right, idle, idle) 상태.
	local npc_1_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_npc_pos_2')
	character_util.set_position(npc[1], npc_1_start_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc[1])
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(npc[1], { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	--남자1 (right, idle, idle) : 실컷 놀았더니, 뭔가 시원한게 땡기는걸…
	npc[1].Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_oneline_1'
	npc[1].Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01'

	--남자2 (left, idle, idle) 상태.
	local npc_2_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_npc_pos_2') + vector(1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(npc[2], npc_2_start_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc[2])
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(npc[2], { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

	--남자2 (left, idle, idle) : 나도! 근처에 빙수 같은거 파는 곳 없나? 
	npc[2].Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_oneline_2'

	--여자1 (right, smile, idle) 상태.
	local npc_3_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_npc_pos_1')
	character_util.set_position(npc[3], npc_3_start_pos)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc[3], self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(npc[3])
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(npc[3], { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	--여자1 (right, smile, idle) : 우리 같이 빙수 사서 나눠 먹을래?
	npc[3].Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_oneline_3'

	--여자2 (left, smile, idle) 상태.
	local npc_4_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_npc_pos_1') + vector(1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(npc[4], npc_4_start_pos)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc[4], self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(npc[4])
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(npc[4], { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

	--여자2 (left, smile, idle) : 찬성! 난 무조건 딸기맛으로!
	npc[4].Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_oneline_4'
	npc[4].Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01'

	--퀘스트 마커는 코코 NPC를 가리키고 있는중.
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, true, innuit)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	if self.mini_game ~= nil then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	if self.octopus_item ~= nil then
		self.octopus_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.octopus_item = nil
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if not self.is_in_zone.sub_fb_witch_coco and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.mini_game_clear and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_fb_witch_coco_zone') then
		self.is_in_zone.sub_fb_witch_coco = true
		start_coroutine(self.witch_coco_zone_enter_event, self)

		return true
	elseif not self.is_in_zone.sub_fb_innuit and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_fb_innuit_zone') then
		self.is_in_zone.sub_fb_innuit = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.innuit_zone_enter_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_innuit_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, innuit) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_mini_game
		start_coroutine(self.innuit_interact_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		if e.Success then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.mini_game_clear
			start_coroutine(self.game_cleared_scene, self)
		elseif not e.Success then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.fail_mini_game, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:mini_game_start()
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, 'shortstory_mermaid_flappy_bird', function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:witch_coco_zone_enter_event()
	local witch_coco = self.get_witch_coco()
	local librarian = self.get_librarian()

	--루피나 (right, attack, idle) : 며칠째 구독자 수가 늘지 않고 있느니라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(witch_coco, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_11', false)

	--루피나 (right, attack, idle) : 이 몸의 악명을 퍼뜨릴 새로운 방법이 필요한 것이다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(witch_coco, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_12', false)

	--란 (left, idle, librarian/writing) : 얼음 마녀의 언짢음을 확인. 란은 이를 기록하였다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(librarian, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_13', false)

	--이후 두 NPC의 마지막 대사를 원라인 대사로 출력.
	witch_coco.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_12'
	librarian.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_13'
	librarian.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_turn_page_01'
end

function local_class:innuit_zone_enter_event()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	--플레이어(인어)가 제자리에 멈추며, 소히가 인어 캐릭터의 왼쪽에 정렬. 
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, 'right')

	local sohee_align_pos = mermaid.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(surfer_sohee, {
		sohee_align_pos
	}, 3, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	--카메라 코코,마코를 중심으로 패닝.
	local camera_pos = innuit.Position
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	--마코 (right, tired, cast) : 미안해 코코 언니… 그만 인형을 놓쳐버렸어…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_1', skip = true })

	--마코 left 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

	--코코 (right, idle, idle) : 괜찮아, 마코. 아직 물 위에 떠있으니까…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_2')

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	character_util.remove_anim(innuit_granddaughter)

	--4초동안 (basket_octopus) 아이템의 y값이 늘어나며 바다로 가라앉는 연출.

	-- 아이템이 회전할 횟수
	local water_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_water_loop_06',
		play_pos = self.octopus_item.Position,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	local cur_rot_z = nil
	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(2, function(progress)
		-- 아이템이 서서히 줄어들면서 가라앉는 표현

		-- 2초에 걸쳐 180도 회전( 문어의 머리가 바닥을 향하도록
		cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, -90, progress)
		self.octopus_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)
		self.octopus_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)
	end)

	--인형 아이템 rotation 회전하며 fx_common_water_splash_in 이펙트 와 함께 사라짐.
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(water_loop_sfx, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_water_01', 0.6)
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in():Instantiate(self.octopus_item_pos)

	self.octopus_item:ConsumeComplete()
	self.octopus_item = nil

	--코코,마코 surprise 표정 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'surprise')

	--대기 0.7초
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--코코 tired 표정 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, 'tired')

	--마코 (left, cry, idle) : 어떡해… 언니가 사준 소중한 인형인데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'cry', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_3', skip = true })

	--카메라 다시 플레이어한테로 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 코코잖아?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(surfer_sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_4')

	--소히 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 저기서 뭐하고 있는거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_5', skip = true })

	--인어(left, tired, sing) : 뭔가 안 좋은 일이 있나 본데… 가서 도와드릴까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'left',
			'sing',
			'tired',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_6', skip = true })

	--소히 (right, tired, idle) : 뭔 소리야. 도움이 필요한 건 우리란 거 잊었어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(surfer_sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_7')

	--소히 (right, idle, question) : 맞아! 생각해보니까 코코 녀석, 얼음을 만들 수 있었잖아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
			'question',
			'idle',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_8', skip = true })

	--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 한가해 보이는데, 빙수라도 만들게 시키면 딱이겠어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(surfer_sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_9')

	--인어(left, surprise, idle) : 도, 도와드리는 게 아니고요?!
	--인어,소히 표정 idle 전환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'left',
			nil,
			'surprise',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_10', skip = true })

	character_util.add_listener(innuit, self.controller)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:innuit_interact_event()
	sp_util.enter_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	--코코 NPC 인터렉트 시, 플레이어(인어)는 ■타일에, 소히는 ■타일 각각 right 방향을 바라보고 정렬하며 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	local align_wp = {
		innuit.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		innuit.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
	}

	local party_align_key = 'sub_fb_s1_party_align_key'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer_sohee, {
		align_wp[1]
	}, 3, nil, self, party_align_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid, {
		align_wp[2]
	}, 3, nil, self, party_align_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_align_key)

	if not self.is_interact_innuit then
		self.is_interact_innuit = true
		--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 야, 코코!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(surfer_sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_14')

		--코코 left 방향 전환 후 0.5초 대기.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'left' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--코코 (left, idle, jump 1회) : 소히? 여긴 어쩐 일이야?
		character_util.remove_emotion(innuit)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(innuit, true)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_15')

		--소히 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 한가하게 바다 구경이나 하고 있길래, 마침 잘 만났다 싶어서.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'cross_arm' },
				'idle',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_16', skip = true })

		--코코 (left, tired, idle) : 넌 여전히 예의가 없구나.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left',
				nil,
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_17', skip = true })

		--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 우린 지금 이곳 해변에서 장사를 하고 있던 중이었거든.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(surfer_sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_18')

		--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 영업에 도움이 될만한 직원을 찾고 있던 중인데…
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(surfer_sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_19')

		--소히 (right, idle, release) : 네가 만든 얼음으로 빙수를 팔면 딱일 것 같아서 말이지.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
				'release',
				'idle',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_20', skip = true })

		--코코 (left, tired, idle) : 미안하지만, 난 지금 네 부탁을 들어줄 기분이 아니야.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_21')

		--코코 (right, tired, idle) : 마코가 슬퍼하는 걸 두고 볼 순 없다고.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'right' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_22')

		--인어 (right, tired, cast) : 아까 멀리서 봤어요. 인형을 잃어버리셨죠?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'right',
				'cast',
				'tired',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_23', skip = true })

		--마코 (left, tired, idle) : 네, 맞아요…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'left',
				nil,
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_24', skip = true })

		--인어가 idle 표정으로 question 자세하며 동시에 (silence) 이모티콘 표시
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(mermaid, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'question' },
				{ name = 'idle' },
				'silence')

		--소히, 코코 NPC left 방향 전환.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

		--코코 idle 표정으로 전환.
		character_util.remove_emotion(innuit)

		--인어 (right, smile, release) : 제가 가서 찾아올게요! 저, 수영엔 자신 있거든요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'right',
				'release',
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_25', skip = true })

		--마코 (left, surprise, idle) : 정말요?!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'left',
				nil,
				{ name = 'surprise' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_26', skip = true })

		--마코 (left, smile, sing) : 감사합니다, 인어 언니!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'left',
				'sing',
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_27', skip = true })

		--소히 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 대신 그 조건으로 우리 직원이 되도록 해, 코코!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
				'cross_arm',
				'idle',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_28', skip = true })

		--코코 (left, tired, idle) : 네 말을 들으려니까 기분이 꺼림직하지만…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left',
				nil,
				'tired',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_29', skip = true })

		--코코 (left, idle, nod 1회) : 마코를 도와준다면… 생각해 볼게.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left',
				'nod',
				'idle',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_30', skip = true })
	end

	--코코 (left, idle, idle) : 지금 들어갈 거야?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_31')

	--선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--『예』 (mercy)
		{ 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_choose_1_1', 'mercy' },
		--『아니오』 (brutal)
		{ 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_choose_1_2', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--『예』 (mercy)
		--인어 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 네! 준비됐어요! 
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
				'idle',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_32', skip = true })

		--소히 (left, idle, release) : 영업에 지장 없게 서둘러서 갔다 오라고.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				'release',
				'idle',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_32_1', skip = true })

		--마코 (left, smile, idle) :  인어 언니… 조심해서 다녀오세요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'left',
				nil,
				'smile',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_32_2', skip = true })

		do
			--인어 캐릭터 아래로 1타일 이동 후 right 방향 전환.
			local mermaid_wp = mermaid.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

			wp_util.move_async(mermaid, mermaid_wp, 3, nil,
					{ run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
			
			--대기 0.5초
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		--소히, 코코, 마코 NPC right 방향 전환.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		do
			local run_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_dash_21',
				parent = mermaid,
				loop = true,
				type_priority = 'loop',
				player_priority = 'npc'
			})

			--인어 캐릭터 오른쪽으로 3타일 run 한 후 jump 하여 바다로 뛰어듬.
			local mermaid_wp = {
				mermaid.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				mermaid.Position + vector(6, 0, 0),
			}

			local speed = 6
			local jump_dist = math.abs(mermaid_wp[1].x - mermaid_wp[2].x)
			local jump_dur = jump_dist / speed
			local jump_height = 2

			wp_util.move_async(mermaid, mermaid_wp, speed, nil,
					{ run = false, callback = function(wp_index)
						if wp_index == 0 then
							music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_loop_sfx)
							scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
							character_util.jump(mermaid, jump_height, jump_dur)
						elseif wp_index == 1 then
							--fx_common_water_splash_in 이펙트와 함께 인어 캐릭터 사라짐. 
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_water_01', 0.6)
							self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in():Instantiate(mermaid.Position)
							character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(mermaid, 0, 0)
						end
					end })
		end

		character_util.convert_to_npc(surfer_sohee)

		--대기 0.5초 이후 화면 페이드 아웃.
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:mini_game_start()

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--『아니오』 (brutal)
		--인어 (right, idle, idle) : 나중에 다시 찾아올게요. 
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_33')

		--선택지 창 제거되며 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.

		--이후 코코 NPC 재인터렉트 시, “지금 들어갈 거야?” 대사부터 진행.
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_innuit_interact
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, true, innuit)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end
end

function local_class:fail_mini_game()
	--미니게임에 실패 후 원래 위치로 돌아왔을 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	self:fail_mini_game_scene()
end

function local_class:fail_mini_game_scene()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()

	--인어는 right, 소히와 코코와 마코는 left 방향 바라보는 상태.
	--인어, 소히, 코코, 마코 NPC 모두 tired 표정
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(innuit)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(innuit_granddaughter)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(surfer_sohee)

	local mermaid_pos = surfer_sohee.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(mermaid, mermaid_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(mermaid, true)

	--플레이어(인어)는 ■타일에, 소히는 ■타일에 위치
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--화면 서큘러 페이드 인이 완전히 끝난 이후 하단의 대사 진행.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.5 })

	--마코 (left, idle, idle) : 인어 언니… 괜찮아요?
	character_util.remove_emotion(innuit_granddaughter)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit_granddaughter, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_fail_1')

	--인어(right, tired, idle) : 전 괜찮아요… 바닷속에 물고기가 많다 보니 그만…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_fail_2')

	--인어(left, tired, release) : 다시 가서 꼭 인형을 찾아드릴게요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'right',
			'release',
			'tired',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_fail_3', skip = true })--인어, 소히, 코코, 마코 NPC 모두 idle 표정으로 전환.

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	--이후 코코 NPC 재인터렉트 시, “지금 들어갈 거야?” 대사부터 진행.
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(surfer_sohee, user_party, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(innuit)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(innuit_granddaughter)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(surfer_sohee)

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, true, innuit)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_innuit_interact
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:game_cleared_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local octopus_item_id = 20984

	--플레이어 제자리에 멈춤.
	local octopus_start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', vector(0, 0, 48), 1)
	local octopus_item_wp = {
		octopus_start_pos,
		octopus_start_pos + vector(-4, 0, 0)
	}

	--이후 8번 위치에 (basket_octopus) 아이템 출현.
	local octopus_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = octopus_start_pos,
		itemid = octopus_item_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true,
		showoncharacter = true
	})

	--8번 위치에 (basket_octopus) 아이템이 왼쪽으로 3칸 이동한 뒤 멈춤.
	--해당 아이템의 속도는 돌(rock)과 동일.
	local octopus_move_dur = 3
	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(octopus_move_dur, octopus_item_wp[1], octopus_item_wp[2], function(_, cur_value)
		octopus_item.Position = cur_value
	end)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.controller.bg_scrolling_end_key }))

	--인어 캐릭터 jump 1회.
	character_util.normal_jump_async(mermaid, true)

	--플레이어 원래 시작점 위치로 자동 정렬.
	local move_speed = 6
	local mermaid_wp = octopus_item_wp[2] + vector(-0.8, 0, -0.2)

	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, {
		mermaid_wp
	}, move_speed, nil, { run = false, locked_dir = 'right' })

	--인어 캐릭터가 (basket_octopus) 아이템이 있는 위치로 이동 후 right 방향 eat 자세 1초.
	local equipping_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = mermaid,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	character_util.set_anim(mermaid, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_loop_sfx)

	--아이템이 획득 되며 victory_extra 애니메이션과 함께 액티비티 클리어 문구 출력.
	octopus_item.ConsumeTarget = mermaid
	octopus_item:Fly()

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.set_anim(mermaid, { name = 'victory_extra' })

	--화면 페이드 아웃 되며, 미니게임 시작 전 위치로 돌아옴.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.controller.stop_bgm_key }))
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.controller.game_clear_scene_end_event_key }))

	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)
	self:mini_game_ending_scene()
end

function local_class:mini_game_ending_scene()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()

	--(추가)미니게임 클리어 이후
	--NPC의 배치가 다음과 같이 변경됨.
	--코코 (right, idle, idle)
	local innuit_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_innuit_start_pos') + vector(-1, 0, 1)
	character_util.set_position(innuit, innuit_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(innuit)

	--마코 (right, tired, idle)
	local innuit_granddaughter_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_innuit_start_pos') + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(innuit_granddaughter, innuit_granddaughter_pos)
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	--소히 (right, idle, idle)
	local surfer_sohee_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_innuit_start_pos') + vector(-2, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.set_position(surfer_sohee, surfer_sohee_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(surfer_sohee)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	local mermaid_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_innuit_start_pos') + vector(4, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(mermaid, mermaid_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(mermaid, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(mermaid, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	do
		local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_camera_pos_1') + vector(2, 0, -2)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)

		--Stage Camera 크기 3값으로 화면 고정.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)
	end

	--인어 캐릭터는 바다에서 보이지 않도록 처리.
	--화면 서큘러 페이드 인.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.5 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--마코 (right, tired, idle) : 인어 언니… 괜찮을까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit_granddaughter, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_1')

	--대기 0.7초
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--인어가 (basket_octopus) 아이템을 든채로,
	local octopus_bone_follow_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = mermaid_pos + vector(-0.3, 0, 0.5),
		itemid = self.item_id.octopus,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true,
		showoncharacter = true,
		sprscale = 0.7
	})

	--left 방향 get 자세로 jump( fx_common_water_splash_out 이펙트 출력) 하여 지정된 위치로 올라옴.
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'get', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_water_01')
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_out():Instantiate(mermaid_pos)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(mermaid, 1, 0)

	--인어가 jump 하는 동시에 코코,마코,소히의 표정 surprise로 변경.
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'surprise')

	--해당 연출과 동시에, 2초 동안 Stage Camera 크기가 4값으로 줌아웃되면서 슬로우 모션 진행.
	local slow_dur = 1
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, slow_dur)

	local slow_zoom = 'slow_zoom'
	time_util.mod(slow_zoom, 0.5)

	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_camera_pos_1') + vector(0, 0, -2)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, slow_dur)

	do
		local mermaid_wp = mermaid.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0)
		local speed = 5
		local jump_dist = math.abs(mermaid.Position.x - mermaid_wp.x)
		local jump_dur = jump_dist / speed
		local jump_height = 2
		local offset = vector(-0.3, 0, 0.8)
		local start_pos = mermaid.Position + offset
		local target_pos = mermaid_wp + offset
		local move_end = false

		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(jump_dur, function(progress)
				local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
				local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * jump_height + lerp_pos.y
				local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)
				octopus_bone_follow_item.Position = cur_pos
			end)

			octopus_bone_follow_item:ConsumeComplete()
			octopus_bone_follow_item = nil
			move_end = true
		end)

		character_util.jump(mermaid, jump_height, jump_dur)
		wp_util.move_async(mermaid, mermaid_wp, speed, nil,
				{ run = false })

		while not move_end do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	time_util.unmod(slow_zoom)

	--인어 (left, smile, idle) : 오래 기다렸지?
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(mermaid, '[base]weapon1', 'basket_octopus')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'staff_idle', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_2', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	--마코 (right, smile, jump 1회) : 내 인형!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(innuit_granddaughter, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'right',
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_3', skip = true })

	--인어가 (left, smile, staff_walk)로 왼쪽으로 1칸 이동한 후 
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'staff_walk' })

	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, mermaid.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 3, nil,
			{ run = false })

	--push하며 마코에게 basket_octopus 아이템을 건네줌.
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'push' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			self.deviate_dur = 0.4
			local deviate_clear_dur = 0.3
			local deviation_pos = vector(-0.3, 0, 0)

			character_util.spine_deviate_local(mermaid, deviation_pos, self.deviate_dur, deviate_clear_dur)

			-- push 애니메이션으로 deviate_dur 동안 앞으로 밀리면서 아이템을 건내주는 연출
			wait_for_sec(self.deviate_dur)

			-- 되돌아오는 deviate_clear_dur 동안은 애니메이션을 지워줌
			character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local item_offset = vector(-0.3, 0, 0.3)
			local octopus_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = self.item_id.octopus,
				pos = mermaid.Position + item_offset,
				skip_text = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				showoncharacter = false,
				notforinven = true,
				sprscale = 0.7
			})

			character_util.spine_remove_attachment(mermaid, '[base]weapon1')

			local item_move_start_pos = mermaid.Position + item_offset
			local item_move_end_pos = mermaid.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0.3)
			coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(self.deviate_dur, item_move_start_pos, item_move_end_pos, function(_, cur_value)
				octopus_item.Position = cur_value
			end)

			--마코에게 아이템이 습득되며, 마코 NPC의 손에 basket_octopus 아이템이 들려짐.
			octopus_item.ConsumeTarget = innuit_granddaughter
			octopus_item:Fly()
		end)
	})

	self.deviate_dur = nil

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(innuit_granddaughter, '[base]weapon1', 'basket_octopus')
	scene_util.set_anim(innuit_granddaughter, self, { name = 'staff_idle', loop = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

	--코코 표정 smile 로 전환, 소히의 표정 idle 로 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_emotion(surfer_sohee)

	--마코 (right, smile, idle) : 감사합니다, 인어 언니!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit_granddaughter, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_4')

	--코코 (right, smile, idle) : 잘 됐다... 감사합니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_5')

	--소히 (right, idle, release) : 자, 코코! 약속대로 우리 직원으로 들어오도록 해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
			'release',
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_6', skip = true })

	--코코 (left, tired, idle) : 도와준 건 저 사람인데 큰소리치긴…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left',
			nil,
			'tired',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_7', skip = true })

	--코코 (left, idle, idle) : 알았어. 뭘 도와주면 된다고?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_8')

	--소히 (right, doyagao, cross_arm) : 너한테 딱 맞는 일이 하나 있거든.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm',
			'doyagao',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_ending_9', skip = true })

	--화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(innuit_granddaughter, '[base]weapon1')

	self:mini_game_clear_pre_setting()
	self:mini_game_clear_scene()
end

function local_class:mini_game_clear_pre_setting()
	local swindler = self.get_swindler()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()

	--상단에 각각 루피나 상가/ 코코 상가 건물이 새로 배치됨.
	self.controller:s1_after_minigame_s2_npc_setting()

	--돌프 (left, idle, idle) 상태.
	local swindler_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_swindler_pos')
	character_util.set_position(swindler, swindler_pos)
	character_util.set_active_state(swindler, 'enabled')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(swindler, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(swindler)

	local kids_npc = {}
	local kids_npc_pos = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_npc_pos_5'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_npc_pos_5') + vector(1, 0, 0)
	}

	--꼬마(남)(right, idle, cast) 상태.
	--손에는 임시 (summer_shaved_ice) 아이템을 들음.
	--꼬마(여)(left, idle, cast) 상태.
	--손에는 임시 (summer_shaved_ice) 아이템을 들음.
	for idx = 7, 8 do
		local kid = self.get_npc(idx)
		table.insert(kids_npc, kid)
	end

	for idx = 1, 2 do
		character_util.remove_emotion(kids_npc[idx])
		scene_util.set_anim(kids_npc[idx], self, { name = 'staff_idle', upper = true })
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(kids_npc[idx], '[base]weapon1', 'summer_shaved_ice')
		character_util.set_position(kids_npc[idx], kids_npc_pos[idx])
		character_util.set_position(kids_npc[idx], kids_npc_pos[idx])
	end

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(kids_npc[1], { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(kids_npc[2], { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

	--플레이어(인어)는 ■타일에, 소히는 ■타일에서 right 방향 바라보는 상태.
	local mermaid_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_npc_pos_4') + vector(-3, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_position(mermaid, mermaid_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	local surfer_sohee_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_npc_pos_4') + vector(-2, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_position(surfer_sohee, surfer_sohee_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(surfer_sohee)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
end

function local_class:mini_game_clear_scene()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()
	local witch_coco = self.get_witch_coco()
	local swindler = self.get_swindler()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local npc = {}

	for idx = 1, 6 do
		npc[idx] = self.get_npc(idx)
	end

	local kids_npc = {}

	for idx = 7, 8 do
		local kids = self.get_npc(idx)
		table.insert(kids_npc, kids)
	end

	--카메라는 이미지를 기준으로 고정되어 있음.
	do
		local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_camera_pos_1') + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	end

	--화면 페이드 인.
	character_util.set_direction(surfer_sohee, 'right')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--코코 (right, idle, eat) : 조금만 기다리세요, 곧 나옵니다.
	local equipping_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = innuit,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_34')
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_loop_sfx)

	--마코 (left, smile, sing) : 차례차례 줄 서주세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit_granddaughter, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_35')

	--여자1 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 진짜 맛있어 보인다!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(npc[4], true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc[4], 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_36')

	--여자2 (up, idle, idle) : 여름엔 역시 빙수지!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc[5], 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_37')

	--인어 (right, smile, idle) : 사람들 반응이 엄청 좋은데요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'right',
			nil,
			'smile',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_38', skip = true })

	--소히 (right, smile, idle) : 그럼! 누구 아이디언데.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
			nil,
			'smile',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_39', skip = true })

	--소히 (right, smile, cross_arm) : 이게 바로 전략이란 거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm',
			'smile',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_40', skip = true })

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--빙수를 든 꼬마(남),(여) NPC가 오른쪽으로 3타일 이동 후 대사 출력.
	do
		scene_util.set_anim(kids_npc[1], self, { name = 'staff_walk', loop = true })
		scene_util.set_anim(kids_npc[2], self, { name = 'staff_walk', loop = true })

		local kids_npc_wp = {
			kids_npc[1].Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
			kids_npc[2].Position + vector(3, 0, 0)
		}
		local kids_move_key = 'sub_fb_s1_kids_move_key'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kids_npc[1], kids_npc_wp[1], 3, nil, self, kids_move_key,
				{ run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kids_npc[2], kids_npc_wp[2], 3, nil, self, kids_move_key,
				{ run = false, last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, kids_move_key)
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(kids_npc[1], self, { name = 'staff_idle', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(kids_npc[2], self, { name = 'staff_idle', loop = true })

	--꼬마(여) (left, idle, idle) : 이 빙수 진짜 맛있겠다, 그치?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(kids_npc[2], 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_41')

	--꼬마(남) (right, idle, idle) : 응! 빨리 가서 먹어보자!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(kids_npc[1], 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_42')

	--인어,소히 캐릭터 down 방향 전환하며 surprise 표정 jump 1회.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(mermaid)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'surprise')

	--동시에 꼬마(남),(여) 아래쪽으로 walk 하며 내려감, 이후 화면에서 사라질 시 제거.
	scene_util.set_anim(kids_npc[1], self, { name = 'staff_walk', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(kids_npc[2], self, { name = 'staff_walk', loop = true })

	do
		local kids_npc_wp = {
			screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', kids_npc[1].Position, -2),
			screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', kids_npc[2].Position, -2),
		}

		wp_util.move(kids_npc[1], kids_npc_wp[1], 3, nil,
				{ run = false, callback = function()
					character_util.set_active_state(kids_npc[1], 'disabled')
				end })
		wp_util.move(kids_npc[2], kids_npc_wp[2], 3, nil,
				{ run = false, callback = function()
					character_util.set_active_state(kids_npc[2], 'disabled')
				end })
	end

	character_util.normal_jump_async(surfer_sohee, true)

	--대기 0.7초 이후 하단의 대사 진행.
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--인어 (down, surprise, release) : 저, 저거! 저희 가게 빙수랑 똑같이 생겼어요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'down',
			'release',
			{ name = 'surprise', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_43', skip = true })

	--소히 (down, surprise, idle) : 그렇다는 건…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'down',
			nil,
			{ name = 'surprise', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_44', skip = true })

	--인어, 소히 attack 표정으로 right 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	--대기 0.7초
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--코코 scared 표정으로 left 방향 전환.
	character_util.remove_anim(innuit)
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'left', sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--코코 (left, scared, release) : 왜, 왜 날 쳐다봐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', keep = true },
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_45', skip = true })

	--코코 (left, scared, release) : 난 계속 여기서 빙수 만들고 있었다고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left',
			nil,
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_46', skip = true })

	--코코 right 방향 바라보며 eat 자세 유지.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	character_util.remove_emotion(innuit)
	scene_util.set_anim(innuit, self, { name = 'eat' })

	--인어, 소히 left 방향 전환, 동시에 화면 왼쪽으로 10타일 이동.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'left', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'left', sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	do
		local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_camera_pos_1') + vector(-13.5, 0, 0)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)
	end

	--남자2 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 뉴튜버가 파는 빙수! 반드시 먹어야 해!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(npc[2], true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc[2], 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_47')

	--남자3 (up, idle, idle) : 구독, 좋아요, 알람 설정까지 다 했어요!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc[3], 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_48')

	--루피나 (right, smile, idle) : 정말 네 말대로 구독자 수가 팍팍 오르는구나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(witch_coco, self, 'right',
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_49', skip = true })

	--돌프 (left, idle, nod 2회) : 그럼요! 계속 그렇게 빙수를 파는 겁니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swindler, self, 'left',
			'nod',
			'idle',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_50', skip = true })

	--루피나 (down, smile, idle) : 모두 외치도록 하여라!
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(witch_coco, { dir = 'down', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(witch_coco, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_51')

	--루피나 (down, awesome, idle) : 루피나 최고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(witch_coco, self, 'down',
			nil,
			'awesome',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_52', skip = true })

	--손님 NPC들 success 자세 하며, 중앙에 말풍선 [shout] : 루피나 최고!!!
	scene_util.set_anim(npc[2], self, { name = 'success' })
	scene_util.set_anim(npc[3], self, { name = 'success' })
	scene_util.set_anim(npc[6], self, { name = 'success' })

	local bubble_data = { bubble_direction = 'none', viewport_pos = vector(0.33, 0.4) }
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(npc[6], 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_53', true, bubble_data)

	for idx = 1, 6 do
		character_util.remove_anim(npc[idx])
	end

	--돌프 루트를 따라 오른쪽으로 4칸 이동하며, 동시에 화면도 오른쪽으로 10타일 이동.
	do
		local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fb_camera_pos_1') + vector(2, 0, 0)
		camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)

		local swindler_wp = swindler.Position + vector(4, 0, 0)
		wp_util.move_async(swindler, swindler_wp, 3, nil,
				{ run = false })
	end

	--돌프 (right, doyagao, cross_arm) : 그런 보잘것 없는 빙수는 오래 못 간다고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swindler, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm',
			'doyagao',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_54', skip = true })

	--돌프 (right, dealwithit, clap) : 뉴튜버가 파는 것에 비하면 말이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swindler, self, 'right',
			'clap',
			'dealwithit',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_55', skip = true })

	--인어, 소히 down 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })

	--소히 mad 표정으로 바뀌면서 (angry) 이모티콘 출력. 동시에 돌프가 루트를 따라 아래쪽길로 가며 사라짐.
	local swindler_w = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', swindler.Position, -2)

	wp_util.move(swindler, swindler_w, 3, nil,
			{ run = false, callback = function()
				character_util.set_active_state(swindler, 'disabled')
			end })

	character_util.remove_emotion(mermaid)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'down',
			nil,
			{ name = 'mad' },
			'angry')

	--소히 (down, mad, shake 0.03값) : 으으… 저 자식!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(surfer_sohee, 0.02, 99999)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'down',
			nil,
			'mad',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s1_56', skip = true })
	character_util.stop_shake(surfer_sohee)

	--화면 플레이어를 기준으로 돌아옴.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	--플레이어 각 NPC들 인터렉트 시, 아래의 원라인 대사 출력.
	self.controller:s1_after_minigame_s2_npc_oneline_setting()

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(surfer_sohee, user_party, true)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.done

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMermaidFlappyBirdSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMermaidFlappyBird @
		Comment = 수영 미니게임 스타피스 획득 챌린지 모드 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc
	self.get_innuit_granddaughter = function()
		return get_character('innuit_granddaughter')
	end

	self.get_mermaid = function()
		return get_character('mermaid')
	end

	self.get_surfer_sohee = function()
		return get_character('surfer_sohee')
	end

	-- fx
	self.get_star_piece_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character')
	end

	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in')
	end

	-- object
	self.get_star_piece = function()
		return get_field_object('flappy_bird_star_piece')
	end

	self.mini_game_name = 'FlappyBird'

	self.is_interact_innuit_granddaughter = false

	self.saved_party = nil

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		-- 마코에게 말걸기 전
		before_innuit_granddaughter_interact = 2,
		-- 미니게임 시작 전
		before_mini_game = 3,
		-- 미니게임 클리어 후
		mini_game_clear = 4,
		done = 5
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_star_piece_effect()
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	--마코 NPC의 3.5타일 오른쪽 바다에 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 지속 출력.
	self.controller:s1_after_minigame_s2_npc_setting()
	self.controller:s1_after_minigame_s2_npc_oneline_setting()
	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_innuit_granddaughter_interact
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end

	if self.mini_game ~= nil then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end

	if self.saved_party ~= nil then
		self.saved_party = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()

	local star_piece_effect_pos = innuit_granddaughter.Position + vector(3, 0, 0)
	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect():Instantiate(star_piece_effect_pos)
	character_util.add_listener(innuit_granddaughter, self.controller)

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
	star_piece.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_innuit_granddaughter_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, innuit_granddaughter) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_mini_game
		start_coroutine(self.minigame_challenge_interact, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		if e.Success then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.mini_game_clear
			start_coroutine(self.game_cleared_scene, self)
		elseif not e.Success then
			start_coroutine(self.fail_mini_game, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:mini_game_start()
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, 'shortstory_mermaid_flappy_bird_challenge', function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:minigame_challenge_interact()
	sp_util.enter_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()

	--마코 NPC 인터렉트 시, 플레이어(인어)는 ■타일에, 소히는 ■타일 각각 up 방향을 바라보고 정렬하며 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	local align_wp = {
		innuit_granddaughter.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
		innuit_granddaughter.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
	}

	local party_align_key = 'sub_fb_s2_party_align_key'

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i], {
			align_wp[i + 1]
		}, 3, nil, self, party_align_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_align_key)

	if not self.is_interact_innuit_granddaughter then
		--마코 (down, idle, idle) : 아, 그러고보니 인어 언니!
		character_util.remove_anim(innuit_granddaughter)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'down',
				nil,
				'idle',
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s2_1', skip = true })
		self.is_interact_innuit_granddaughter = true
	end

	--마코 (down, idle, idle) : 아까 바다에서 인형을 놓쳤을 때, 안쪽 깊은 곳에 뭔가 있는걸 봤어요!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit_granddaughter, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s2_2')

	--마코 (down, idle, question) : 뭔가 노랗고 예쁘게 빛나는 것 같았는데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'down',
			'question',
			'idle',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s2_3', skip = true })

	--마코 (down, idle, idle) : 가서 한번 확인해보시겠어요?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit_granddaughter, 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s2_4')

	--선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--『예』 (mercy)
		{ 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s2_choose_1_1', 'mercy' },
		--『아니오』 (brutal)
		{ 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s2_choose_1_2', 'brutal' }
	})
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--『예』(mercy)
		--인어 캐릭터가 right 방향 전환.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'right', sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		--대기 0.5초
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--소히 right 방향 전환.
		if user_party.Count > 1 then
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
		end

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

		do
			--인어 캐릭터 오른쪽으로  jump 하여 바다로 뛰어듬.
			local mermaid_wp = {
				mermaid.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
			}

			local speed = 6
			local jump_dist = math.abs(mermaid.Position.x - mermaid_wp[1].x)
			local jump_dur = jump_dist / speed
			local jump_height = 2

			scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			character_util.jump(mermaid, jump_height, jump_dur)

			wp_util.move_async(mermaid, mermaid_wp, speed, nil,
					{ run = true, callback = function(wp_index)
						if wp_index == 0 then
							--fx_common_water_splash_in 이펙트와 함께 인어 캐릭터 사라짐. 
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_water_01', 0.6)
							self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in():Instantiate(mermaid.Position)
							character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(mermaid, 0, 0)
						end
					end })
		end

		--대기 0.5초 이후 화면 페이드 아웃.
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--이후 미니게임 챌린지 액티비티 진행.

		if user_party.Count > 1 then
			self.saved_party = user_party[1]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(self.saved_party)
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		self:mini_game_start()

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--『아니오』(brutal)
		--선택지 창 제거되며 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
		--이후 마코 NPC 재인터렉트 시, “아까 바다에서 인형을 놓쳤을 때, 안쪽 깊은 곳에 뭔가 있는걸 봤어요!” 대사부터 진행.
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_innuit_granddaughter_interact

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end
end

function local_class:game_cleared_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()

	star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false

	--플레이어 원래 시작점 위치로 자동 정렬.

	local star_piece_start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', vector(0, 0, 48), 1)
	local star_piece_end_pos = star_piece_start_pos + vector(-4, 0, 0)

	--해당 아이템의 속도는 돌(rock)과 동일.
	local star_piece_move_dur = 3
	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(star_piece_move_dur, star_piece_start_pos, star_piece_end_pos, function(_, cur_value)
		star_piece.Position = cur_value
	end)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.controller.bg_scrolling_end_key }))

	local move_speed = 6
	local mermaid_wp = star_piece_end_pos + vector(-0.8, 0, 0)

	--인어 캐릭터 jump 1회.
	character_util.normal_jump_async(mermaid, true)

	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, {
		mermaid_wp
	}, move_speed, nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	--인어 캐릭터가 (basket_octopus) 아이템이 있는 위치로 이동 후 right 방향 eat 자세 1초.
	local equipping_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = mermaid,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	character_util.set_anim(mermaid, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_loop_sfx)

	--아이템이 획득 되며 victory_extra 애니메이션과 함께 액티비티 클리어 문구 출력.
	message_system:Send(star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.set_anim(mermaid, { name = 'victory_extra' })

	--화면 페이드 아웃 되며, 미니게임 시작 전 위치로 돌아옴.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.controller.stop_bgm_key }))
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	character_util.set_active_shadow(mermaid, true)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.controller.game_clear_scene_end_event_key }))

	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

	self:minigame_challenge_clear()
end

function local_class:minigame_challenge_clear()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	--미니게임 클리어 이후, 플레이어(인어)는 ■타일에, 소히는 ■타일 각각 left 방향을 바라본 상태.
	local party_pos = {
		innuit_granddaughter.Position + vector(-1, 0, -4),
		innuit_granddaughter.Position + vector(0, 0, -4),
	}

	character_util.set_position(mermaid, party_pos[1])
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	if self.saved_party ~= nil then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.saved_party, user_party, true)
		character_util.set_position(self.saved_party, party_pos[2])
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.saved_party, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.saved_party)
	end

	--마코 (left, smile, idle) : 좀 이따가 코코 언니랑 또 놀아야지!
	character_util.remove_relate_event(innuit_granddaughter, self.controller)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit_granddaughter, self, 'smile')

	--마코 NPC 인터렉트 시, 하단의 원라인 대사 출력.
	innuit_granddaughter.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_s2_oneline_1'

	--바다에 있던 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트는 꺼진 상태.
	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	--서큘러 화면 페이드 인, 이후 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	--퀘스트 클리어
	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:fail_mini_game()
	--이후 서큘러 페이드 아웃하며 미니게임 진입 전 위치로 이동.
	--플레이어(인어)는 ■타일에, 소히는 ■타일에 위치
	--인어, 소히 둘다 left 방향 idle 자세.
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local innuit_granddaughter = self.get_innuit_granddaughter()

	--미니게임 클리어 이후, 플레이어(인어)는 ■타일에, 소히는 ■타일 각각 left 방향을 바라본 상태.
	local party_pos = {
		innuit_granddaughter.Position + vector(-1, 0, -4),
		innuit_granddaughter.Position + vector(0, 0, -4),
	}

	character_util.set_position(mermaid, party_pos[1])
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	if self.saved_party ~= nil then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.saved_party, user_party, true)
		character_util.set_position(self.saved_party, party_pos[2])
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.saved_party, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	end

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit_granddaughter, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_innuit_granddaughter_interact

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(mermaid, true)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMermaidFoxPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMermaidFox @
		Comment = ShortStoryMermaidFox 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.pizza_box = {
		item = nil,
		item_id = 21004,
		scale = 1,
		obj_name = 'sub_fox_pizza',
		get = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.obj_name)
		end,
		load = function(this, position)
			local fo = this:get()
			fo.Position = position
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			this.item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = position,
				itemid = this.item_id,
				notforinven = true,
				sprscale = this.item_scale,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				showoncharacter = false
			})
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.item ~= nil then
				this.item:ConsumeComplete()
				this.item = nil
			end
		end
	}

	self.main_quest_id = 7001501
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()

	--스테이지 진입 시 이미 클리어 되어있을 경우
	if self.controller.starting_grade ~= -1 then
		self.controller:clear_setting()

		--나리 클리어 이후 부터 메인 퀘스트 클리어 전까지 프린세스 post 처리
		local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
		if main_quest_progress ~= nil and not main_quest_progress.IsComplete then
			self.controller:princess_setting()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.pizza_box:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.pizza_box:get()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_pizza_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_pizza_routine()
	local sea_witch = get_character('sea_witch')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--나레이션 박스 『바다마녀 아라님께 바치는 ‘최고급 게살 피자’』
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_130' })

	--아라 (right, mad , release) : 무엄하다! 내 공물에 손대지 마!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(sea_witch, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sea_witch, self, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim(sea_witch, self, 'release')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(sea_witch, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_131')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sea_witch)

	--아라 (down, idle, idle) 로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(sea_witch, 'down', false)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local pizza_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fox_pizza_pos')
	self.pizza_box:load(pizza_pos)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_fox_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fox()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_getting_the_item
		sp_util.start_scene(self.fox_interact_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_getting_the_item and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fox()) then
		start_coroutine(self.fox_give_item, self)
		return true
	end

	--아이템 관련 이벤트
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_getting_the_item and
			not self.getting_item_manager:is_picked('milk') and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_milk_obj()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.milk_item_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_getting_the_item and
			not self.getting_item_manager:is_picked('beer') and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_seller(1)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.beer_item_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_getting_the_item and
			not self.getting_item_manager:is_picked('icecream') and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_seller(2)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ice_item_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_getting_the_item and
			not self.getting_item_manager:is_picked('water') and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mermaid_friend()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.water_item_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_fox_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'fox_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_fox_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.fox_enter_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	if not self.is_drop_milk and self.current_state == self.section_state.before_getting_the_item and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'milk_drop_zone') then
		self.is_drop_milk = true
		start_coroutine(self.drop_milk_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.before_sea_witch_talk and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sea_witch_enter_zone') then
		self.before_sea_witch_talk = false
		start_coroutine(self.sea_witch_enter_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.before_princess_talk and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_princess_event_zone') then
		self.before_princess_talk = false
		sp_util.start_scene(self.princess_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'mini_game_activate_signal' then

	return false
end

function local_class:fox_give_item()
	local fox = self.get_fox()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	party_util.align_party(fox.Position, 'right', 1)

	--나리 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 그래, 내가 원하는건 가져왔어?
	scene_util.set_anim(fox, self, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_35')
	character_util.remove_anim(fox)

	do
		local choose_data = {}
		local func_data = {}

		local branch_data = {
			{
				key = 'milk',
				choose = { 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_2', 'forced' },
				func = self.milk_give_routine,
			},
			{
				key = 'beer',
				choose = { 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_3', 'intellect' },
				func = self.beer_give_routine,
			},
			{
				key = 'icecream',
				choose = { 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_4', 'mercy' },
				func = self.icecream_give_routine,
			},
			{
				key = 'water',
				choose = { 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_5', 'brutal' },
				func = self.water_give_routine,
			},
		}

		--선형적으로 선택지 생성을 위해 1번부터 진행
		for num = 1, #branch_data do
			if self.getting_item_manager:is_picked(branch_data[num].key) and
					not self.getting_item_manager:is_giveed(branch_data[num].key) then
				table.insert(choose_data, branch_data[num].choose)
				table.insert(func_data, branch_data[num].func)
			end
		end

		--줄 수 있는 아이템이 없을 경우 '줄 것이 없다.' 데이터 입력
		if #choose_data < 1 then
			table.insert(choose_data, { 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_1', 'normal' })
			table.insert(func_data, self.nothing_give_routine)
		end

		--선택지 출력
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_data)

		--해당 선택지 이벤트 진행
		func_data[choose_result](self)
	end
end
