function local_class:clear_routine()
	local fox = self.get_fox()
	local sea_witch = self.get_sea_witch()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	local oldman_1 = get_character('sub_fox_oldman_1')
	local oldwoman_1 = get_character('sub_fox_oldwoman_1')
	local kid_boy_1 = get_character('sub_fox_kid_boy_1')
	local kid_girl_1 = get_character('sub_fox_kid_girl_1')
	local swindler = get_character('sub_fox_swindler')

	self:set_clear_scene()

	--나리 리스너 해제
	character_util.remove_relate_event(fox, self.controller)

	local crowd_beach_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_03', loop = true })

	--화면 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--나리 (down, smile, idle) : 맛있는 붕어빵 있어요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_116')

	--할아버지1 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 오랜만에 먹어보는 팥 붕어빵이구먼!
	character_util.normal_jump(oldman_1, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oldman_1, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_117')

	--할머니1 (up, idle, idle) : 혹시 인절미 맛도 있는가?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oldwoman_1, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_118')

	--소히 (right, smile, idle) : 단번에 노인 고객층을 사로잡아버리다니…
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_119')

	--소히 (left, smile, cross_arm) : 난 천재야!
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_120')

	--인어(right, smile, idle) : 노인분들께서 표정이 좋아보여요!
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_121')

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	do
		local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fox_mermaid_clear_pos') + vector(2, 0, 2)
		local target_pos = camera_pos + vector(-6, 0, 0)

		--화면 좌측에서 [shout] : 문어빵 8개 주세요!
		--위 대사와 동시에 소히 attack 표정으로 left 방향 전환.
		--화면 오른쪽으로 9타일 이동.
		scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, 'attack')
		character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

		scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left', false)
		character_util.remove_emotion(mermaid)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_122', true,
				{ bubble_direction = 'none', viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.5) })

		camera_util.move_async(target_pos, 2)
	end

	--꼬마(남)1 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 소스 듬뿍 뿌려주세요!
	character_util.normal_jump(kid_boy_1, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(kid_boy_1, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_123')

	--꼬마(여)1 (up, idle, idle) : 맛있겠다아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(kid_girl_1, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_124')

	--아라 (right, idle, idle) : 별일이구나. 정말 이런 시시한 일이 소원이란 말이냐?
	scene_util.set_direction(sea_witch, 'right', true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sea_witch, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_125')

	--돌프 (left, idle, nod 2회) : 그럼요! 바다 마녀님께서 문어빵을 잔뜩 팔아주시는게 제 소원입니다!
	scene_util.set_anim(swindler, self, 'nod')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_126')

	--아라 down 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(sea_witch, 'down', false)

	do
		local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fox_mermaid_clear_pos') + vector(0, 0, 2)
		local wp_key = 'swindler'

		character_util.remove_anim(swindler)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(swindler, {
			swindler.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
		}, 2, nil, self, wp_key)

		--돌프 루트를 따라 오른쪽으로 3칸 이동하며, 동시에 화면도 오른쪽으로 9타일 이동.
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 2)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--돌프 (right, doyagao, cross_arm) : 철 지난 붕어빵 장사하느라 수고들 많군.
	scene_util.set_emotion(swindler, self, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.set_anim(swindler, self, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_127')

	--돌프 (right, dealwithit, clap) : 대세는 쫄깃한 문어빵이지!
	scene_util.set_emotion(swindler, self, 'dealwithit')
	scene_util.set_anim(swindler, self, 'clap')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swindler, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_128')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(swindler)

	do
		local target_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', swindler.Position, -1.5)

		--돌프 퇴장
		wp_util.move(swindler, target_pos, 4, nil, { end_callback = function()
			swindler.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end })

		--소히 mad 표정으로 바뀌면서 (angry) 이모티콘 출력. 동시에 돌프가 루트를 따라 아래쪽길로 가며 사라짐.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, 'mad')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'angry')

		scene_util.set_emotion(swindler, self, 'doyagao')
		character_util.remove_anim(swindler)

	end

	--소히 (down, mad, shake 0.03값) : 으으… 저 자식!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down', false)
	character_util.shake(sohee, 0.03, 99999)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_129')
	character_util.stop_shake(sohee)

	--화면 플레이어를 기준으로 돌아옴.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	--퀘스트 종료 셋팅
	do
		--기존 액팅들 완료 처리
		if not self.getting_item_manager:is_picked('milk') then
			local fo = self.get_milk_obj()
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end

		if not self.getting_item_manager:is_picked('beer') then
			local npc = self.get_seller(1)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)
		end

		if not self.getting_item_manager:is_picked('icecream') then
			local npc = self.get_seller(2)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)
		end
	end
	-- 메인 섹션에 미니게임(선택지 나리 영입) 클리어 이벤트 발송
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'mini_game_clear_signal' }))

	crowd_beach_sfx:FadeOut(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	quest_marker_util.remove(fox.Name)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

--아이템 먹는 연출
function local_class:milk_item_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local interact_fo = self.get_milk_obj()

	--방향 전환
	if leader.Position.x < interact_fo.Position.x then
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	else
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	end

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true,
												 type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player' })

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	self.getting_item_manager:getting_item('milk', leader)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	interact_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	interact_fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:beer_item_routine()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local seller = self.get_seller(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--플레이어(인어)는 ■타일에, 소히는 ■타일에 up 방향으로 정렬.
	party_util.align_party(seller.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.3), 'down', 0.5)

	--상인1 (down, idle, idle) : 어서오세요! 시원한 탄산 보리차 팔고있습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_42')

	--상인1 (down, idle, idle) : 하나 사가시겠어요?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_43')

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_6', 'mercy' },
		{ 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_7', 'brutal' }
	})

	--선택지 출력
	--『예』(mercy)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--상인 NPC가 left 방향으로 eat 자세 1초 진행.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_milkshop_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(seller, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(seller, self, 'eat')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 이후 down 방향으로 throw 애니메이션 1회 진행.
		scene_util.set_direction(seller, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(seller, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

		--이후 down 방향을 바라보고 (shield_beer_full) 아이템을 인어한테 던짐.
		do
			local start_pos = seller.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
			local target_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0.2, -0.6)

			local item = self.getting_item_manager:create_item('beer', start_pos)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
			self:item_move_curve(item, target_pos, 1, 0.5, 2)

			--『탄산 보리차』아이템 플레이어에게로 흡수되며 습득.
			wait_for_sec(1)

			self.getting_item_manager:getting_item('beer', mermaid)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			if not self.is_seller_talk then
				self.is_seller_talk = true
				--상인1 (down, idle, question) : 그러고 보니 인어님을 찾으시던 분이 계셨는데…
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.set_anim(seller, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_43_1')

				--인어 (up, idle, idle) : 저를요? 누가…?
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_43_2')

				--상인1 (down, idle, question) : 금발을 한 어떤 여성분이셨습니다.
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_43_3')

				--상인1 (down, idle, idle) : 좀 전에 오른쪽 길로 지나가셨는데, 한번 만나보는 건 어떤가요?
				character_util.remove_anim(seller)
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_43_4')

				--인어 (up, idle, idle) : 네! 알려주셔서 감사드려요!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_43_5')

				self:friend_setting()
			end
		end

		--이후 해당 NPC 아래의 원라인 대사 출력상태로 변경.
		character_util.remove_relate_event(seller, self.controller)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--『아니오』(brutal)
		--상인1 (down, idle, idle) : 언제든 찾아와주세요!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(seller, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_44')
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_92')

	--소히(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 그건 스스로 상품가치를 떨구는 행위라고, 하고 싶다면 최소한 승부가 끝나고 해!
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_93')

	--인어(left) (right) (left) 1초 간격
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--인어(left,tired,idle): 저, 저는…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_94')

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_12', 'mercy' },
		{ 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_choose_13', 'brutal' },
	})

	--선택지
	--선물한다. (초록)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--인어(left,attack,idle): 이, 이정도는 괜찮잖아요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_95')

		--물건 건내주는 연출 다이 레퍼런스
		do
			scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'push')
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(mermaid, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.4, 0.3)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			--목걸이 생성
			local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = mermaid.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.3),
				itemid = 20998,
				notforinven = true,
				sprscale = 1,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				showoncharacter = false
			})

			drop_item_util.move_item_async(item, mermaid.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0.3))

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			item.ConsumeTarget = friend
			item:Fly()
			character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)
		end

		--소히(left,tired,idle)  (annoyed) 이모티콘 버블
		scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, 'tired')
		character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

		--친구(right,tired,sing): 괜찮은건가요?
		scene_util.set_emotion(friend, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(friend, self, 'sing')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(friend, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_96')

		--인어(left,tired,nod2회): 응, 괜찮아.
		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'nod')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_97')
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--선물하지 않는다. (빨강)

		--인어(left,tired,idle) : 미, 미안해…
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_98')

		--친구(right,smile,nod2회): 아뇨! 마음만으로도 감사해요!
		scene_util.set_emotion(friend, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(friend, self, 'nod')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(friend, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_99')
	end

	--공통진행
	--친구(right,smile,idle)(jump1회) : 아 맞다!
	character_util.normal_jump(friend, true)
	scene_util.set_emotion(friend, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(friend)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(friend, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_100')

	--친구(left,smile,eat) 1초
	eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true,
										   type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player' })
	scene_util.set_direction(friend, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(friend, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	--친구(right,smile,staff_idle)로 보온병을 손에 든다. (제작 요청 예정)(마시는 연출용 90도도 발주)
	--친구(right,smile,staff_idle): 이거 저희 어머니가 인어님 만나면 드리라고 주신거에요!
	--임시스프라이트(water)
	scene_util.set_direction(friend, 'right', false)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(friend, '[base]weapon1', 'summer_thermos')
	scene_util.set_anim(friend, self, 'staff_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(friend, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_101')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(friend, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	--물건 건내주는 연출 다이 레퍼런스
	do
		scene_util.set_anim(friend, self, 'push')
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(friend, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.4, 0.3)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		local item = self.getting_item_manager:create_item('water', friend.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.3))

		drop_item_util.move_item_async(item, friend.Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0.3))

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		self.getting_item_manager:getting_item('water', mermaid)
		character_util.remove_anim(friend)
	end

	--인어(left,smile,sing): 고마워! 어머님께도 감사하다고 꼭 전해줘!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'sing')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_102')

	--친구(right,smile,idle)(jump1회) : 네! 그럼 바빠보이시니 있다가 다시 만나요!
	character_util.normal_jump(friend, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(friend)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(friend, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_103')

	do
		local move_pos = friend.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
		local outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', move_pos, -1.5)

		local run_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01',
													   parent = friend, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', loop = true })

		--친구 (run) 모션과 속도로 그리드 밖으로 퇴장후 삭제
		wp_util.move_async(friend, {
			move_pos,
			outside_pos,
		}, 4, nil, { run = true })

		run_sound:Stop()
		run_sound = nil

		character_util.set_position(friend, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
end

function local_class:fox_interact_routine()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local fox = self.get_fox()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--각각 left 방향을 바라보고 정렬하며 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	do
		local wp_key = 'align_fox'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(sohee, fox.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				4, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid, fox.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
				4, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--소히 (left, idle, idle) : 이봐, 여우 신선!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_1')

	--인어(left, tired, release) : 소, 소히님! 신선님께 예의를 갖추셔야 해요!
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'release')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_2')
	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

	--나리 right 방향 전환 후 0.5초 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(fox, 'right', false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--나리 (right, idle, jump 1회) : 뭐냐, 네놈은?
	character_util.normal_jump(fox, true)
	character_util.remove_emotion(fox)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_3')

	--나리 (right, idle, idle) : 무슨 볼일 있어?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_4')

	--소히 (left, idle, idle) : 도움이 좀 필요해서 말이야.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_5')

	--소히 (left, idle, idle) : 우린 지금 해변에서 장사를 하고 있던 중이거든.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_6')

	--소히 (left, idle, idle) : 보아하니 근처의 노인들한테 꽤 인기 끌고 있던데…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_7')

	--소히 (left, idle, idle) : 너라면 노인 고객층을 사로 잡을 수 있을 것 같아서 말이야.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_8')

	--인어 (left, tired, cast) : 부, 부탁드려도 될까요… 여우신선님?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_9')
	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

	--나리 (right, doyagao, idle) : 내가 왜? 귀찮게 시리 너흴 왜 도와줘?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fox, self, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_10')

	--나리 (right, doyagao, idle) : 그냥 여기서 맛있는 거만 얻어먹으면 되는데 말이야.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_11')

	--인어 (left, tired, cast) : 그, 그건 그렇지만…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_12')

	--나리 (right, idle, idle) : 뭐, 정 도움이 필요하다면…
	character_util.remove_emotion(fox)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_13')

	--나리 (right, idle, idle) : 내가 원하는걸 가져와 주면 한번 생각해 볼게.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_14')

	--나리 (right, idle, idle) : 뭔가… <b>시원한 게<b> 땡기는데 말이지.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_15')

	--소히 (left, idle, release) : 시원한 거? 그 정도야 얼마 안걸리지.
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, 'release')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_16')
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

	--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 이 근처 도움이 될만한 건 전부 다 챙겨 오자고!
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right', false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_16_1')

	--인어 (left, idle, idle) : 금, 금방 찾아올게요, 여우신선님!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_17')

	--3가지 아이템 보유 npc에 마커 생성
	self.getting_item_manager:set_item_quest_marker('milk')
	self.getting_item_manager:set_item_quest_marker('icecream')
	self.getting_item_manager:set_item_quest_marker('beer')

	--아이템 보유 npc 리스너 등록
	local seller_1 = self.get_seller(1)
	local seller_2 = self.get_seller(2)

	character_util.add_listener(seller_1, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(seller_2, self.controller)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
end

function local_class:fox_enter_routine()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local fox = self.get_fox()

	local oldwoman_1 = get_character('sub_fox_oldwoman_1')
	local oldwoman_2 = get_character('sub_fox_oldwoman_2')
	local oldman_1 = get_character('sub_fox_oldman_1')
	local oldman_2 = get_character('sub_fox_oldman_2')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--플레이어(인어)가 제자리에 멈추며, 소히가 인어 캐릭터의 왼쪽에 정렬.
	wp_util.move_async(sohee, mermaid.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 2)

	-- 인어,소히가 나리 NPC를 향해 바라봄
	character_util.look_at(sohee, fox)
	character_util.look_at(mermaid, fox)

	--카메라는 나리 NPC를 중심으로 패닝.
	camera_util.move_async(fox.Position, 1)

	--할머니1 (left, idle, idle) : 눈이 참 똘망똘망 하구나. 할머니가 맛있는 거 줄까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oldwoman_1, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_20')

	--할머니1 NPC가 나리 NPC한테 (rice_cake) 아이템 던져줌, 나리가 아이템 습득.
	do
		local item_id = 20991
		local create_pos = oldwoman_1.Position + vector(-0.5, 0.5, 0)
		local target_pos = fox.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = create_pos,
			itemid = item_id,
			notforinven = true,
			sprscale = 0.5,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showoncharacter = true
		})

		scene_util.set_anim(oldwoman_1, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		self:item_move_curve(item, target_pos, 1, 0.5, 3)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		item.ConsumeTarget = fox
		item:Fly()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	--나리 (right, smile, sing) : 감사합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_21')

	--할아버지2 (left, smile, idle) : 어린애 답지 않게 이런 음식도 좋아하고, 별 일이구먼.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oldman_2, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_22')

	--할아버지1 (right, smile, idle) : 자, 이것도 먹으려무나.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(oldman_1, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_23')


	--할아버지1 NPC가 나리 NPC한테 (corn) 아이템 던져줌, 나리가 아이템 습득.
	do
		local item_id = 20992
		local create_pos = oldman_1.Position + vector(0.5, 0.5, 0)
		local target_pos = fox.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = create_pos,
			itemid = item_id,
			notforinven = true,
			sprscale = 0.5,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showoncharacter = true
		})

		scene_util.set_anim(oldman_1, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		self:item_move_curve(item, target_pos, 1, 0.5, 3)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		item.ConsumeTarget = fox
		item:Fly()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	--나리 (left, smile, sing) : 정말 고맙습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(fox, 'left', false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_24')

	--할머니1,할아버지2 NPC는 우측 상단으로 이동 후 각각 left 방향, right 방향 바라봄.
	--할아버지1, 할머니2 NPC는 좌측 하단으로 이동 후 각각 left 방향, right 방향 바라봄.
	do
		local wp_key = 'old_move'
		local group = {
			oldman_1, oldman_2, oldwoman_1, oldwoman_2
		}

		character_util.remove_group_anim(group)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oldwoman_1, {
			oldwoman_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5),
			oldwoman_1.Position + vector(5, 0, 1.5),
		}, 4, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oldman_2, {
			oldman_2.Position + vector(0, 0, 2.5),
			oldman_2.Position + vector(4, 0, 2.5),
		}, 4, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oldman_1, {
			oldman_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -5),
			oldman_1.Position + vector(-8, 0, -5),
		}, 4, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oldwoman_2, {
			oldwoman_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -4),
			oldwoman_2.Position + vector(-7, 0, -4),
		}, 4, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--나리 (left, doyagao, idle) : 맛있는걸 이렇게 잔뜩 얻어먹을 수 있다니… 최고야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fox, self, 'doyagao')
	character_util.remove_anim(fox)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fox, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_25')

	--카메라 다시 플레이어한테로 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--소히, 인어 마주보게 함
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left', false)

	--인어(left, surprise, release) : 저, 저분은…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'release')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_26')
	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

	--소히 (right, idle, idle) : 아는 사람이야?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_27')

	--인어(left, idle, cast2) : 틀림 없어요! 여우 신선 나리 님이세요!
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'cast2')
	character_util.remove_emotion(mermaid)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_28')
	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

	--소히 (left, tired, bomb_idle) : 신선이 왜 저런 꼬마 모습으로 얻어먹을거나 탐하는거야…
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_sub_fox_29')

	--소히 (left, idle, question) : 가만. 저렇게 노인들한테 인기가 많다는건 …
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

function local_class:item_move_curve(item, target_pos, height, duration, rotation_num)
	local start_pos = item.Position

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local addr_height = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, addr_height, 0)

		item.Position = lerp_pos

		local cur_rotation = progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
	end)

	--보정
	item.Position = target_pos
	item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
			unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(360 * rotation_num, unity_class.vector3.forward)
	item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
			unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(360 * rotation_num, unity_class.vector3.forward)
end

	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil

	end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.inter_section_params = nil

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.ending_scene_dynamic_npc:load_async()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.interactable_item:dispose_all()

	self.ending_scene_dynamic_npc:dispose()
	self.ending_data:dispose()

	if self.black_and_white ~= nil then
		self.black_and_white:Dispose()
		self.black_and_white = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'hana_event_start_zone') and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.before_enter_event_zone then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.entered_event_zone
		start_coroutine(self.hana_speech_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, self.past_blocking_zone.count do
		local zone = self.past_blocking_zone.key .. i
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, zone) and
				not self.past_blocking_zone.is_entered then
			self.past_blocking_zone.is_entered = true
			local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone, leader, self.past_blocking_zone.dir[i])
			sp_util.start_scene(self.entered_past_block_zone, self, return_pos)
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'hana_gather_clue_clear') and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.cleared_gather_clue then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.reasoning
		sp_util.start_scene(self.reasoning_scene, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 하나 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_hana()) then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.entered_event_zone then
			-- 첫 대화
			self.current_state = self.section_state.talk_with_hana
			sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_with_hana_scene, self)
		elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.talk_with_hana then
			-- 거절 후 대화 
			sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_with_hana_repeat_scene, self)
		elseif self.started_reasoning_event then
			-- 하나 파티 이탈 후 재대화
			sp_util.start_scene(self.restart_hana_event, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	-- 단서 아이템 인터랙트
	local item_table = self.interactable_item:get_item_table_by_refer_equal(e.Target)
	if item_table ~= nil then
		if item_table.interacted == false then
			item_table.interacted = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.start_clue_scene, self, item_table)
		else
			sp_util.start_scene(self.clue_narration_scene, self, item_table.cb_narration)
		end
		return true
	end

	-- 가판대 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('hana_past_store')) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.cleared_reasoning then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_interact_chef_or_seller
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_store_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 요리사, 사장 대화 이벤트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_chef()) or
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_seller()) then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_interact_chef_or_seller then
			self.current_state = self.section_state.interacting_chef_or_seller
			sp_util.start_scene(self.last_interact_chef_or_seller_scene, self)
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	self.fx:load_all()

	quest_icon_util.pre_load()

	-- 하나 세팅
	self:set_hana()

	-- npc 세팅
	start_coroutine(self.set_npc, self)

	-- 아이템 세팅
	self.interactable_item:create_all()
end

-- npc 세팅
function local_class:set_npc()
	local chef = self.get_chef()
	local seller = self.get_seller()

	chef.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	seller.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(chef, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(seller, 0, 0)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	chef.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	seller.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

-- 하나 세팅
function local_class:set_hana()
	local hana = self.get_hana()
	local hana_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('hana_hana_start_pos')

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(hana)

	character_util.set_position(hana, hana_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(hana, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hana, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.add_listener(hana, self.controller)
end

-- 하나 독백 루틴
function local_class:hana_speech_routine()
	local hana = self.get_hana()
	local wait_time = 3
	while self.current_state == self.section_state.entered_event_zone and
			not self.controller.stage_ended and not self.controller.exclusive_quest_started do
		character_util.set_direction(hana, 'left')
		-- 분명 여기 근처일 텐데…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = 'short_story_mm_hana_1' })

		self.controller:custom_wait_for_sec(wait_time)

		if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.entered_event_zone or
				self.controller.stage_ended then
			return
		end

		character_util.set_direction(hana, 'right')
		-- 대체 어디 있는 거죠?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = 'short_story_mm_hana_2' })

		self.controller:custom_wait_for_sec(wait_time)
	end
end

	local hana = self.get_hana()

function local_class:interact_store_scene()
	local mermaid = get_party_leader()
	local hana = self.get_hana()
	local store = get_field_object('hana_past_store')
	local store_pos = store.Position

	store.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	--이후 B 아이템 스프라이트(drink_wine_1) 인터랙트 시
	--아래와 같이 정렬
	do
		local leader_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(
				store_pos + unity_class.vector3.left
		)

		self:align_party_consider_sohee(leader_pos, 1, 'left', {
			'right', 'right', 'right'
		})
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_time_travel_02')
	local watch = self:create_watch()

	local chef = self.get_chef()
	local seller = self.get_seller()

	self.interactable_item:fade_and_remove_all()

	--1번: sm_npc_a#summer_seller (left, smile, cast)
	--2번: steampunk_stew_chef (right, smile, cross_arm)
	--3번: sm_npc_a#summer_bad_male (right, smile, seat)
	--4번: sm_npc_a#summer_bad_female (left, smile, seat)
	--5번: sm_npc_a#summer_male (right, smile, seat)
	--6번: sm_npc_a#summer_female (right, smile, seat)
	--7번: sm_npc_b#summer_kid_girl (left smile, seat)
	--8번: sm_npc_a#summer_female (right, smile, seat)
	--9번: sm_npc_a#summet_bad_male (left, idle, seat)
	--10번: sm_npc_a#summer_bad_female (right, idle, seat)
	--11번: sm_npc_a#summer_female (left, idle, seat)
	local npcs = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(_, index)
			if index == 1 then
				return seller
			elseif index == 2 then
				return chef
			end

			return self.ending_scene_dynamic_npc:get(index)
		end,
		__len = function()
			return self.ending_scene_dynamic_npc.count + 2
		end
	})

	local center_pos = self.ending_data.get_talk_center_pos()

	do
		local create_data = function(pos, dir, emotion, anim)
			return {
				pos = pos,
				dir = dir,
				emotion = emotion,
				anim = anim
			}
		end

		local chair_y = self.ending_data.chair_y

		local npc_setting_data = {
			--1번: sm_npc_a#summer_seller (left, smile, cast)
			create_data(center_pos + vector(-0.75, 0, 0),
					'left', 'smile', 'cast'),
			--2번: steampunk_stew_chef (right, smile, cross_arm)
			create_data(center_pos + vector(0.75, 0, 0),
					'right', 'smile', 'cross_arm'),
			--3번: sm_npc_a#summer_bad_male (right, smile, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(1, chair_y) + vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
					'right', 'smile', 'seat'),
			--4번: sm_npc_a#summer_bad_female (left, smile, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(1, chair_y) + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
					'left', 'smile', 'seat'),
			--5번: sm_npc_a#summer_male (right, smile, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(2, chair_y) + vector(-1, 0, 0.5),
					'right', 'smile', 'seat'),
			--6번: sm_npc_a#summer_female (right, smile, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(2, chair_y) + vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
					'right', 'smile', 'seat'),
			--7번: sm_npc_b#summer_kid_girl (left smile, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(2, chair_y) + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
					'left', 'smile', 'seat'),
			--8번: sm_npc_a#summer_female (right, smile, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(3, chair_y) + vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
					'right', 'smile', 'seat'),
			--9번: sm_npc_a#summet_bad_male (left, idle, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(3, chair_y) + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
					'left', nil, 'seat'),
			--10번: sm_npc_a#summer_bad_female (right, idle, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(4, chair_y) + vector(-1, 0, 0.5),
					'right', nil, 'seat'),
			--11번: sm_npc_a#summer_female (left, idle, seat)
			create_data(self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(4, chair_y) + vector(1, 0, 0.5),
					'left', nil, 'seat'),
		}

		for i = 1, #npcs do
			local npc = npcs[i]
			local data = npc_setting_data[i]

			character_util.set_position(npc, data.pos)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data.dir)

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)

			if data.emotion ~= nil then
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data.emotion)
			end

			if data.anim ~= nil then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, data.anim)
			end

			npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
		end
	end

	self.ending_data.items = {}
	local create_item = function(key, data)
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item(data)

		self.ending_data.items[key] = item

		return item
	end

	local item_to_component = {}

	local set_item_alpha = function(key_or_item, alpha)
		local item = key_or_item

		if type_util.is_string(item) then
			item = self.ending_data.items[item]
		end

		if item_to_component[item] == nil then
			local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			item_to_component[item] = {
				item_sprite = item_sprite,
				shadow_sprite = shadow_sprite,
				default_shadow_alpha = shadow_sprite.Alpha,
				default_item_color = item_sprite.TintColor,
			}
		end

		local item_component = item_to_component[item]

		item_component.item_sprite.TintColor = alpha * unity_class.color.white
		item_component.shadow_sprite.Alpha = alpha * item_component.default_shadow_alpha

		item_component.item_sprite:Rebuild()
		item_component.shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
	end

	local table_height = 0.7

	--E 아이템 스프라이트 : shield_Beer_full
	do
		local beer_item_id = 20994
		local set_poses = {
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(1, table_height) + vector(-0.25, 0, -0.5),
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(2, table_height) + vector(-0.25, 0, -0.5),
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(3, table_height) + vector(-0.25, 0, -0.5),
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(4, table_height) + vector(0.25, 0, 0.5),
		}

		for index, pos in pairs(set_poses) do
			local item = create_item('beer_' .. index, {
				itemid = beer_item_id,
				pos = pos,
				notforinven = true,
				showoncharacter = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			})

			set_item_alpha(item, 0)
		end
	end

	--D 아이템 스프라이트 : empty_dish 위에 있는 aw_pizza_4
	do
		local dish_item_id = 21009
		local pizza_item_id = 21010
		local set_poses = {
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(1, table_height) + vector(0.25, 0, -0.5),
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(2, table_height) + vector(-0.25, 0, 0.5),
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(2, table_height) + vector(0.25, 0, -0.5),
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(3, table_height) + vector(0.25, 0, -0.5),
			self.ending_data.get_table_x0z(4, table_height) + vector(-0.25, 0, 0.5),
		}

		for index, pos in pairs(set_poses) do
			local item = create_item('dish_' .. index, {
				itemid = dish_item_id,
				pos = pos,
				notforinven = true,
				showoncharacter = false,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			})

			set_item_alpha(item, 0)
		end

		for index, pos in pairs(set_poses) do
			local item = create_item('pizza_' .. index, {
				itemid = pizza_item_id,
				pos = pos,
				notforinven = true,
				-- pizza가 더 위에 있도록 소팅 레이어 변경
				showoncharacter = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				sprscale = 0.5
			})

			set_item_alpha(item, 0)
		end
	end

	--2초에 걸쳐 fade in으로 아래와 같이 NPC와 아이템 스프라이트 배치
	local fade_in_duration = 2

	do
		for i = 1, #npcs do
			local npc = npcs[i]

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, fade_in_duration)
		end

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(fade_in_duration, function(progress)
			for _, item in pairs(self.ending_data.items) do
				set_item_alpha(item, progress)
			end
		end)
	end

	drop_item_util.dispose_item(watch)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(mermaid, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 엄청난 사람들이 가게에 찾아왔어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, nil,
			nil, 'scared', 'short_story_mm_hana_134_1')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	--하나 (right, surprise, cast) : 왜 저런 음식을 먹으러 왔을까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hana, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'surprise', 'short_story_mm_hana_135')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	--하나 (right, tired, hurt) : 분명히 모두 화를 낼 거예요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hana, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'scared', 'short_story_mm_hana_136')

	-- 이미 일어난 일이에요. 
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, nil,
			nil, 'attack', 'short_story_mm_hana_136_1')

	--인어 (left, attack, idle) : 끔찍해도 귀신을 찾으려면 볼 수밖에 없어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'short_story_mm_hana_137')

	character_util.add_listener(chef, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(seller, self.controller)
end

-- 엔딩씬
function local_class:after_reasoning_scene()
	local summer_sohee = self:get_summer_sohee()
	local hana = self.get_hana()
	local mermaid = get_party_leader()
	local seller = self.get_seller()

	local foreach_party_member = function(action)
		action(mermaid)
		action(hana)

		if summer_sohee ~= nil then
			action(summer_sohee)
		end
	end

	--white in 될 땐 아래와 같이 ‘서브 구역 1’로 이동
	local leader_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('hana_reset_pos') + unity_class.vector3.right * 2

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i].Position = leader_pos
	end
	self:align_party_consider_sohee(leader_pos, 1, 'left')
	
	self:show_other_quest_marker()

	--인어, 하나, 소히 down, surprise, idle 동작 실행
	foreach_party_member(function(member)
		character_util.set_direction(member, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'surprise')
	end)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	if self.black_and_white ~= nil then
		self.black_and_white:Dispose()
		self.black_and_white = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local beach_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_beach_01', loop = true })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--현실 복귀
	--인어, 하나, 소히, 아래와 같이 ‘서브 구역 1 복사’와 똑같은 좌표인 상태로 ‘서브 구역 1’에 도착
	--이후 대화(대화 시작 시 idle, idle 상태로 출력)
	foreach_party_member(function(member)
		character_util.remove_emotion(member)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(member, mermaid) then
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(member, 'left')
		else
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(member, 'right')
		end
	end)

	--인어 (left, idle, idle) : 어라? 현실로 돌아왔네요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_hana_161')

	--하나 (right, idle, idle) : 모든 기억을 확인해서 그런가 봐요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hana, 'short_story_mm_hana_162')

	--인어 (left, tired, idle) : 요리사는 사기꾼이 아니었어요….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'short_story_mm_hana_163')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	--하나 (right, tired, question) : 그렇다면 왜 살인이 일어났을까요...?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hana, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'question', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'short_story_mm_hana_164')

function local_class:get_summer_sohee()
	local hana = self.get_hana()

	for i = 2, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(member, hana) then
			return member
		end
	end

	return nil
end

--- 인어 -> 하나 -> 소히 순으로 파티 정렬
--- 소히가 없다면 하지 않음
function local_class:align_party_consider_sohee(leader_pos, duration, align_dir, last_dir)
	local align_pos_adder = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(align_dir)
	local min_speed = 1
	local move_key = 'align_party_consider_sohee'

	local get_last_dir = function(index)
		if type_util.is_table(last_dir) then
			return last_dir[index]
		end

		return last_dir
	end

	local members = {
		get_party_leader(),
		self.get_hana(),
		self:get_summer_sohee()
	}

	for i = 1, #members do
		local member = members[i]
		local target_pos = leader_pos + align_pos_adder * (i - 1)
		local dist = (member.Position - target_pos).magnitude
		local speed = math.max(dist / duration, min_speed)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, speed, nil,
				self, move_key, { last_direction = get_last_dir(i) })
	end

	local start_time = unity_class.time.time

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 남은 시간동안 추가 대기
	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 시계 사용
function local_class:use_watch()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hana = self.get_hana()
	local cur_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('hana_hana_start_pos')
	local past_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('hana_event_start_pos')
	local watch_offset = vector(0, 1, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	local watch = self:create_watch()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_time_slow_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		user_party[i].Position = past_pos + (user_party[i].Position - cur_pos)
	end
	hana.Position = past_pos + (hana.Position - cur_pos)

	watch.Position = leader.Position + watch_offset

	if self.black_and_white == nil then	
		self.black_and_white = self.fx:black_and_white():Instantiate(vector(999, 0, 999))
	else
		self.black_and_white.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_mermaid/audio:bgm_mermaid_past', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	self:hide_other_quest_marker()
	self:show_quest_marker()

	drop_item_util.dispose_item(watch)
end

-- 시계 생성 연출
function local_class:create_watch()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local watch_offset = vector(0, 1, 0)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'get' }, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local watch = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = leader.Position + watch_offset,
		                                         itemid = self.watch_item_key, notforinven = true,
												 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true,
												 showoncharacter = true, sprscale = 0.5 })
	watch.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	return watch
end

	local hana = self.get_hana()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.look_at(hana, leader)
	character_util.look_at(leader, hana)

	-- 다시 현재로 돌아가고 싶으신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hana, self, nil, nil, 'tired', 'short_story_mm_hana_exit_1')

	-- 예
	-- 아니오
	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'short_story_mm_hana_15', 'mercy' }, { 'short_story_mm_hana_16', 'brutal' } })

	if choose == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_time_slow_01')

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

		local hana_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('hana_hana_start_pos')
		local party_pos = { hana_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0), hana_pos, hana_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0)}

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.quest_progress then
		if (self.quest_progress.IsComplete or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 5) then
			self:remove_board()
		end

		if  self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 5 then
			self:mermaid_store_setting()
		end

		-- 섹션 7이하일 경우 (exit inner 비활성화)
		if (not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 7) then
			self:s8_setting_cave()
		end

		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			self:sand_castle_restaurant_setting()
		end

		-- wall_invisible 모든 섹션에서 비활성화하기 위함
		local landmarker = self.get_landmark()

		landmarker.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	self:set_fo_by_progress(true)
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.stage_ended = true

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_fo_by_progress(on_loaded)
	local section = 1
	local is_cleared = false
	local section_data_prefix = 'from_section_'

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		is_cleared = self.quest_progress.IsComplete
		section = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress + 1
	end

	local get_current

	if on_loaded then
		-- StageLoaded에서 불렸다면 이전 섹션들 중 마지막 세팅을 불러옴
		if is_cleared then
			get_current = function(data)
				local result = data.cleared

				if result ~= nil then
					return result
				end

				for i = section, 1, -1 do
					result = data[section_data_prefix .. i]

					if result then
						return result
					end
				end

				return nil
			end
		else
			get_current = function(data)

				for i = section, 1, -1 do
					local result = data[section_data_prefix .. i]

					if result then
						return result
					end
				end

				return nil
			end
		end
	else
		if is_cleared then
			get_current = function(data)
				return data.cleared
			end
		else
			get_current = function(data)
				return data[section_data_prefix .. section]
			end
		end
	end

	for name, data in pairs(self.fo_data_by_progress) do
		local current = get_current(data)

		if current ~= nil then
			local fo = get_field_object(name)

			fo.Position = current:get_pos()

			local rot_or_nil = current:get_rot_or_nil()

			if rot_or_nil ~= nil then
				fo.Transform.localRotation = rot_or_nil
			end

			-- 추가 세팅
			if current.after_set_executor ~= nil then
				current.after_set_executor(fo)
			end
		end
	end
end

--region quest_marker
---fieldObject에 퀘스트 마커를 만든다. key는 내부에서 자동으로 생성
function local_class:add_quest_marker_fo(fo)
	local fo_key = fo.Name

	if self.quest_marker_set:add(fo_key) then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(fo_key, self.quest_id, true, fo)
	end
end

---원하는 위치에 퀘스트 마커를 만든다. key에 쓰일 이름도 인자로 넣어야 한다.
function local_class:add_quest_marker_pos(pos, name)
	if self.quest_marker_set:add(name) then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(name, self.quest_id, true, pos)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_quest_marker_fo(fo)

--region custom function
function local_class:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height)
	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + vector(0, height, 0),
		end_pos + vector(0, height, 0),
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end

function local_class:finish_play_stage_enter()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
end

-- 나레이션 출력
function local_class:play_narration(text)
	local text_fade_in_duration = 1
	local text_fade_out_duration = 1
	local text_maintain_duration = 3
	local text_exposure_duration = text_fade_in_duration + text_maintain_duration + text_fade_out_duration
	local text_width = 2000
	local text_speed = 0

	--아래 text_out이 들어가고 중간에 text가 사라지게 되어서 start_coroutine_enumerator로 변경 후 대기시간동안 기다려준다.
	wait_all({
		--typing_text setting
		self.typing_text:SetTypedText(
				text,
				text_width,
				text_speed,
				text_exposure_duration
		),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--fade in 대기
			self:fade_typing_text_in(self.typing_text, text_fade_in_duration)

			--노출 시간 대기
			wait_for_sec(text_maintain_duration)

			--fade out 대기
			self:fade_typing_text_out(self.typing_text, text_fade_out_duration)
		end)
	})
end

-- 나레이션 대사 페이드 인
function local_class:fade_typing_text_in(typing_text, duration)
	self:fade_typing_text(typing_text, 1, duration)
end

-- 나레이션 대사 페이드 아웃
function local_class:fade_typing_text_out(typing_text, duration)
	self:fade_typing_text(typing_text, 0, duration)
end

-- 나레이션 대사 페이드 함수
function local_class:fade_typing_text(typing_text, target_alpha, duration)
	local start_alpha = typing_text.Label.alpha
	local end_alpha = target_alpha

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_alpha, end_alpha, function(_, cur_value)
		typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_value
	end)
end

function local_class:fall_npc(target, duration, start_pos, end_pos)
	start_coroutine(function()
		--prostrate가 자연스럽게 떨어지면서 적용되도록 떨어지기 전에 약간 빠르게 애니메이션 적용
		wait_for_sec(duration - 0.1)
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'prostrate')
	end)

	--회전 및 곡선 이동
	character_util.spine_rotate(target, 1440, duration)
	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local pos = self:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, 8)

		target.Position = pos
	end)
end
--endregion custom

return local_class

		'release', nil, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_23')

	-- 인어(right,smile,idle) 소히(right,tired,idle) 돌프(left,tired,idle) 에이미(left,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'smile')

	scene_util.set_direction(surfer_sohee, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'tired')

	scene_util.set_direction(swindler, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(swindler, self, 'tired')

	-- 돌프(left,tired,cross_arm): 이제 내기같은 건 상관없어, 안 싸우기로 했거든.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swindler, self, 'left',
		'cross_arm', 'tired', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_24')

	-- 인어(right,smile,sing): 맞아요! 이제 서로 사이좋게 지내기로 했어요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'right',
		'sing', 'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_25')

	-- 소히(right,attack,release): 그 동상이야 내가 어떻게든 고쳐놓으면 될 거 아냐!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
		'release', 'attack', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_26')

	-- 에이미(left,tired,idle): 나랑 돌프도… 고치는 거 도울게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_amy, self, 'left',
		nil, 'tired', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_27')

	-- 유즈(down,sleep_deep,nod2회): 흠… 그래도 내기는 내기니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self, 'down',
		'nod', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_28')

	-- 유즈(down,attack,release): 너희 둘다 이번 시즌장사는 그만둬줘야겠어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self, 'down',
		'release', 'attack', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_29')

	-- 이때 인원들(up,idle,idle)(jump1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	for i = 1, #event_group do
		scene_util.set_direction(event_group[i], 'up')
		character_util.normal_jump(event_group[i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 소히(up,idle,release): 잠깐만! 그게 무슨소리야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'up',
		'release', nil, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_30')

	-- 유즈(down,attack,idle): 내기에 졌으면 규칙에 따라야지!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self, 'down',
		nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_31')

	-- 유즈(down,attack,idle): 손님이 가장 많은 가게만 남고 나머진 물러난다! 벌써 잊었어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self, 'down',
		nil, nil, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_32')

	character_util.remove_emotion(lifeguard_yuze)

	-- 돌프(up,idle,idle)(jump1회): 그게 무슨소리야! 여기 우리보다 큰 상권이 어딨다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swindler, self, 'up',
		nil, nil, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_35')

	character_util.normal_jump_async(lifeguard_yuze, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 유즈(down,smile,idle)(jump1회): 날 따라와 봐!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self, 'down',
		nil, 'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_37')

	-- 유즈 NPC만 상단으로 올라가며, 소히 NPC question 버블 이모티콘 출력.

	local yuze_waypoint = {
		start_camera_pos + vector(0, 0, 1),
		start_camera_pos + vector(0, 1, 6),
		start_camera_pos + vector(0, 1, 8)

	wp_util.move(lifeguard_yuze, yuze_waypoint, 4, nil, {

--- 엔딩
function local_class:ending()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()
	local swindler = self.get_swindler()
	local summer_amy = self.get_summer_amy()
	local lifeguard_yuze = self.get_lifeguard_yuze()

	local event_group = { mermaid, surfer_sohee, swindler, summer_amy }

	local end_camera_pos = self.get_end_camera_pos()

	-- 유즈 (up, idle, idle)
	character_util.stop(lifeguard_yuze)
	character_util.set_direction(lifeguard_yuze, 'up')
	lifeguard_yuze.Position = self.get_end_camera_pos()

	-- 인어 , 소히 (right, surprise, idle)
	-- 돌프, 에이미 (left, surprise, idle)
	local mermaid_pos = end_camera_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, -1)

	for i = 1, #event_group do
		local target = event_group[i]
		character_util.stop(target)
		target.Position = mermaid_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * (i - 1)

		if i < 3 then
			character_util.set_direction(target, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'surprise')
	end

	scene_util.hide_weapon(summer_amy)
	scene_util.set_anim(summer_amy, self, 'idle')

	camera_util.move(end_camera_pos, 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })

	-- 화면 서큘러 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 인어,소히,돌프,에이미 up 방향 전환.
	for i = 1, #event_group do
		local target = event_group[i]
		character_util.remove_emotion(target)
		scene_util.set_direction(target, 'up')
	end

	-- 소히(up,idle,idle)(jump1회)[shout]: 아니 저게 도대체 뭐야!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(surfer_sohee)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'up',
		nil, nil, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_38')

	-- 카메라 위쪽그리드까지 찍고 다시 표시한 유즈 중심으로 내려옴
	local end_center_pos = self.get_end_center_pos()
	camera_util.move_async(end_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 7), 3.5, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.move_async(end_center_pos, 1.5)

	-- 인어 중심 그룹
	local mermaid_group = { mermaid, surfer_sohee, swindler, summer_amy, lifeguard_yuze }

	-- 대형 유지한채로 앞으로 전진 공주옆까지 온다.
	for i = 1, #mermaid_group do
		local member = mermaid_group[i]
		local front_stair_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(member.Position, end_camera_pos.z + 0.7)

		local waypoint = {
			front_stair_pos,
			front_stair_pos + vector(0, -1, 1.3),
			member.Position + vector(0, -1, 5)
		}

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, waypoint, 4, nil, self)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	-- 전원 (right,idle,idle)
	for i = 1, #mermaid_group do
		local member = mermaid_group[i]
		scene_util.set_direction(member, 'right')
	end

	local princess = self.dynamic_npcs.summer_princess

	-- 공주(left,idle,idle)0.5초
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 공주(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 앗! 너희들 왔구나!
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
		nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_39')

	-- 공주(left,smile,sing): 어때? 우리가 지은 캔터베리 성의 모습은?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
		'sing', nil, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_40')

	-- 소히(left,tired,idle) 1초 (right)방향 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(surfer_sohee, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'tired')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction(surfer_sohee, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 소히(right,tired,question): 이… 이건.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
		'question', 'tired', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_41')

	-- 소히(right,damaged,embarrassed): 과학적으로 말이 안되잖아!!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self, 'right',
		{ name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = '03_runaway_02' },
		{ name = 'damaged', keep = true }, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_42')

	-- 공주(left,attack,idle)(jump1회): 과학같은 건 중요하지 않아!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
		nil, 'attack', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_43')

	-- 공주(left,smile,sing): 중요한 건 열정과 의지! 그리고 상상력이라고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left',
		'sing', 'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s10_44')

	-- 카메라 두칸 위로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(end_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), 1)

	local bob = self.dynamic_npcs.summer_bob
	local linda = self.dynamic_npcs.summer_linda

	-- 밥:마, 맞습니다… 공주님!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bob, self, nil,
		nil, nil, 'short_story_mm_main_s10_45')

	-- 린다: 캐, 캔터베리 가디언즈 만세…!

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.start then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.runaway_trigger_zone_name) then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.runaway_civil

			start_coroutine(self.enter_runaway_civil_zone, self)

			start_coroutine(self.lifeguard_talk_to_surfer, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.runaway_civil then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.restricted_zone_name) then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_restricted_zone, self)

			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.beach_event_zone_name) then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_beach_event

			start_coroutine(self.play_beach_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp
			and self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.first_qte then
		if self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.first_qte then
			self.current_surfing_qte_step = self.surfing_qte_step.first_qte_success

			return true
		end
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight
			and self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.second_qte then
		if self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.second_qte then
			self.current_surfing_qte_step = self.surfing_qte_step.second_qte_success

			return true
		end
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown
			and self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.last_qte then

		if self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.last_qte
				and self.qte_tap_count < self.qte_max_tap_count then
			self.qte_tap_count = self.qte_tap_count + 1

			-- tap count 수가 tap max count 수와 같을거나 많을 경우 qte step 넘어감
			if self.qte_tap_count >= self.qte_max_tap_count then
				self.current_surfing_qte_step = self.surfing_qte_step.end_step
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
