-- 소히 서핑 이벤트 배경 셋팅
function local_class:set_ocean_wave_bg()
	local bg_pos = self.get_ocean_camera_pos()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, self.ocean_wave_bg_data.asset_bundle, self.ocean_wave_bg_data.prefab_name, function(prefab)
				self.ocean_wave_bg = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.ocean_wave_bg.transform.localPosition = bg_pos
			end)

	self.ocean_wave_bg.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:enter_runaway_civil_zone()
	local runaway_civil_group = {
		self.get_runaway_civil(1),
		self.get_runaway_civil(2),
		self.get_runaway_civil(3)
	}

	-- 플레이어 트리거 1 지점 진입 시 컨트롤 뺏지않고 실행
	-- 1,2,3번 (right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	for i = 1, #runaway_civil_group do
		scene_util.set_emotion(runaway_civil_group[i], self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(runaway_civil_group[i], 'right')
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 1번: 사, 살려줘!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(runaway_civil_group[1], 'short_story_mm_main_s2_1_1', false)
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 2번: 꺄아악!!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(runaway_civil_group[2], 'short_story_mm_main_s2_1_2', false)
	end)

	character_util.group_normal_jump_async(runaway_civil_group, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 시민들 도망 시작 시 사운드 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_04')

	-- 도망 시작
	local move_key = 'civil_runaway'

	for i = 1, #runaway_civil_group do

		scene_util.set_emotion(runaway_civil_group[i], self, 'scared')

		local wp_list = {
			self.get_runaway_civil_pos(i, 2),
			self.get_runaway_civil_pos(i, 3),
			self.get_runaway_civil_pos(i, 4),
			self.get_runaway_civil_pos(i, 5),
		}
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(runaway_civil_group[i],
				wp_list,
				9,
				nil,
				self, move_key,
				{ run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	for i = 1, #runaway_civil_group do
		character_util.set_active_state(runaway_civil_group[i], 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:lifeguard_talk_to_surfer()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()
	local lifeguard_yuze = self.get_lifeguard_yuze()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	while self.restricted_zone_event do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.party_talking_in_not_control = true

	-- 유즈: 무슨 짓을 하고 다닌거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(lifeguard_yuze, 'short_story_mm_main_s2_1_3', false)

	if not self.party_talking_in_not_control then
		return
	end

	-- 소히: 신경 꺼.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(surfer_sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s2_1_4', false)
end

function local_class:enter_restricted_zone()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()
	local lifeguard_yuze = self.get_lifeguard_yuze()

	-- 이전 소히, 유즈 말풍선 제거 및 컨트롤 상태 아닐때 대화 이벤트 플래그 false로 변경하여 종료시킴
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(surfer_sohee)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lifeguard_yuze)

	self.party_talking_in_not_control = false

	-- 이벤트 시작 플래그 true
	self.restricted_zone_event = true

	-- 플레이어 정지한 상태에서 유즈 대사 실행.

	-- 하단 대사와 함께 소히 attack, idle 실행.
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'attack')

	-- 유즈 (현재 방향, attack,idle)(jump1회) : 소히! 사람들 쫓아가지 마!
	character_util.normal_jump(lifeguard_yuze, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self,
			nil,
			{ one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_2_1', skip = true })


	-- 이후 유즈 대사 종료되면 소히 하단을 바라본 채 0.5타일 위로 올라감.
	local move_key = 'party_back_off'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer_sohee,
			vector(surfer_sohee.Position.x, 0, surfer_sohee.Position.z + 0.5),
			4,
			nil,
			self, move_key,
			{ locked_dir = 'down', last_direction = 'down' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(lifeguard_yuze,
			vector(lifeguard_yuze.Position.x, 0, lifeguard_yuze.Position.z + 0.5),
			4,
			nil,
			self, move_key,
			{ locked_dir = 'down', last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 표정 초기화
	character_util.remove_emotion(surfer_sohee)
	character_util.remove_emotion(lifeguard_yuze)

	self.restricted_zone_event = false
end

function local_class:play_beach_event()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	self:talking_sohee_n_yuze()

	self:surfing_in_ocean()
end

-- 해변에서 소히, 유즈 대화 이벤트
function local_class:talking_sohee_n_yuze()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_surfer_sohee()
	local lifeguard_yuze = self.get_lifeguard_yuze()

	local move_key = 'party_align'

	local sohee_pos = self.get_beach_sohee_pos(1)
	local yuze_pos = self.get_beach_yuze_pos(1)

	local stage_camera_backup_pos = nil

	-- 배경음 음량 조절
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 0.5)
	-- 환경음 재생
	self.ambient_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_beach_01', volume = 0.5, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	-- 이전에 컨트롤 뺏지 않고 소히, 유즈 말풍선 띄우는 부분이 있어 지워줌
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(surfer_sohee)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lifeguard_yuze)

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	self.controller:remove_quest_marker_pos(self.quest_marker_key)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer_sohee,
			sohee_pos,
			4,
			nil,
			self, move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(lifeguard_yuze,
			yuze_pos,
			4,
			nil,
			self, move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	stage_camera_backup_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	camera_util.move(stage_camera_backup_pos, 0)

	-- 이벤트용 소히로 바꿔치기
	local surfer_sohee_pos = surfer_sohee.Position
	character_util.set_position(surfer_sohee, vector(999, 0, 999))
	surfer_sohee = self.get_event_surfer_sohee()
	character_util.set_position(surfer_sohee, surfer_sohee_pos)

	camera_util.move_async(surfer_sohee.Position, 0.1, {end_target = surfer_sohee})

	-- 소히 (left, attack, release) : 그래, 여긴 어때? 아무도 없잖아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_1', skip = true })

	-- 유즈 up, right, left를 1초 간격으로 1회씩 바라봄.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(lifeguard_yuze, 'up')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(lifeguard_yuze, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(lifeguard_yuze, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 유즈 (left, smile, nod2회) : 좋아! 이른 아침이라 아직 빈 해변도 있어서 다행이야!
	-- 01_rustle_01 + 03_dialogue_positive_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_2', skip = true })

	-- 아래 유즈 말과 동시에 소히(right,tired,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, { dir = 'right' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(surfer_sohee)

	-- 유즈(left,tired,bomb_idle): 네 소문때문에 사람들이 도망간 거 같기도 하고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_3', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (left, smile, twohand_idle)(무기 듦) : 그러면 이제 맘껏 신 기술 연습을...!
	-- 대사와 동시에 (left) 한칸 이동
	sohee_pos = self.get_beach_sohee_pos(2)

	-- 소히 움직임 종료 확인을 위한 변수
	move_key = 'sohee_move_1'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer_sohee,
			sohee_pos,
			2,
			nil,
			self, move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'left', end_callback = function()
				scene_util.show_weapon(surfer_sohee)
				-- 무기 장착
				character_util.spine_set_attachment(surfer_sohee, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_surfersohee')
				scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, 'twohand_idle')
			end })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			{ one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_ready_01' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_4', skip = true })

	-- 소히 움직임 끝나기를 기다림
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 유즈 (left, attack, jump 1회) : 잠깐만 기다려!
	-- 유즈의 대사와 함께 소히 (right, tired) 로 변경.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer_sohee, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'tired')

	character_util.normal_jump(lifeguard_yuze, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_5', skip = true })

	-- 유즈 left, idle, eat를 실행. 1초 뒤 fx_dead와 함께 표지판이 생성되며 유즈 0.5칸 우측 이동 유즈 left, idle, idle 실행.
	start_coroutine(function()
		local event_signboard = self.get_warning_sign_board()
		local event_signboard_pos = self.get_beach_signboard_pos(1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		self.fx.dead():Instantiate(event_signboard_pos)

		event_signboard.Position = event_signboard_pos

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	end)

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.play_wait_action(lifeguard_yuze, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'eat' },
			nil,
			1.5)

	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	equipping_sfx = nil

	-- 잠시 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 소히 오른쪽 2칸 이동. 이동이 완료되면 카메라 소폭 줌 인.
	character_util.remove_anim(surfer_sohee)

	sohee_pos = self.get_beach_signboard_pos(1) + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(surfer_sohee, sohee_pos, 2, nil)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.8, 1)

	-- 소히 (up, idle, idle) : 소히가 서핑중이니… 다가오지 마시오?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_6', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, mad, release) : 뭐야! 꼭 이렇게 까지 해야해?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_02' },
			{ name = 'mad' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_7', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, 'twohand_idle')

	-- 카메라 유즈에게 이동
	camera_util.move_async(lifeguard_yuze.Position, 0.5)

	-- 유즈 left, smile, nod 2회 실행.
	-- 01_rustle_01 + 01_bad_fairy_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(lifeguard_yuze, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(lifeguard_yuze, self,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2, loop = true, one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(lifeguard_yuze)

	-- 유즈 nod 종료되면 카메라 줌 풀림. 카메라 소히에게 복귀
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(surfer_sohee.Position, 0.5, { end_target = surfer_sohee })

	-- 소히 좌측으로 한칸 이동
	sohee_pos = surfer_sohee.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim(surfer_sohee)
	wp_util.move_async(surfer_sohee, sohee_pos, 2, nil)

	-- 소히(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm) : 하, 정말…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_8', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (left, attack, cast2) : 하, 이 해변은 왜 소히의 발전을 두려워하는 거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'cast2', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_9', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, 'twohand_idle')

	-- 유즈 (left, tired, bomb_idle) : 내 생각엔 네 발전이 아니라 너를 두려워하는 거 같은데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_10', skip = true })

	-- 유즈 (left, attack, release) : 조금 있다 사람들이 오면 치울테니 그때부턴 서핑 금지야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard_yuze, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_11', skip = true })

	-- bomb_idle애니로 인해 잠시 장착 해제
	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(surfer_sohee, '[base]weapon1')

	-- 소히 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 그래 그래, 알았다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_3_12', skip = true })

	-- 이후 소히 left, attack, run을 1번까지 이동 후
	sohee_pos = self.get_beach_sohee_pos(3)

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	character_util.set_direction(surfer_sohee, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'run', loop = true })
	character_util.move_to_async(surfer_sohee,
			sohee_pos,
			nil,
			6,
			true,
			false)

	dash_sfx:FadeOut(0)

	-- 다시 보드 장비 장착
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(surfer_sohee, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_surfersohee')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(surfer_sohee)

	-- left, attack, get 자세로 점프한 후, 2 지점에 left, surfer_sohee/walk 사용
	sohee_pos = self.get_beach_sohee_pos(4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	wp_util.move(surfer_sohee, sohee_pos, nil, 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(surfer_sohee, 'left', 0.5, 1.2)

	-- 물가에 착지하면 fx_common_water_splash_in 이펙트 재생
	self.fx.water_splash_in():Instantiate(sohee_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_01')

	sohee_pos = sohee_pos + vector(-5, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_direction(surfer_sohee, 'left')

	coroutine.yield()

	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/walk', loop = true })

	-- 소히 바다에 뛰어든 후 약간의 딜레이 후 이동
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	start_coroutine(self.on_sohee_surfing_trail_effect, self)
	local sohee_move_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.move_to_async(surfer_sohee, sohee_pos, 1, nil, true, false)
		sohee_move_end = true
	end)

	-- 서핑 사운드 3D 재생
	dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_11',
															volume = 0.6,
															loop = true })

	start_coroutine(function()
		while not sohee_move_end do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		dash_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- fade out과 함꼐 bgm 종료, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	-- 환경음 변경
	self.ambient_sound:FadeOut(0)
	self.ambient_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_beach_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'event',
		name = 'ondemand/short_story_mermaid/audio:bgm_mermaid_game',
		volume = 0.6
	})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(lifeguard_yuze, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lifeguard_yuze)

	-- 파도 배경 프리펩 활성화
	if self.ocean_wave_bg ~= nil then
		self.ocean_wave_bg.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
end

function local_class:surfing_in_ocean()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_event_surfer_sohee()
	local dolphin = self.get_dolphin()
	local camera_pos = self.get_ocean_camera_pos()
	local stage_camera_backup_pos = nil

	-- 별도의 그리드 공간으로 이동 mermaid_ocean_wave_scene 프리팹을 적용한다. (섹션 시작 시 로드함)
	-- 소히의 발 아래에 fx_mermaid_ocean_surfing_trail 이펙트가 재생된다. (이전 씬에서 셋팅함)

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 카메라 위치
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 0)

	-- 돌고래 위치 셋팅 (시작 위치에서 y값 조금 낮춰 셋팅)
	character_util.set_scale_factor(dolphin, dolphin.Name, 1.5)
	character_util.set_active_state(dolphin, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_shadow(dolphin, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local sohee_pos = self.get_ocean_sohee_pos(1)
	local outside_sohee_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos(
			'left',
			sohee_pos,
			-1.5)

	-- 페이드 인 시 해변에 소히가 (right,idle, surfer_sohee/run)으로 좌측에서부터 등장한 뒤 지정된 지점에서 멈춘다. (속도2)
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/run', loop = true })
	character_util.set_position(surfer_sohee, outside_sohee_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(surfer_sohee, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local move_key = 'sohee_ocean_move_1'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer_sohee,
			sohee_pos,
			2,
			nil,
			self, move_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 지정된 장소에 멈추면 모션 (surfer_sohee/walk)
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/walk', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 소히 (right, idle, surfer_sohee/walk) : 네레이드의 마기톤 에너지 정상,.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_1', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, idle, surfer_sohee/walk) : 파도의 세기도 적당하고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_2', skip = true })

	-- 소히(right,smile,surfer_sohee/walk): 좋았어! 가볍게 시작해볼까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			{ one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_3', skip = true })

	-- 배경음 음량 조절
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1, 0.5)

	-- 첫번째 QTE (실패 시 재시작)
	local qte_success = false
	while not qte_success do
		qte_success = self:surfing_first_qte_event()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	qte_success = false

	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/walk', loop = true })

	-- 소히 (right, smile, surfer_sohee/walk) : 좋아, 오늘 컨디션 괜찮은데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			{ one_shot_sfx = '01_bad_fairy_01' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_5', skip = true })

	-- 두번째 QTE (실패 시 재시작)
	while not qte_success do
		qte_success = self:surfing_second_qte_event()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	qte_success = false

	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/walk', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 소히 (right, sleep_deep, surfer_sohee/walk) : 원래 목적은 사람들의 이목을 끄는 거였지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_6', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, smile, surfer_sohee/walk) : 텅빈 해안도 연습하기 좋고 나름 괜찮은데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_7', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, tired, surfer_sohee/walk) : 어차피 좀 있으면 유즈 때문에 서핑도 못할테고…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_8', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, attack, surfer_sohee/walk) : 오늘 도전해보는 거야! 금단의 공중 5회전을 말이지!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
			nil,
			{ one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_china_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_9', skip = true })

	-- 소히 (right, attack, surfer_sohee/run) 0.5초 후 QTE 시작 (연타)(실패 X)
	-- 소히 attack 표정으로 바뀌며 QTE 준비할 때마다 1회 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/run', loop = true })
	wp_util.move_async(surfer_sohee,
			self.get_ocean_sohee_pos(2),
			4.5,
			nil,
			{ run = true })

	-- 마지막 QTE (실패 루트 없음)
	self:surfing_last_qte_event()

	-- 서핑 trail 이펙트 삭제
	self.surfer_sohee_surfing = false

	-- 돌고래 sine move
	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 소히 움직임 기다림
		wait_for_sec(3.15)

		-- summer_dolphin (스파인 크기 1.5배) 이 표시된 구간에서 (in_water) 애니메이션 재생
		-- 동시에  fx_common_water_splash_out  출력
		local dolphin_start_pos = self.get_ocean_dolphin_pos()

		-- summer_dolphin 스파인이 나타나는 동시에 소히 surprise 표정 전환
		scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'surprise')

		self.fx.water_splash_out():Instantiate(dolphin_start_pos)

		-- 돌고래 등장 사운드
		-- 02_surfer_dolphin_01 + 03_dialogue_negative_02
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_surfer_dolphin_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

		character_util.set_position(dolphin, self.get_ocean_dolphin_pos())
		character_util.set_active_shadow(dolphin, true)

		character_util.spine_rotate(dolphin, -45, 0)

		local restore_rotate_time = 0.15
		local sine_move_half_duration = 0.8
		local sine_move_duration = (sine_move_half_duration * 2) + restore_rotate_time

		-- 일정시간 대기 후 돌고래 정위치로 회정 후 45도 회전
		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(sine_move_duration * 0.23)

			character_util.spine_rotate(dolphin, 0, sine_move_duration * 0.2)

			wait_for_sec(sine_move_duration * 0.2)

			character_util.spine_rotate(dolphin, 45, sine_move_duration * 0.24)
		end)

		-- 돌고래 sine move
		self:local_character_sine_move(dolphin, { from = dolphin.Position, to = dolphin.Position + vector(-5.5, 0, 0),
												  duration = sine_move_duration, height = 2.2, flying = true })

		-- 돌고래는  fx_common_water_splash_in 출력과 함께 사라짐
		self.fx.water_splash_out():Instantiate(dolphin.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5))

		character_util.set_position(dolphin, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_active_shadow(dolphin, false)
	end)

	-- 소히 뛰어오르고 3초 후 슬로우 모션 및 애니, 이모션 처리
	local sohee_z_rotate_duration = 3
	local sohee_jump_duration = 3.7
	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 소히 표정 (surpride) 으로 변경 회전하는 연출 중지
		wait_for_sec(sohee_z_rotate_duration)

		wait_for_sec(0.01)

		-- 소히(right) 1칸 이동 (== 남은 0.7초 동안 이동)
		stage_camera_backup_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
		camera_util.move(surfer_sohee.Position, 0.5)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.8, 0.5)

		-- 슬로우 모션 시작 사운드
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		-- 슬로우 시작
		time_util.mod('collision_event', 0.25)
	end)

	--  QTE입력시 jump높이 2배로 뛰면서 (up)(left)(down)(right)를 0.25초 간격으로 방향전환 하면서
	-- (right)로 3칸이동 3초 시점에 표시된 구간에 온다.
	-- 회전하는 연출 3번 반복
	start_coroutine(self.target_npc_z_rotate, self, surfer_sohee, 3, 3, 'right')

	-- 서핑 점프 이펙트
	self.fx.ocean_surfing_jump():Instantiate(surfer_sohee.Position)

	-- 소히 점프 시 애니 재생 일시정지
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(surfer_sohee, 0)

	-- 소히 점프 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_surfer_spin_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

	self:local_character_sine_move(surfer_sohee, { from = surfer_sohee.Position, to = self.get_ocean_collision_pos(),
											  duration = sohee_jump_duration, height = 0.75, flying = true })

	local sohee_crash_pos = surfer_sohee.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0)

	-- 소히가 화면 바깥으로 sine_move하며 도착할 위치 계산
	outside_sohee_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos(
			'right',
			unity_class.vector3.zero,
			4)

	local fly_height = 5
	outside_sohee_pos = vector(outside_sohee_pos.x, fly_height, surfer_sohee.Position.z)

	-- FX_hit 와 FX_lasthit 동시에 재생하면서 카메라줌 풀리면서 소히 화면밖으로 날아가는 연출
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(sohee_crash_pos + vector(0.25, 0, 0))

	self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(sohee_crash_pos + vector(0.25, 0, 0))

	-- 소히, 돌고래 충돌 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')

	-- 충돌함과 동시에 화면 0.04값으로 1초동안 shake
	camera_util.shake(0.04, 1)

	-- 서퍼 소히 그림자 비활성화
	character_util.set_active_shadow(surfer_sohee, false)

	camera_util.move(stage_camera_backup_pos, 0.5)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

	-- 서핑 이펙트 위치 갱신 루프 탈출
	self.surfer_sohee_surfing = false

	-- damaged, embarrassed 자세로 회전하며 날아가고, 소히가 화면을 벗어나며 화면 페이드 아웃.
	-- 소히(right) 1칸 이동하면서  (water_out) 애니메이션 중인 돌고래와 충돌
	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(surfer_sohee, '[base]weapon1')
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = '01_fall_down_01' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'damaged')

	-- 대사: 끄아악!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(surfer_sohee,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_10',
			  bubble_type = 'shout',
			  viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.75),
			  skip = false })

	-- 서퍼 소히 무기도 같이 날아가는 표현을 위해 weapon item 생성
	self:set_surfer_weapon_item(sohee_crash_pos + vector(0, 1, 0))

	local sohee_move_outside_duration = 1.75
	-- 소히 무기 회전하며 날아감
	start_coroutine(function()
		local outside_sohee_weapon_pos = outside_sohee_pos + vector(3, 2, 0)

		sp_util.sine_move(self.drop_item_sohee_weapon,
				{ from = self.drop_item_sohee_weapon.Position,
				  to = outside_sohee_weapon_pos,
				  duration = sohee_move_outside_duration,
				  height = 1.2 })
	end)

	-- 소히 애니 재생 일시정지 해제
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(surfer_sohee, 1)

	start_coroutine(self.sohee_weapon_item_rotate_n_scale, self, 1.25, 5)

	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 소히 날아가고 2초 후 슬로우모션 제거 화면 화이트 페이드 아웃 3섹션으로 이동
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 부딪히고 0.5초 후 슬로우 해제
		time_util.unmod('collision_event')
	end)

	-- (water_out) 애니메이션 중인 돌고래와 충돌, 소히 회전하며 날아감
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(surfer_sohee, 'Top Effects', 2)
	character_util.spine_rotate(surfer_sohee, 360 * 4, sohee_move_outside_duration)
	character_util.spine_scale(surfer_sohee, unity_class.vector3.one * 7, sohee_move_outside_duration)

	start_coroutine(self.local_character_sine_move, self, surfer_sohee,
			{ from = surfer_sohee.Position, to = outside_sohee_pos, duration = sohee_move_outside_duration,
			  height = 1, flying = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 다음 섹션에서 소히 말풍선 남는 것 방지
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(surfer_sohee)

	self.ambient_sound:FadeOut(4)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(surfer_sohee, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(surfer_sohee)

	-- 해변에 배치했던 표지판 보이지 않는 위치로 이동
	local event_signboard = self.get_warning_sign_board()

	event_signboard.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 섹션 정리
	self:section_end_setting()

	-- 다음 섹션 이동
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:surfing_first_qte_event()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_event_surfer_sohee()
	local backup_surfer_sohee_pos = surfer_sohee.Position
	self.current_surfing_qte_step = self.surfing_qte_step.first_qte

	-- 소히(right,attack,surfer_sohee/run) 0.5초 후 QTE 시작 (UP)
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/run', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'attack')

	-- 소히 attack 표정으로 바뀌며 QTE 준비할 때마다 1회 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- QTE 이벤트 시작.
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	screen_util.qte_swipe('up')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < self.first_qte_limit_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		-- first qte step에서 다른 step으로 넘어갔으면 루프 탈출
		if self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.first_qte_success then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- 2.5 초내에 (UP)입력하지 않았을 시 (실패)
	if self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.first_qte then
		local surfer_sohee_fail_pos = backup_surfer_sohee_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)

		-- 서핑 trail 이펙트 삭제
		self.surfer_sohee_surfing = false

		scene_util.set_emotion(surfer_sohee, self, 'damaged')

		-- 대사: 우아아앗!!
		-- 01_slide_01 + 03_dialogue_negative_01
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slide_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(surfer_sohee,
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_4',
				  bubble_type = 'shout',
				  viewport_pos = vector(0.23, 0.6),
				  skip = true })

		-- 서핑 점프 이펙트
		self.fx.ocean_surfing_jump():Instantiate(surfer_sohee.Position)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_02')

		-- 아래 1초 동안 왼쪽으로 1칸 이동.
		local jump_failed_action_duration = 1

		-- 소히(right,damaged,surfer_sohee/run) 상태로 1초동안 jump, 왼쪽으로 z축 두바퀴 돌기
		character_util.spine_rotate(surfer_sohee, 360 * 2, jump_failed_action_duration)
		self:custom_jump(surfer_sohee, 0.5, jump_failed_action_duration, nil)

		character_util.move_to_async(surfer_sohee,
				surfer_sohee_fail_pos,
				jump_failed_action_duration,
				nil,
				false,
				false)

		-- 이 후 착지하면  fx_common_water_splash_in 과 함께 소히가 사라지며 페이드 아웃
		self.fx.water_splash_in():Instantiate(surfer_sohee_fail_pos)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_01')

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		character_util.set_position(surfer_sohee, vector(999, 0, 999))

		-- 페이드 인 후 좋았어! 가볍게 시작해볼까? 대사 부터 재시작한다.

		wait_for_sec(1)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(surfer_sohee)

		self.ambient_sound:FadeOut(0.5)

		--
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		-- 소히 재배치
		scene_util.set_anim(surfer_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/walk', loop = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(surfer_sohee)
		character_util.set_position(surfer_sohee, backup_surfer_sohee_pos)
		character_util.spine_rotate(surfer_sohee, 0, 0)
		start_coroutine(self.on_sohee_surfing_trail_effect, self)

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		self.ambient_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_amb_beach_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

		-- fade in
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 소히(right,smile,surfer_sohee/walk): 좋았어! 가볍게 시작해볼까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer_sohee, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s2_4_3', skip = true })

		return false
	elseif self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.first_qte_success then
		-- 소히 (up)(left)(down)(right) 방향을 0.25초 간격으로 바꾸면서 도는 듯한 연출을 2회 반복 해당 연출동안 오른쪽으로 1칸 이동

function local_class:custom_jump(target, height, duration, sfx)
	height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 0.5)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.3)

	if sfx then
		if type(sfx) == 'string' then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(sfx)
		else
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')
		end
	end

	target:Jump(height, duration)
end

function local_class:target_npc_z_rotate(target, rotate_count, duration, last_dir)
	-- 소히 (up)(left)(down)(right) 방향을 0.25초 간격으로 바꾸면서 도는
	local look_dir_count = 4
	local look_dir_wait_duration = duration / (look_dir_count * rotate_count)

	for i = 1, rotate_count do
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'up')

		wait_for_sec(look_dir_wait_duration)

		character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')

		wait_for_sec(look_dir_wait_duration)

		character_util.set_direction(target, 'down')

		wait_for_sec(look_dir_wait_duration)

		character_util.set_direction(target, 'right')

		wait_for_sec(look_dir_wait_duration)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(target, last_dir)
end

function local_class:set_surfer_weapon_item(create_pos)
	self.drop_item_sohee_weapon = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = create_pos,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		itemid = self.drop_item_sohee_weapon_id,
		sprscale = 0.75,
		notforinven = true
	})

	self.drop_item_sohee_weapon:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Top Effects', 2, 'Default', 0)
	self.drop_item_sohee_weapon.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:sohee_weapon_item_rotate_n_scale(duration, last_scale)
	local falling_item = self.drop_item_sohee_weapon
	local time_passed = 0
	local default_scale = 1

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress)
		local rotate_num = -3
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotate_num

		falling_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		falling_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one *
				unity_class.mathf.Lerp(default_scale, last_scale, progress)

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:on_sohee_surfing_trail_effect()
	local surfer_sohee = self.get_event_surfer_sohee()
	local surfer_look_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(surfer_sohee.Direction)
	local pos = surfer_sohee.Position + vector(surfer_look_dir_vec.x * -0.5, 0, 0)

	self.fx_ocean_surfing_trail = self.fx.ocean_surfing_trail():Instantiate(pos)

	self.surfer_sohee_surfing = true

	-- 서핑 사운드
	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_11', volume = 0.4, loop = true })

	while self.surfer_sohee_surfing do
		-- 위치 갱신
		surfer_look_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(surfer_sohee.Direction)
		pos = surfer_sohee.Position + vector(surfer_look_dir_vec.x * -0.5, 0, 0)
		self.fx_ocean_surfing_trail.transform.localPosition = pos

		-- 방향 갱신
		self.fx_ocean_surfing_trail.transform.localScale = vector(surfer_look_dir_vec.x, 1, 1)

		if self.loop_escape then
			dash_sfx:FadeOut(0)

			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 이펙트 삭제
	if self.fx_ocean_surfing_trail ~= nil then
		self.fx_ocean_surfing_trail:Dispose()
		self.fx_ocean_surfing_trail = nil
	end

	dash_sfx:FadeOut(0)
end

function local_class:surfer_sohee_back_moving(surfer)

	if self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.first_qte_success then
		-- 첫번째 qte 성공 연출 중 백 무빙
		-- 착지 후 소히(right,attack,surfer_sohee/run) (right)바라보는 상태로 0.5초에 걸쳐 대각선 왼쪽 위(↖)로 0.5칸 이동
		character_util.move_to_async(surfer,
				surfer.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
				0.5,
				nil,
				false,
				false)

		-- 소히(right,attack,surfer_sohee/run) 1초에 걸쳐 대각선 왼쪽 아래(↙)로 1칸 이동
		character_util.move_to_async(surfer,
				surfer.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1),
				1,
				nil,
				false,
				false)

		-- 소히(right,attack,surfer_sohee/run) 1초에 걸쳐 QTE 시작 위치점으로 돌아옴.
		character_util.move_to_async(surfer,
				surfer.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
				1,
				nil,
				false,
				false)
	elseif self.current_surfing_qte_step == self.surfing_qte_step.second_qte_success then
		-- 착지 후 소히(right,attack,surfer_sohee/run) (right)바라보는 상태로 0.5초에 걸쳐 대각선 왼쪽 위(↖)로 0.75칸 이동
		character_util.move_to_async(surfer,
				surfer.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 1),
				0.5,
				nil,
				false,
				false)

		-- 소히(right,attack,surfer_sohee/run) 1초에 걸쳐 대각선 왼쪽 아래(↙)로 2칸 이동.
		character_util.move_to_async(surfer,
				surfer.Position + vector(-1.25, 0, -1.5),
				1,
				nil,
				false,
				false)

		-- 소히(right,attack,surfer_sohee/run) 1초에 걸쳐 QTE 시작 위치점으로 돌아옴.
		character_util.move_to_async(surfer,
				surfer.Position + vector(-0, 0, 0.5),
				1,
				nil,
				false,
				false)
	end
end

function local_class:local_character_sine_move(target, data)
	local start_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'from')
	local target_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'to')
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration')
	local height = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'height', 1)
	local flying = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'flying', true)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

		character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos, flying)

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)
end

return local_class

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	end

		return get_character('s3_seller')
	end

	self.get_oldman = function()
		return get_character('s3_oldman')
	end

	self.wagon = {
		name = 'store_wagon',
		get = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.name)
		end,
		set_pos = function(this, position)
			local wagon = this:get()
			wagon.Position = position
		end,
		move_async = function(this, move_position, speed)
			local wagon = this:get()
			local end_pos = wagon.Position + move_position
			character_util.move_to_async(wagon, end_pos, nil, speed)
		end,
	}

		end,
		add_count = function(this)
			this.clear_count = this.clear_count + 1
		end,
		is_cleared = function(this)
			return this.clear_count == this:max_count()
		end,
		clear_count = 0,
		box_data = {
			{
				name = 'store_sack',
				func = self.open_item_routine
			},
			{
				name = 'store_box_1',
				func = self.open_box_routine
			},
			{
				name = 'store_box_2',
				func = self.open_bench_routine
			},
		},
	}

	--item
	self.items = {
		insert = function(this, item)
			table.insert(this.data, item)
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					this.data[i]:ConsumeComplete()
					this.data[i] = nil
				end
			end
		end,
		data = {}

	self.items:dispose_all()

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_store_open then
		for num = 1, self.store_boxes:max_count() do
			local box_obj = self.store_boxes:get(num)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, box_obj) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.box_interact_routine, self, num)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_store_open then
		for num = 1, 3 do
			local zone_name = 's3_event_zone_' .. num
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_mermaid(), zone_name) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.back_enter_routine, self, num, zone_name)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_qte_start and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

							e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
							e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
						return true
					end
					return false
				end
			}
			message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
		end

		local shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event' })


		--(QTE)(right) 실행 (실패X)
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

		while self.is_qte_start and self.turbo_tap_count < max_count do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_qte_start = false

		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		shake_sfx:Stop()
		shake_sfx = nil

		--사용 후 게임패드 구독 해제
		if self.game_pad_handler then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
			self.game_pad_handler = nil
		end
	end

	--입력시
	--인어(left,damaged,push): 이야아아아아!!
	--대사와 동시에 속도 4로 수레와 함께 오른쪽으로 5칸 이동
	--[화면 0.3값으로 1초 shake하며]
	local move_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_push_rock_01', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.7)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'damaged')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(mermaid, { key = 'short_story_mm_main_s3_17' })
	self:drag_wagon_async(mermaid, vector(5, 0, 0), 4, 'left')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(mermaid)
	move_sfx:Stop()

	--대사끝나고 경로대로 수레쪽으로 다가감
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, {
		mermaid.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
		mermaid.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -1),
	}, 4)

	--인어 smile,eat자세
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'eat')

	--박스 오브젝트 3개가 1번 부터 순서대로 0.5초 간격으로 fx_dead와 함께 [A] 위치에 생성 포물선으로 뿌려진다.
	--[1] [gimmick]sack / [2,3][gimmick]box1
	do
		local wait_duration = 0.5
		local throw_duration = 0.5
		local height = 1.5
		local wagon = self.wagon:get()
		local start_pos = wagon.Position + vector(1, 0.5, 0)
		local end_pos = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_sack_pos') + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('store_box_pos'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('store_flipped_bench_pos'),
		}

		--순서대로
		for num = 1, self.store_boxes:max_count() do
			local fo = self.store_boxes:get(num)

			--오브젝트에 셋팅
			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.store_boxes.box_data[num].name, self.controller.quest_id, true, fo)
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			--fx와 함께 생성
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_wood_02')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
			fo.Position = start_pos
			self.fx.dead():Instantiate(start_pos)

			--포물선 운동
			start_coroutine(self.fo_move_curve, self, fo, end_pos[num], height, throw_duration, function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02')
			end)

			wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
		end

		local box_2 = self.store_boxes:get(1)
		box_2.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0, 0, 0.5), vector(1.25, 1, 1))
	end


	--인어 0.5칸 아래로 이동
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, mermaid.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 4)

	--인어(down,smile,success): 좋았어, 사람들 오기 전에 빨리 정리하자!

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s3_18')

function local_class:box_interact_routine(num)
	local box = self.store_boxes:get(num)
	local current_data = self.store_boxes.box_data[num]

	--set
	box.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	quest_marker_util.remove(current_data.name)

	local spin_and_move_async = function(fo, start_pos, target_pos, duration, angle, end_cb)
		if angle ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_rotate(fo, angle, duration)
		end

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed <= duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

			fo.Position = lerp_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		fo.Position = target_pos

		if angle ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 0, 0)
		end

		if end_cb ~= nil then
			end_cb()
		end
	end

function local_class:drag_wagon_async(npc, move_pos, speed, locked_dir, wagon_height)

-- 필드 오브젝트를 해당 지점으로 포물선을 그리며 이동
function local_class:fo_move_curve(fo, target_pos, height, duration, end_callback)
	local start_pos = fo.Position

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

		fo.Position = lerp_pos
	end)

	fo.Position = target_pos

	if end_callback then
		end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:item_move_curve(item, target_pos, height, duration, rotation_num)
	local start_pos = item.Position

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

		item.Position = lerp_pos

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
	end)

	item.Position = target_pos
end

function local_class:billboard_interact_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local billboard = self.get_billboard()

	--해당 오브젝트 좌우로 정렬
	--소히 (right,idle,idle) , 인어 (left,idle,idle)
	local move_key = 'party_align'
	local speed = 3
	local align_pivot = vector_util.get_x0z(billboard.Bounds.center)

	local sohee_align_pos = align_pivot + vector(-0.75, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(sohee, sohee_align_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'right' })

	local mermaid_align_pos = align_pivot + vector(0.75, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid, mermaid_align_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	--소히(left)(down) 1초 간격
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--소히(down,attack,release): 뭐야 이 불편하고 원시적인 물건들은?
	--이때 인어 (left,scared,idle)(jump1회) (scared)표정 유지
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.normal_jump(mermaid, true)

	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_23')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	--소히(right,attack,idle): 장사의 기본은 손님의 만족감을 이끌어내는 거라고!
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_24')

	--소히(right,tired,bomb_idle): 그리고 이 어린애 장난같은 판때기는 또 뭐야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'tired' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_25')

	--인어(left,tired,cast)
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'cast' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })

	--선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--그건 현대미술이에요! (빨강)
		{ 'short_story_mm_main_s4_26', 'brutal' },
		--그건 제 추억이에요! (초록)
		{ 'short_story_mm_main_s4_27', 'mercy' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--인어(left,tired,release): 그, 그건 현대미술이에요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_28')

		--인어(left,tired,sing): 이 인어 그림에서 불안함과 속상함의 감정이 느껴지시지 않나요? 인어(tired)표정 유지
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'sing' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_29')
		character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

		--소히(right,sleep_deep,question) (...) silence 이모티콘 버블
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'silence')
		character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

		--소히(right,attack,idle): 진짜 현대 미술이 뭔지 보여줘?
		scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_30')

		--소히(right,attack,cast2): 요새는 작품을 부수는 행위까지가 예술이라고!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'cast2' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_31')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	else
		--인어(left,tired,idle): 그… 그건 제 추억이에요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_32')

		--인어(left,tired,release): 자주 만났던 꼬마애가 절 위해 그려준 거에요 인어(tired)표정 유지
		scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_33')
		character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

		--소히(right,sleep_deep,question) (...) silence 이모티콘 버블
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'silence')
		character_util.remove_anim(sohee)

		--소히(right,attack,idle): 이걸 널 위해서 그려줬다고?
		scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_34')

		--소히(right,attack,release): 그럼, 네가 더 잘 되길 바랄 거 아냐!
		scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_35')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	end

	--소히(right,attack,surfer_sohee/attack) 모션과 함께 fx_dead 이펙트로 해당 바닥에 있던 오브젝트가 사라진다.
	--오브젝트 사라질 때 화면 shake 0.1 (0.5초)
	--모션취할때 연출용 해변소히에서 기존 해변소히로 변경 cwp_sohee_surfer 들고 있다
	--모션 끝나면 연출용 해변소히로 변경 및 (right,attack,idle) cwp_sohee_surfer 장착해제
	local event_sohee = self.get_event_sohee()

	character_util.set_active_state(event_sohee, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(event_sohee, direction_util.to_str(sohee.Direction))
	event_sohee.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'cwp_surfersohee')
	event_sohee.Position = sohee.Position
	sohee.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(event_sohee, self, { name = 'surfer_sohee/attack', count = 1 })
	scene_util.set_emotion(event_sohee, self, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.233)

	local fx_dead_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(billboard.Position, billboard.Bounds.center.y)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(fx_dead_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	billboard.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	--부서질때 인어 (left,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(mermaid, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--인어(left,scared,embarrassed)(shake0.03): 으아아아…!
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'scared' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_36')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	event_sohee.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	sohee.Position = event_sohee.Position
	event_sohee.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:all_interact_end_scene()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	--둘 모두 인터랙트 했다면 다시 수레앞에 정렬 후 마주보며 대화를 시작한다.
	--소히(right,idle,idle) 인어(left,idle,idle)
	local sohee_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_end_interact_align_pos')
	local mermaid_align_pos = sohee_align_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

	local move_key = 'party_align'
	local speed = 3

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(sohee, sohee_align_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid, mermaid_align_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	--소히(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 좋아, 이제 네 가게의 수리 견적을 말해줄게.
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_37')

	--인어 (left,tired,cast) 카메라 줌 1초
	local cam_size = stage_camera.Size

	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'cast' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(cam_size * 0.6, 1)

	--소히(right,mad,release): 이 가게는 전제부터 다 틀려먹었어!
	--이때 인어 (left,scared,idle)(jump1회)
	--화면 shake 0.1
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'release' })
			scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'mad' })
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_38')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)
			scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'scared' })
			character_util.normal_jump(mermaid, true)
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end)
	})

	--카메라 줌 풀림
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--소히(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm) : 네 가게는 아예 설계부터 다시 만들 거야.
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_39')

	--인어(left,scared,release): 마, 말도 안돼요! 이제 손님들도 올텐데…!
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_40')

	--소히(right,attack,bomb_idle): 안되는 게 어딨어! 그럼 이걸 고쳐서라도 쓰겠다고?
	--이때부터 인어 (left,tired,cast) 유지
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'cast' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })

	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_41')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

	--선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--시간이 없다. (노랑)
		{ 'short_story_mm_main_s4_42', 'intellect' },
		--다 버리기엔 아깝다. (빨강)
		{ 'short_story_mm_main_s4_43', 'brutal'}
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--인어(left,tired,sing): 그, 그래도 시간이…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'sing' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_44')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	else
		--인어(left,tired,sing): 이걸 다 버리기엔… 아깝지 않나요?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'sing' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_45')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	end

	--소히(right,idle,bomb_idle): 나한테 다 계획이 있으니까 걱정말라니까.
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_46')

	--소히(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 일단 내가 서핑 보드 제작을 위해 연구한 초고속 마결합 기술을 소재로 사용하면 원하는 가게를 구축하는 건 순식간에 끝날거라 시간은 문제 없어.
	--이때 인어 (left,tired,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_47')

	--소히(right,attack,release): 설계와 구성도 최신 유행 잡지 썸머 포커스지를 참고하면 순식간이지! 주로 7호, 16호, 20호의 올해의 가게 코너를 활용할 거야!
	--이때 인어 (left,confused,idle) 유지
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'confused' })
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'release' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_47_1')

	--소히(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 그럼, 일단 제작에 필요한 건 천연 마법 수정 7개, 이걸 마기톤 에너지와 테슬라 에너지로 고 마력 가공시킨 후 거기서 나온 마력을 응고시키면 돼.
	local sohee_talk_end = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sohee, 'short_story_mm_main_s4_48', false)
		sohee_talk_end = true
	end)

			{ name = 'ondemand/short_story_mermaid/preload:bgm_mermaid_main', state = 'field', mix = 0 })
end

function local_class:start()
	self:start_sohee_repair_routine()

	--원라인 npc 꺼주기
	local oneline_npc_count = 4
	local oneline_npc_number = 23

	for i = 1, oneline_npc_count do
		local npc = self.get_oneline_npc(oneline_npc_number)

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')

		oneline_npc_number = oneline_npc_number + 1
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.controller:remove_board()
	self.controller:remove_all_quest_markers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.is_sohee_repair_routine = false

	-- 소히 마기톤 버스터 이팩트가 있다면 dispose
	if self.fx_sohee_laser_effect ~= nil then
		self.fx_sohee_laser_effect:Dispose()
		self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local name = e.Zone.Name
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.sohee_zone_enter and
			self.get_swindler_zone[name] ~= nil then

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.swindler_zone_enter

		self.controller:remove_quest_marker_fo(self.get_swindler())

		local zone_data = self.get_swindler_zone[name]

		--인어가게쪽 NPC배치 됨 (6섹션에 변경예정)
		self.controller:mermaid_store_npc_setting()

		--인어 가게 길막 npc 세팅
		local block_npc_count = 12
		for i = 1, block_npc_count do
			local npc = self.get_s5_mermaid_block_npc(i)

			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
		end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.swindler_zone_enter_event, self, zone_data)

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.sohee_zone_enter and
			self.swindler_store_block_zones[name] ~= nil then

		local zone_data = self.swindler_store_block_zones[name]
		local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(name, leader, zone_data.dir)

		sp_util.start_scene(self.swindler_store_block_zone_event, self, return_pos, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_44')

	elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.mermaid_serving and
			self.fitting_room_block_zones[name] ~= nil then

		local zone_data = self.fitting_room_block_zones[name]
		local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(name, leader, zone_data.dir)
		local set_sohee_dir = zone_data.sohee_dir

		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.fitting_interact then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.mermaid_block_zone_event, self, return_pos, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_10')
			return
		end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.fitting_room_block_zone_event, self, return_pos, set_sohee_dir, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_1')

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.fitting_interact and
			self.mermaid_block_npc_zone_name[name] ~= nil then

		local zone_data = self.mermaid_block_npc_zone_name[name]
		local npc = self.get_s5_mermaid_block_npc(zone_data.talk_npc_number)
		local npc_2 = self.get_s5_mermaid_block_npc(zone_data.interact_npc_number)

		if zone_data.is_showing then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(function()
			zone_data.is_showing = true
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, { key = zone_data.talk })
			npc.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
			npc_2.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end)

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mermaid_serving and
			self.get_mermaid_serving_zone[name] ~= nil then

		local zone_data = self.get_mermaid_serving_zone[name]

		if zone_data.is_showing or not self.is_serving_ready then
			return
		end

		zone_data.is_showing = true

		sp_util.start_scene(self.serving_zone_enter_event, self, zone_data)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.start
			and e.Target == self.get_fitting_room() then

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.fitting_interact

		sp_util.start_scene(self.fitting_room_event, self)

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.fitting_interact
			and self.mermaid_block_npc_interact[e.Target.Name] ~= nil then

		local interact_npcs = { 3, 4, 5, 6 }
		local npc_data = self.mermaid_block_npc_interact[e.Target.Name]

		for i = 1, #interact_npcs do
			local interact_npc = self.get_s5_mermaid_block_npc(interact_npcs[i])

			character_util.remove_relate_event(interact_npc, self.controller)
		end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.sohee_zone_enter_event, self, npc_data.talk_npc_name, npc_data)

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.mermaid_serving and not
	self.is_serving_ready and e.Target == self.get_vending_machine() then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.serving_ready_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.stoppable_move_req_id ~= nil and
			type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.sohee_routine_gird) then
		--소히 위치 세팅
		character_util.set_position(self.get_sohee(), self.get_sohee_repair_pos(1))

		self:start_sohee_repair_routine()
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.stoppable_move_req_id ~= nil and
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.sohee_routine_gird) then
		self:stop_sohee_repair_routine()
	end
end

function local_class:fitting_room_block_zone_event(return_pos, set_sohee_dir, bubble_text)
	--컨트롤 뺏기며 BGM 볼륨 0.5로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	self:stop_sohee_repair_routine()

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, set_sohee_dir)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, 'mad')
	character_util.normal_jump(sohee)

	local left_bubble_screen_pos = vector(-400, 0)
	local right_bubble_screen_pos = vector(200, -200)

	--소희 대사
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	--(빨간존)동선 이탈시
	--소히가 (mad)(jump1회) 인어 위쪽으로 가면 (left) 오른쪽으로 가면 (right) 바라본다.
	--[shout] 말풍선으로 대사 출력 위쪽으로 가면 우 하단에 오른쪽으로 가면 좌측에 : 옷부터 갈아 입으라니까!
	if set_sohee_dir == 'left' then
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')

		character_util.normal_jump(leader)

		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(sohee, bubble_text, true, { screen_pos = right_bubble_screen_pos })
	else
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')

		character_util.normal_jump(leader)
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(sohee, bubble_text, true, { screen_pos = left_bubble_screen_pos })
	end

	--소희 표정 애님,표정 초기화
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	--소희 초기 위치로 변경
	local reset_pos = self.get_sohee_repair_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(
			sohee,
			reset_pos,
			{ z = reset_pos.z }
	)

	wp_util.move(sohee, waypoints, 4, nil, {
		end_callback = function()
			self:start_sohee_repair_routine(false)
		end })

	wp_util.move_async(leader, return_pos, 4)

	--컨트롤 돌아오며 BGM 볼륨 1.0로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:start_sohee_repair_routine()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	if self.stoppable_move_req_id == nil then
		self.stoppable_move_req_id = 0
	end

	sohee.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	--소히 무기 장착
	local weapon_slot_name = '[base]weapon1'
	local weapon_name = 'cwp_ghostbuster'

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(sohee, weapon_slot_name, weapon_name)

	--소히 무기 스파인 상시 업데이트로 변경
	sohee.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	if self.is_sohee_repair_routine then
		return
	end

	self.is_sohee_repair_routine = true

	--소히 가게 수리 세팅
	start_coroutine(self.sohee_repair_routine, self, true)
end

function local_class:sohee_repair_routine(is_first)
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	local sohee_attack_anim = 'rifle_shoot2'

	if is_first then
		local sohee_move_pos_offset = 0.5

		wp_util.move_async(sohee, {
			vector(sohee.Position.x, 0, sohee.Position.z + sohee_move_pos_offset),
			vector(self.get_sohee_repair_pos(1).x, 0, sohee.Position.z + sohee_move_pos_offset),
			self.get_sohee_repair_pos(1)
		}, 4, nil)

		scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	end

	local sohee_move_pos_1 = self.get_sohee_repair_pos(1)
	local sohee_move_pos_2 = self.get_sohee_repair_pos(2)

	local function repair_attack(dir, ani)
		scene_util.set_direction(sohee, dir, false)
		scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, ani)

		local rotation = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToQuaternion(sohee.Direction, unity_class.vector3.right)
		local offset = vector(1, 0.5, 0)

		--소히 rifle_shoot2 마다 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_hyper_laser_01',
			parent = sohee,
			loop = false,
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'npc'
		})

		self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = self.get_fx_magiton()
										 :Instantiate(sohee.Position + rotation * offset, rotation, nil)
	end

	local function attack_end()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)

		if self.fx_sohee_laser_effect ~= nil then
			self.fx_sohee_laser_effect:Dispose()
			self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = nil
		end
	end

	local function move_next(next_pos)
		local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(
				sohee,
				next_pos,
				{ z = next_pos.z - 1 }
		)

		wp_util.move_async(sohee, waypoints, 4, nil)
	end

	self.stoppable_move_req_id = self.stoppable_move_req_id + 1
	local cur_id = self.stoppable_move_req_id

	while cur_id == self.stoppable_move_req_id and
			not self.controller.stage_ended and self.is_sohee_repair_routine do

		repair_attack('right', sohee_attack_anim)

		self:sohee_custom_wait_for_sec(3)

		attack_end()

		if self.controller.stage_ended or not self.is_sohee_repair_routine then
			break
		end

		move_next(sohee_move_pos_2)

		if self.controller.stage_ended or not self.is_sohee_repair_routine then
			break
		end

		repair_attack('left', sohee_attack_anim)

		self:sohee_custom_wait_for_sec(3)

		attack_end()

		if self.controller.stage_ended or not self.is_sohee_repair_routine then
			break
		end

		move_next(sohee_move_pos_1)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_sohee_repair_routine()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	self.is_sohee_repair_routine = false

	character_util.stop(sohee)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(sohee, '[base]weapon1')

	sohee.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	if self.fx_sohee_laser_effect ~= nil then
		self.fx_sohee_laser_effect:Dispose()
		self.fx_sohee_laser_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:fitting_room_event()
	--컨트롤 뺏기며 BGM 볼륨 0.5로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--아래쪽 그리드에 탈의실 인터랙트 시
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local mermaid_change = self.get_mermaid_change()

	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	local npc_female_1 = self.get_s5_npc(1)
	local npc_female_2 = self.get_s5_npc(2)

	local fitting_room = self.get_fitting_room()

	--퀘스트 마커 제거
	self.controller:remove_all_quest_markers()

	--npc 인터렉트 해제
	npc_female_1.Interactable.Talk = ''
	npc_female_2.Interactable.Talk = ''

	--소히 코루틴 종료
	self:stop_sohee_repair_routine()
	self.stoppable_move_req_id = nil

	--소히 무기 스파인 상시 업데이트 종료
	sohee.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

	--소희 위치 세팅
	character_util.set_position(sohee, self.get_sohee_pos(1))
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'up')

	--인어 가게 길막 npc 세팅
	self:show_mermaid_store()

	--탈의실 인터렉트 제거
	self.get_fitting_room().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	--원라인 npc 세팅
	local oneline_npc_count = 4
	local oneline_npc_number = 23

	for i = 1, oneline_npc_count do
		local npc = self.get_oneline_npc(oneline_npc_number)

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		oneline_npc_number = oneline_npc_number + 1
	end

	--인어 정렬
	local fitting_room_back_pos = fitting_room.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	local mermaid_move_pos_list = {
		vector(mermaid.Position.x, 0, fitting_room_back_pos.z),
		vector(fitting_room.Position.x, 0, fitting_room_back_pos.z)
	}

	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, mermaid_move_pos_list, 4, nil)

	--인어(left,idle,idle) (right)(left)(up) 1초간격으로 방향전환
	scene_util.look_around(mermaid, { 'left', 'right' }, nil, 1)

	--0.5초 대기후
	local mermaid_wait_duration = 0.5
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(mermaid_wait_duration)

	--위로 한칸이동하면서 인어 알파페이드 아웃
	wp_util.move(mermaid, mermaid.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward,
			4, 0)

	local mermaid_alpha_duration = 0.5
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(mermaid, 0, mermaid_alpha_duration)
	wait_for_sec(mermaid_alpha_duration)

	--탈의실 shake마다 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	--인어 완전히 사라진 후 탈의실 0.5초 대기 / shake0.03 /0.5초 / 0.5초 대기
	local mermaid_fitting_duration = 0.5
	field_object_util.shake(fitting_room, 0.03, mermaid_fitting_duration)
	wait_for_sec(mermaid_fitting_duration)

	--인어(탈의실)[shout]: 우와아아!!
	--이때 화면 shake 0.1 / 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_4')

	character_util.set_position(mermaid_change, fitting_room.Position)
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid_change, 'down')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(mermaid_change, 0, 0.1)
	character_util.set_active_state(mermaid_change, 'enabled')

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(mermaid_change)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_position(mermaid, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	--탈의실 오브젝트는 shake0.03 0.5초 / 1초 대기 /다시 0.5초 shake 반복
	local is_shake_fitting_room = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		while is_shake_fitting_room do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

			field_object_util.shake(fitting_room, 0.03, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	end)

	--A,B(right,idle,idle) (?) question 이모티콘 버블
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_female_1, 'right', false)
	character_util.show_emoticon(npc_female_1, nil, 'question')

	character_util.remove_anim(npc_female_2)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_female_2, 'right', false)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(npc_female_2, nil, 'question')

	--A(right,idle,bomb_idle) B(left,tired,idle) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_female_2, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_female_2, self, 'tired')

	scene_util.set_anim(npc_female_1, self, 'bomb_idle')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(npc_female_1)

	local npc_move_key = 'npcs_move_wait'

	--이 후 경로대로 퇴장
	local function npcs_move(npc)
		local npcs_move_end_pos = npc.Position + vector(-1, 0, 10)

		local npcs_move_list = {
			vector(npcs_move_end_pos.x, 0, npc.Position.z),
			npcs_move_end_pos
		}

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npcs_move_list, 4, nil,
				self, npc_move_key)
	end

	npcs_move(npc_female_1)
	npcs_move(npc_female_2)

	--A / B 이동 시작하면 탈의실에서 대사: 설명서대로만 하면 되겠죠…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid_change, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_4_1')

	--A / B퇴장 후
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, npc_move_key)

	character_util.set_active_state(npc_female_1, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(npc_female_2, 'disabled')

	is_shake_fitting_room = false

	--인어가 (smile) 이모션상태로 오브젝트로 부터 한칸내려오면서 알파 페이드 인
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid_change, self, 'smile')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(mermaid_change, 1, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(mermaid_change,
			mermaid_change.Position + unity_class.vector3.back,
			4, nil)

	--인어(down,smile,idle) 0.5초
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid_change, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid_change, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid_change)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--인어(left,smile,sing): 우와아… 이 옷 진짜 이쁘다…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid_change, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid_change, self, 'sing')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid_change, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_5')

	--인어(left,smile,cast): 원래 옷같은 건 관심도 없었는데…
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid_change, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid_change, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_6')

	--인어(left,tired,idle): 소히 님이라고 했던가… 그 사람 조금 무섭긴 하지만.
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid_change, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid_change)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid_change, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_7')

	--인어(left,idle,idle): 생각해보면, 딱히 틀린말도 안했던거 같고…
	character_util.remove_emotion(mermaid_change)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid_change, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_8')

	--인어(left,idle,question): 생각보다 좋은 사람일지도…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid_change, self, 'question')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid_change, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_9')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid_change)

	--퀘스트 마커 생성
	self.controller:add_quest_marker_fo(sohee)

	--컨트롤 돌아오며 BGM 볼륨 1.0로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:sohee_zone_enter_event(talk_interact_npc, npc_data)

	--인어(left,tired,bomb_idle): 그래도… 이게 제 가게라는 느낌은…

	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'angry')

			'mad', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_14')

			nil, 'short_story_mm_main_s5_17')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

		pos = vending_machine.Position,
		target = item_throw_pos,

	})

	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'surprise')

	mermaid.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'bar_drink_bluemoon')
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'staff_idle')

	--소히(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 네 가게 물품을 정리해 만든 최신식 무인 자동판매기야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sohee, self, 'left', 'cross_arm',

			'doyagao', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_20')

	--음료수 사라짐
	character_util.normal_double_jump(mermaid, '01_small_jump_01')

	mermaid.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, nil, 'idle',
			'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_20_1')

	--소히(left,idle,bomb_idle): 뭐, 일단 손님도 잔뜩 왔으니 테이블이나 세팅 해 놔.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sohee, self, 'left', 'bomb_idle',
			'idle', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_20_2')

	--인어(right,smile,sing): 알았어요! 손님들을 이대로 세워놓을 순 없으니까요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'right', 'sing',

	wp_util.move(sohee, sohee_waypoints,

				scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')

			end })

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.mermaid_serving

	self:create_serving_marker(false)

	loop_sfx:Stop()

function local_class:serving_zone_enter_event(zone_data)
	--컨트롤 뺏기며 BGM 볼륨 0.5로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	self.controller:remove_all_quest_markers()

	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid_change()
	local npc_1 = self.get_s5_mermaid_block_npc(zone_data.npc_number[1])
	local npc_2 = self.get_s5_mermaid_block_npc(zone_data.npc_number[2])

	--3번째 서빙 후 이벤트 진행할때 어느 방향이 기준인지 체크
	local mermaid_end_dir = nil

	--서빙 횟수 증가
	self.serving_count = self.serving_count + 1

	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, zone_data.mermaid_pos, 4, nil)

	local serving_end_pos = 0

	if zone_data.scene_number == 3 then
		scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'up')
		serving_end_pos = mermaid.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	else
		scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'down')
		serving_end_pos = mermaid.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid, true)

	local cup_number = self.serving_count * 2 - 1

	local cup = self.get_mermaid_serving_cups(cup_number)

	cup.Transform.parent = nil

	table.insert(self.s5_mermaid_serving_obj_pool, cup)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_teahouse_01')

	scene_util.show_serving_async(mermaid, cup, 0.5, { end_pos = serving_end_pos })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if zone_data.scene_number == 1 then
		--(2)(right,smile,release): 여기가 아가씨 가게인가요?
		--이때 인어 (left,smile,idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_2, self, 'right', 'release',
				'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_21')

		--인어(left,smile,sing): 네 맞아요! 물건 좀 보고가실래요?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'left', 'sing',
				'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_21_1')

		--(1)(right,smile,bomb_idle): 정말이요? 지금 바로 볼 수 있을까요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right', 'bomb_idle',
				'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_21_2')

		--인어(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 네! 금방 준비해 드릴게요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')

		character_util.normal_jump(mermaid)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'left', 'idle',
				'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_21_3')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_2)

		mermaid_end_dir = 'left'
		--컨트롤 풀림
	elseif zone_data.scene_number == 2 then
		--(3)(right,idle,bomb_idle): 그 옷 예쁘네? 어디서 산거야?
		scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_1, self, 'right', 'bomb_idle',
				'idle', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_21_4')

		--인어(left,smile,sing): 헤헤, 산건 아니고 선물 받았어요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self, 'left', 'sing',
				'smile', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_21_5')

function local_class:serving_ready_event()
	self.controller:remove_all_quest_markers()

	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid_change()
	local vending_machine = self.get_vending_machine()

	local serving_obj_number = self.serving_count * 2 + 1
	local serving_obj_number_2 = self.serving_count * 2 + 2

	local dir
	-- 자판기보다 왼쪽에 있을 경우
	if vending_machine.Position.x > mermaid.Position.x then
		wp_util.move_async(mermaid,
				vending_machine.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 4, nil)

		dir = 'right'
	else
		wp_util.move_async(mermaid,
				vending_machine.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 4, nil)

		dir = 'left'
	end

	self:serving_ready(mermaid, dir, self.get_mermaid_serving_cups(serving_obj_number),
			self.get_mermaid_serving_cups(serving_obj_number_2))

	self.get_vending_machine().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self:create_serving_marker(false)
end
