function local_class:swindler_zone_enter_event(zone_data)
	--컨트롤 뺏기며 BGM 뮤트, 믹스 디폴트 값
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	--위 사운드와 함께 루프 재생, 믹스 디폴트 값
	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_03',
		loop = true,
		fade_out_time = 2,
		type_priority = 'loop'
	})

	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid_change()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()
	local swindler = self.get_swindler()
	local amy = self.get_amy()
	local yuze = self.get_yuze()

	--에이미 무기 꺼주기
	scene_util.hide_weapon(amy, true)

	local function table_is_empty(table)
		local is_empty = true
		for key, value in pairs(table) do
			is_empty = false
			break
		end

		return is_empty
	end

	local object_table = self.s5_mermaid_serving_obj_pool

	--인어 가게 서빙 해놨던 오브젝트 제거
	if not table_is_empty(object_table) then
		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(object_table) do
			object_table[i].Position = vector(999,0,999)
		end
	end

	--진입시 각 위치에서 정렬 후
	local party_align_key = 'align_key'
	local sohee_waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(sohee,
			field_util.get_marker_pos(zone_data.sohee_marker_name), false)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(sohee, sohee_waypoints, 4, nil, self, party_align_key)

	local mermaid_waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(mermaid,
			field_util.get_marker_pos(zone_data.mermaid_marker_name), false)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid, mermaid_waypoints, 4, nil, self, party_align_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_align_key)

	--소히(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(sohee, '01_player_jump_01')

	--돌프쪽으로 카메라 이동 및 카메라 사이즈 5로 뒤로 빠짐 2초 대기
	local camera_move_duration = 0.5
	local camera_zoom_in_size = 2
	local camera_zoom_out_size = 5

	camera_util.resize_to(camera_zoom_out_size, camera_move_duration)
	camera_util.move_async(swindler.Position, camera_move_duration)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--각 위치에서 경로대로 돌프 옆 위치로 이동
	--동시에 카메라 위치 표시한 곳으로 이동 사이즈 4로 복귀
	local camera_align_pos = swindler.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(camera_move_duration)

	local party_align_key_2 = 'align_key_2'
	local sohee_waypoints_2 = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(sohee,
			self.get_sohee_pos(2), true)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(sohee, sohee_waypoints_2, 4, nil, self, party_align_key_2)

	local mermaid_waypoints_2 = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(mermaid,
			self.get_mermaid_pos(2), true)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid, mermaid_waypoints_2, 4, nil, self, party_align_key_2)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_align_key_2)

	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'right')

	--소히 표정 (attack)으로 변경 소히(left)(right)(down)0.5초 간격

	scene_util.look_around(sohee, { 'left', 'right', 'down' }, nil, 0.5)

	--소히(right,idle,question): 이 가게의 형태… 이 향기까지 완전히 내 연구 결과와 판박이야.

			'idle', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_58')

			'attack', 'short_story_mm_main_s5_59')

function local_class:create_serving_marker(talk_vending_machine)
	local zone_count = 5
	local zone_name = 'main_s5_mermaid_serving_zone_'

	self.controller:remove_all_quest_markers()

	if talk_vending_machine then

		self.controller:add_quest_marker_fo(self.get_vending_machine())
		return
	end

	for i = 1, zone_count do
		local zone = field_util.get_zone(zone_name .. i)

		if not self.get_mermaid_serving_zone[zone_name .. i].is_showing then
			self.controller:add_quest_marker_pos(zone.Bounds.center, 'serving_' .. i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:serving_ready(character, dir, parent_obj, child_obj)
	local loop_sfx_equip = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	scene_util.play_wait_action(character,
			self, dir, 'eat', 'smile', 1)

	loop_sfx_equip:Stop()
	--
	--[summer.tileset] obj_table_cup /obj_table_cup2 을 같이 머리위로 들어올린 상태로 고정된다.
	parent_obj.Position = vector(0, 0, 0)
	child_obj.Position = vector(0, 0, 0)

	child_obj.Transform.parent = parent_obj.Transform

	parent_obj.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	child_obj.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	parent_obj.Position = character.Position + vector(0, 0.35, 0)
	parent_obj.Transform.parent = character.Transform

	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'hold', upper = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--서빙 준비 완료
	self.is_serving_ready = true
end

--스테이지 end 이벤트를 통한 코루틴 중지 second 커스텀 함수
function local_class:sohee_custom_wait_for_sec(duration)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time

	--
	while not self.controller.stage_ended and self.is_sohee_repair_routine and
			unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.sohee_eat_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.sohee_eat_sfx)
		self.sohee_eat_sfx = nil
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then
		return false
	end

	local name = e.Zone.Name
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.garbage_held then
		if name == self.garbage_target_zone and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, mermaid) then
			start_coroutine(self.garbage_scene_meet_amy, self)

			return true
		end

		if self.block_zones[name] ~= nil and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, mermaid) then
			local zone_data = self.block_zones[name]
			local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(name, mermaid, zone_data.dir)

			start_coroutine(self.enter_block_zone_event, self, return_pos)

			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	local is_cur_quest_progressed = function(cur_quest_id)
		return e.QuestId == cur_quest_id and e.PrevProgress == 0
	end

	for _, quest_id in pairs(self.pre_mini_game_quest_id) do
		if is_cur_quest_progressed(quest_id) then
			self:after_mini_game_scene_selector()
			return
		end
	end

	for _, quest_id in pairs(self.post_mini_game_quest_id) do
		if is_cur_quest_progressed(quest_id) then
			self:after_mini_game_scene_selector()
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.pre_mini_game_quest_id.fox then
		self:after_mini_game_scene_selector()
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.is_stage_ended = true
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.stoppable_move_req_id ~= nil and
			type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'amy_grid') then
		self:start_amy_serving_routine()
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.stoppable_move_req_id ~= nil and
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'amy_grid') then
		self:stop_and_wait_amy_serving_routine()
	end
end
--endregion event

--region Custom
function local_class:start_routine()
	self.controller:swindler_store_npc_setting()
	self.controller:mermaid_store_npc_setting()

	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.start

	self:activate_pre_mini_games_ensured()

	local was_garbage_scene_played = self:get_activated_mini_game_quest_num(self.post_mini_game_quest_id) > 0

	--완료된 미니게임 퀘스트의 숫자에 따라 진행도 설정
	if self:is_all_pre_mini_game_cleared() then
		if was_garbage_scene_played then
			self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.garbage_scene_played
		else
			self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.garbage_scene_available
		end

		if self:is_all_post_mini_game_cleared() then
			self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.all_clear_scene_available
		end
	end

	--시작 연출 알맞게 골라 실행
	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.garbage_scene_available then
		self:garbage_scene_on_start_routine()
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.all_clear_scene_available then
		self:set_all_clear_scene_on_start_routine()
	elseif self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 5 or was_garbage_scene_played then
		self:fade_in_routine(true)
	end

	--TODO: 나중에 컨트롤러에서 제어할지 정해야함
	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.start then
		self:start_amy_serving_routine()
	end
end

function local_class:after_mini_game_scene_selector()
	if self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.start and
			self:is_all_pre_mini_game_cleared() then
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.garbage_scene_available
		start_coroutine(self.garbage_scene_beginning, self)
	elseif self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.garbage_scene_played and
			self:is_all_post_mini_game_cleared() then
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.all_clear_scene_available
		start_coroutine(self.all_clear_scene, self)
	else
		self:reset_ui_and_control_after_mini_game()
	end
end

function local_class:enter_block_zone_event(return_pos)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mermaid, 'short_story_mm_main_s6_block_zone_1')

	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, return_pos, 4)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	self:reset_ui_and_control_with_action_disabled()
end

function local_class:garbage_scene_on_start_routine()
	sp_util.enter_scene()
	self:fade_in_routine(false, true)
	self:garbage_scene_beginning()
end

function local_class:set_all_clear_scene_on_start_routine()
	sp_util.enter_scene()
	self:fade_in_routine(false, true)
	self:all_clear_scene()
end

function local_class:fade_in_routine(reset_control, wait_at_end)
	reset_control = lua_helper.get_or_default(reset_control, true)

	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(mermaid.Position,
			mermaid.Direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name), reset_control))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	if wait_at_end then
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end
end

---6섹션 서브 이벤트 중 2개를 클리어 시 연출
---액티비티 마지막 연출에 컨트롤 풀림 부분대신 추가되어 연출
function local_class:garbage_scene_beginning()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local sohee = self.get_sohee()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(sohee)
	character_util.look_at(mermaid, sohee)

	--소히(left,sleep_deep,nod(0.5속도 loop X) : 후우…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sohee, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1, scale = 0.5 },
			'sleep_deep',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_1')

	--소히(left,sleep_deep,cross_aem): 맘대로 해보라지, 어차피 이기는 건 나일테니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sohee, self,
			'left',
		{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false },
			'sleep_deep',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_2')

	--소히(left,idle,idle)(shake0.03) (?) question 이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_buzzy_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sohee)
	character_util.shake(sohee, 0.03, 0.5)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'question')

	--소히가 (left,idle,bow_idle)로 핸드폰을 손에 들고있다.
	--maiden_phone
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'bow_idle' })
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(sohee, '[base]weapon1', self.phone_item)

	--1초대기 후 표정이 (attack) (!)notice로 변경
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(sohee, nil, 'notice')

	--소히(left,sleep_deep,nod2회)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(sohee, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(sohee, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--인어(right,tired,bomb_idle): 뭐 때문에 그러시나요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_3')

	--소히(left,attack,release): 급한 일이야! 가게에 문제가 생겼어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sohee, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_4')

	--인어(right,surprise,cast)(jump1회): 문제가 생겼다고요?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(mermaid, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'right',
			'cast',
			'surprise',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_5')

	--페이드 인 페이드 아웃 후
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_05')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--가게앞으로 이동되어 있다.
	local garbage = self.get_garbage(1)
	local wagon_pos = get_field_object('s5_repair_sohee_store').Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
	local sohee_pos = wagon_pos + vector(2, 0, -0.5)
	local garbage_pos = sohee_pos + vector(-0.75, 0, 0)
	local mermaid_pos = sohee_pos + vector(1.75, 0, 0)

	sohee.Position = sohee_pos
	garbage.Position = garbage_pos
	mermaid.Position = mermaid_pos

	garbage.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	garbage.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '02_simple_slash_hit_01'

	--소히(left,tired,eat)
	character_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'eat' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(sohee, self, { name = 'tired' })

	--상태 인어(left,tired,cast) 상태
	character_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'cast' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, { name = 'tired' })

	camera_util.move_async(mermaid.Position, 0)

	--5섹션 끝에 배치됐던 10/11번 NPC제거
	local npc_10 = self.get_mermaid_store_npc(10)
	local npc_11 = self.get_mermaid_store_npc(11)

	character_util.set_active_state(npc_10, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(npc_11, 'disabled')

	local billboard = self.get_billboard()

	billboard.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--인어 (right)0.5칸 이동/1초 대기/(left)0.5칸 이동 / 1초 대기/ (right)0.5칸 이동 / 1초 대기 /(left)0.5칸 이동
	local mermaid_walk_speed = 1
	local repeat_num = 2
	local move_right_dis = vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	local move_left_dis = move_right_dis * -1

	for i = 1, repeat_num do
		character_util.move_distance_async(mermaid, move_right_dis,
				nil, mermaid_walk_speed, true, true)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.move_distance_async(mermaid, move_left_dis,
				nil, mermaid_walk_speed, true, true)

		if i < repeat_num then
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)

	--소히(left,attack,cross_arm): 흠… 이거 참.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sohee, self,
			'left',
			'cross_arm',
			'attack',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_6')

	--인어(left,scared,release): 문제가 많이 심각한가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'scared',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_7')

	--인어(left,tired,cast)(shake0.03): 더 이상 가게를 또 잃고 싶지 않은데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(mermaid, 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'left',
			'cast',
			'tired',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_8')

	--소히(right,tired,bomb_idle): 또 무슨 쓸데없는 걱정을 하고 있는 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sohee, self,
			'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'short_story_mm_main_s6_mid_9')

	--소히(left,idle,eat) 1초 후
	eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.set_direction(sohee, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(sohee, self, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)

	--해당 오브젝트 없었다가 fx_dead 와 함께 해당 모션때 소히 좌측에서 생성되어 들어올리고 (left)방향 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_02')
	garbage.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(garbage.Bounds.center)

	--소히가 holdable로 [summer.tileset]obj_homeless를 들고있다.
	character_util.remove_anim(sohee)
	command_util.execute_holdup(sohee, garbage, sohee.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--소히 바로 오른쪽에 해당 오브젝트를 hildable오브젝트를 던지듯 내려놓는다.
	garbage.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local garbage_bhv = garbage.FieldObjectBehaviour

	cast(garbage_bhv, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectBehaviour))

---가짜로 쓰레기 들고있는 것처럼 보이게 하여 npc들과 상호작용은 가능하도록 한다.
function local_class:start_fake_holding_garbage()
	self.is_garbage_fake_holding = true

	local garbage = self.get_garbage(1)
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local garbage_original_parent = garbage.Transform.parent

	message_system:SendSync(garbage, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	message_system:SendSync(mermaid, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(mermaid))

	garbage.Transform.parent = mermaid.Transform

	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'hold', one_shot_sfx = false, upper = true })

	while not self.is_stage_ended do
		if not self.is_garbage_fake_holding then
			garbage.Transform.parent = garbage_original_parent
			character_util.remove_anim(mermaid, true)
			command_util.execute_holdup(mermaid, garbage, mermaid.Position, 0, false)
			scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'hold', one_shot_sfx = false, upper = true, scale = 999 })
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_and_wait_amy_serving_routine()

--섹션 5 이후부터 돌프 상점 에이미 서빙 루틴
function local_class:s5_amy_serving_routine()
	local amy = self.get_amy()

	local function get_amy_pos(number)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_amy_pos_' .. number)
	end

	local check_stop = function()
		return self.stage_ended or not self.is_amy_serving
	end

	character_util.set_position(amy,	get_amy_pos(1))
	--섹션 5 에이미 서빙 루틴 관리
	self.is_amy_serving = true
	self.is_amy_serving_ended = false

	--이벤트 끝나면 에이미 경로따라 자동 이동 (1-2-3-4-1-2…순서로) (이동때 충돌처리X)
	--각 위치에 (down,idle,idle) 상태로 3초씩 대기
	amy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	scene_util.hide_weapon(amy)

	local temp_pos = get_amy_pos(2)
	local amy_waypoint_1_to_2 = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(amy, temp_pos,
			{ x = temp_pos.x - 2 })

	temp_pos = get_amy_pos(4)
	local amy_waypoint_3_to_4 = {
		vector(temp_pos.x + 2, 0, get_amy_pos(3).z),
		vector(temp_pos.x + 2, 0, temp_pos.z),
		temp_pos
	}
	--에이미 wapoints 설정
	local amy_waypoints = {
		amy_waypoint_1_to_2,
		get_amy_pos(3),
		amy_waypoint_3_to_4,
		get_amy_pos(1)
	}

	local amy_loop_index = 1

	self.stoppable_move_req_id = self.stoppable_move_req_id + 1
	local cur_id = self.stoppable_move_req_id

	while cur_id == self.stoppable_move_req_id and not check_stop() do
		scene_util.set_direction(amy, 'down', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(amy)

		local duration = 3
		local start_time = unity_class.time.time

		while not check_stop() and unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if check_stop() then
			break
		end

		wp_util.move_async(amy, amy_waypoints[amy_loop_index], 4, 0)

		amy_loop_index = amy_loop_index + 1

		if amy_loop_index > 4 then
			amy_loop_index = 1
		end
	end

	self.is_amy_serving_ended = true

	scene_util.show_weapon(amy)
end

---미니게임 이후 컨트롤 리셋
---직관적인 함수의 이름으로 래핑
function local_class:reset_ui_and_control_after_mini_game()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, mermaid)
end

--걷는 것만 가능하도록 세팅한다.
function local_class:reset_ui_and_control_with_action_disabled()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, mermaid)

	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(mermaid, false)
	local enable_control = CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact
	local disable_control = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~ CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(enable_control)

	player_state:DisableControls(disable_control)
	message_system:SendSync(mermaid.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))
end

--순회가 길지 않으니 용도에 맞게 함수를 분리하는 것을 최우선으로 두겠음
--InnerProgress 가 0이면 활성화 된 퀘스트로, 1이면 메인 퀘스트의 미니게임 퀘스트 완료로 취급
function local_class:get_activated_mini_game_quest_num(target_mini_game_quest_table)
	local active_count = 0

	for _, quest_id in pairs(target_mini_game_quest_table) do
		local cur_mini_game_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_id)

		if cur_mini_game_quest ~= nil then
			active_count = active_count + 1
		end
	end

	return active_count
end

function local_class:get_completed_mini_game_quest_num(target_mini_game_quest_table)
	local complete_count = 0

	for _, quest_id in pairs(target_mini_game_quest_table) do
		local cur_mini_game_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_id)

		--챌린지가 없는 미니게임이면 IsComplete이 true면 완료된 것으로 대응
		if cur_mini_game_quest ~= nil and
				(cur_mini_game_quest.InnerProgress >= 1 or cur_mini_game_quest.IsComplete) then
			complete_count = complete_count + 1
		end
	end

	return complete_count
end

function local_class:activate_pre_mini_games_ensured()
	if self:get_activated_mini_game_quest_num(self.pre_mini_game_quest_id) < self.pre_mini_game_quest_len then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.pre_mini_game_activate_event_key }))
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		while self:get_activated_mini_game_quest_num(self.pre_mini_game_quest_id) < self.pre_mini_game_quest_len do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:activate_post_mini_games_ensured()
	if self:get_activated_mini_game_quest_num(self.post_mini_game_quest_id) < self.post_mini_game_quest_len then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.post_mini_game_activate_event_key }))
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		while self:get_activated_mini_game_quest_num(self.post_mini_game_quest_id) < self.post_mini_game_quest_len do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_all_pre_mini_game_cleared()
	return self:get_completed_mini_game_quest_num(self.pre_mini_game_quest_id) == self.pre_mini_game_quest_len
end

function local_class:is_all_post_mini_game_cleared()
	return self:get_completed_mini_game_quest_num(self.post_mini_game_quest_id) == self.post_mini_game_quest_len
end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_landmark()) and not self.is_not_control then
			self.is_not_control = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_throw_waterballoon_event, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_section_state > self.section_state.check_mermaid_store then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mermaid_store_npc(14)) then
			local npc_1 = self.get_mermaid_store_npc(14)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc_1,
					{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_oneline_1', skip = false })
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mermaid_store_npc(15)) then
			local npc_2 = self.get_mermaid_store_npc(15)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc_2,
					{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_oneline_2', skip = false })
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true
	self.loop_escape = true

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.check_swindler_store or
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.throw_waterballoon then
		if not self.is_not_control and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s7_swindler_store_near_area_1_zone_name) then
			self.swindler_store_zone_enum = self.swindler_store_zone.left
		elseif not self.is_not_control and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s7_swindler_store_near_area_2_zone_name) then
			self.swindler_store_zone_enum = self.swindler_store_zone.right
		end

		-- 돌프 가게 근처 존 오른쪽 or 왼쪽 존 엔터했을 경우
		if self.swindler_store_zone_enum ~= self.swindler_store_zone.none and not self.is_not_control then
			self.is_not_control = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_swindler_store_event, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then

		if not self.qte_complete_1 then
			self.qte_tap_count = self.qte_tap_count + 1

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc_info(npc, pos, dir, anim, emo, enable_interaction, string)
	enable_interaction = lua_helper.get_or_default(enable_interaction, false)

	if npc == nil then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
	character_util.set_direction(npc, dir)

	if anim ~= nil and type_util.is_string(anim) then
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim)
	else
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
	end

	if emo ~= nil and type_util.is_string(emo) then
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, emo)
	else
		character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
	end

	if enable_interaction then
		character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)
	end

	if string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(string) then
		npc.Interactable.Talk = string
	end
end

function local_class:interacted_mermaid_store_guest()
	local civil_1 = self.get_mermaid_store_npc(14)
	local civil_2 = self.get_mermaid_store_npc(15)
	local surfer = self.get_surfer_sohee()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local swindler = self.get_swindler()
	local surfer_pos = self.get_surfer_sohee_pos(self.current_section_state, 1)
	local mermaid_pos = self.get_mermaid_pos(self.current_section_state, 1)
	local swindler_pos = self.get_swindler_pos(1)
	local civil_1_pos

	-- 배경음 음량 조절
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	self.controller:remove_quest_marker_fo(self.get_obstruction_signboard())

	local move_key_1 = 'party_align_1'
	local move_key_2 = ''

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer,
			surfer_pos,
			3,
			nil,
			self, move_key_1,
			{ last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid,
			mermaid_pos,
			3,
			nil,
			self, move_key_1,
			{ last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key_1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 소히(left,surprsie,idle) 1초 (down) 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_wait_action(surfer, self, 'left', nil, 'surprise', 1)

	scene_util.play_wait_action(surfer, self, 'down', nil, 'surprise', 1)

	-- 돌프 초기 위치 미리 셋팅
	self:set_npc_info(swindler, swindler_pos, 'up', nil, nil)
	character_util.set_active_state(swindler, 'enabled')

	-- 이때 인어 (left,tired,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'tired')
	character_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left')

	-- 소히(left,attack,idle)(jump1회): 뭐야?! 손님들이 다 어디간거야?
	character_util.normal_jump(surfer, '01_player_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_1_1', skip = true })

	-- 인어(left,tired,cast): 이게 도대체 무슨 일이죠…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_1_2', skip = true })

	-- (1)/(2)(left,idle,idle)
	character_util.set_direction(civil_1, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(civil_2, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(civil_1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(civil_2)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이때 소히 , 인어(right,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(surfer, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'right')

	-- (1)(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 아니! 인어님 여기 계셨군요!
	character_util.normal_jump(civil_1, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civil_1, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_1_3', skip = true })

	-- (2)(left,idle,bomb_idle): 가게는 안차리시고 어디 계셨습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civil_2, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_1_4', skip = true })

	-- 인어(right,tired,sing): 여, 여기가 제 가게에요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sing', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_bad_01' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_1_5', skip = true })

	-- (1)/(2)(up,idle,idle)
	character_util.set_direction(civil_1, 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(civil_2, 'up')

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- (1)(up,idle,idle): 이게 인어님의 가게였다고요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civil_1, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_1_6', skip = true })

	-- (1)/(2)(left,idle,idle)
	character_util.set_direction(civil_1, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(civil_2, 'left')

	-- (2)(left,smile,bomb_idle): 이렇게 멋진 가게를 차리시다니! 저희를 보낸 이유가 이거였군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civil_2, self,
			nil,

function local_class:swindler_store_event_setting()
	local swindler = self.get_swindler()
	local amy = self.get_summer_amy()
	local amy_pos = self.get_summer_amy_pos(1)

	self:set_npc_info(swindler, vector(999, 0, 999), 'down', nil, nil)

	self:stop_and_wait_amy_serving_routine()

	self:set_npc_info(amy, amy_pos, 'down', nil, 'sleep_deep')
	character_util.set_active_state(amy, 'enabled')

	-- 퀘스트 마커 셋팅
	self.controller:add_quest_marker_fo(self.get_summer_amy())

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.check_swindler_store
end

function local_class:play_swindler_store_event()
	local surfer = self.get_surfer_sohee()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local summer_amy = self.get_summer_amy()
	local surfer_align_end_pos_1 = self.get_surfer_sohee_pos(2,
			self.swindler_store_zone_enum)
	local mermaid_align_end_pos_1 = self.get_mermaid_pos(2,
			self.swindler_store_zone_enum)

	-- 배경음 음량 조절
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	-- 해당 빨간존으로 들어가면 해당 대열로 정렬
	-- 좌측 소히,인어 (right,idle,idle) 우측 소히,인어(left,idle,idle)
	local move_key_1 = 'party_align_2'

	local party_last_dir
	local amy_dir
	local party_back_move_dir_vec_x

	if self.swindler_store_zone_enum == self.swindler_store_zone.left then
		party_last_dir = 'right'
		party_back_move_dir_vec_x = -1
		amy_dir = 'left'
	elseif self.swindler_store_zone_enum == self.swindler_store_zone.right then
		party_last_dir = 'left'
		party_back_move_dir_vec_x = 1
		amy_dir = 'right'
	end

	-- 다른 손님들 말풍선 제거
	for i = 1, self.swindler_store_npc_max_count do
		local npc = self.get_swindler_store_npc(i)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
	end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer,
			surfer_align_end_pos_1,
			3,
			nil,
			self, move_key_1,
			{ last_direction = party_last_dir })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid,
			mermaid_align_end_pos_1,
			3,
			nil,
			self, move_key_1,
			{ last_direction = party_last_dir })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key_1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 첫 이벤트 진입 시
	if not self.played_event.amy_obstructive then
		-- 소히 대사: 좋아… 그럼.
		-- 소히 표정 (attack) 모션(release)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'release' },
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_2_1', skip = true })
	end

	-- 에미미가 각 온 방향을 바라본다 표정 (frenzy_idle)
	character_util.set_direction(summer_amy, amy_dir)
	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_amy, self, 'frenzy_idle')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')

	-- 소히 인어 온 방향으로 (surprise)표정 (jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(mermaid)
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(surfer)

	-- 소히 인어 들어온 방향 반대쪽으로 (damaged,embarrassed)모션으로 1.5칸 뒷걸음질
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	wp_util.move(mermaid, mermaid.Position + vector(1.5 * party_back_move_dir_vec_x, 0, 0),
			3.5, nil, { locked_dir = party_last_dir })
	wp_util.move(surfer, surfer.Position + vector(1.5 * party_back_move_dir_vec_x, 0, 0),
			3.5, nil, { locked_dir = party_last_dir })

	-- 동시에 에이미 각방향 바로앞으로 1칸 이동 (frenzy_idle frenzy_smile
	-- 점프하며 공격 twohand_attack4
	local anim_scale = 1.5
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(summer_amy,
			'twohand_attack4') / anim_scale
	local pos_diff = (mermaid.Position - summer_amy.Position):GetX0z()
	local dir = pos_diff.normalized

	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_amy, self, 'frenzy_idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(summer_amy, self,
			{ name = 'twohand_attack4',
			  count = 1,
			  scale = anim_scale,
			  one_shot_sfx = '02_ficklelady_cast_01',
			  loop = true })

	move_key_1 = 'amy_attack'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(summer_amy,
			summer_amy.Position + dir,
			nil,
			anim_duration,
			self, move_key_1)

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.85)

	self.fx.viking_stomp_super():Instantiate(summer_amy.Position)

	-- 카메라 쉐이크 1초, 세기 0.1
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ficklelady_explosion_01')

	-- 동시에 인어 소히 표정 (scared)로 변경 (jump1회)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'scared')
	character_util.normal_jump(mermaid)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(surfer)
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer, self, 'scared')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(surfer)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key_1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 에이미 공격 동작 후 어느정도 다가 왔을때 인어,소히(scared)표정으로 3칸 뒷걸음질
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'scared')
	character_util.remove_anim(mermaid)
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer, self, 'scared')
	character_util.remove_anim(surfer)
	wp_util.move(mermaid, mermaid.Position + vector(3 * party_back_move_dir_vec_x, 0, 0),
			4, nil, { locked_dir = party_last_dir })
	wp_util.move(surfer, surfer.Position + vector(3 * party_back_move_dir_vec_x, 0, 0),
			4, nil, { locked_dir = party_last_dir })

	-- 에이미 보는 방향으로 (twohand_attack) 이 후 (twohand_idle) 상태 1초
	scene_util.set_anim_async(summer_amy, self,
			{ name = 'twohand_attack',
			  count = 1,
			  one_shot_sfx = '02_twohand_slash_01',
			  loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 첫감상시
	if not self.played_event.amy_obstructive then
		-- 에이미(tired,idle): 미안… 돌프가 너희들이 오지 못하게 하랬어…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_amy, self,
				nil,
				{ one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
				{ name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_2_2', skip = true })

		-- 에이미 중앙에 다시 정렬후 (down,idle,idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(summer_amy)
		wp_util.move_async(summer_amy, self.get_summer_amy_pos(1),
				2.5, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

		-- 소히(mad)(shake0.03): 이게… 폭력까지 쓰겠다. 이거지?
		scene_util.shake(surfer, 0.03, 99999)

		scene_util.set_emotion(surfer, self, 'mad')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_2_3', skip = true })

		-- 인어(tired): 이제 어쩌죠?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_2_4', skip = true })

		character_util.stop_shake(surfer)

		-- 소히(sleep_deep,question) (...) slience 이모티콘 버블
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(surfer, self,
				nil,
				'question',
				'sleep_deep',
				'silence')

		-- 소히(attack)(jump1회) (!) notice 이모티콘 버블
		character_util.normal_jump(surfer)
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(surfer, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'idle', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_notice_01' },
				'idle',
				'notice')

		character_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left')

		-- 소히(left,attack,release)(shake풀림): 좋아! 저기 커다란 돌고래 뒤로 따라와 봐!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
				'left',
				{ name = 'release' },
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_2_5', skip = true })

		-- 인어(left,tired,bomb_idle): 뭔가… 방법이 있으신건가요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
				'left',
				{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
				{ name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_2_6', skip = true })

		-- 랜드마크 뒤쪽으로 메인 마커
		local quest_marker_pos = self.get_quest_marker_pos()
		self.controller:add_quest_marker_pos(quest_marker_pos, self.quest_marker_key)

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.move_to_landmark

		-- 퀘스트 마커 근처 자리에 이펙트 생성 (임시 위치)
		local landmark = self.get_landmark()

		if landmark ~= nil then
			landmark.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end

		local twinkle_effect_pos = landmark.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

		self.fx_twinkle_effect = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(twinkle_effect_pos)

		-- 에이미 퀘스트 마커 제거
		self.controller:remove_quest_marker_fo(self.get_summer_amy())

		-- 다음 상태 값으로 변경
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.throw_waterballoon
		self.played_event.amy_obstructive = true
	else
		-- 첫감상이 아닐시 에이미 중앙에 다시 정렬후 (down,idle,idle)
		-- 해당 이벤트는 다음씬으로 넘어가지 않으면 반복됨
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(summer_amy)
		wp_util.move_async(summer_amy, self.get_summer_amy_pos(1),
				2.5, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(surfer)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	-- 배경음 음량 조절
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

	self.swindler_store_zone_enum = self.swindler_store_zone.none
	self.is_not_control = false
end

-- 랜드마크 근처에서 상호작용 후 진행되는 에이미에게 물풍선 던지는 이벤트
function local_class:play_throw_waterballoon_event()
	local surfer = self.get_surfer_sohee()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local summer_amy = self.get_summer_amy()
	local surfer_move_pos = self.get_surfer_sohee_pos(
			self.current_section_state, 1)
	local mermaid_move_pos = self.get_mermaid_pos(
			self.current_section_state, 1)
	local summer_amy_move_pos = self.get_last_event_summer_amy_pos(
			self.current_section_state, 1)

	-- 소히 랜드마크 오르는 지점
	local landmark_center_pos = self.get_surfer_sohee_pos(self.current_section_state, 2)
	local landmark_top_pos = self.get_surfer_sohee_pos(self.current_section_state, 3)

	-- 이벤트 표시 이펙트 삭제
	if self.fx_twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.fx_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.fx_twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	-- 배경음 음량 조절
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	-- 에이미 위치 이동
	scene_util.hide_weapon(summer_amy)
	wp_util.move(summer_amy, summer_amy_move_pos, 5, nil,
			{ last_direction = 'down' })


	local move_key_1 = 'party_align_3'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(surfer,
			surfer_move_pos,
			3,
			nil,
			self, move_key_1,
			{ last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(mermaid,
			mermaid_move_pos,
			3,
			nil,
			self, move_key_1,
			{ last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key_1)

	-- 이벤트용 소히로 교체
	character_util.set_position(self.get_event_surfer_sohee(), surfer_move_pos)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_position(self.get_surfer_sohee(), vector(888, 0, 888))

	surfer = self.get_event_surfer_sohee()

	-- 소히 파티 탈퇴시킴
	party_util.remain_only_leader()

	-- 소히(right,idle,release): 좋아! 너 동상에 기대고 있어봐!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_1', skip = true })

	-- 인어(left,tired,cast): 네…? 뭘 하실려고…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_2', skip = true })

	-- 아래 상황에서 인어(left,scared,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'scared')

	-- 소히(right,attack,release): 잔말말고 일단 기대보라고!
	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_3', skip = true })


	-- 인어 0.5칸 오른쪽 이동후 (right,idle,push)
	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, mermaid.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 3, nil)
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'push' })

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 소히 마리오점프로 인어 머리를 밟는다.
	-- 인어 소히 착지와 동시에 fx_hit 이펙트 (damaged)표정으로 바뀜+ 눌리면서 빨간틴트 (피격효과)+화면 shake 0.1 /0.5초
	-- + 점프 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	local surfer_jump_end_pos = mermaid.Position + vector(0, 0.75, 0)
	wp_util.move(surfer, surfer_jump_end_pos, nil, 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(surfer, 'right', 0.5, 1.5)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	scene_util.set_anim(surfer, self, { name = 'push' })

	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(surfer_jump_end_pos)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	-- 인어 밟힐때 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(mermaid)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(mermaid)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 인어(right,damaged,push)(shake0.03): 자, 잠깐만. 지금 뭐하시는 거에요?!
	scene_util.shake(mermaid, 0.03, 99999)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_4', skip = true })

	-- 소히(right,attack,push): 잔말말고 버텨봐!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_5', skip = true })

	-- QTE (10번 터치) (실패x)
	self:climb_qte_event()

	-- 입력성공시
	-- 소히 마리오 점프로 랜드마크 중앙지점까지 점프 해당 지점에서 (right,attack,push)상태로 버티고 있다.
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(surfer_jump_end_pos)

	-- 인어 소히 점프와 동시에 fx_hit 이펙트+ 눌리면서 빨간틴트 (피격효과)+화면 shake 0.1 /0.5초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	-- 소히 뛰기 전 인어 밟힘 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(mermaid)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(mermaid)
	character_util.stop_shake(mermaid)

	-- 이때 인어 (left,damaged,seat) 되면서 0.5칸 좌측으로 이동
	local pushed_out = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'seat' })

		character_util.move_to_async(mermaid,
				mermaid.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
				nil,
				5,
				false,
				false)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 인어 마리오 점프로 기상 (right,tired,idle)
		-- + 기상할때 사운드
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

		scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'tired')
		character_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'right')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(mermaid, 'right')

		pushed_out = true
	end)

	wp_util.move(surfer, landmark_center_pos, nil, 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(surfer, 'right', 0.5, 1.5)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	scene_util.set_emotion(surfer, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer, self, { name = 'push' })

	-- 인어 밀려나는 연출 종료까지 대기
	while not pushed_out do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 인어(right,scared,cast)(jump1회)
	-- + 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, { name = 'cast' })

	character_util.normal_jump_async(mermaid)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 인어(right,scared,release): 자, 잠깐만요! 거기 함부로 오르거나 하시면 안되요!!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'scared' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_6', skip = true })

	-- 인어(right,tired,cast2): 마을 사람들이 얼마나 고생하며 만든 동상인데요!!
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast2', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_7', skip = true })

	-- 소히한테 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move_async(landmark_top_pos, 0.5)

	-- 소히(right,attack,push)상태에서 마리오점프로 랜드마크 꼭대기까지 점프한다.
	-- + 점프 사운드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	wp_util.move(surfer, landmark_top_pos, nil, 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(surfer, 'right', 0.5, 1.5)

	-- 인어(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회): 지금 뭐하시려는 거에요!!
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(mermaid)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			nil,
			{ one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_02' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_8', skip = true })

	-- 소히(right,attack,eat): 내가 말했잖아! 똑같이 돌려줄거라고!
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'eat' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_9', skip = true })

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(surfer, '[base]weapon1', 'water_balloon_blue')
	self:set_surfer_weapon_item(vector(999, 0, 999))

	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	equipping_sfx = nil

	-- 소히(right,attack,bomb_idle): 그 잘난 미소가 찬물을 끼얹어도 계속 따뜻할지 한 번 보자고!
	scene_util.set_anim(surfer, self, { name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(surfer, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_10', skip = true })

	-- 에이미에게 이동 전 음식 들게하기
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(summer_amy, '[base]weapon1', 'food_hamburg')
	scene_util.set_anim(summer_amy, self, { name = 'gauntlet_idle' })
	self:set_hamburg_item(vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 카메라 에이미쪽으로 이동한다.
	camera_util.move_async(summer_amy.Position, 1)

	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(summer_amy, '[base]weapon1')
	scene_util.show_serving_async(summer_amy, self.drop_item_hamburg, 0.4,
			{ start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(summer_amy.Position, 0.7) })

	-- 에이미 (down, tired, idle) : 부… 부르셨나요. 손님.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_amy, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_11', skip = true })

	local talk_npc = self.get_swindler_store_npc(5)
	-- 양아치남 (right, smile, idle)(jump1회) : 우효~! 아가씨 내 타입인데?
	scene_util.set_emotion(talk_npc, self, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump(talk_npc)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(talk_npc, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s7_3_12', skip = true })

	-- 양아치남 (right, smile, release) : 잠깐 옆에 앉았다 갈래?
	scene_util.set_anim(talk_npc, self, { name = 'release', upper = true })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(talk_npc, self,

function local_class:climb_qte_event()
	-- QTE 이벤트 시작.
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	screen_util.show_turbo_tap()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')

	while not self.qte_complete_1 do

		if self.qte_tap_count > self.qte_tap_end_count then
			self.qte_complete_1 = true
		end

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	-- QTE 끝
end

function local_class:move_bench_civil()
	-- 첫번째 지점은 마리오 점프 이동
	for i = 1, #self.runaway_bench_npc_idx_list do
		local npc_idx = self.runaway_bench_npc_idx_list[i]
		local npc = self.get_swindler_store_npc(npc_idx)
		local next_move_pos = self.get_swindler_store_npc_pos(npc_idx, 2)
		local move_diff = (next_move_pos - npc.Position):GetX0z()
		local dir = move_diff.normalized

		if npc_idx == 5 then
			dir = dir * 2
		end

		local npc_dir = direction_util.to_str(vector_util.to_direction(dir))

function local_class:sohee_water_balloon_item_rotate(duration)
	local falling_item = self.drop_item_waterballoon
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress)
		local rotate_num = -6
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotate_num

		falling_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:amy_serving_routine()
	local amy = self.get_summer_amy()

	character_util.set_active_state(amy, 'enabled')

	local function get_amy_pos(number)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_amy_pos_' .. number)
	end

	local check_stop = function()
		return self.is_stage_end or not self.is_amy_serving
	end

	character_util.set_position(amy,	get_amy_pos(1))
	--섹션 5 에이미 서빙 루틴 관리
	self.is_amy_serving = true
	self.is_amy_serving_ended = false

	--이벤트 끝나면 에이미 경로따라 자동 이동 (1-2-3-4-1-2…순서로) (이동때 충돌처리X)
	--각 위치에 (down,idle,idle) 상태로 3초씩 대기
	amy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	scene_util.hide_weapon(amy)

	local temp_pos = get_amy_pos(2)
	local amy_waypoint_1_to_2 = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(amy, temp_pos,
			{ x = temp_pos.x - 2 })

	temp_pos = get_amy_pos(4)
	local amy_waypoint_3_to_4 = {
		vector(temp_pos.x + 2, 0, get_amy_pos(3).z),
		vector(temp_pos.x + 2, 0, temp_pos.z),
		temp_pos
	}
	--에이미 wapoints 설정
	local amy_waypoints = {
		amy_waypoint_1_to_2,
		get_amy_pos(3),
		amy_waypoint_3_to_4,
		get_amy_pos(1)
	}

	local amy_loop_index = 1

	self.stoppable_move_req_id = self.stoppable_move_req_id + 1
	local cur_id = self.stoppable_move_req_id

	while cur_id == self.stoppable_move_req_id and not check_stop() do
		scene_util.set_direction(amy, 'down', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(amy)

		local duration = 3
		local start_time = unity_class.time.time

		while not check_stop() and unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
			if self.loop_escape then
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if check_stop() then
			break
		end

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		wp_util.move_async(amy, amy_waypoints[amy_loop_index], 4, 0)

		amy_loop_index = amy_loop_index + 1

		if amy_loop_index > 4 then
			amy_loop_index = 1
		end
	end

	self.is_amy_serving_ended = true

	scene_util.show_weapon(amy)
end

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_entering_the_cave

		sp_util.start_scene(self.before_entering_the_cave, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_entering_the_cave and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, mermaid, self.after_amy_move_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_amy_move

		--에이미 움직이는 중
		self.amy_is_moving = true

		start_coroutine(self.after_amy_move, self)

		return true

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_amy_move and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, mermaid, self.ending_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending

		--엔딩 전 마커 지우기
		self.controller:remove_all_quest_markers()

		--엔딩 존에 미는 돌이 존재하면 그 돌 초기화

			self:reset_pushable_stone(self.get_pushable_stone(1))
		end

		if zone_util.contains_fo(e.Zone, self.get_pushable_stone(2)) then
			self:reset_pushable_stone(self.get_pushable_stone(2))
		end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending, self)

		return true

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.ending and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, mermaid, self.after_ending_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

		sp_util.start_scene(self.exit_cave_event, self)

		return true
	end

	--말풍선 출력과 동시에 화면 shake 0.5, 0.3초
	--말풍선 출력과 동시에 인어 up, idle, jump1회 후 idle + emoticon_bubble_notice
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.5)

			scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'up', false)
			character_util.normal_jump_async(mermaid, true)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
			scene_util.play_emoticon_action(mermaid, self,
					nil,
					nil,
					nil,
					'notice'
			)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')
			scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(amy, self, nil, nil, nil,
					{
						key = 'short_story_mm_main_s8_1_1',
						viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.85),
						skip = true,
						scale = 2.0
					})
		end)
	})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	--카메라 에이미(cwp_maid 장착중)한테로 포커싱
	character_util.hide_weapon(amy, false)

	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'up', false)
	camera_util.move_async(amy.Position, 1, { end_target = amy, ignorecameragrids = true })

	--카메라 에이미에게 이동 끝난 후 아래 연출 진행.
	local function stones_destruction_routine(target_data, attack_count)
		local foreach_stone = function(func)
			for i = 1, #target_data.stone do
				func(i, target_data.stone[i])
			end
		end

		if attack_count then
			-- 이동
			if target_data.amy_move_pos then
				wp_util.move_async(amy, target_data.amy_move_pos, 4)
			end

			--에이미(right, frenzy_smile, twohand_attack(재생속도2배)
			--에이미 무기에 부딪힐 때 마다 shake 0.03, 0.1초 화면 shake 0. 1 (모션3회할때까지) (n회)
			local twohand_attack_duration = (spine_util.get_animation_duration(
					amy, 'twohand_attack')) * 0.5

			scene_util.set_emotion(amy, self, 'frenzy_smile')

			start_coroutine(function()
				self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration * 0.65)

				for count = 1, attack_count do
					camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.1)
					foreach_stone(function(idx, target)
						field_object_util.shake(target, 0.03, 0.1)
					end)

					self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration)
				end
			end)

			--모션 n회 마지막과 동시에
			scene_util.set_anim(amy, self, { name = 'twohand_attack', count = attack_count, scale = 2 })

			--마지막이 달라서 코루틴으로 
			start_coroutine(function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_back_slash_02')

				self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_back_slash_02')

				self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_slash_02')
			end)

			self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration * ((attack_count - 1) + 0.65))

			foreach_stone(function(idx, target)
				local target_pos = target.Bounds.center

				target.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')
				self.get_fx_slime_buttbounce():Instantiate(target_pos)
				self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(target_pos)
			end)

			--화면 shake 0.15 1초 + shake 시작과 동시에 에이미앞의 바위 FX_slime_buttbounce 이펙트와 함께 사라짐
			camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)

			self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration * 0.35)
		else
			-- 이동
			if target_data.amy_move_pos then
				wp_util.move_async(amy, target_data.amy_move_pos, 12, nil, { run = true })
			end

			--fx_hit
			--FX_slime_buttbounce 
			--FX_slime_buttbounce 와 동시에 부딪히는 바위는 제거됨
			foreach_stone(function(idx, target)
				local target_pos = target.Bounds.center

				target.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')
				self.get_fx_slime_buttbounce():Instantiate(target_pos)
				self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(target_pos)
			end)

			--화면 shake 0.1, 0.3초
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
		end
	end

	--에이미는 부수고있다.
	self.amy_is_destroying = true

	--맨 처음 3회 바위 파괴
	stones_destruction_routine(stones_destruction_data[1], 3)

	--에이미 ‘검은색 화살표’ 경로따라 이동하면서 바위 파괴하는 모습을 보여준다.(바위 파괴 연출은 아래 참조)
	stones_destruction_routine(stones_destruction_data[2])
	stones_destruction_routine(stones_destruction_data[3])
	stones_destruction_routine(stones_destruction_data[4])
	stones_destruction_routine(stones_destruction_data[5])

	--연출 종료 전 별개 코루틴 재생 
	start_coroutine(function()
		stones_destruction_routine(stones_destruction_data[6])
		stones_destruction_routine(stones_destruction_data[7])

		local amy_pos = {
			self.get_amy_pos(9),
			self.get_amy_pos(10)
		}

		wp_util.move_async(amy, amy_pos, 4)

		scene_util.set_anim(amy, self, 'twohand_idle')
		scene_util.set_emotion(amy, self, 'frenzy_idle')

		--파괴가 완료되었다.
		self.amy_is_destroying = false
	end)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	if self.background_sfx then
		self.background_sfx:Stop()
		self.background_sfx = nil
	end

	--플레이어 컨트롤 시작되며 BGM 재생, 볼륨 1, 믹스 디폴트 값
	--BGM 변경
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
			{ name = 'ondemand/short_story_mermaid/audio:bgm_mermaid_sadness', state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

--exit_inner 입장 이벤트 후 exit_inner 간소화 입장 기능 추가
function local_class:teleport_position(exit_pos, dir, call_back)
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local teleport_pos = exit_pos

	--동굴 진입 시 효과음 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.65, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(mermaid, teleport_pos)

	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, dir, false)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	if call_back then
		call_back()
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.65, 'linear')
end

--exit_inner 입장 이벤트 후 exit_inner 간소화 퇴장 기능 추가
function local_class:cave_in(call_back)
	local call_back = lua_helper.get_or_default(call_back, nil)

	self.controller:remove_all_quest_markers()

	--동굴 진입시 카메라 효과 꺼주기
	stage_camera.ImageEffectController.enabled = false

	self:teleport_position(self.get_exit_pos(2), 'up', call_back)
end

function local_class:cave_out()
	if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.ending then
		self.controller:add_quest_marker_fo(self.get_interact_exit_inner(1))
	end

	--동굴 진입시 카메라 효과 켜주기
	stage_camera.ImageEffectController.enabled = true

	if self.background_sfx then
		self.background_sfx:Stop()
		self.background_sfx = nil
	end

	self:teleport_position(self.get_exit_pos(1), 'down')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
end

--에이미 이동 및 점프 이동
--플레이어 빨간 트리거존 진입시 하단 비강제 이벤트 출력
function local_class:after_amy_move()
	local amy = self.get_amy()
	local amy_jump_pos = self.get_amy_pos(11)
	local amy_move_speed = 4
	local amy_second_move_pos = {
		self.get_amy_pos(12),
		self.get_amy_pos(13),
		self.get_amy_pos(14)
	}

	--이전 코루틴 종료까지 대기
	while self.amy_is_destroying do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.amy_is_moving then
		return
	end

	local jump_move_duration = vector_util.distance(amy_jump_pos, amy.Position)
			/ amy_move_speed

	--에이미가 up, idle, idle상태에서 1번 위치에서 2번 위치까지 jump로 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(amy, 1.5, jump_move_duration)
	wp_util.move_async(amy, amy_jump_pos, nil, jump_move_duration, { run = true })

	if not self.amy_is_moving then
		return
	end

	--이후 up, idle, run(속도9)로 하단 ‘초록색 원’위치까지 달려간다. (하단 이미지 참고)
	wp_util.move_async(amy, amy_second_move_pos, 9, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'up' })

	if not self.amy_is_moving then
		return
	end

	self.amy_is_moving = false
end

function local_class:ending()
	local mermaid = self.get_mermaid()
	local amy = self.get_amy()

	local fall_stone = {
		first = self.get_stone(22),
		second = self.get_stone(24),

		fourth = {
			self.get_stone(26),
			self.get_stone(27),
			self.get_stone(28),
			self.get_stone(29)
		}
	}
	local fall_target_stone = self.get_stone(23)
	local fall_stone_pos = {
		first = {
			self.get_fall_stone_pos(1),
			self.get_fall_stone_pos(2)
		},
		second = {
			self.get_fall_stone_pos(3),
			self.get_fall_stone_pos(4),
			self.get_fall_stone_pos(5)
		},
		third = {
			self.get_fall_stone_pos(6),
			self.get_fall_stone_pos(7),
		},
		fourth = {
			{
				self.get_fall_stone_pos(8),
				self.get_fall_stone_pos(9)
			},
			{
				self.get_fall_stone_pos(10),
				self.get_fall_stone_pos(11)
			},
			{
				self.get_fall_stone_pos(12),
				self.get_fall_stone_pos(13)
			},
			{
				self.get_fall_stone_pos(14),
				self.get_fall_stone_pos(15)
			}
		}
	}
	local stone_1 = self.get_stone(19)
	local stone_2 = self.get_stone(20)
	local stone_3 = self.get_stone(21)

	--에이미 move 이벤트 종료 대기
	while self.amy_is_moving do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--이벤트 시작과 함께 BGM 볼륨 0.5로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--빨간존 진입시
	--인어 해당 장소로 정렬
	wp_util.move_async(mermaid, self.get_mermaid_pos(4), 4)

	--인어 ‘하늘색 원’위치에 up, idle, idle로 정렬
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'up', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	--낙석 세팅
	fall_stone.first.Position = fall_stone_pos.first[1]
	fall_stone.second.Position = fall_stone_pos.second[1]

	--인어(up,idle,idle) 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--인어(left,tired,cast) 1초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(mermaid, self,
			'left',
			'cast',
			'tired',
			1)

	--인어(right,tired,bomb_idle): 분명 이쯤에…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
			'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s8_1_2', skip = true })

	--인어 대사 끝나면 하단 연출 진행
	--화면 shake 0.03 2회 +  화면 좌측에 fx_cp11_rock_landslide_brown_small 이펙트 출력.
	--인어 up, idle, idle, + emoticon_bubble_question
	--이후 ‘하얀색 네모 1번’위치에 [gimmick]rock_1 낙석됨
	local screen_shake_duration = 2

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
	self.get_fx_cp11_rock_landslide_brown_small():Instantiate(fall_stone_pos.first[2])

	camera_util.shake(0.03, screen_shake_duration)

	wait_for_sec(screen_shake_duration)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(mermaid, self,
			'up',
			nil,
			nil,
			'question')

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.3, function(progress)
		local change_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
				fall_stone_pos.first[1], fall_stone_pos.first[2], progress)

		fall_stone.first.Position = change_pos
	end)

	--잔해 낙하하여 바위 파괴하는 순간
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')

	--낙석된 후 바위에 fx_lasthit + 화면 shake 0.1, 0.3초 + fx_object_smokescreen
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(fall_stone.first.Bounds.center)
	self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate((fall_target_stone.Position + fall_stone.first.Bounds.center) / 2)

	fall_target_stone.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	fall_stone.first.Position = vector(fall_stone_pos.first[2].x, 0, fall_stone_pos.first[2].z)

	--잔해 낙하 시 인어 하단 대사 출력하며 동시에 left, surprise, jump하여 우측으로 0.5타일 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'surprise')

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local jump_move_duration = 0.3

			character_util.jump(mermaid, 0.5, jump_move_duration)
			wp_util.move_async(
					mermaid,
					mermaid.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
					nil, jump_move_duration,
					{ locked_dir = 'left' })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--인어(left, surprise, jump1회 후 left, surprise, cast) : 우악!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mermaid, self,
					nil,
					'cast',
					'surprise',
					{ key = 'short_story_mm_main_s8_1_3', skip = true })
		end)
	})

	local twohand_attack_duration = (spine_util.get_animation_duration(
			amy, 'twohand_attack'))
	local stone_shake_mmagnitude = 0.05
	local stone_shake_delay = 0.25

	start_coroutine(function()
		self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration * 0.65)

		field_object_util.shake(stone_1, stone_shake_mmagnitude, stone_shake_delay)
		field_object_util.shake(stone_2, stone_shake_mmagnitude, stone_shake_delay)
		camera_util.shake(0.1, stone_shake_delay)
	end)

	--에이미(up, frenzy_idle, twohand_attack) 에이미 앞에 두바위 에이미 모션에 맞춰 0.25초 씩 shake0.05 화면 shake 0.1 0.5초
	scene_util.set_direction(amy, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(amy, self, 'frenzy_idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(amy, self, { name = 'twohand_attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_twohand_slash_02' })

	--동시에 인어 (left,surprise,cliff) jump 1회와 동시에 (left) 0.5칸 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(mermaid, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(mermaid, self, 'cliff')
	character_util.normal_jump(mermaid)

	self:custom_wait_for_sec(stone_shake_delay)

	--화면 shake 끝나면 인어 (up,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(mermaid, 'up')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mermaid)

	--동시에 카메라 에이미에게 이동
	camera_util.move_async(amy.Position, 0.5)

	--에이미에게 카메라 도착시
	--에이미(up,frenzy_idle,twohand_attack(loop))[shout]: 이 빌어먹을 짓거리를 언제까지 해야 해!!!
	scene_util.set_emotion(amy, self, 'frenzy_idle')

	character_util.hide_weapon(amy, false)

	local stone_shake_loop_magnitude = 0.03
	local camera_shake_magnitude = 0.1
	local camera_shake_loop_delay = 0.3

	local twohand_attack_loop_exit = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		while not twohand_attack_loop_exit do
			self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration * 0.65)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_monster_01')

			--휘두를때 마다 앞에 두 오브젝트 shake 0.03 /0.5초 화면 shake 0.1 / 0.5초
			field_object_util.shake(stone_1, stone_shake_loop_magnitude, 0.5)
			field_object_util.shake(stone_2, stone_shake_loop_magnitude, 0.5)

			camera_util.shake(camera_shake_magnitude, 0.5)

			self:custom_wait_for_sec(twohand_attack_duration * 0.35)
		end
	end)

	scene_util.set_anim(amy, self, { name = 'twohand_attack', sfx_name = '02_twohand_slash_02' })

	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(amy, 'short_story_mm_main_s8_2')

	twohand_attack_loop_exit = true

	--에이미(up,frenzy_idle,twohand_attack3)[shout]: 크아아!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(amy, {
		key = 'short_story_mm_main_s8_3',
		skip = false,
		bubble_type = 'shout'
	})

	field_object_util.stop_shake(stone_1)
	field_object_util.stop_shake(stone_2)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	--해당 모션 1회만 재생 모션 끝과 동시에 화면 shake 0.1 0.3초 + 에이미앞의 바위 FX_slime_buttbounce 이펙트 + fx_lasthit와 함께 사라짐
	camera_util.shake(0.1, camera_shake_loop_delay)

	scene_util.set_anim(amy, self, { name = 'twohand_attack3', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_01' })

	local animation_end_duration = 0.35

	wait_for_sec(animation_end_duration)

	--에이미 앞의 바위 2개 격파
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')

	--바위 사라짐과 동시에 화면 중앙에 fx_cp11_rock_landslide_brown_small 이펙트 출력
	self.get_fx_cp11_rock_landslide_brown_small():Instantiate(amy.Position)

	self.get_fx_slime_buttbounce():Instantiate(stone_1.Bounds.center)
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(stone_1.Bounds.center)

	self.get_fx_slime_buttbounce():Instantiate(stone_2.Bounds.center)
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(stone_2.Bounds.center)

	stone_1.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	stone_2.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--에이미 2번 위치로 이동 후 (right,frenzy_idle,twohand_attack): 그 망할 가게…
	local amy_wapoints_1 = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(amy,
			self.get_amy_pos(15), { z = amy.Position.z - 0.5 })

	wp_util.move_async(amy, amy_wapoints_1, 4, 0)

function local_class:custom_wait_for_sec(duration, condition)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time

	while not self.controller.stage_ended and
			unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()

function local_class:enter()
	self:set()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_exit_cave

	-- 하나 서브 이벤트 비활성화
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExclusiveQuestStartEvent.Create('main_s9_start', false))

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.get_cave_exit() }
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	if self.surfer_sohee_machine_item.instance ~= nil then
		self.surfer_sohee_machine_item.instance:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.surfer_sohee_machine_item.instance = nil

	self.dynamic_npc:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.dynamic_npc:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

	return false

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_exit_cave and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_cave_exit_interactable()) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.exited_cave

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		self.get_cave_exit().ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		self.get_cave_exit_interactable().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.exit_cave_scene, self):Then(function()
			-- 끝나면 자동으로 넘어가도록 함.
			-- 연출 구문과 프로그래싱을 분리하기 위해 이렇게 세팅
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_enter_fight

			local marker_pos = (self.get_surfer_sohee().Position + self.get_swindler().Position) / 2

			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
				{ zone = 'main_field', target = marker_pos }
			})
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
