function local_class:init()
	---@type table<string, ShortStoryMilkyWayEventGroup>
	self.event_groups = {}

	self.main_quest_id = 7001801
end

function local_class:initialize()
	local _, npc_pooling_system = global_table_util.try_create_npc_pooling_system()

	local init_event_groups = function(constants)
		for group_name, group_constants in pairs(constants) do
			local creator = event_groups[group_name] or event_group_base

			self.event_groups[group_name] = creator(npc_pooling_system, group_constants)
		end
	end

	local constants = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/ShortStory/MilkyWay/Common/EventGroupConstant')
	local librarian_constants = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/ShortStory/MilkyWay/Common/LibrarianEventConstants')

	npc_pooling_system:init_pools(constants.pools)

	init_event_groups(constants.groups)
	init_event_groups(librarian_constants)

	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

	local progress = -1
	local cleared = false

	if main_quest ~= nil then
		progress = main_quest.InnerProgress
		cleared = main_quest.IsComplete
	end

	for group_name, group in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		local is_valid = group:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)

		if is_valid then
			self:activate_group(group_name)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	for group_name, group in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		self:deactivate_group(group_name)

		group:dispose()

		self.event_groups[group_name] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId ~= self.main_quest_id then
		return false
	end

	return self:on_quest_condition_changed()
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId ~= self.main_quest_id then
		return false
	end

	return self:on_quest_condition_changed()
end

function local_class:on_quest_condition_changed(overriden_progress, overriden_cleared)
	local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

	local progress = -1
	local cleared = false

	if main_quest ~= nil then
		progress = main_quest.InnerProgress
		cleared = main_quest.IsComplete
	end

	if overriden_progress ~= nil then
		progress = overriden_progress
	end

	if overriden_cleared ~= nil then
		cleared = overriden_cleared
	end

	local groups_to_init = {}
	local groups_to_dispose = {}

	for group_name, group in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		local is_activated = group.activated
		local is_valid = group:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)

		if not is_activated and is_valid then
			groups_to_init[#groups_to_init + 1] = group_name
		elseif is_activated and not is_valid then
			groups_to_dispose[#groups_to_dispose + 1] = group_name
		end
	end

	for _, group_name in ipairs(groups_to_dispose) do
		self:deactivate_group(group_name)
	end

	for _, group_name in ipairs(groups_to_init) do
		self:activate_group(group_name)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:activate_group(group_name)
	local group = self.event_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil or group.activated then
		return
	end

	group.activated = true
	group:enter()

	--logger_util.log(string.format('[EventGroupManger] Group [Name : %s] activated.', group_name))
end

function local_class:deactivate_group(group_name)
	local group = self.event_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil or not group.activated then
		return
	end

	group:exit()
	group.activated = false

	--logger_util.log(string.format('[EventGroupManger] Group [Name : %s] deactivated.', group_name))
end

---@return ShortStoryMilkyWayEventGroup
function local_class:get_group(group_name)
	local group = self.event_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil then
		return
	end

	if group == nil and not group.activated then
		return
	end

	return group
end

local cleared_value = 'clear'

do
	function event_group_base:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		---@type LuaNpcPoolingSystem
		self.npc_pooling_system = npc_pooling_system

		---@type table<string, LuaNpcPoolHandler>
		self.pooled_npc_handlers = {}

		self.activated = false

		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		if constants ~= nil then
			self.condition_data = constants.condition
			self.member_infos = constants.members
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:dispose()
		self.npc_pooling_system = nil
		self.condition_data = nil
		self.member_infos = nil
	end

	function event_group_base:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)
		if self.condition_data == nil then
			return false
		end

		for i = 1, #self.condition_data.progress_infos do
			local info = self.condition_data.progress_infos[i]

			if info.from == cleared_value then
				if cleared then
					return true
				end
			elseif info.to == cleared_value then
				if info.from <= progress or cleared then
					return true
				end
			elseif info.from <= progress and progress <= info.to and not cleared then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	---@return LuaNpcPoolHandler
	function event_group_base:get_handler(name)
		return self.pooled_npc_handlers[name]
	end

	function event_group_base:wait_for_sec(duration)
		local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration

		while self.activated and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:enter()
		if self.member_infos ~= nil then
			for npc_name, npc_info in pairs(self.member_infos) do
				local position = get_position(npc_info.position)
				local handler = self.npc_pooling_system:get_npc_handler(npc_info.key, position, npc_info.direction)

				if npc_info.anim ~= nil then
					handler:set_anim(self, npc_info.anim)
				end

				if npc_info.emotion ~= nil then
					handler:set_emotion(self, npc_info.emotion)
				end

				if npc_info.talk ~= nil then
					if type_util.is_table(npc_info.talk) then
						handler:set_one_line(npc_info.talk.key, npc_info.talk.sfx)
					else
						handler:set_one_line(npc_info.talk)
					end
				end

				self.pooled_npc_handlers[npc_name] = handler
			end
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:exit()
		for npc_name, handler in pairs(self.pooled_npc_handlers) do
			handler:dispose()

			self.pooled_npc_handlers[npc_name] = nil
		end
	end

	---@param action fun(name:string, handler:LuaNpcPoolHandler, npc:ICharacter)
	function event_group_base:foreach(action)
		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		for name, handler in pairs(self.pooled_npc_handlers) do
			action(name, handler, handler:get_npc())
		end
	end

	---@param handler LuaNpcPoolHandler
	function event_group_base:show_stoppable_speech_async(handler, key, data)
		local talker = handler:get_npc()

		if talker == nil then
			return
		end

		if data == nil then
			data = {}
		end

		data.key = key

		handler:add_dispose_action('speech', dispose_actions.speech)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, data)

		if self.activated then
			handler:add_dispose_action('speech', nil)
		end
	end
end

		self.zone_name = 'event_square_seller'

		self.in_zone = false
		self.in_routine = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.in_zone and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.in_zone = true

			if not self.in_routine then
				self.in_routine = true

				start_coroutine(self.talk_routine, self)
			end

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_zone_leave_event(e)
		if self.in_zone and not e.FullLeave and e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
			self.in_zone = false
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:talk_routine()
		local handler = self:get_handler('seller')

		--존 엔터하면 컨트롤 뺏지 않고 이벤트 진행. 모든 대사는 스킵 불가능으로 처리.
		while self.in_zone do
			--(남)1번(shortstory_mw_summer_seller)(down, smile, clap) : 자, 자! 맛있는 닭꼬치와 오징어 구이가 있습니다!
			handler:set_anim(self, 'clap')
			self:show_stoppable_speech_async(handler, 'ss_milkyway_event_square_seller')

			if not self.activated then
				break
			end

			--대사 끝나면 애니 해제, 표정 유지.
			handler:remove_anim()

			--플레이어가 존을 떠나지 않은 상태 + 위 대사 끝난 지 3초 지난 상태면 대사 재출력.
			self:wait_for_sec(3)

			if not self.activated then
				break
			end
		end

		self.in_routine = false
	end
end

do
	local event = firework_block

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.zone_name = constants.blocking_zone_name
		self.fo_infos = constants.fo_infos

		self.in_blocking_routine = false
	end

	function event:dispose()
		self.fo_infos = nil

		self.super:dispose()
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		for fo_name, info in pairs(self.fo_infos) do
			local fo = get_field_object(fo_name)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.visible)

			self:set_fo(fo, get_position(info.position))
		end

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		for fo_name, _ in pairs(self.fo_infos) do
			local fo = get_field_object(fo_name)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		self.in_blocking_routine = false

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.in_blocking_routine and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.in_blocking_routine = true

			--존 엔터 하면 컨트롤 뺏고 이벤트 진행.
			sp_util.start_scene(self.blocking_scene, self):Then(function()
				self.in_blocking_routine = false
			end)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:set_fo(fo, center_pivot)
		local fo_center_pivot = field_object_util.get_center_pivot(fo)
		local offset = fo_center_pivot - fo.Position

		fo.Position = center_pivot - offset
	end

	function event:blocking_scene()
		local handler = self:get_handler('lifeguard')
		local lifeguard = handler:get_npc()
		local leader = get_party_leader()

		--플레이어 5번 npc 바라본다.
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, {
			look_target = lifeguard,
		})

		--5번(플레이어 바라보고, attack, release) : 안전을 위해 관계자 외의 출입은 금지되어 있습니다. 물러나주세요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lifeguard, self, {
			look_target = leader,
			lock = true,
		}, 'release', 'attack', 'ss_milkyway_event_firework_block')

		--플레이어 아래로 1칸 걸어서 내려간다.
		do
			local target_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(self.zone_name, leader, 'down')

			wp_util.move_async(leader, target_pos, 2)
		end

		--5번 down, idle, idle로 전환.
		character_util.reset_locked_dir(lifeguard)
	end
end

		if self.writing_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.writing_sfx)
			self.writing_sfx = nil
		end
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.triggered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.triggered = true

			start_coroutine(self.talk_routine, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:talk_routine()
		local librarian_handler = self:get_handler('librarian')
		local librarian_sub_1_handler = self:get_handler('librarian_sub_1')
		local librarian_sub_2_handler = self:get_handler('librarian_sub_2')

		self.writing_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_writing_loop_01',
			loop = true,
			play_pos = librarian_handler:get_npc().Position,
			min_distance = 3,
			max_distance = 5,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.loop,
			-- 알아서 적당히 끊기도록 함
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.default,
		})

		--8 ~ 10번(1일차 낮 / 중앙 광장)
		--존 엔터 시 하단의 대사 순서대로 실행.
		--(여)10번(shortstory_mw_lahn)(left, idle, idle) : 기록실 서기의 의무에 따라 란은 이곳에 돌아오게 되었다.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_1')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--(여)10번(left, idle, idle) : 란은 이제부터 어떤 것들을 기록해야 함을 묻는다.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_2')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--(여)8번(shortstory_mw_summer_librarian_sub)(right, idle, idle) : 이번 별무리제의 새로운 서기장이 임명됨을 전한다.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_sub_1_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_3')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--(여)9번(shortstory_mw_summer_librarian_sub)(right, idle, idle) : 모든 서기는 이 과정의 모든 순간을 기록.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_sub_2_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_4')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--(여)8번(shortstory_mw_summer_librarian_sub)(right, idle, idle) : 별무리제의 모든 기록을 남겨두는 것이 목적이다.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_sub_1_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_5')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--(여)10번(shortstory_mw_lahn)(left, idle, librarian/writing) : 란은 서기의 목적에 따라 기록을  진행하게 되었다.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_6')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.writing_sfx, 0.5)
		self.writing_sfx = nil

		--이후 원라인 캐릭터 3종 모두 자신의 마지막 상태로 원라인 배치.
		librarian_handler:set_one_line('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_6')
		librarian_sub_1_handler:set_one_line('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_5')
		librarian_sub_2_handler:set_one_line('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_1_day_4')
	end
end

do
	function librarian_normal:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.zone_name = constants.target_zone
		self.talk_infos = constants.talk_infos
		self.triggered = false

		self.trigger_enabled = lua_helper.get_value(constants, 'trigger_enabled_first', true)
	end

	function librarian_normal:dispose()
		self.talk_infos = nil

		self.super:dispose()
	end

	function librarian_normal:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function librarian_normal:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function librarian_normal:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if self.trigger_enabled and not self.triggered and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.triggered = true

			start_coroutine(self.talk_routine, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function librarian_normal:enable_trigger()
		self.trigger_enabled = true
	end

	function librarian_normal:talk_routine()
		local librarian_handler = self:get_handler('librarian')

		local writing_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_writing_loop_01',
			loop = true,
			play_pos = librarian_handler:get_npc().Position,
			min_distance = 3,
			max_distance = 5,
			type_priority = sfx_type_priority.loop,
			-- 알아서 적당히 끊기도록 함
			player_priority = sfx_player_priority.default,
		})

		for i = 1, #self.talk_infos do
			local info = self.talk_infos[i]
			local key

			if type_util.is_string(info) then
				key = info
			else
				key = info.key

				librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, info.emotion)
			end

			self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, key)

			if not self.activated then
				music_player_util.stop_sfx(writing_sfx)

				return
			end

			librarian_handler:remove_emotion()
		end

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(writing_sfx, 1)

		local last_info = self.talk_infos[#self.talk_infos]
		local key

		if type_util.is_string(last_info) then
			key = last_info
		else
			key = last_info.key
		end

		librarian_handler:set_one_line(key)
	end
end

do
	local event = event_groups.librarian_day_4_day

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.zone_name = 'event_librarian_day_4_day'
		self.triggered = false

		self.get_ipad_fo = function()
			return get_field_object('event_librarian_ipad')
		end

		self.get_box_fo = function(index)
			return get_field_object('event_librarian_box_' .. index)
		end

		self.get_fx_smokescreen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')
		end

		self.get_fx_smokescreen()
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		dispose_actions.speech(self.get_ipad_fo())

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.triggered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.triggered = true

			start_coroutine(self.talk_routine, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:ipad_talk_async(key)
		local fo = self.get_ipad_fo()

		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fo, key, false)
	end

	function event:talk_routine()
		local librarian_handler = self:get_handler('librarian')
		local librarian = librarian_handler:get_npc()

		--존 엔터하면 컨트롤 뺏지 않고 이벤트 진행. 란의 대사는 모두 스킵 불가능으로.
		--아이패드 : 하하! 이 루피나님의 화려한 장면들이 확실하게 보았느냐?
		self:ipad_talk_async('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_1')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--란 (left, smile, librarian/writing) : 음성으로 전달받은 기록임에도, 얼음 마녀의 격한 대사와 효과음은 이전과 변함이 없음을 기록.
		if self:is_player_in_same_grid() then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_writing_01',
				play_pos = librarian.Position,
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.event,
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.npc,
			})
		end

		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_2')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--란 (left, tired, librarian/writing) : 하지만 멀리 있어… 정확한 시점과 상황 기록 불가.
		librarian_handler:remove_emotion()
		librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, 'tired')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_3')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--상단 아이패드 대사와 함께 란 smile 변경 후 유지.
		librarian_handler:remove_emotion()
		librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')

		--아이패드 : 조아려라! 괄목하라! 내게 눈을 보이지 마라! 아하하하하!!
		if self:is_player_in_same_grid() then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_broadcast_01',
				play_pos = self.get_ipad_fo().Position,
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.event,
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.npc,
			})
		end

		self:ipad_talk_async('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_4')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--란 (left, smile, librarian/writing) : 강렬한 대사와 험악한 언행들…!
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_5')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--란 (left, sleep_deep, librarian/writing) : 허나… 명확한 파악이 불가…
		librarian_handler:remove_emotion()
		librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, 'sleep_deep')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_6')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--상단 아이패드 대사와 함께 란 attack 변경 후 유지.
		librarian_handler:remove_emotion()
		librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, 'attack')

		--아이패드 : 쳇! 귀찮구만… 이걸 나 혼자 일일히 해야 하다니…
		self:ipad_talk_async('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_7')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--상단 대사와 함께 란 up, idle, jump 실행.
		librarian_handler:remove_anim()
		character_util.set_direction(librarian, direction_constants.up)
		character_util.normal_jump(librarian)

		--아이패드 : 그 서기 놈은 언제 오는 것이냐! 내 화려함이 하루하루 낭비되는 게 불쾌하구나!
		self:ipad_talk_async('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_8')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--란(left, attack, librarian/writing) : 얼음 마녀의 방송 중 서기를 찾는 말을 확인.
		character_util.set_direction(librarian, direction_constants.left)
		librarian_handler:set_anim(self, 'librarian/writing')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_9')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 란(left, attack, librarian/writing) : 이후의 대사는 명확한 확인이 필요하다 판단!
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_10')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 란 up, idle, boong_attack_ready를 0.5초간 실행.
		character_util.set_direction(librarian, direction_constants.up)
		librarian_handler:set_anim(self, 'boong_attack_ready')
		self.super:wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 이후 up, idle, boong_attack을 실행하고, 실행 완료 타이밍에 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 실행하고, 가려진 타이밍에 wall_in_box2 제거.
		librarian_handler:set_anim(self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false })
		self.super:wait_for_sec(0.3)

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		librarian_handler:remove_anim()

		if self:is_player_in_same_grid() then
			local play_pos = (self.get_box_fo(1).Position + self.get_box_fo(2).Position) / 2

			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '02_energy_fist_01',
				play_pos = play_pos,
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.event,
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object,
			})

			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '02_explosion_01',
				play_pos = play_pos,
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.event,
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object,
			})
		end

		self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate(librarian.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 1))
		self.super:wait_for_sec(0.1)

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, 2 do
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.get_box_fo(i), active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		self.super:wait_for_sec(2)

		-- 이펙트 종료 후 란 up, idle, run(7)로 지정 위치까지 이동 후 left, smile, librarian/writing 실행.
		local move_librarian = function(target_pos)
			local is_moving = true

			field_object_util.set_active_state(librarian, active_state_type.visible)

			librarian_handler:add_dispose_action('move_waypoint', function(npc)
				is_moving = false

				character_util.stop(npc)
			end)

			wp_util.move(librarian, target_pos, 7, nil, {
				run = true,
				end_callback = function()
					is_moving = false

					field_object_util.set_active_state(librarian, active_state_type.enabled)
				end,
				play_sfx = self:is_player_in_same_grid(),
			})

			while is_moving do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			librarian_handler:add_dispose_action('move_waypoint', nil)
		end

		move_librarian(librarian.Position + vector(0, 0, 3))

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		character_util.set_direction(librarian, direction_constants.left)
		librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')
		librarian_handler:set_anim(self, 'librarian/writing')

		-- 아이패드 : 쳇, 그 별무리제인지 뭔지가 뭐가 중요하다는 것이냐!
		self:ipad_talk_async('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_11')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 대사와 함께 란 attak 표정으로 변경.
		librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, 'attack')

		-- 아이패드 : 이 루피나님의 아름다움보다 중요한 것이 무엇이 있다고! 불경한 것!
		self:ipad_talk_async('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_12')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 대사와 함께 란 0.02만큼 shake 상태 지속.
		scene_util.shake(librarian, 0.02, 99999, false)

		-- 란(left, sleep_deep, librarian/writing[정지]) : ……기록실의 서기로서 별무리제의 기록을 남기는 것은 란의 의무.
		librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, 'sleep_deep')
		librarian_handler:set_anim(self, { name = 'librarian/writing', scale = 0 })
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_13')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 란(left, sleep_deep, librarian/writing[정지]) : 하지만… 처음으로 기록의 우선 순위의 혼동을…
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_14')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 란 left, attack, librarian/writing[정지] 와 함께 shake 지속 제거.
		librarian_handler:set_emotion(self, 'attack')
		character_util.stop_shake(librarian)

		-- 아이패드 : 실증이 나는구나! 오늘 방송은 끝이다!
		self:ipad_talk_async('ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_15')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		if self:is_player_in_same_grid() then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01',
				play_pos = librarian.Position,
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.event,
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.npc,
			})
		end

		-- 란(left, attack, jump 1회) : 불허! 란은 얼음 마녀의 기록이 이어지지 않을 것이라 판단!
		librarian_handler:remove_anim()
		character_util.normal_jump(librarian)
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_16')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 란(down, attack, idle) : 다음 기록을 위해 얼음 마녀에게 복귀!
		character_util.set_direction(librarian, direction_constants.down)
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(librarian_handler, 'ss_milkyway_librarian_day_4_day_17')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 이후 란 down, attack, run(7)의 속도로 D의 통로로 내려간 뒤 사라짐.
		move_librarian(librarian.Position + vector(0, 0, -6))

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(librarian, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	function event:is_player_in_same_grid()
		return field:IsInSameCameraGrid(self.get_ipad_fo().Position, get_party_leader().Position)
	end
end

		end

		self.idol_captain_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_concert_hall_idol_captain_pos')
		end

		--npc
		self.idol_captain = function()
			return get_character('idol_captain')
		end

		self.civilian_kid_boy = function()
			return get_character('civilian_kid_boy')
		end

		self.back_dancer = function(number)
			return self:get_handler('s9_back_dancer_' .. number):get_npc()
		end

		self.concert_hall_group = nil
		self.npc_count = 16
		self.name_pre_pix = 's9_concert_'
		self.zone_name = 's9_concert_hall_zone'
		self.triggered = false
		self.check_bgm = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		local idol_captain = self.idol_captain()

		field_object_util.set_active_state(idol_captain, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(idol_captain, self.idol_captain_pos())
		character_util.set_direction(idol_captain, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(idol_captain, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(idol_captain, self, 'sing')

		self.concert_hall_group = {}

		for i = 1, self.npc_count do
			local handler = self:get_handler(self.name_pre_pix .. i)
			local npc = handler:get_npc()

			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, '[base]weapon1', 'onehandsword_cheering_stick')
			table.insert(self.concert_hall_group, npc)
		end

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

		local back_dancers = { self.back_dancer(1), self.back_dancer(2), self.back_dancer(3) }

		character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(back_dancers)

		local idol_captain = self.idol_captain()

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(idol_captain)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(idol_captain, active_state_type.disabled)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(idol_captain)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.civilian_kid_boy())

		for i = 1, #self.concert_hall_group do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.concert_hall_group[i])
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(self.concert_hall_group[i], '[base]weapon1', 'empty')
		end

		self.concert_hall_group = nil

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			if self.check_bgm then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_milkyway/audio:bgm_milkyway_store', state = 'event' })
			else
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			end

			if not self.triggered then
				self.triggered = true

				start_coroutine(self.concert_routine, self)
			end

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_zone_leave_event(e)
		if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:concert_routine()
		local idol_captain = self.idol_captain()
		local back_dancers = { self.back_dancer(1), self.back_dancer(2), self.back_dancer(3) }
		local npc_group = self.concert_hall_group

		local speech_npc = {
			self.concert_hall_group[1],
			self.concert_hall_group[2],
			self.concert_hall_group[3],
			self.concert_hall_group[4]
		}

		local col_line_1 = { npc_group[1], npc_group[2], npc_group[3], npc_group[4] }
		local col_line_2 = { npc_group[5], npc_group[6], npc_group[7], npc_group[8] }
		local col_line_3 = { npc_group[9], npc_group[10], npc_group[11], npc_group[12] }
		local col_line_4 = { npc_group[13], npc_group[14], npc_group[15], npc_group[16] }

		local row_line_1 = { npc_group[1], npc_group[5], npc_group[9], npc_group[13] }
		local row_line_2 = { npc_group[2], npc_group[6], npc_group[10], npc_group[14] }
		local row_line_3 = { npc_group[3], npc_group[7], npc_group[11], npc_group[15] }

			return

		dance_func(col_line_4, 'left', 'sword_attack', 'ss_milkyway_main_s9_4_1',

		--상인 1~4 동시에 (left, smile, sword_attack)
		--위와 동시에 1번 ●지점, 4번 ●지점에 내용이 같은[shout] 말풍선 출력

end

do
	local event = event_groups.day_1_daylight_around_kids

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.grid_name = 'daylight_accommodation_grid'
		self.kid_count = 2

		self.around_pos_list = nil
		self.speed = 3

		self.kid_data = nil

		self.move_state = {
			run = 1,
			search_next_pos = 2
		}

		self.request_id = 1
		self.max_request_id = 10

		self.speech_bubble_delay = 3
		self.cur_speech_bubble_delay = 0
		self.is_talk_kid_girl = false

		self.is_around = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		self.around_pos_list = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('day_1_festive_pos_3_1'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('day_1_festive_pos_3_2'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('day_1_festive_pos_3_3'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('day_1_festive_pos_3_4'),
		}

		self.kid_data = {}

		for i = 1, self.kid_count do
			local kid = self:get_handler('around_kid_' .. i):get_npc()
			kid.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

			local data = {
				kid = kid,
				target_index = 1,
				time_passed = 0,
				duration = 0,
				start_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero,
				end_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero,
				cur_move_state = self.move_state.search_next_pos,
				speed = 3
			}

			table.insert(self.kid_data, data)
		end

		self.run_sfx = nil

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent), 'on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent))

		self:stop_run_sfx()
		self.is_around = false
		self.around_pos_list = nil

		for i = 1, #self.kid_data do
			local kid = self.kid_data[i].kid

			local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(kid)
			if bubble ~= nil then
				bubble:ResetBubble()
			end

			kid.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		end

		self.kid_data = nil

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event(e)
		if e.CameraGrid == nil then
			self.is_around = false
			return false
		end

		if e.CameraGrid.name == self.grid_name then
			start_coroutine(self.around_routine, self)
			return true
		end

		self.is_around = false
		return false
	end

	function event:around_routine()
		self:set_request_id()
		local rq_id = self.request_id

		-- 다음 위치 선정 함수
		local function set_next_around_data(kid_data, start_pos)
			kid_data.start_pos = start_pos
			kid_data.end_pos = self.around_pos_list[kid_data.target_index]
			kid_data.duration = vector_util.get_x0z(kid_data.end_pos - kid_data.start_pos).magnitude / kid_data.speed

			local dir = vector_util.to_direction(kid_data.end_pos - kid_data.start_pos)
			scene_util.set_direction(kid_data.kid, dir, false)

			kid_data.time_passed = 0
			kid_data.cur_move_state = self.move_state.run
		end

		-- 이동할 위치 세팅
		for i = 1, #self.kid_data do
			set_next_around_data(self.kid_data[i], self.kid_data[i].kid.Position)
		end

		self:play_run_sfx()

		-- 스피치 버블 return
		self.is_around = true
		while self.is_around and self.activated and rq_id == self.request_id do
			do
				local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

				-- 3초 마다 출력되는 스피치 버블
				self.cur_speech_bubble_delay = self.cur_speech_bubble_delay + dt

				if self.cur_speech_bubble_delay >= self.speech_bubble_delay then
					local before_talker = self.is_talk_kid_girl and self.kid_data[1].kid or self.kid_data[2].kid
					local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(before_talker)
					if bubble ~= nil then
						bubble:ResetBubble()
					end

					local talker = self.is_talk_kid_girl and self.kid_data[2].kid or self.kid_data[1].kid
					local bubble_key = self.is_talk_kid_girl and 'ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_4_2' or
							'ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_4_1'

					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(talker, { key = bubble_key })

					self.is_talk_kid_girl = self.is_talk_kid_girl == false
					self.cur_speech_bubble_delay = 0
				end
			end

			-- 꼬마들 이동 함수
			do
				local dt = unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime

				for i = 1, #self.kid_data do
					local data = self.kid_data[i]
					data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt

					if data.cur_move_state == self.move_state.search_next_pos then
						local before_index = data.target_index
						data.target_index = data.target_index + 1

						if data.target_index > #self.around_pos_list then
							data.target_index = 1
						end

						set_next_around_data(data, self.around_pos_list[before_index])
					else
						local progress = math.min(data.time_passed / data.duration)
						data.kid.Position = vector_util.lerp(data.start_pos, data.end_pos, progress)

						if data.time_passed >= data.duration then
							data.cur_move_state = self.move_state.search_next_pos
						end
					end
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self:stop_run_sfx()
	end

	function event:play_run_sfx()
		if self.kid_data == nil then
			return
		end

		self:stop_run_sfx()
		self.run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = self.kid_data[1].kid, loop = true })
	end

	function event:stop_run_sfx()
		if self.run_sfx == nil then
			return
		end

		self.run_sfx:Stop()
	end

	function event:set_request_id()
		self.request_id = self.request_id + 1
		if self.request_id >= self.max_request_id then
			self.request_id = 1
		end
	end
end

do
	local event = event_groups.day_1_daylight_search_central_square

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.zone_name = 'day_1_daylight_event_2'
		self.triggered = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		self:get_handler('search_npc_1'):get_npc().OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.triggered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.triggered = true
			start_coroutine(self.talk_routine, self)
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:talk_routine()
		local male_handler = self:get_handler('search_npc_1')
		local lifeguard_handler = self:get_handler('search_npc_2')

		-- (남)1번(shortstory_mw_summer_male)(right, tired, cast) : 혹시 수상 광장이라는 곳은 어떻게 가는 지 아시나요?
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(male_handler, 'ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_2_1')

		male_handler:remove_emotion()
		male_handler:remove_anim()

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- (여)2번(shortstory_mw_summer_lifeguard_female)(left, smile, release 3회) : 저쪽으로 쭉 직진하시고…
		lifeguard_handler:set_anim(self, { name = 'release', count = 3 })
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(lifeguard_handler, 'ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_2_2')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- (여)2번(up, release 3회)오른쪽으로 꺾으시면 됩니다!
		lifeguard_handler:remove_anim()
		lifeguard_handler:set_anim(self, { name = 'release', count = 3 })
		scene_util.set_direction(lifeguard_handler:get_npc(), 'up', false)
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(lifeguard_handler, 'ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_2_3')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- (여)2번(left, smile, bomb_idle) : 즐거운 별무리제 되세요!
		scene_util.set_direction(lifeguard_handler:get_npc(), 'left', false)
		lifeguard_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')
		lifeguard_handler:set_anim(self, 'bomb_idle')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(lifeguard_handler, 'ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_2_4')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 2번 npc는 이후, 마지막 대사/표정 그대로 원라인으로 남는다.
		lifeguard_handler:set_one_line('ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_2_4')

		-- 1번 npc는 이후, 충돌처리 없는 상태로 속도 2로 왼쪽으로 쭉 걸어, 그리드 너머까지 이동한다.
		local male = male_handler:get_npc()
		local start_pos = male.Position
		local target_pos = start_pos - vector(15.5, 0, 0)
		male.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		local function walk_routine()
			local time_passed = 0

			local speed = 3
			local duration = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed

			local dir = vector_util.to_direction(target_pos - start_pos)
			scene_util.set_direction(male, dir, false)

			male_handler:set_anim(self, 'walk')

			while time_passed < duration do
				if not self.activated then
					return
				end

				local progress = math.min(time_passed / duration, 1)
				male.Position = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			male_handler:remove_emotion()
		end

		walk_routine()

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- (남)1번(left, tired, question 1회) : 여기서 오른쪽이랬지…?
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = male_handler:get_npc().Position, loop = false })
		male_handler:set_emotion(self, 'tired')
		male_handler:set_anim(self, 'question')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(male_handler, 'ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_2_5')

		-- 0.5초 대기.
		self.super:wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 1번 충돌처리 없는 상태로 속도 2로 걸어 위쪽 그리드 너머로 이동한다.
		male_handler:remove_emotion()
		start_pos = male.Position
		target_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 12.5)
		walk_routine()

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		start_pos = male.Position
		target_pos = start_pos - vector(7, 0, 0)
		walk_routine()

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		male.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

		-- 1번 right, smile, idle 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', play_pos = male_handler:get_npc().Position, loop = false })
		male_handler:remove_anim()
		male_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_direction(male, 'right', false)
		self.super:wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 1번 left, smile, idle 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', play_pos = male_handler:get_npc().Position, loop = false })
		scene_util.set_direction(male, 'left', false)
		self.super:wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 1번(up, idle, idle) : 여기가 별무리섬의 수상 광장이구나!
		scene_util.set_direction(male, 'up', false)
		male_handler:remove_emotion()
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(male_handler, 'ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_2_6')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		male_handler:set_one_line('ss_milkyway_day_1_daylight_event_2_6')
	end
end

do
	local event = event_groups.s4_make_couple

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.zone_name = 's4_oneline_house_event_zone'
		self.move_end_zone_name = 's4_oneline_concert_event_zone'

		self.is_first = true
		self.is_move_scene_first = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if self.is_first and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.is_first = false

			start_coroutine(self.talk_routine, self)

			return true
		elseif self.is_move_scene_first and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.move_end_zone_name) then
			self.is_move_scene_first = false

			start_coroutine(self.talk_routine_move_end, self)
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:talk_routine()
		local female_handler = self:get_handler('female')
		local male_handler = self:get_handler('male')

		local male = male_handler:get_npc()
		local female = female_handler:get_npc()

		female_handler:remove_anim()
		male_handler:remove_anim()

		--존 엔터하면 컨트롤 뺏지 않은 채로 이벤트 진행,
		--(남)1번 (shortstory_mw_summer_male)(right, tired, cast) : 혹시 공연장이 어디인지 아시는지…
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(male_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11_1')

		--(여)2번 (shortstory_mw_summer_lifeguard_female)(left, smile, idle) : 어! 오늘 아침에도 길 알려드리지 않았나요?
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(female_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11_2')

		--(남)1번 (right, tired, cast) : 아, 맞죠… 제가 워낙 길치라서 어디가 어디인지…
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(male_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11_3')

		--(여)2번 (left, smile, idle) : 후후, 알려드릴게요. 저 따라오시겠어요?
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(female_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11_4')

		--(남)1번 (right, smile, idle) : 아, 네! 감사합니다!
		male_handler:remove_anim()
		male_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(male_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11_5')

		--1, 2번 npc는 이후, 2번 NPC가 선두가 되어 충돌처리 없는 상태로 속도 2로 왼쪽으로 쭉 걸어, 그리드 너머까지 이동한다.
		do
			local move_key = 'couple_move'
			local move_pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_field_online_house_npc_pos_1_1')
			local offset = vector(0, 0, 1)

			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(male, move_pivot_pos, true)
			local waypoints_girl = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(female, move_pivot_pos + offset, true)

			male.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			female.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(male, waypoints, 4, nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(female, waypoints_girl, 4, nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

			male.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
			female.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			self.is_move_scene_first = true
		end
	end

	function event:talk_routine_move_end()
		local female_handler = self:get_handler('female')
		local male_handler = self:get_handler('male')

		--이후 지정된 지점에 멈춰서면 존 생성되고, 플레이어 존 입장 시 아래의 대사 실행.
		--(여)2번 (left, smile, idle) : 이 왼쪽이에요. 혹시 세실 공연 보러 오신 건가요?
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(female_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11_6')

		--(남)1번 (left, blush, idle) : 아 네… 애들도 아니고, 참 부끄럽네요…
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(male_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11_7')

		--(여)2번 (left, smile, idle) : 뭘요. 저도 세실 진짜 좋아해요! 직접 보는 건 저도 처음이라구요!
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(female_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_12')

		--(남)1번 (left, blush, idle) : 그, 그런가요…! 다행이네요…
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(male_handler, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11')

		--이후 1, 2번 NPC 마지막 대사 상태로 원라인 전환.
		male_handler:set_one_line('ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_11')
		female_handler:set_one_line('ss_milkyway_main_s4_field_oneline_12')
	end
end

do
	local event = event_groups.up_to_section_2_nanny

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.get_nanny = function()
			return get_character('librarian_nanny')
		end

		self.nanny_event_request_id = 1
		self.max_request_id = 10
		self.is_active_nanny_event = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		-- 유모 세팅
		local nanny = self.get_nanny()

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nanny)
		scene_util.set_direction(nanny, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(nanny, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(nanny, self, 'sing')
		nanny.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_nanny_pos_1')

		self.is_active_nanny_event = false

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent), 'on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event')

		if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(get_party_leader().Position, nanny.Position) then
			start_coroutine(self.nanny_auto_event, self)
		end
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent))

		local nanny = self.get_nanny()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nanny)
		nanny.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(nanny, active_state_type.disabled)

		self.is_active_nanny_event = false

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event(e)
		if e.CameraGrid == nil then
			self.is_active_nanny_event = false
			return false
		end

		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'daylight_concert_grid' then
			start_coroutine(self.nanny_auto_event, self)
			return true
		end

		self.is_active_nanny_event = false
		return false
	end

	function event:nanny_auto_event()
		self:set_nanny_request_id()
		local request_id = self.nanny_event_request_id

		local nanny = self.get_nanny()
		self.is_active_nanny_event = true

		local function local_wait_for_sec(time)
			local s = unity_class.time.time
			while unity_class.time.time - s < time and self.is_active_nanny_event do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

		while self.is_active_nanny_event and request_id == self.nanny_event_request_id do
			-- 유모(right, tired, sing, jump 1회): 레나님~ 이제 그만 돌아오세요~
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', play_pos = nanny.Position, loop = false })
			character_util.normal_jump(nanny)
			scene_util.set_direction(nanny, 'right', false)

do

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.move_end_check = false
		self.zone_name = 's9_event_1_zone'

		self.get_npc = function(number)
			return self:get_handler('s9_wall_npc_' .. number):get_npc()
		end

		self.fx = setmetatable({
			hit = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
			end,
			lasthit = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
			end,
		}, {
			__index = {
				load_all = function(this)
					for _, func in pairs(this) do
						func()
					end
				end
			}
		})

		self.fx:load_all()

	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()
		self:setting()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		character_util.stop_shake(self.get_npc(1))
		character_util.stop_shake(self.get_npc(2))
		character_util.stop_shake(self.get_npc(3))
		character_util.stop_shake(self.get_npc(4))
		character_util.stop(self.get_npc(1))
		character_util.stop(self.get_npc(2))
		character_util.stop(self.get_npc(5))
		character_util.stop(self.get_npc(6))
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_npc(5))

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.move_end_check and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.move_end_check = true
			start_coroutine(self.move_routine, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	function event:setting()
		character_util.shake(self.get_npc(1), 0.03, 999999)
		character_util.shake(self.get_npc(2), 0.03, 999999)
		character_util.shake(self.get_npc(3), 0.03, 999999)
		character_util.shake(self.get_npc(4), 0.03, 999999)

		-- 메인 퀘스트
		local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

		if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress < 9 then
			return
		end

		self.move_end_check = true

		character_util.set_position(self.get_npc(1), self.get_npc(7).Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(self.get_npc(2), self.get_npc(7).Position + vector(-1, 0, -0.4))

		character_util.set_group_direction({ self.get_npc(7), self.get_npc(8) }, 'left')
		scene_util.set_group_emotion({ self.get_npc(7), self.get_npc(8) }, self, 'surprise')

		local life_guard_male = self.get_npc(5)

		character_util.set_position(life_guard_male, self.get_npc(8).Position + vector(1, 0, -1))
		character_util.set_direction(life_guard_male, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(life_guard_male, self, 'attack')
		life_guard_male.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_milkyway_main_s9_oneline_7'

		local life_guard_female = self.get_npc(6)

		character_util.set_position(life_guard_female, self.get_npc(8).Position + vector(2, 0, -2))
		character_util.set_direction(life_guard_female, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(life_guard_female, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(life_guard_female, self, 'cast2')
		life_guard_female.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_milkyway_main_s9_oneline_8'

		character_util.set_position(self.get_npc(9), self.get_npc(1).Position + vector(-1, 0, -1))
	end

	function event:move_routine()
		local move_npcs = { self.get_npc(1), self.get_npc(2) }
		local stop_npcs = { self.get_npc(7), self.get_npc(8) }
		local life_guard_male = self.get_npc(5)
		local life_guard_female = self.get_npc(6)
		local old_woman = self.get_npc(9)

		wp_util.move(old_woman, old_woman.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
				2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		--동시에 1, 2번 사람들도 위로 0.6초만에 위로 이동해, 벽에 박는다.
		do
			local wp_key = 'move_npc_wp'

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(move_npcs[1], move_npcs[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
					nil, 0.6, self, wp_key)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(move_npcs[2], move_npcs[2].Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
					nil, 0.6, self, wp_key)

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
		end

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--벽에 박는 순간 1, 2번 둘다 fx_hit 이펙트, damagesquish, redpulse 1번에게는 fx_lasthit 까지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_comic_01', play_pos = move_npcs[1].Position })
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(move_npcs[1])
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(move_npcs[1])
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(move_npcs[1].Position)
		self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(move_npcs[1].Position)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(move_npcs[2])
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(move_npcs[2])
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(move_npcs[2].Position)

		--동시에 9, 10번은 left, surprsie, idle로.
		character_util.set_group_direction(stop_npcs, 'left')
		scene_util.set_group_emotion(stop_npcs, self, 'surprise')

		--이후, 5, 6번이 아래 동선을 따라 속도 4로 이동한다.(이동 시작하면서부터 이더리얼 처리)
		do
			life_guard_male.Interactable.Talk = nil
			life_guard_male.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

			life_guard_female.Interactable.Talk = nil
			life_guard_female.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

			character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ life_guard_male, life_guard_female })

			local wp_key = 'life_guard_wp'

			local male_wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(life_guard_male,
					stop_npcs[2].Position + vector(1, 0, -1), true)

			local female_wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(life_guard_female,
					stop_npcs[2].Position + vector(2, 0, -2), true)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(life_guard_male, male_wp, 4, nil, self, wp_key,
					{ run = true, last_direction = 'left' })
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(life_guard_female, female_wp, 4, nil, self, wp_key,
					{ run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

			life_guard_male.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
			life_guard_female.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		end

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--도착하면 5번, 6번 left, attack, idle로 변경.
		scene_util.set_emotion(life_guard_female, self, 'attack')
		--5번(left, attack, release 2회, 스킵 불가능, shout 말풍선) : 모두 멈추세요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(life_guard_male, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
				'ss_milkyway_main_s9_oneline_7')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--이후, 원라인 대사
		--5번(left, attack, idle) : 모두 멈추세요!
		life_guard_male.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_milkyway_main_s9_oneline_7'

		--6번(left, attack, cast2) : 진정하세요, 모두들!!
		scene_util.set_anim(life_guard_female, self, 'cast2')
		life_guard_female.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_milkyway_main_s9_oneline_8'
	end
end

do
	local event = event_groups.night_trainee_area

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.event_handlers = {
			enter = nil,
			exit = nil,
		}

		self.get_trainee = function()
			return get_character('aspiring_idol_trainee')
		end

		self.get_camera = function()
			return get_character('aspiring_idol_camera')
		end

		self.get_trainee_night_start_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('aspiring_idol_night_trainee_1')
		end

		self.dance_talk_zone = 'aspiring_idol_night_event'

		self.dance_states = {
			none = 1,
			dance = 2,
			dance_and_talk = 3
		}

		self.dance_grid_name = 'night_trainee_grid'

		self.dance_key = 0

		self.current_dance_state = nil
	end

	function event:dispose()
		self.super:dispose()
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent), 'on_camera_grid_move_end_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

		--밤 위치로 옮기기
		local trainee = self.get_trainee()
		local cam = self.get_camera()

		-- 마커 있으면 제거
		quest_icon_util.remove(trainee)

		-- 충돌 안되도록
		trainee.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		-- 지망생 최초 위치 지정
		trainee.Position = self.get_trainee_night_start_pos()
		field_object_util.set_active_state(trainee, active_state_type.disabled)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trainee)

		scene_util.set_direction(trainee, direction_constants.down, false)

		--카메라 위치 지정
		cam.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('aspiring_idol_night_camera')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(cam, active_state_type.enabled)

		-- 섹션마다 수행될 동작 수행
		if self.event_handlers.enter ~= nil then
			self.event_handlers.enter()
		end
	end

	function event:exit()
		-- 종료 시 바로 멈추기
		self.current_dance_state = self.dance_states.none
		self:night_trainee_dance_stop()

		-- 섹션마다 수행될 동작 수행
		if self.event_handlers.exit ~= nil then
			self.event_handlers.exit()
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
		-- 춤추기 시작하기
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.dance_grid_name) then
			self.current_dance_state = self.dance_states.dance
			start_coroutine(self.night_trainee_dance_routine, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_camera_grid_move_end_event(e)
		-- 춤추기 멈추고 시작 자리로 옮기기
		if e.From.name == self.dance_grid_name and
				e.To.name ~= self.dance_grid_name then
			self.current_dance_state = self.dance_states.none

			-- 여기서 호출해야 카메라가 나갔을때, 이동 중에도 바로 멈출 수 있음
			self:night_trainee_dance_stop()

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		-- 존에 들어가면 대화 시작
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'aspiring_idol_night_event') then
			self.current_dance_state = self.dance_states.dance_and_talk

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_zone_leave_event(e)
		-- 존에서 나가면 대화 안들림
		if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'aspiring_idol_night_event') then
			self.current_dance_state = self.dance_states.dance

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:night_trainee_dance_stop()
		local trainee = self.get_trainee()

		character_util.stop(trainee)

		-- 비활성화 (대화 지우기)
		dispose_actions.speech(trainee)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(trainee, active_state_type.disabled)

		trainee.Position = self.get_trainee_night_start_pos()
		scene_util.set_direction(trainee, direction_constants.down, false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trainee)
	end

	function event:night_trainee_dance_routine()
		local trainee = self.get_trainee()
		local speed = 5

		local markers = {
			self.get_trainee_night_start_pos(),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('aspiring_idol_night_trainee_2'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('aspiring_idol_night_trainee_3')
		}

		-- 캐릭터 활성화
		field_object_util.set_active_state(trainee, active_state_type.enabled)

		-- 중복 실행 방지용
		self.dance_key = self.dance_key + 1
		local current_dance_key = self.dance_key

		-- 조건 체크 함수
		local is_movable = function()
			return self.dance_key == current_dance_key and self.current_dance_state ~= self.dance_states.none
		end

		local is_talkable = function()
			return self.dance_key == current_dance_key and self.current_dance_state == self.dance_states.dance_and_talk
		end

		-- 탈출 가능한 wait 함수
		local wait_for_sec_stoppable = function(delay, is_valid_cb_param)
			local s = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
			while CS.UnityEngine.Time.time - s < delay and is_valid_cb_param() do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

		-- 댄스 루틴 1회 수행 후 계속 이어갈지 조건 리턴하는 함수
		local try_dance_progress = function(dir, emo,
											anim, waypoint, talk_key)
			scene_util.set_direction(trainee, dir, false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(trainee, self, emo)
			scene_util.set_anim(trainee, self, { name = anim, remove_after = 2 })

			if talk_key ~= nil and is_talkable() then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', play_pos = trainee.Position, loop = false })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(trainee,
						{ key = talk_key, skip = false })
			end

			wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, is_movable)

			if is_movable() then
				wp_util.move_async(trainee, waypoint, speed)
			else
				self:night_trainee_dance_stop()

				return false
			end

			return true
		end

		while is_movable() do
			--1번 (down,attack,dance_voodoo) ->
			if not try_dance_progress(direction_constants.down, 'attack',
					'dance_voodoo', markers[2]) then
				break
			end

			-- 2번 (left,attack,dance) ->
			if not try_dance_progress(direction_constants.left, 'attack',
					'dance', markers[1], 'ss_milkyway_aspiring_idol_oneline_1') then
				break
			end

			-- 1번(down,attack,dance_voodoo) ->
			if not try_dance_progress(direction_constants.down, 'attack',
					'dance_voodoo', markers[3]) then
				break
			end

			-- 3번(right,attack,dance) ->
			if not try_dance_progress(direction_constants.right, 'attack',
					'dance', markers[1], 'ss_milkyway_aspiring_idol_oneline_2') then
				break
			end

			-- 1번(down,attack,dance_voodoo) 반복
			--패트롤 이동 속도 : 5
			--각 지점에 도달 후 동작 지속 시간 : 2초
		end
	end
end

do
	local event = event_groups.up_to_section_3_moderator

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.triggered = false
		self.is_un_subscribe = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		character_util.add_lua_listener(self:get_handler('moderator'):get_npc(), self)
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		self:un_subscribe_interact_event()

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:un_subscribe_interact_event()
		if self.is_un_subscribe then
			return
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		character_util.remove_lua_listener(self:get_handler('moderator'):get_npc(), self)
		self.is_un_subscribe = true
	end

	function event:on_event(e)
		local moderator = self:get_handler('moderator'):get_npc()

		if not self.triggered and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, moderator) then
			self.triggered = true

			start_coroutine(function()
				character_util.look_at(moderator, get_party_leader())
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(moderator, { key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s1_oneline_6', skip = false })

				if self.is_exit then
					return
				end

				scene_util.set_direction(moderator, 'left', false)
				self.triggered = false
			end)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end

	local night_walkie_talkie_fo = self.walkie_talkie.get_night_invisible_fo()

		self.get_female(),
		self.get_kid()

			'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_oneline_2',

		}

		local dirs = { 'left', 'right', 'left' }
		local emotion_keys = { 'tired', 'tired', 'cry' }

		for index = 1, #npcs do
			npcs[index].Position = positions[index]
			npcs[index].Interactable.Talk = oneline_keys[index]

			scene_util.set_emotion(npcs[index], self, emotion_keys[index])
			scene_util.set_anim(npcs[index], self, 'seat')
		end
	end
end

--[[QuestAttribute

]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryMilkyWayMagicWalkieTalkieController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_milkyway'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_people_use = 2,
		in_people_use = 3,
		before_interact_bad_female = 4,
		in_interact_bad_female = 5,
		canceled_pay = 6,
		in_interact_walkie_talkie = 7,
		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 이미지와 같이 세팅된 상태
	-- NPC
	-- 빨간색은 여성, 파란색은 남성
	-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, cast2)
	-- (남)일반 남성(right, smile, idle)
	-- (여)할머니(right, idle, idle)
	-- (남)꼬마 남성(right, smile, idle)
	-- 아이템 스프라이트
	-- 무전기 스프라이트가 테이블 위에 올라가 있다
	self.controller:place_static_npc()
	self.controller:place_wait_line_npc(true)

	self.current_state = self.states.before_people_use
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	-- 종료 시 바로 멈추기
	self.current_state = self.states.done
	self:pu_stop()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_people_use and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'magic_walkie_talkie_people_use') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_people_use

		start_coroutine(self.people_use_event, self):Then(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_bad_female
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if (self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_bad_female or
			self.current_state == self.states.canceled_pay) and
			e.Target == self.controller.get_bad_female() then
		local is_first_talk = self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_bad_female

		self.current_state = self.states.in_interact_bad_female

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			local payed = self:interact_bad_female(is_first_talk)

			if payed then
				self.current_state = self.states.in_interact_walkie_talkie
				self:interact_walkie_talkie()
			else
				self.current_state = self.states.canceled_pay
			end
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 원라인 이벤트 동작 정지(스피치 버블 제거)
function local_class:pu_stop()
	local remove_speech = function(npc)
		local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

		if bubble ~= nil then
			bubble:ResetBubble()
		end
	end

	local npcs = {}
	npcs[1] = self.controller.get_bad_female()
	npcs[2] = self.controller.get_male()
	npcs[3] = self.controller.get_female()
	npcs[4] = self.controller.get_kid()
	npcs[5] = self.controller.walkie_talkie.get_invisible_fo()

	for i = 1, #npcs do
		remove_speech(npcs[i])
	end
end

function local_class:people_use_event()
	local bad_female = self.controller.get_bad_female()
	local male = self.controller.get_male()
	local female = self.controller.get_female()
	local kid = self.controller.get_kid()
	local walkie_talkie_fo = self.controller.walkie_talkie.get_invisible_fo()

	-- zoooooooooooooool
	local wait_line = {
		male,
		female,
		kid
	}

	---@type fun(end_character:ICharacter, end_pos:Vector3, speed:number, is_run:boolean, oneline_key:string)
	local progress_line = function(end_character, end_pos,
								   speed, is_run, oneline_key)
		local progress_key = 'line_exit'

		local previous_crash_behaviour = end_character.CrashBehaviour

		-- 이동 시작할 때 충돌 처리 해제
		-- NOTE: active type을 바꾸면 말풍선이 사라진다
		end_character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		-- 줄에서 나갈 사람 end_pos로 이동
		-- NOTE: 웨이포인트를 여러 번 거쳐서 나가는 경우가 생기면, 인자를 waypoints 자체를 받도록 변경
		do
			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(end_character, end_pos)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(end_character, waypoints,
					speed, nil, self, progress_key, { run = is_run, end_callback = function()
						-- 활성화
						end_character.CrashBehaviour = previous_crash_behaviour

						-- 이동 완료 후 원라인 NPC로 세팅
						end_character.Interactable.Talk = oneline_key

						scene_util.set_anim(end_character, self, 'seat')
					end })
		end

		-- NOTE: 줄에서 제거
		for i = 1, #wait_line do
			if end_character == wait_line[i] then
				table.remove(wait_line, i)
			end
		end

		-- 줄에 있는 사람들 전부
		-- 앞 사람이 이동 시작하고 1초 뒤, 뒤에 줄 선 캐릭터들 전부 다 속도 2로 오른쪽으로 1칸씩 이동한다.

			wait_for_sec(1)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(wait_line[i], active_state_type.visible)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(wait_line[i],
					wait_line[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.right,
					2, nil, self, progress_key, { end_callback = function()
						field_object_util.set_active_state(wait_line[i], active_state_type.enabled)
					end })
		end

			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_1', skip = false })

	-- (남)일반 남성(right, smile, release): 마법의 무전기님! 오늘은 뭘 하면서 노는게 제일 재미있을까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(male, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_2', skip = false })

	-- (남)일반 남성(right, smile, cast)

	-- (남)일반 남성(right, tired, nod 2회) 끝날 때까지 대기

	progress_line(male, self.controller.get_male_end_pos(),

	-- (여)일반 여성(right, tired, bomb_idle): 작년 여름에 입었던 옷들이 맞지 않는게 많더라고요….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(female, self,

	-- 앞 사람이 이동 시작하고 1초 뒤, 뒤에 줄 선 캐릭터 속도 2로 오른쪽으로 1칸씩 이동한다. 끝날 때까지 대기

	-- (남)꼬마 남성(right, blush, cast): 제, 제가 좋아하는 여자애가 있는데요…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', play_pos = kid.Position, loop = false })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'blush' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_7', skip = false })

	-- (남)꼬마 남성(right, blush, release): 그 애랑 잘 될 수 있을까요…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'blush', keep = true },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_8', skip = false })

	-- (남)꼬마 남성(right, blush, cast)
	scene_util.set_anim(kid, self, 'cast')

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- (남)꼬마 남성(right, tired, idle)
	-- (남)무전기: 아니.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_glitch_02', play_pos = walkie_talkie_fo.Position, loop = false })
	character_util.remove_anim(kid)
	scene_util.set_emotion(kid, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(walkie_talkie_fo,
			'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_9', false)

	-- 앞사람 줄에서 빠진다
	-- 이동 시작할 때 충돌 처리 해제
	-- (남)꼬마 남성(cry) 속도 5로 위 그림의 경로 따라 달려서 이동
	-- 이동할 때 대사 출력
	-- (남)꼬마 남성: 으아앙~!
	-- 이동 완료 후 원라인 NPC로 세팅
	-- 충돌 처리 다시 설정
	-- 앞 사람이 이동 시작하고 1초 뒤, 다음 동작 진행
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_02', play_pos = kid.Position, loop = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(kid, self, 'cry')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid, { key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_10', skip = false })
	progress_line(kid, self.controller.get_kid_end_pos(),
			5, true, 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_oneline_3')

	-- (남)꼬마 남성(left, cry, seat): 으아앙~!
	-- (여)불량 여성(left, doyagao, cast2) 상호작용 활성화
	scene_util.set_emotion(bad_female, self, 'doyagao')
	character_util.add_listener(bad_female, self)

	-- 머리 위에 퀘스트 말풍선 출력
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(bad_female)
end

function local_class:interact_bad_female(is_first_talk)
	local bad_female = self.controller.get_bad_female()
	local pirate = self.controller.get_pirate()

	quest_icon_util.remove(bad_female)

	-- NPC 인터랙트 시 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- (여)불량 여성과 최초 상호작용시 다음 이벤트 시작
	-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim(bad_female)
	scene_util.set_emotion(bad_female, self, 'smile')

	-- (여)불량 여성 왼쪽 1칸 옆 지점에 1초간 정렬. 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- 나머지 파티원들은 옆에 한줄로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(self.controller.get_bad_female_pos(), 'left', 1, 'linear')

	if is_first_talk then
		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, release): 안녕하세요! 여러분들도 마법의 무전기님께 답을 찾으러 오신 분들이신가요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'release' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_11', skip = true })

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, idle)

		-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, idle): 마법의 무전기?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_12', skip = true })

		-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, idle)

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, bomb_idle): 별무리섬의 명물, 마법의 무전기님을 모르시나요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_13', skip = true })

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, cast): 오늘 저녁메뉴같은 가벼운 고민부터 마음 속 깊이 숨겨놓은 근심 걱정 거리까지!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast' },
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_14', skip = true })

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, cast2): 마법의 무전기님 께서는 모든 걸 알고 답을 해 주십니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast2' },
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_15', skip = true })

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, release): 원래는 한번에 1만 골드인데, 지금은 세일해서 7백 골드에 모시고 있습니다. 어떠세요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'release' },
				{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_16', skip = true })

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, idle)

		-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, doyagao): 음… 재미는 있어 보이는데….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_17', skip = true })

		-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, idle)
		-- 선택 이벤트로 연결
	else
		-- (여)불량 여성과 두번째 이상으로 상호작용시 다음 이벤트 시작
		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, idle)

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, release): 마법의 무전기님과의 대화 기회! 단 돈 7백 골드에 모시고 있습니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'release' },
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_18', skip = true })

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, idle)
		-- 선택 이벤트로 연결
	end

	-- 선택 이벤트
	-- 선택지
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_choose_1', 'mercy' },
		{ 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_choose_2', 'normal' },
	})

	if result == 1 then
		-- (mercy) 7백 골드를 낸다. 7백 골드를 낸다.
		if CS.Oak.User.Me.Gold >= 700 then
			-- 플레이어가 7백 골드 이상 있는 경우
			-- 플레이어 계정에서 7백골드 제거
			-- 대화 이벤트로 연결
			coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.StageApiRouter.SendPayGold(stage.StageId, 700))

			return true
		else
			-- 아닌 경우
			-- (여)레이첼(right, tired, idle)
			scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'tired')

			-- (여)불량 여성(left, tired, cast): 죄송합니다. 지금 잔액이 부족하신 것 같네요….
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'cast' },
					{ name = 'tired' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_19', skip = true })

			-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, cast2): 다음에 다시 찾아와 주세요!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'cast2' },
					{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_20', skip = true })

			-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, idle)
			character_util.remove_emotion(pirate)

			-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, idle)
			-- 컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료.
			-- 컨트롤 복귀 시 BGM 볼륨 1로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			return false
		end
	else
		-- (normal) 내지 않는다.
		-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, bomb_idle): 아냐. 난 됐어.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_21', skip = true })

		-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, idle)
		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, release): 혹시 마음이 바뀌시면 다시 찾아와 주세요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_female, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'release' },
				{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_22', skip = true })

		-- (여)불량 여성(left, smile, idle)
		-- 컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
		-- 컨트롤 복귀 시 BGM 볼륨 1로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		-- 머리 위에 퀘스트 말풍선 출력
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(bad_female)

		return false
	end
end

function local_class:interact_walkie_talkie()
	local bad_female = self.controller.get_bad_female()
	local pirate = self.controller.get_pirate()
	local walkie_talkie_fo = self.controller.walkie_talkie.get_invisible_fo()

	-- 대화 이벤트
	-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, nod 2회): 좋아. 한 번 해볼까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_23', skip = true })

	-- 화면 1초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 화면 가려진 동안 세팅
	-- 레이첼(right, idle, idle) 이미지의 위치에 세팅
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'right', false)

	pirate.Position = self.controller.walkie_talkie.get_pos() + unity_class.vector3.left

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 화면 1초간 페이드 인. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, cross_arm): 좋아. 그럼 뭘 물어볼까…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_24', skip = true })

	local choose_count = 0

	-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, idle)
	local common_reaction = function()
		if choose_count < 2 then
			-- 모든 선택지를 보지 않은 경우 다음 대사 출력 후 선택지 다시 출력
			-- (여)레이첼(right, tired, idle) annoyed 이모티콘 출력
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
			scene_util.play_emoticon_action(pirate, self,
					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					nil,
					{ name = 'tired' },
					'annoyed')

			-- (여)레이첼(right, tired, idle): …다른걸 물어보는게 낫겠어.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					nil,
					{ name = 'tired' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_50', skip = true })

			-- (여)레이첼(right, idle, idle)
			choose_count = choose_count + 1
		end
	end

	-- 선택지 출력. 이미 선택한 적이 있는 선택지는 다음 선택지 출력때 제거되고, 모든 선택지를 선택해 봐야 다음 이벤트로 넘어갈 수 있다.
	choose_util.play_choose_sampling_without_replacement({
		{
			key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_choose_3',
			tendency = 'mercy',
			cb_func = function()
				-- (mercy) 연애에 대해서
				-- (여)레이첼(right, blush, cast): 크흠! 그… 그….
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
						{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'cast' },
						{ name = 'blush' },
						{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_25', skip = true })

				-- (여)레이첼(right, blush, release): 혹시 그… 내가… 이번 축제를 계기로 멋진 남자친구를….
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
						{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'release' },
						{ name = 'blush' },
						{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_26', skip = true })

				-- (여)레이첼(right, tired, idle)
				character_util.remove_anim(pirate)
				scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'tired')

				-- (남)무전기: 아니.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(walkie_talkie_fo,

				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
						{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						nil,
						{ name = 'tired' },
						{ key = 'ss_milkyway_magic_walkie_talkie_s1_28', skip = true })

				-- (여)레이첼(right, smile, sing): 그럼 혹시 언제쯤….

						{ name = 'sing' },
						{ name = 'smile' },

				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
						{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },

						{ name = 'tired' },

	self.controller = controller

	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.get_twinkle_invisible_fo = function()
		return get_field_object('magic_walkie_talkie_twinkle_fo')
	end

	self.fx = {
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능

end

	self.fx:load_all()
end
