				align_down_pos,
				pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 2.5),
			}
		},
		[star_girl] = {
			enter = enter_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			align = {
				vector(enter_pos.x - 1, 0, align_down_pos.z),
				align_down_pos,
				pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 3.5),
			}
		},
		[teatan_hero] = {
			enter = enter_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1),
			align = {
				vector(enter_pos.x - 1, 0, align_down_pos.z),
				align_down_pos,
				pivot_pos + vector(1, 0, 3.5),
			}
		},
		[civilian_kid_boy] = {
			enter = enter_pos + vector(-2, 0, -1),
			align = {
				vector(enter_pos.x - 2, 0, align_up_pos.z),
				align_up_pos,
				pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 3.5)
			}
		},
		[teatan_kid_girl] = {
			enter = enter_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			align = {
				vector(enter_pos.x - 2, 0, align_up_pos.z),
				align_up_pos,
				pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 2.5)
			}
		},
		[innuit_kid_boy] = {
			enter = enter_pos + vector(-2, 0, 1),
			align = {
				vector(enter_pos.x - 2, 0, align_up_pos.z),
				align_up_pos,
				pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 2.5),
			}
		}
	}

	--2초에 걸쳐진행자 NPC를 중심으로 카메라 패닝하면서, 파티원 6명 모두 down 방향으로 상단의 이미지에 지정된 위치로 정렬
	--(이때 파티원들 지정된 경로를 attack, run으로 이동하여 정렬.)

	camera_util.move_to_target(moderator, 2)

	local dash_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_dash_01',
		parent = pirate,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	for fo, wp in pairs(wp_list) do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp.enter, nil, 0.5, self, nil,

	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	for fo, wp in pairs(wp_list) do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, wp.align, 7, nil, self, nil,
				{ run = true, play_sfx = false, last_direction = direction_constants.down, y_mode = 'floor',})
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_loop_sfx)

	-- 진행자 (left, smile, victory_get) : 여러분!!! 오래 기다리셨습니다!!

			{ name = 'victory_get' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_1', skip = true })

	-- 진행자 (left, smile, idle) : 드디어 오늘! 레이싱 대회의 마지막 승자가 결정되는 날이 다가왔습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(moderator, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_2', skip = true })

	-- 진행자 (left, smile, cast) : 과연 승자는 누가 될 것인지~~!

			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_3', skip = true })

	--진행자 (left, smile, sing) : 그야말로 한치 앞을 알 수 없을 강력한 두 팀의 대결이 예상되는데요!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(moderator, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'sing' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_3_1', skip = true })

	-- 진행자 (left, smile, release) : 그럼, 바로 진행해볼까요!!

			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },

			{ name = 'smile' },

	scene_util.set_emotion(star_girl, self, 'attack')

	scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_kid_boy, self, 'attack')

	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_kid_girl, self, 'attack')

	-- 진행자 up, attack, jingak 1회를 실행하고, 진각 애니메이션 발 구르는 타이밍에 0.2초에 걸쳐 카메라 위쪽으로 5칸 이동.

	scene_util.set_emotion(moderator, self, 'attack')

	scene_util.set_anim(moderator, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	do
		local camera_pos = moderator.Position + vector(0, 0, 4)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.2)
	end

	-- 진행자 : [shout] 붉은 장미 해적단!
	--해당 대사는 화면 하단에서 출력 + 1.4배 크기 + 화면 0.3만큼 0.2초간 shake

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')

	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(moderator, self,

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_11', skip = true })

	--마리안 (down, sleep_deep, idle) : 만약 네가 그걸 사용한다면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },

			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_12', skip = true })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },

			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_13', skip = true })

	--레이첼 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 정말? 그럼 이것만 있으면…!
	character_util.normal_jump(pirate, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_13_1', skip = true })

	--마리안 (down, attack, idle) : …하지만 한번 사용하면 그걸로 끝.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_13_2', skip = true })

	--마리안 (down, attack, idle) : 엔진은 부스터의 열기를 버티지 못해 녹아내리고, 보트는 그대로 멈춰버릴 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_13_3', skip = true })

	--마리안 (down, smile, idle) : 그러니… 제일 중요한 순간에 써줬으면 해. 나와 이 아이를 위해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_13_4', skip = true })

			{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_14', skip = true })

	-- 레이첼 (up, idle, nod 1회) : …고마워! 꼭 이기고 돌아올게!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s12_15', skip = true })

	-- 0.5초에 걸쳐 카메라 아래쪽으로 5칸 이동.

function local_class:mini_game_start(key)
	self.mini_game_name = 'MilkyWayRacing'
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)
	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 대기
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

	--dynamic
	self.dynamic_npc = {
		dict = nil,

		---@param this self
		load_async = function(this)
			if this.dict ~= nil then
				return
			end

			local npc_spec = {}
			for _, data in pairs(this.npc_data) do
				for key, info in pairs(data) do
					npc_spec[key] = info.spec
				end
			end

			this.dict = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(npc_spec)
		end,

		---@param this self
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.dict == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.dict)
			this.dict = nil
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param key string
		get = function(this, key)
			return this.dict[key]
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param data table
		set_by_npc_data = function(this, data)
			for key, info in pairs(data) do
				local npc = this:get(key)
				local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(info.marker_name)

				field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

				character_util.set_direction(npc, info.dir)
				character_util.set_emotion(npc, info.emo)
				character_util.set_anim(npc, info.anim)

				if info.oneline ~= nil then
					npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
					npc.Interactable.Talk = info.oneline
				end

				npc.Position = pos + info.offset

				field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		get_knight = function(this)
			--반대 성별 npc 숨김
			if user_util.has_knight_male() then
				return this:get('knight_male')
			else
				return this:get('knight_female')
			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		hide_knight = function(this)
			--반대 성별 npc 숨김
			if user_util.has_knight_male() then
				field_object_util.set_active_state(this:get('knight_female'), active_state_type.disabled)
			else
				field_object_util.set_active_state(this:get('knight_male'), active_state_type.disabled)
			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		hide_all = function(this)
			for key, npc in pairs(this.dict) do
				field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		set_award_npc = function(this)
			this:hide_all()

			this:set_by_npc_data(this.npc_data.award)

			this:hide_knight()

			local knight = this:get_knight()

			knight.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			character_util.add_listener(knight, self.controller)
		end,

				return
			end

			this.fo = self.fx:constellation_star():Instantiate(pos)
			this.rose_fx = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(this.fo.transform, '[add]constellation_rose')
			this.rose_fx.gameObject:SetActive(false)

			local star_count = 8
			for num = 1, star_count do
				local star_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(this.fo.transform, 'glow0' .. num)
				local line_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(this.fo.transform, 'line0' .. num)

				star_obj.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

				line_obj.gameObject:SetActive(false)

				local current_data = {
					star = star_obj,
					line = line_obj,
					radius = 1.1,
				}

				this.data[num] = current_data
			end

			--마지막 선택지 추가
			local last_star = this.data[3].star
			local last_line = this.data[star_count].line

			this.data[star_count + 1] = {
				star = last_star,
				line = last_line,
				radius = 1.1,
			}
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param pos Vector2
		check = function(this, pos)
			local convert_pos = stage_camera.Camera:ScreenToWorldPoint(vector(pos.x, pos.y, 0))
			local current_data = this.data[this.count]
			local start_pos = current_data.star.position
			local touch_pos = vector(convert_pos.x, start_pos.y, convert_pos.z + convert_pos.y - start_pos.y)
			local dist = vector_util.distance(start_pos, touch_pos)

			if dist < current_data.radius then
				return true
			end

			return false
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param dt number
		update = function(this, dt)
			if this.current_state == self.constellation_state.success then
				local current_data = this.data[this.count]
				local fx_pos = current_data.star.position

				if this.hint_fx ~= nil then
					this.hint_fx:Dispose()
					this.hint_fx = nil
				end

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_firefly_02')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_firefly_05')

				self.fx:constellation_success():Instantiate(fx_pos)

				if this.count > 1 then
					local prev_count = this.count - 1
					local prev_data = this.data[prev_count]
					prev_data.line.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				else
					self.tutorialSpineObj:Dispose()
					self.tutorialSpineObj = nil
				end

				this.current_state = self.constellation_state.scale
				this.max_duration = 0.5

			elseif this.current_state == self.constellation_state.scale then
				local current_data = this.data[this.count]

				this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt

				if this.time_passed >= this.max_duration then
					current_data.star.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
					this.current_state = self.constellation_state.hint
					this.time_passed = 0
				else
					current_data.star.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) + vector(1, 1, 1) * this.time_passed
				end
			elseif this.current_state == self.constellation_state.hint then
				this.count = this.count + 1

				if this.count > #this.data then
					this.current_state = self.constellation_state.wait
					this.next_state = self.constellation_state.finish
					this.max_duration = 1
				else
					local current_data = this.data[this.count]
					local fx_pos = current_data.star.position

					this.hint_fx = self.fx:constellation_hint():Instantiate(fx_pos)

					this.current_state = self.constellation_state.ready
				end
			elseif this.current_state == self.constellation_state.finish then
				this.rose_fx.gameObject:SetActive(true)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_windchime_01')

				this.current_state = self.constellation_state.wait
				this.next_state = self.constellation_state.done
				this.max_duration = 1.5
			elseif this.current_state == self.constellation_state.wait then
				this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt

				if this.time_passed > this.max_duration then
					this.current_state = this.next_state
					this.time_passed = 0
				end
			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.fo ~= nil then
				this.fo:Dispose()
				this.fo = nil
			end

			if this.hint_fx ~= nil then
				this.hint_fx:Dispose()
				this.hint_fx = nil
			end

			this.data = nil
		end,
	}

	self.knight_interact = false
	self.clap_sfx = nil
end

end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.intro_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if self.clap_sfx ~= nil then
		self.clap_sfx:Stop()
		self.clap_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.wave_fx ~= nil then
		self.wave_fx:Dispose()
		self.wave_fx = nil
	end

	self.dynamic_npc:dispose()

	self.constellation:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.first_award_enter and
			self.current_state ~= self.states.trio_interact and
			(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:teatan_kid()) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:human_kid()) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:innuit_kid())) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.trio_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state < self.states.first_award_enter and
			self.current_state ~= self.states.teatan_hero_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:teatan_hero()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.teatan_hero_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if not self.knight_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.dynamic_npc:get_knight()) then
		self.knight_interact = true
		start_coroutine(self.knight_interact_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.first_award_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s13_enter_zone') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.back_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.first_award_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s13_award_enter_zone_1') then
		start_coroutine(self.audience_routine, self)
		self.current_state = self.states.second_award_enter
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.second_award_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s13_award_enter_zone_2') then
		start_coroutine(self.audience_routine, self)
		self.current_state = self.states.third_award_enter
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.third_award_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s13_award_enter_zone_3') then
		start_coroutine(self.audience_routine, self)
		self.current_state = self.states.start_award
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.start_award and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s13_award_start_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_award_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.award_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.start_mini_game then
		return false
	end

	if self.constellation.current_state == self.constellation_state.ready and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and
			self.constellation:check(e.TouchPos) then
		self.constellation.current_state = self.constellation_state.success

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:intro_scene()
	local pirate = self.npc:pirate()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_oasis', state = 'field',
										 volume = 0.6, mix = 10 })

	--set
	do
		--dynamic
		self.dynamic_npc:load_async()
		self.dynamic_npc:set_award_npc()

		camera_util.move_async(pirate.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 0)

		-- 최초 Stage Camera 값은 5로.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0)

		self.clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_01', loop = true, volume = 0.6,
													 play_pos = pirate.Position + vector(0, 0, 16), max_distance = 10, })
	end

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	-- 1초간 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--최초 ■지점에서 2초에 걸쳐 2.5칸 내려옴
	camera_util.return_to_leader(2.5)

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 4로 복귀.
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(1)

	-- 레이첼 right, smile, idle 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'right', true)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'smile')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 레이첼 left, smile, idle 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- (여)레이첼(down, smile, cast) : 사람들이 이렇게 많다니…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_1', skip = true })

	do
		local wait = true
		start_coroutine(function()
			scene_util.set_anim_async(pirate, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
			wait = false
		end)

		-- (여)레이첼(right, smile, victory_get 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지.) : 모두 내가 최고의 선장이 되는 걸 축하하러 왔나 보군!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_2', skip = true })

		-- victory_get 1회 끝남 + 대사끝남일 경우 다음 진행.
		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- (여)레이첼(right, attack, idle, jump 1회) : 아, 이럴 때가 아니지.
	character_util.normal_jump(pirate, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(pirate)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_3', skip = true })

	-- (여)레이첼(right, smile, release 2회) : 시상식이 시작하기 전에 단원들을 챙겨야 해!.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_4', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pirate)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:trio_interact_scene()

	local teatan_kid = self.npc:teatan_kid()
	local human_kid = self.npc:human_kid()
	local innuit_kid = self.npc:innuit_kid()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.trio_key)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(teatan_kid, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(human_kid, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(innuit_kid, self.controller)

			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },

			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },

			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_6', skip = true })

			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },

			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_fist_01')
	scene_util.set_group_direction(kid_group, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_group_anim(kid_group, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false })

	-- (여)티꼬(left, smile, boong_attack 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지) : 왼쪽으로 다같이 손을 뻗는 거랑…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_kid, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_9', skip = true })

	-- 3인방 down, smile, idle로 전환.
	scene_util.set_group_direction(kid_group, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_group_anim(kid_group)

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 인꼬, 이꼬도 동시에 right, smile, boong_attack 1회, 끝나고 자세 유지.

			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'clap', count = 3 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_15', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_group_direction(kid_group, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(kid_group, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_group_anim(kid_group)

	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_anim(pirate)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 액션 실행과 동시에 카메라 shake 0.3초, 세기 0.15
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)

	-- 3인방 + 레이첼 위에서 정한 액션 실행, 대신 표정은 awesome으로.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')

	if self.ceremony == 1 then
		character_util.group_normal_jump(kid_group, false)
		scene_util.set_group_direction(kid_group, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_group_anim(kid_group, self, { name = 'get', loop = false })

		scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'down', false)

	elseif self.ceremony == 2 then
		scene_util.set_group_direction(kid_group, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_group_anim(kid_group, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false })

		scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(pirate, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	elseif self.ceremony == 3 then
		scene_util.set_group_direction(kid_group, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_group_anim(kid_group, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false })

		scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(pirate, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	end

	--대기 1.2초
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	--인간 꼬마, 티탄 꼬마, 이누이트 꼬마 동시에 (right, smile, idle) 자세로 전환.
	scene_util.set_group_direction(kid_group, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(kid_group, self, 'smile')
	character_util.remove_group_anim(kid_group)

	-- (여)레이첼(left, smile, release 2회) : 자, 이제 어서 시상식으로 가자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_16', skip = true })

	-- (여)레이첼(left, smile, bomb_idle) : 레나 신참이 기다릴 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_17', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(kid_group)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pirate)

	-- 마리안 이벤트 보지 않았으면 3인방이 팔로우로 합류.
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(teatan_kid, user_party, false)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(human_kid, user_party, false)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(innuit_kid, user_party, false)

	if self.current_state == self.states.teatan_hero_interact then
		self:award_setting()
	else
		self.current_state = self.states.trio_interact
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:teatan_hero_interact_scene()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
					{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_22', skip = true })

			-- (여)마리안(left, doyagao, bomb_idle) : 미안하지만 난 이제 계약 종료라고.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
					{ name = 'doyagao' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_23', skip = true })

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			-- (여)레이첼(right, tired, idle) : 새로운 배가 좋았는데…
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
					{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
					nil,
					{ name = 'tired' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_24', skip = true })

			-- (여)마리안(left, smile, bomb_Idle) : 뭐, 덕분에 나도 재밌었어.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'bomb_Idle' },
					{ name = 'smile' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_25', skip = true })

		end
	end

	-- (여)마리안(left, idle, idle) : 그래서 뭐 때문에 온 거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_26', skip = true })

	-- (여)레이첼(right, smile, idle) : 시상식 시작하기 전에 데리러 왔지!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_27', skip = true })

	-- (여)마리안(left, idle, question) : 벌써 그렇게 됐구나.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'question', loop = false },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_28', skip = true })

	-- (여)마리안(left, smile, nod 2회) : 좋아, 가자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_29', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(teatan_hero)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pirate)
	scene_util.show_weapon(teatan_hero)

	-- 3인방 이벤트 보지 않았으면 마리안이 팔로우로 합류.
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(teatan_hero, user_party, false)

	if self.current_state == self.states.trio_interact then
		self:award_setting()
	else
		self.current_state = self.states.teatan_hero_interact
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:award_scene()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.award_key)

	self:award_start_scene()
	self:mini_game_scene()
	self:epilogue_scene()
end

function local_class:award_start_scene()
	local pirate = self.npc:pirate()
	local star_girl = self.dynamic_npc:get('star_girl')
	local teatan_kid = self.npc:teatan_kid()
	local human_kid = self.npc:human_kid()
	local innuit_kid = self.npc:innuit_kid()
	local teatan_hero = self.npc:teatan_hero()
	local secretary = self.dynamic_npc:get('secretary')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	--레이첼 , 마리안, 티탄, 인간, 이누이트 꼬마 파티원 모두 동시에 1.5초에 걸쳐 up 방향으로 정렬.
	do
		local wp_key = 'align_key'
		local duration = 1.5
		local default_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s13_award_default_pos')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(pirate, default_pos,
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'up' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(teatan_hero, default_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'up' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(teatan_kid, default_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'up' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(human_kid, default_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -2),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'up' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit_kid, default_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
				nil, duration, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--0.8초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--서기장 (down, idle, nod 1회) : 이제 별무리제도 마지막 순서에 이르렀습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(secretary, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_31_1', skip = true })

	--서기장 (down, idle, idle) : 그리고, 저의 진행도 이것이 마지막이 되겠군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(secretary, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_31_2', skip = true })

	--서기장 (down, idle, cast) : 저는 오늘 이 자리에서, 레나 수석 서기에게 서기장의 자리를 인계합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(secretary, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_31_3', skip = true })

	--서기장 (down, sleep_deep, cast) : 남은 진행은… 새로운 서기장님이 그 자격을 증명하는 자리가 될 것 입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(secretary, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_31_4', skip = true })

	--서기장 (down, idle, idle) : 그럼…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(secretary, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_31_5', skip = true })

	--서기장 left 방향 바라본채로 1초에 걸쳐 오른쪽으로 1.5칸 walk 자세로 이동.
	do
		local duration = 1

		character_util.remove_anim(secretary)
		wp_util.move_async(secretary, secretary.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
				nil, duration, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레나 1초에 걸쳐 아래쪽으로 1.5칸 walk 자세로 이동.
	do
		local duration = 1

		character_util.remove_anim(star_girl)
		wp_util.move_async(star_girl, star_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
				nil, duration)
	end

	--대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- (여)레나(down, idle, idle, 말풍선 크기 0.7배) : 선장. 준비됐어?
	character_util.remove_emotion(star_girl)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_32', skip = true, scale = 0.7 })

	do
		-- 레이첼 선택지
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- 갑자기 떨린다.(intellect)
			{ 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_choose_6', 'intellect' },
			-- 준비 됐다.(mercy)
			{ 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_choose_7', 'mercy' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- (여)레이첼(left, scared, cast, shake 0.5초, 말풍선 크기 0.7배) : 막, 막상 시상식이 되니까 조금 떨리네…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			scene_util.normal_shake(pirate, 0.5, false)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'cast' },
					{ name = 'scared' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_33', skip = true, scale = 0.7 })

			scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'up', false)

			-- (여)레나(down, smile, idle, 말풍선 크기 0.7배) : 긴장할 거 없어, 선장.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
					{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
					nil,
					{ name = 'smile' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_34', skip = true, scale = 0.7 })

		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			-- (여)레이첼(left, smile, nod 2회, 말풍선 크기 0.7배) : 준비 됐어, 신참!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
					{ name = 'smile' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_35', skip = true, scale = 0.7 })

			scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'up', false)

			-- (여)레나(down, smile, idle, 말풍선 크기 0.7배) : 좋아. 시작할게.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
					{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
					nil,
					{ name = 'smile' },
					{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_36', skip = true, scale = 0.7 })
		end
	end

	--레나(down, sleep_deep, cast) 자세로 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(star_girl, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(star_girl, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(star_girl, self, 'cast')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- (여)레나(down, idle, cast) : 올해에도 저희를 별무리 섬까지 인도해 주신 것에 진심으로 감사드립니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_38', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나(down, smile, bomb_idle) : 밀키웨이 레이싱의 우승 팀, 붉은 장미 해적단.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_39', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나(down, smile, clap 3회) : 다시 한번 진심으로 우승을 축하드립니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'clap', count = 3 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_40', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나(down, idle, bomb_idle) : 붉은 장미 해적단의 선장 레이첼.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_43', skip = true })

	-- 레이첼이 위쪽으로 1초간 1칸 이동한다.
	wp_util.move_async(pirate, pirate.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 1)

	-- (여)레나(down, smile, bomb_idle) : 당신이 올해 최고의 선장이라는 기록은, 영원토록 보존될 것입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_45', skip = true })


	-- (여)레이첼(down, smile, idle) : 히힛, 이건 시작일 뿐이라고!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(pirate, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_46', skip = true })

	-- (여)레이첼(down, smile, cast2) : 붉은장미 해적단!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'down' },
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_47', skip = true })

	do
		local wait = true

		local kid_group = {
			self.npc:teatan_kid(),
			self.npc:human_kid(),
			self.npc:innuit_kid(),
			self.npc:teatan_hero(),
		}
		-- 3인방 + 마리안 전원 down, smile, cast2로 전환.
		scene_util.set_group_direction(kid_group, 'down', false)

			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.25), bubble_direction = 'none', type_speed = 0, life_time = 1 })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레이첼, 마리안, 티탄/인간/이누이트 꼬마 동시에 (up, idle, idle) 로 전환.
	do

	-- (여)레나(down, sleep_deep, cast) : 그럼… 새로운 서기장으로서.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },

			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_48', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나(down, smile, cast) : 새로운 기록을 시작할 하늘의 별자리를 그리겠습니다.

	--(여)레이첼(up, idle, cast 말풍선 크기 0.7배) : 정말… 할 수 있는거겠지?

	do

		scene_util.set_group_direction(group, 'up', false)

function local_class:mini_game_scene()
	local star_girl = self.dynamic_npc:get('star_girl')
	local pirate = self.npc:pirate()

	self.current_state = self.states.start_mini_game

	--별자리 액티비티
	do
		local default_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s13_award_default_pos')
		local camera_offset = vector(0, 0, 24.5)
		local constellation_offset = vector(0, 0, -1.5)

		self.constellation:load(default_pos + camera_offset + constellation_offset)

		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(7, 7)
		camera_util.move_async(default_pos + camera_offset, 7, { ignorecameragrids = true })

		local first_star = self.constellation.data[1].star
		local star_pos = first_star.position

		self.tutorialSpineObj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("tutorial_spine"):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero);
		local ui_root = stage.UIRoot
		local active_width = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.width * ui_root.activeHeight / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
		local pos = CS.ViewportScaler.Instance:WorldToViewportPoint(star_pos)
		local cam_pos = (pos - vector(0.5, 0.5, 0)) * 2

		local tutorialSpineWidget = self.tutorialSpineObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIWidget))

		tutorialSpineWidget.transform.parent = ui_root.transform
		tutorialSpineWidget.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero

		tutorialSpineWidget:SetAnchor(ui_root.transform)

		local x = cam_pos.x * active_width / 2
		local y = cam_pos.y * ui_root.activeHeight / 2
		local isRtl = game_string.IsRTL

		tutorialSpineWidget.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		tutorialSpineWidget.leftAnchor.relative = 0.5
		tutorialSpineWidget.rightAnchor.relative = 0.5
		tutorialSpineWidget.leftAnchor.absolute = isRtl and -math.floor(x) or math.floor(x)
		tutorialSpineWidget.rightAnchor.absolute = isRtl and -math.floor(x) or math.floor(x)

		tutorialSpineWidget.topAnchor.relative = 0.5
		tutorialSpineWidget.bottomAnchor.relative = 0.5
		tutorialSpineWidget.topAnchor.absolute = math.floor(y)
		tutorialSpineWidget.bottomAnchor.absolute = math.floor(y)

		tutorialSpineWidget:UpdateAnchors()

		local tutorialSpine = self.tutorialSpineObj:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))

		tutorialSpine.state:SetAnimation(1, 'tap', true)
		tutorialSpine.timeScale = 1
		tutorialSpine.skeleton.A = 1
		tutorialSpine.state:Update(0.0001)
		tutorialSpine.useUnscaledTime = false

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

		while self.constellation.current_state ~= self.constellation_state.done do
			self.constellation:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end

	--별자리 잇기 미니게임 클리어 이후, 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 카메라 아래로 패닝되며 화면 전환되어 레이첼과 레나에게로 돌아온다.
	do
		local duration = 7

		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, duration)
		camera_util.move_async(star_girl.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), duration)
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'down', true)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'smile')

	-- (여)레나(down, sleep_deep ,cast) : 새로운 별자리…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_51', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나(down, smile, bomb_idle) : 장미 자리입니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_52', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_03', loop = true, duration = 5, fade_out_time = 5 })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 5 })

	-- 동시에 화면 5초간 검게 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out(5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	start_coroutine(function()
		local duration = 1
		-- 동시에 아래 말풍선들은 1초 간격으로 하나씩 실행.

		-- 좌상단 shout 말풍선, 스킵 불가 : 우와아아아!!
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(star_girl, 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_52_1', false,
				{ viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.75), bubble_direction = 'none', type_speed = 0, life_time = duration })

		-- 중앙 shout 말풍선, 스킵 불가 : 정말 예쁜 별자리야!
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(star_girl, 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_52_2', false,
				{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5), bubble_direction = 'none', type_speed = 0, life_time = duration })

		-- 우하단 shout 말풍선, 스킵 불가 : 최고의 선장 만세!!
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(star_girl, 'ss_milkyway_main_s13_52_3', false,
				{ viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.75), bubble_direction = 'none', type_speed = 0, life_time = duration })
	end)

	-- 카메라 포커스 5초간 위로 3칸 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 3), 5)
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMilkywayMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMilkywayMain @
		Comment = 선원 모집을 위해 첫 선술집 방문 이벤트 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryMilkywayMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_milkyway'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		in_pub = 2,
		show_trio_event = 3,
		interact_sailor = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.get_pub_inner = function()
		return get_field_object('pub_day_inner_1')
	end

	self.npc_list = {
		teatan_hero = function()
			return get_character('teatan_hero')
		end,
		star_girl = function()
			return get_character('star_girl')
		end,
		nanny = function()
			return get_character('librarian_nanny')
		end,
		trio_boss = function()
			return get_character('trio_boss')
		end,
		trio_man = function()
			return get_character('trio_man')
		end,
		trio_man_beard = function()
			return get_character('trio_man_beard')
		end,
		trio_panda = function()
			return get_character('trio_panda')
		end,
		interact_sailor = function(index)
			return get_character('s2_interact_sailor_' .. index)
		end,
		oneline_npc = function(index)
			return get_character('s2_npc_' .. index)
		end,
		bartender = function()
			return get_character('bartender')
		end,
	}

	self.online_npc_count = 7
	self.sailor_count = 2

	self.fx = {
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.restaurant_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	do
		-- 레나
		local star_girl = self.npc_list.star_girl()

		star_girl.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_star_girl_pos_1')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(star_girl)
		scene_util.set_direction(star_girl, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(star_girl, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(star_girl, self, 'cast')

		field_object_util.set_active_state(star_girl, active_state_type.enabled)
	end

	do
		-- 매드 팬더단
		local trio = { self.npc_list.trio_boss(), self.npc_list.trio_panda(), self.npc_list.trio_man() }

		for i = 1, #trio do
			local npc = trio[i]

			local marker = field_util.get_marker('s2_mad_panda_pos_' .. i)

			npc.Position = marker.position
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(trio[3], self, 'doyagao')
	end

	do
		-- 마리안 / 사회자 세팅
		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			-- (여)마리안(left, attack, bomb_idle) : 너희도 탈락이야. 얼른 가 봐.
			local teatan_hero = self.npc_list.teatan_hero()
			character_util.hide_weapon(teatan_hero, true)
			teatan_hero.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_teatan_hero_pos')
			scene_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, self, { name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })
			teatan_hero.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_milkyway_main_s1_oneline_7'
			field_object_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero, active_state_type.enabled)

			get_character('teatan_hero_engine').Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('teatan_hero_engine_point_1')
		end
	end

	-- 선술집 입구 PublishInteractable로 변경
	local pub_inner = self.get_pub_inner()
	pub_inner.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'day_field', target = self.get_pub_inner() },
		{ zone = 'night_field', target = get_field_object('pub_night_inner_1') },
		{ zone = 'tavern_field', target = self.npc_list.interact_sailor(2) },
		{ zone = 'room_a_field', target = get_field_object('room_a_outer_1') },
		{ zone = 'room_b_field', target = get_field_object('room_b_outer_1') },
		{ zone = 'room_c_field', target = get_field_object('room_c_outer_1') }
	})

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent), 'on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	do
		self.group = self.controller.event_controller:get_group('up_to_section_2_pub_npc')

		-- 영입해볼 선원 add_listener
		for i = 1, self.sailor_count do
			local handler = self.group:get_handler('s2_interact_sailor_' .. i)
			local sailor = handler:get_npc()
			character_util.add_listener(sailor, self.controller)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent))

	for i = 1, self.sailor_count do
		local sailor = self.npc_list.interact_sailor(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(sailor, self.controller)
	end

	self:stop_restaurant_sfx()

	self.online_npc_count = nil
	self.sailor_count = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		local pub_inner = self.get_pub_inner()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pub_inner) then
			start_coroutine(self.enter_pub_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state <= self.states.show_trio_event then
		for i = 1, self.sailor_count do
			local handler = self.group:get_handler('s2_interact_sailor_' .. i)
			local sailor = handler:get_npc()

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sailor) then
				self.current_state = self.states.interact_sailor
				sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_sailor_scene, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.show_trio_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_mad_panda_auto_1') then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_trio_event
		start_coroutine(self.auto_mad_panda_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event(e)
	self:stop_restaurant_sfx()

	if self.current_state ~= self.states.in_pub
			and self.current_state ~= self.states.show_trio_event then
		return false
	end

	if e.CameraGrid == nil then
		return false
	end

	if e.CameraGrid.name == 'in_grid' then
		self:play_restaurant_sfx()
		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:enter_pub_scene()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local pirate = self.controller.get_pirate()
	local pirate_crew = self.controller.get_pirate_crew()

	self:reset_pub_inner()

	quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	local fade_duration = 0.6

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(fade_duration, 'linear')

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	-- 선술집 들어가는 exit에 인터랙트 하면 기존 exit처럼 서큘러 페이드 아웃된 후, 서큘러 페이드 인 될 때부터 이벤트 진행.
	-- 페이드 인/아웃 시간 값도 기존
	local inner_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('pub_inner_1')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pirate)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'up', false)
	character_util.set_position(pirate, inner_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))

	local pos_list = {
		inner_pos - vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		inner_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1),
		inner_pos - vector(0.5, 0, 1),
	}

	for i = 1, #pirate_crew do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pirate_crew[i])
		scene_util.set_emotion(pirate_crew[i], self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_direction(pirate_crew[i], 'up', false)
		pirate_crew[i].Position = pos_list[i]
	end

	-- 카메라 4초간 2번 마름모로 이동.
	local camera_pos = inner_pos + vector(0, 0, 13)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:play_restaurant_sfx()
	self.current_state = self.states.in_pub

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(fade_duration, 'linear')

	local move_end_key = 'move_end'
	camera_pos = camera_pos - vector(0, 0, 8)
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				camera_util.move_async, camera_pos, 4
			},
			function()
				-- 카메라 이동 시작하고 2초 뒤, 레이첼 일행 위 경로 따라 속도 2.5로 이동.
				wait_for_sec(2)

				-- 도착하면 티꼬, 인꼬는 left, smile, idle
				-- 도착하면 레이첼, 이꼬는 right, smile, idle
				for i = 1, #pirate_crew do
					pirate_crew[i].Position = pos_list[i]
					wp_util.move_with_end_callback(pirate_crew[i],
							pirate_crew[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 5),
							2.5, nil, self, move_end_key, {
								last_direction = i == 2 and 'right' or 'left'
							})
				end

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(pirate, pirate.Position + vector(0, 0, 5),
						2.5, nil, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			end
	)

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
			{ name = 'ondemand/short_story_milkyway/audio:bgm_milkyway_cafe', state = 'field' })

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 카메라 사이즈 4로 1초간 복귀.
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(1)

	self.restaurant_sfx:ChangeVolume(0.3, 5)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6, mix = 6 })

	-- (여)레이첼(right, awesome, sing) : 오오! 진짜 수상카페잖아!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, nil, 'sing',
			'awesome', 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_1')

	-- 티꼬, 인꼬 right, smile, idle로 전환.
	-- 이꼬는 left, smile, idle로 전환.
	for i = 1, #pirate_crew do
		scene_util.set_direction(pirate_crew[i], i == 2 and 'left' or 'right', false)
	end

	-- (여)레이첼(left, tired, cast) : 마리안은 영입하지 못 했지만…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false }, 'cast',
			'tired', 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_2')

	-- (여)레이첼(left, smile, bomb_idle) : 좋은 선원을 데려 오면 뭐, 수리공이야 어떻게든 되지 않겠어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, nil, 'bomb_idle',
			'smile', 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_3')

	-- (여)티꼬(티탄꼬마)(right, smile, nod 2회) : 멋진 선원이 오면 마리안 누나도 들어오고 싶다고 할 지도 몰라!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate_crew[1], self, nil, 'nod',
			'smile', 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_4')

	-- 레이첼 일행 4인 모두(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(pirate_crew, 'up', false)

	-- (남)인꼬(인간 꼬마)(right, attack, release 2회) : 선장, 저기 저 사람들은 어때?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate_crew[3], self, nil, { name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil, 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_5')

	-- (남)이꼬(이누이트 꼬마)(left, idle, idle) : 맞아. 되게 힘이 세 보이는데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate_crew[2], self, nil, nil,
			nil, 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_6')

	-- 카메라 포커스 1초간 선2에게로 이동.
	local handler = self.group:get_handler('s2_interact_sailor_2')
	local sailor = handler:get_npc()
	camera_util.move_async(sailor.Position, 1)

	scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(pirate_crew, self, 'smile')

	-- 도착하면 레이첼, 이꼬는 right, smile, idle
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ pirate, pirate_crew[2] }, 'left', false)

	-- 도착하면 티꼬, 인꼬는 left, smile, idle
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ pirate_crew[1], pirate_crew[3] }, 'right', false)

	-- 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카메라 포커스 1초간 2번 연두색 마름모로 이동.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- (여)레이첼(left, attack, nod 1회) : 좋아. 가 보자고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			'attack', 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_7')

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	-- 컨트롤 돌려준다.
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'day_field', target = self.get_pub_inner() },
		{ zone = 'night_field', target = get_field_object('pub_night_inner_1') },
		{ zone = 'tavern_field', target = sailor.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1) },
		{ zone = 'room_a_field', target = get_field_object('room_a_outer_1') },
		{ zone = 'room_b_field', target = get_field_object('room_b_outer_1') },
		{ zone = 'room_c_field', target = get_field_object('room_c_outer_1') }
	})

	start_coroutine(self.auto_star_girl_event, self)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:auto_star_girl_event()
	-- 선술진 진입 이벤트 끝나면 그 즉시 아래 이벤트 진행.
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local star_girl = self.npc_list.star_girl()

	local handler = self.group:get_handler('s2_npc_8')
	local sailor = handler:get_npc()

	-- (남)선원(right, idle, idle): 그래, 널 팀원으로 넣어달라고?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(sailor, 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_8', false)

	-- (남)선원(right, idle, idle)
	if self.current_state >= self.states.interact_sailor then
		return

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(star_girl, 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_9', false)

	-- (여)레나(left, tired, idle)

		return

	character_util.remove_anim(star_girl)
	scene_util.set_emotion(star_girl, self, 'tired')

	-- (남)선원(right, attack, idle)
	if self.current_state >= self.states.interact_sailor then
		return
	end

	-- (여)레나(left, tired, cast): 제가 원채 운동부족이라….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self, nil, 'cast',
			nil, { key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_12_3', skip = false })

		return

	music_player_util.play_sfx({

	if self.current_state >= self.states.interact_sailor then

	-- (남)선원(left, attack, idle): 안 돼. 안 바꿔줘. 바꿀 생각 없어. 빨리 돌아가!

function local_class:interact_sailor_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local pirate = self.controller.get_pirate()
	local pirate_crew = self.controller.get_pirate_crew()
	local trio = {
		boss = self.npc_list.trio_boss(),
		panda = self.npc_list.trio_panda(),
		man = self.npc_list.trio_man(),
	}
	local star_girl = self.npc_list.star_girl()
	local nanny = self.npc_list.nanny()

	local sailor = {
		self.group:get_handler('s2_interact_sailor_1'):get_npc(),
		self.group:get_handler('s2_interact_sailor_2'):get_npc()
	}

	for i = 1, #sailor do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(sailor[i], self.controller)
	end

	-- 헐크 선원 둘 중 누구에게 인터랙트 하든 이벤트 진행.

	-- 1초간 위 위치로 레이첼 일행 정렬.
	local align_pos_list = {
		sailor[2].Position + vector(2, 0, -1),
		sailor[2].Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
		sailor[2].Position + vector(3, 0, -1),
	}

	wp_util.move(pirate, sailor[2].Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

	for i = 1, #pirate_crew do
		wp_util.move(pirate_crew[i], align_pos_list[i], nil,
				1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	-- 동시에 카메라 포커스도 1초간 선2와 레이첼의 중간 지점으로 이동.
	local camera_pos = sailor[2].Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	-- 레이첼 선택지
	-- 그냥 말을 건다.(Mercy)
	-- 호의를 표현한다.(Intellect)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_16', 'mercy' }, { 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_17', 'intellect' } })

	-- 그냥 말을 건다.(Mercy)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 그냥 말을 건다.(Mercy)

		-- (여)레이첼(left, smile, sing, jump 1회) : 거기, 멋있는 선원 분들!
		character_util.normal_jump(pirate, '01_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, nil, 'sing',
				'smile', 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_18')
	else
		-- 호의를 표현한다.(Intellect)

		-- (여)레이첼(left, smile, release 2회) : 바텐더, 저기 멋진 선원 둘에게 탄산보리차 한 잔씩 줘!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, nil, { name = 'release', count = 2 },
				'smile', 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_19')

		-- (여)레이첼(left, doyagao, bomb_idle) : 돈은 나중에 우승하면 줄게.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, nil, 'bomb_idle',
				'doyagao', 'ss_milkyway_main_s2_20')

		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos + vector(0, 0, 3), 0.5)

		-- 바텐더 down, tired, idle, silence 이모티콘.
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(self.npc_list.bartender(), self,
				nil, nil, 'tired', 'silence')

		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.5)

	-- 동시에 1초간 위 위치로 일행들 정렬.

			npc.Position + vector(3.5, 0, -2)

	scene_util.set_anim(innuit_kid_boy, self, 'dagger_idle')

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMilkywayMainSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMilkywayMain @
		Comment = @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryMilkywayMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	--self.available_stage_names = {}
	self.get_bartender = function()
		return get_character('bartender')
	end

	self.get_interact_chair = function()
		return get_field_object('s4_interact_chair')
	end

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		sub_quest_clear = 2,
		minigame_start = 3,
		done = 4,
	}

	self.minigame_data = {
		slang_prefix = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_slang_',
		max_slang_number = 18,
		is_time_out = false,
		is_unique_turn = false,
	}

	self.quest_marker_data = {
		quest_name = 'main_quest',
		quest_field = 'night_field',

		before_bar = {
			'merchant_quest',
			'concert_quest',
		},

		pos = {
			vector(-34.15, 1.5, -83.25),
			vector(-28, 0, -103),
		},

		is_clear = {
			false,
			false,
		},

		bar_quest = 'bar_quest'
	}

	self.foods = {}

	self.npcs = {}
	self.named_npcs = {}
	self.add_listener_npcs = {
		npcs = {},

		add = function(this, fo)
			character_util.add_listener(fo, self.controller)

			table.insert(this.npcs, fo)
		end,

		remove_npcs = function(this)
			if not table_util.is_empty(this.npcs) then
				for index = 1, #this.npcs do
					character_util.remove_relate_event(this.npcs[index], self.controller)
				end
			end

			this.npcs = nil
		end
	}

	self.is_talk_market = false

	self.is_talk_half_vampire = false

	self.is_first_in_block_zone = true

	self.bgm_data = {
		current_zone_name = nil,
		changed_zone_name = nil,
		active_concert_bgm = false,
		has_new_bgm_change_request = false,
		default_clip_name = nil,
		vampire_concert_zone_name = 'main_s4_concert_zone',
		cafe_environmental_sfx = nil,
		cafe_zone_name = 'tavern_field'
	}

	self.bgm_constants = {
		main_s4_concert_zone = 'ondemand/short_story_milkyway/audio:bgm_milkyway_idol',
		tavern_field = 'ondemand/short_story_milkyway/audio:bgm_milkyway_cafe',
		night_field = 'ondemand/short_story_milkyway/audio:bgm_milkyway_night'
	}

	self.nowhere = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.merchant = nil

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.half_vampire_oneline = {
		get_character = function()
			return get_character('half_vampire')
		end,

		sfx_holder = nil,

		current_req_id = 0,
		is_valid_id = function(this, req_id)
			return req_id == this.current_req_id
		end,

		progress_id = function(this)
			this.current_req_id = this.current_req_id + 1

			return this.current_req_id
		end,

		play_sfx = function(this)
			if this.sfx_holder ~= nil then
				return
			end

			this.sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_eat_01',
				loop = true,
				parent = this.get_character(),
				type_priority = 'loop',
				player_priority = 'npc'
			})
		end,

		stop_sfx = function(this)
			if this.sfx_holder ~= nil then
				music_player_util.stop_sfx(this.sfx_holder)

				this.sfx_holder = nil
			end
		end,

		execute = function(this)
			local req_id = this:progress_id()

			start_coroutine(this.speech_routine, this, req_id)
		end,

		speech_routine = function(this, req_id)
			local npc = this.get_character()
			local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

			-- 기존 루틴 탈출시킴
			if bubble ~= nil then
				bubble:ResetBubble()
			end

			this:play_sfx()

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(this.get_character(), 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_oneline_1')

			if this:is_valid_id(req_id) then
				this:stop_sfx()
			end
		end
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	do
		--마리안 boat 세팅

		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_night_repair_boat_pos') + vector(1.5, 0, 0)

		local teatan_hero = get_character('teatan_hero')

		field_object_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(teatan_hero, pos)

		--마리안 이미지의 위치에 세팅
		--(여)마리안(right, attack, eat) : 아직 배가 완벽한 상태가 아니야.
		scene_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, self, { name = 'eat', one_shot_sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, self, 'attack')

		teatan_hero.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_oneline_2_1'

		table.insert(self.named_npcs, teatan_hero)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	self:field_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.half_vampire_oneline:stop_sfx()

	if not table_util.is_empty(self.foods) then
		for index = 1, #self.foods do
			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.foods[index])
		end
	end

	if not table_util.is_empty(self.npcs) then
		for index = 1, #self.npcs do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npcs[index])

			self.npcs[index].Interactable.Talk = ''

			character_util.set_position(self.npcs[index], self.nowhere)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.npcs[index], active_state_type.disabled)
		end
	end

	if not table_util.is_empty(self.named_npcs) then
		for index = 1, #self.named_npcs do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.named_npcs[index])

			self.named_npcs[index].Interactable.Talk = ''

			character_util.set_position(self.named_npcs[index], self.nowhere)

			self.named_npcs[index].SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
		end
	end

	self.add_listener_npcs:remove_npcs()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.quest_marker_data.is_clear[1] and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.merchant) then

		self.quest_marker_data.is_clear[1] = true

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_data.quest_name, self.quest_marker_data.before_bar[1])

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_merchant_scene, self)
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.sub_quest_clear and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_interact_chair()) then

		self.current_state = self.states.minigame_start

		self.get_interact_chair().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_data.quest_name, self.quest_marker_data.bar_quest)

		do
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			start_coroutine(self.before_slang_fight_scene, self)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('half_vampire')) then
		self.half_vampire_oneline:execute()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.quest_marker_data.is_clear[2] and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's6_concert_hall_event') then

		self.quest_marker_data.is_clear[2] = true

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_data.quest_name, self.quest_marker_data.before_bar[2])

		sp_util.start_scene(self.looked_vampire_scene, self)

	elseif not self.is_talk_market and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_market_zone') then

		self.is_talk_market = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			--트리거 존 안에 들어가면 비강제 이벤트 출력
			--(남)상인 (down, idle, idle) : 없는 음식 빼고 다 있습니다! 야식 드시고 가세요!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.merchant, 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_market_1', false)

			self.is_talk_market = false
		end)

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s4_block_zone') then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.block_zone_event, self)

	elseif self.active_concert_bgm
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.bgm_data.vampire_concert_zone_name) then

		local is_not_same_zone = self.bgm_data.current_zone_name ~= e.Zone.Name
		local is_new_request = not self.bgm_data.has_new_bgm_change_request
		self.bgm_data.current_zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		if is_new_request and is_not_same_zone then
			self.bgm_data.has_new_bgm_change_request = true
			start_coroutine(self.change_stage_bgm_clip, self, self.bgm_data.current_zone_name)
		end

	elseif not self.bgm_data.has_new_bgm_change_request and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.bgm_data.cafe_zone_name) then

		--		--수상카페 화면 페이드인에 환경음 볼륨 0.3으로 재생, 믹스 디폴트값
		if self.bgm_data.cafe_environmental_sfx == nil then
			self.bgm_data.cafe_environmental_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_restaurant_01', loop = true,
																				volume = 0.3, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.active_concert_bgm and not self.bgm_data.has_new_bgm_change_request
			and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.bgm_data.vampire_concert_zone_name) then

		local zone_name = 'night_field'

		local is_not_same_zone = self.bgm_data.current_zone_name ~= zone_name
		local is_new_request = not self.bgm_data.has_new_bgm_change_request
		self.bgm_data.current_zone_name = zone_name

		if is_new_request and is_not_same_zone then
			self.bgm_data.has_new_bgm_change_request = true
			start_coroutine(self.change_stage_bgm_clip, self, zone_name)
		end
	elseif not self.bgm_data.has_new_bgm_change_request and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.bgm_data.cafe_zone_name) then
		self.bgm_data.cafe_environmental_sfx:Stop()
		self.bgm_data.cafe_environmental_sfx = nil
	end
end

			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_7', skip = true })

			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			nil,
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(pirate, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
			end

	-- (여)레이첼 (up, idle, release) : 여기 주문이요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_8', skip = true })

	-- 플레이어와 레이첼의 위치는 아래쪽 벤치로 이동.
	do
		local star_girl_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_star_girl_eat_pos')
		local pirate_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_pirate_eat_pos')

		character_util.set_position(star_girl, star_girl_pos)
		character_util.set_position(pirate, pirate_pos)

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(star_girl, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(pirate, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

		-- 레나 ■타일에서 (right, greed, eat) 지속중 , 레이첼은 ■타일에서 (left, damaged, seat).
		scene_util.set_emotion(star_girl, self, 'greed')
		scene_util.set_anim(star_girl, self, { name = 'eat' })

		scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'greed')
		scene_util.set_anim(pirate, self, { name = 'eat' })
	end

	-- 둘 사이 벤치 위에 다음의 아이템들이 차례로 배치되어 있음.
	local items = {}

	-- gravoid_sandwich
	-- aw_pizza_3
	-- cocktail_fail_3
	-- baked_potato
	-- chicken_basket
	local item_data_table = {
		sandwich_id = 21301,
		sandwich_offset = vector(-0.25, 0, 0.5),

		pizza_id = 21302,
		pizza_offset = vector(0.25, 0, 0.5),

		cocktail_id = 21303,
		cocktail_offset = vector(0, 0.25, 0),

		potato_id = 21304,
		potato_offset = vector(0.25, 0, -0.5),

		chicken_basket_id = 21305,
		chicken_basket_offset = vector(-0.25, 0, -0.5),
	}

	do
		local control_point = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_restaurant_food_2')

		local function create_item_in_table(id, pos, pos_offset, array, scale)
			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos + pos_offset,
				item_id = id,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = true,
				skip_item_text = true,
				spr_scale = scale
			})

			table.insert(array, item)
		end

		create_item_in_table(item_data_table.sandwich_id, control_point, item_data_table.sandwich_offset, items, 0.7)
		create_item_in_table(item_data_table.pizza_id, control_point, item_data_table.pizza_offset, items, 0.5)
		create_item_in_table(item_data_table.cocktail_id, control_point, item_data_table.cocktail_offset, items, 0.4)
		create_item_in_table(item_data_table.potato_id, control_point, item_data_table.potato_offset, items, 0.7)
		create_item_in_table(item_data_table.chicken_basket_id, control_point, item_data_table.chicken_basket_offset, items, 0.7)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--(여)레이첼 캐릭터 (left, damaged, seat) 전환하며  shake (0.01,0.3)
	do
		local duration = 0.3

		scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(pirate, self, 'seat')
		scene_util.shake(pirate, 0.01, duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'damaged' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_9', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나 (right, smile, seat) :  진짜 맛있다! 책에서봤던 것들하고는 묘하게 달라…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_10', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나 (right, smile, release 2회) :  이 햄버거는 채식주의자도 먹을 수 있게 식물성 패티를 사용했구나!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = star_girl },
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_11', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나 (right, smile, cast) :  그리고 이 콜라는… 설탕이 전혀 첨가되지 않은 제로콜라였어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2, upper = true },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_12', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나 (right, greed, eat) 3초 진행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(star_girl, self, 'greed')
	scene_util.set_anim(star_girl, self, 'eat')

	-- eat 자세 진행한지 1초가 되었을 때부터 벤치 위의 아이템들이 0.5초 텀으로 플레이어한테 흡수됨.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		for index = 1, #items do
			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(items[index], star_girl)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(star_girl, true)

	-- (여)레나 (right, awesome, seat) : 잘 먹었습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'awesome' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_13', skip = true })

	-- (여)레이첼 (left, smile, seat) : 하핫…! 레나한테 이런 대식가 기질이 있었을 줄이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_14', skip = true })

	--플레이어와 레이첼이 0.3초에 걸쳐 (이동 방향,idle,idle) 자세로 0.5타일 옆으로  jump.
	--의자에서 내려온 후 1초에 걸쳐 위와 같은 동선으로 이동후 아래와 같이 정렬.
	--플레이어 (right,idle,idle)
	--레이첼 (left,idle,idle)
	do
		local duration = 0.3
		local move_offset_data = {
			vector(-1, -0.5, 0), vector(1, -0.5, 0)
		}
		local function party_forward_jump(fo, pos, dur)

			scene_util.set_direction(fo, direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(character_util.get_look_direction(fo)), '01_small_jump_01')

			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'get')
			character_util.jump(fo, 1, 0.3)

			wp_util.move(fo, pos, nil, dur)
		end

		party_forward_jump(star_girl, star_girl.Position + move_offset_data[1], duration)
		party_forward_jump(pirate, pirate.Position + move_offset_data[2], duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(star_girl)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pirate)

		local move_pos_data = {
			vector(1, 0, -1.5), vector(-1, 0, -1.5)
		}
		local npc_data = {
			star_girl, pirate
		}
		local align_key = 'move_align'

		for index = 1, #npc_data do
			local fo = npc_data[index]
			local pos = fo.Position + move_pos_data[index]
			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(fo, pos, false)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fo, waypoints, 3, nil, self, align_key)
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

		character_util.reset_locked_dir(star_girl)
		character_util.reset_locked_dir(pirate)

		scene_util.set_direction(star_girl, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'left', false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:check_end_event()
	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
end

function local_class:looked_vampire_scene()

	local pirate = self.controller.get_pirate()
	local kids = self.controller.get_pirate_crew()

	-- 플레이어 강제 트리거 존 진입 시, 1초에 걸쳐 플레이어(레나)는 ■타일로 left 방향 , 레이첼은 ■타일로 left 방향 정렬.
	do
		local star_girl_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_concert_pos_2')
		local pirate_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_concert_pos_1')

		local move_key = 'align'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(pirate, pirate_pos, nil, 1, self, move_key)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(star_girl, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(pirate, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	end

	-- (여)레나 (left, smile, release 2회)
	scene_util.play_custom_action(
			star_girl,
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			'smile',
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(star_girl, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
			end
	)

	-- 티탄 꼬마, 인간 꼬마, 이누이트 꼬마 동시에 right 방향 전환하며 jump 1회.
	do
		for index = 1, #kids do
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(kids[index], { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
			character_util.normal_jump(kids[index], '01_small_jump_01')
		end
	end

	-- 이누이트꼬마  (right, smile, idle) : 선장하고 신참 왔구나!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kids[2], self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_15', skip = true })

	-- 인간 꼬마  (right, smile, idle) : 안 그래도 이제 막 공연 시작하려던 참이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kids[3], self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_16', skip = true })

	-- 티탄 꼬마  (right, smile, release) : 빨리 앉아서 같이 듣자!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kids[1], self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_17', skip = true })

	-- (여)레이첼 (left, smile, nod 2회) : 잘했어, 꼬맹이들! 아주 훌륭해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_18', skip = true })

	-- 2초에 걸쳐 티탄꼬마, 인간꼬마, 이누이트꼬마, 플레이어(레나), 레이첼 NPC가 동시에 walk 자세로 상단의 이미지 지점으로 정렬.
	do
		local move_key = 'align'

		local kids_move_data = {
			vector(-2, 0, 0),
			vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
			vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
		}

		local party_move_data = {
			vector(-1, 0, 0),
			vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		}

		for index = 1, #kids do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
					kids[index],
					kids[index].Position + kids_move_data[index],
					nil,
					2,
					self,
					move_key
			)
		end

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(star_girl,
				star_girl.Position + party_move_data[1],
				nil,
				2,
				self,
				move_key
		)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(pirate,
				pirate.Position + party_move_data[2],
				nil,
				2,
				self,
				move_key
		)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

		-- 이후 정렬이 끝나면 모두 up 방향으로 전환.
		for index = 1, #kids do
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(kids[index], { dir = 'up', sfx = false })
		end

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(star_girl, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(pirate, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 7 })

	-- 0.5초 대기.

	--세실 기타 꺼낼 때
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_idol_guitar_01')

	-- 세실 (down, idle, sing) 자세로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(vampire, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(vampire, self, { name = 'sing' })

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 세실 (down, idle, sing) : 많은 분들께서 와주셨네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'sing' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_19', skip = true })

function local_class:before_slang_fight_scene()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local star_girl = self.controller.get_star_girl()
	local pirate = self.controller.get_pirate()
	local bartender = self.get_bartender()
	local trio = self.controller.get_trio()

	-- 플레이어가 왼쪽에서 4번째 의자 인터렉트 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.

	-- 레나, 레이첼 left 방향, seat 자세로 전환.
	do
		local duration = 0.5

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
		self:jump_move(star_girl, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_star_girl_chair_pos'), 'right', duration)
		self:jump_move(pirate, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_pirate_chair_pos'), 'right', duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration + 0.1)

		scene_util.set_direction(star_girl, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'left', false)

		scene_util.set_anim(star_girl, self, 'seat')
		scene_util.set_anim(pirate, self, 'seat')
	end

	-- 선술집 주인 (right, smile, idle) : 어서 와요! 꽤 보고 싶었다고요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bartender, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_39', skip = true })

	-- 선술집 주인 (right, smile, idle) : 오늘 밤은 바쁘지만 여러분이 낄 자리는 얼마든지 있죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bartender, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_40', skip = true })

	-- (여)레이첼 (left, smile, seat) : 주인장! 여기 탄산보리차 2잔으로 부탁해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_41', skip = true })

	-- 선술집 주인 nod 1회 이후 (right, smile, eat 자세 1.5초)
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
	scene_util.play_wait_action(bartender, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'eat' },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			1.5)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()

	--선술집 주인이 손에shield_beer_full 아이템을 듦.
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(bartender, '[[base]weapon1', 'shield_beer_full')

	--선술집 주인, 1초에 걸쳐 1.5 타일 우측으로 이동 후 (down,smile,idle) 자세
	do
		local items = {}
		local beer_full_id = 21311

		local function serving_beer()
			scene_util.set_direction(bartender, 'down', false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = bartender.Position,
				item_id = beer_full_id,
				drop_type = quest_drop_item_drop_type.move,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = true,
				skip_item_text = true,
				spr_scale = 1
			})

			table.insert(items, item)

			local serving_end_pos = bartender.Position + vector(0, 1, -1)
			local serving_start_pos = bartender.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_pancakehouse_01')

			scene_util.show_serving_async(bartender, item, 0.5, {
				start_pos = serving_start_pos, end_pos = serving_end_pos
			})
		end

		do
			local pos = bartender.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0.25)
			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(bartender, pos, false)

			wp_util.move_async(bartender, waypoints, 4, nil)

			serving_beer()
		end

		--선술집 주인 다시 1초에 걸쳐 0.5타일 위로 뒷걸음질 후 1초에 걸쳐 2타일 우측으로 이동해 맥주 올려놓는 것 반복.
		do

			local pos = bartender.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)

			wp_util.move_async(bartender, pos, 4, nil)

			serving_beer()

			character_util.spine_remove_attachment(bartender, '[base]weapon1')
		end

		local party = {
			pirate, star_girl
		}

		for index = 1, #items do
			quest_drop_item_util.consumed(items[index], party[index])
		end

		--이후 shield_beer_full 아이템이 각각 레나와 레이첼 캐릭터한테 흡수됨.
		--동시에 선술집 주인 다시 1초에 걸쳐 3.5타일 좌측으로 이동
		local return_pos = bartender.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, -0.25)
		local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(bartender, return_pos, true)

		wp_util.move(bartender, waypoints, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
	end

	--1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 2로 줌인.
	--동시에 1초에 걸쳐 카메라 1타일 우측으로 이동

		local pos = pirate.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
		local duration = 1

		camera_util.move(pos, duration)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2, duration)
	end

	-- 레이첼 right 방향 전환.

	-- (여)레나 (left, smile, seat) : 이게… 책에서 봤던 그 탄산 보리차 라는거구나!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'seat' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_42', skip = true })

	-- (여)레나 (left, smile, seat) : 꼭 한번 마셔보고 싶었어…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(star_girl, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'ss_milkyway_main_s4_43', skip = true })
